regions.name: The Asagiri Isles
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-60 · Danger: Deadly]

The Asagiri Isles are a crescent of mountains and rice plains under a morning mist, with a volcanic isle to the south and an ice isle to the north. A puppet emperor reigns in Miyako and a regent rules in his name; samurai houses hold the plains, two hidden shinobi villages sell their blades from the cedar mountains, and on the northwest cliffs the Veil Court's gate takes in the dead. Yokai courts keep the deep woods, onmyoji ward the cities, breath hunters keep the night out of the north, and curse-bearers walk the ash of an old war. Every art in the isles draws on one current, the Soul: shinobi shape it with seals, samurai forge it into blades, Veil Officers are made of it, yokai are its wild overflow. No one rules all of it, and the post road runs between them all.

regions.name: The Asagiri Isles, After the War
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 20-60 · Danger: Deadly]

The Asagiri Isles after the Succession War: a hollow Regent's peace. The Regent won the field and lost the realm: the emperor is dead with no heir, Miyako half-burned and ruled on Saikai's debt, the Fifty Stations Road cut by Straw Mask barricades, Hinode's valleys held by the demon court, Kagegi and Hayate still at war, the Sealing Vaults cracked.

regions.name: The Otherworld
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 10-40 · Danger: Severe]

One country behind the isles' oldest gates, five faces around a trampled yard: The Training Ground: The trampled yard at the Otherworld's heart, where the five quarters meet: lodges for eight masters, a mess, a bunk hall and the ring of gate posts that lead home. A party that stays together trains here while any one of them explores. The Far Shore: The dead's side of the Weeping Torii: a grey tide that never turns, ferry stones, the Veil Court's true seat and a drowned causeway where what the ferrymen could not carry waits. The Hidden Court: The yokai country behind the kodama grove and the fox road: lanterns in old trees, a walk where the masked promenade, a court with its own law, and a hollow tree that goes down further than it should. The Five Sanctums: Five nature worlds in one quarter, one for each Element: stone, water, fire, wind and the void between, each kept by what the Element made, each a sanctum and a trial. Sun Peak: The breath ascetics' mountain, where the air thins until the lungs change: steps, a boulder every hunter has tried to cut, and a dark side where demons test what the breath is worth. The Hundred Blades: The sword saints' terraces, a hundred of them climbing a cliff, a whetstone that remembers every blade, and a hundredth terrace where the saint waits.

Tomoshibi Isle, the lamplight isle, lies a morning's row west of Saikai: a curled leaf of cliff, pine and terrace with a dead lighthouse on its northern rock. The keeper's family left thirty years ago, after the night the lamp went dark and three ships went down beneath it. Saikai calls it unlucky. A widow on the harbour post holds the deed.

npcs.name: Abandoned Koto
npcs.info:
An old thirteen-string koto that woke after a hundred years, walking the night shore on its bridges and plucking itself. The woken koto plays a mournful tune that leads listeners into the cold lake, and lashes with its strings. A stock foe, one of many. In person: old wooden koto with thirteen strings walking.

**Speaking Style:** A plucked, mournful voice, words sung between strings. Tell: played well, its strings fall silent.
**Combat Role:** a tune to lure, then lashing strings
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: walks on its bridges; mourns; follows good music
Quirk: plucks itself

npcs.name: Acolyte Shinsuke
npcs.info:
A young acolyte who rings the temple bell for every ship that comes home and counts the ones that do not. In person: young shaven-headed acolyte monk ringing a great bronze bell; sea wind.

**Home Ground:** Bell Terrace at Temple of Safe Voyages, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle and earnest, a young monk who apologises to the bell before he rings it. Gentle and earnest, a small apology before anything bold, a prayer murmured under the bell. Tell: at the Brine Tide's name his gentleness thins.
**Combat Role:** a temple staff, swung with apologies.
**Relationship Hook:** Listen to the bell for a night and you hear it ring a beat late.
personality: Core: apologises to the bell; counts ships; climbs the bell rope barefoot
Quirk: prays for sailors by name

npcs.name: Acolyte Shinsuke
npcs.location: Temple of Safe Voyages, Temple of the Unreturned
npcs.info:
The temple's acolyte after the war, who rings the bell for every ship that comes home and now counts more that do not than ever. In person: young shaven-headed monk with rope-burned hands; a great bronze bell hung with mourning cloth; sea wind.

**Home Ground:** Bell Terrace, After the War at Temple of Safe Voyages, Temple of the Unreturned, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle and earnest, a young monk who apologises to the bell before he rings it. Gentle and earnest, a small apology before anything bold, a prayer murmured under the bell. Tell since the war: he says the name of every ship that did not come home under his breath, and loses his place in what he was saying.
**Combat Role:** a temple staff, swung with apologies.
**Relationship Hook:** Listen to the bell for a night and you hear it ring a beat late.
personality: Core: apologises to the bell; counts ships; climbs the bell rope barefoot
Quirk: prays for sailors by name

npcs.name: Acolyte Shizuku of the Stag
npcs.location: Ice Shrine of the White Stag
npcs.info:
An acolyte of the white stag's ice shrine who tends the antler hall and waits for the stag that has not come in years. In person: serene acolyte; frost.

**Home Ground:** Antler Hall at Ice Shrine of the White Stag, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Hushed and clear as cold air, an acolyte who never raises her voice in the antler hall. Hushed and clear as cold air, never above a murmur. Tell: about the stag her hush catches.
**Combat Role:** a monk's staff and a ward of ice.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch with her at night and you see the carvings weep.
personality: Core: never raises her voice; touches the antlers; leaves salt out
Quirk: waits at night

npcs.name: Admiral Mizuchi Naotora
npcs.info:
Admiral of House Mizuchi, sixty, broad, salt-grey and patient, whose river-dragon fleet holds the straits and hangs pirates at Ashiura. He runs the anchorage like a ship and the house like a fleet. In person: broad salt-grey admiral; short beard; stern sea-weathered face; dark blue armoured coat with a river dragon crest.

**Home Ground:** Admiral's Hall at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A quarterdeck voice, big and level; he gives orders like weather reports. Quarterdeck projection, level as a calm sea, orders delivered like forecasts. Tell: when his son's fever comes up, the voice stays level but the sentences get shorter.
**Combat Role:** spear and grappling hook on a rolling deck; a fleet behind him.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the truth of the sleeping warship and he gives you a ship's passage anywhere.
personality: Core: gives orders like weather reports; walks the shipyard at dawn; never shows grief
Quirk: keeps a model ship of every vessel he lost

npcs.name: Admiral Mizuchi Naotora
npcs.location: Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet
npcs.info:
The admiral of House Mizuchi after the war, sixty-two, whose fleet burned at its moorings. He hides in the silent shipyard, gathering the captains who stayed loyal, and the house thinks him dead. In person: broad salt-grey admiral; beard grown out; a scorched dark blue coat; the river-dragon crest cut off and kept in his sleeve; stern, grieving eyes.

**Home Ground:** Admiral's Hall, After the War at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A quarterdeck voice, big and level; he gives orders like weather reports. Quarterdeck projection, level as a calm sea, orders delivered like forecasts. Tell since the war: he touches the cut-off crest in his sleeve before he gives an order, and gives it quieter.
**Combat Role:** spear and grappling hook on a rolling deck; a fleet behind him.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the truth of the sleeping warship and he gives you a ship's passage anywhere.
personality: Core: gives orders like weather reports; walks the shipyard at dawn; never shows grief
Quirk: keeps a model ship of every vessel he lost

npcs.name: Amenbo the Skimmer
npcs.info:
A wiry young messenger who runs letters across the marsh faster than boats and has never been caught. She is gone from the plank walks before anyone sees her go. In person: young adult woman; wiry; short windswept hair; bright eyes; light courier clothes with tied-back sleeves and bare calves; a short sword; blurred with speed.

**Home Ground:** Plank Walks at Kirisame Stilt Village, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick and teasing, out of breath only when she laughs; she finishes other people's sentences. Quick and teasing, finishing other people's sentences, breathless only when laughing. Tell: the old courier mentioned and for once she stops moving.
**Combat Role:** speed above all: she is beside, behind and in front of a foe before they turn.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep up with her for a morning.
personality: Core: never stands still; counts steps under her breath; laughs when out of breath
Quirk: finishes your sentences

npcs.name: Amenbo the Skimmer
npcs.location: Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark
npcs.info:
The wiry messenger after the war, who runs letters across the marsh faster than any boat, twice an hour now. The clan's children carry the grey mark, and she carries their cure. In person: young woman; wiry; short windswept hair; bright eyes; light courier clothes; a short sword; blurred with speed; a satchel of medicine jars.

**Home Ground:** Plank Walks, After the War at Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick and teasing, out of breath only when she laughs; she finishes other people's sentences. Quick and teasing, finishing other people's sentences, breathless only when laughing. Tell since the war: she slows to a walk when she passes a marked child, and nowhere else.
**Combat Role:** speed above all: she is beside, behind and in front of a foe before they turn.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep up with her for a morning.
personality: Core: never stands still; counts steps under her breath; laughs when out of breath
Quirk: finishes your sentences

npcs.name: Angry Kodama
npcs.info:
A small pale tree spirit with a blank round face, its echo turned to a scream at the saw line. Angry kodama curse the loggers who fell their trees and lead them in circles. A stock foe, one of many. In person: small pale tree spirit with a blank round face; screaming.

**Speaking Style:** An echo of a voice, your words thrown back wrong. Tell: given an offering, the echo turns gentle.
**Combat Role:** an echo scream and roots underfoot
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: screams; curses loggers; accepts offerings
Quirk: echoes

npcs.name: Aoi of the Wreck
npcs.info:
A young woman, twenty, living alone in the wreck of a southern ship on the Black Stone Coast, surviving on gulls and driftwood. In person: lone survivor; wild dark hair; pale steady eyes; tattered southern clothes.

**Home Ground:** Wreck Cove at Black Stone Coast, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and flat; she tells the truth because lies take too much warmth to tell. She speaks through chattering teeth. Tell: when the wreck's captain is mentioned her flatness breaks into anger, briefly.
**Combat Role:** none, until the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her before the Warden hunters do.
personality: Core: speaks flatly; feeds the sea eagles; carves her name in the wreck
Quirk: never sleeps

npcs.name: Aoi of the Wreck
npcs.location: Black Stone Coast, The Shaking Coast
npcs.info:
The lone survivor of the southern wreck after the war, twenty-two, living in Wreck Cove beside a broken Warden ship. The cliffs shake at night where the fissure meets the sea. In person: lone survivor; wild dark hair; pale steady eyes that glow at night; Warden furs taken from the wreck.

**Home Ground:** Wreck Cove, After the War at Black Stone Coast, The Shaking Coast, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and flat; she tells the truth because lies take too much warmth to tell. She speaks through chattering teeth. Tell since the war: her teeth stop chattering when she is angry now, and the air around her warms.
**Combat Role:** none, until the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her before the Warden hunters do.
personality: Core: speaks flatly; feeds the sea eagles; carves her name in the wreck
Quirk: never sleeps

npcs.name: Archivist Fumihiko
npcs.info:
A court archivist, forty-five, hiding among the porters in a borrowed porter's coat that does not fit. He flinches at every samurai on the road. In person: frightened thin archivist; spectacles; ink-stained fingers; an ill-fitting porter's coat.

**Home Ground:** Bunk Room at Porters' Lodge, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Thin, frightened and pedantic; he corrects facts even while hiding. Thin, reedy, corrects dates mid-panic, apologises for correcting. Rustles paper constantly. Tell: when the genealogy is mentioned he whispers the forger's name before he can stop himself.
**Combat Role:** none at all.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him somewhere safe and the copy is yours to use.
personality: Core: corrects facts while hiding; flinches at samurai; carries the copy against his chest
Quirk: cannot carry a load

npcs.name: Archivist Fumihiko
npcs.location: Porters' Lodge, Porters for the Army
npcs.info:
The runaway court archivist after the war, forty-seven, still among the porters, still in the coat that does not fit. He carries the wounded home for coins now and has stopped flinching at samurai. In person: thin archivist; cracked spectacles; porter's coat; calloused hands where the ink used to be.

**Home Ground:** Bunk Room, After the War at Porters' Lodge, Porters for the Army, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Thin, frightened and pedantic; he corrects facts even while hiding. Thin, reedy, corrects dates mid-panic, apologises for correcting. Rustles paper constantly. Tell since the war: he no longer whispers the forger's name; he says it out loud, then waits to see if anyone flinches.
**Combat Role:** none at all.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him somewhere safe and the copy is yours to use.
personality: Core: corrects facts while hiding; flinches at samurai; carries the copy against his chest
Quirk: cannot carry a load

npcs.name: Armourer Gorobei Tetsuhane
npcs.info:
The armourer of the Whetstone terrace, who turns a whetstone the size of a millwheel and remembers every blade he has ever touched by its maker and its flaw. He whets for isles coin and keeps a crate of isles steel and materials for sale. In person: mature man; thick-armed and soot-dark; grey beard; a leather apron; turning the crank of a vast whetstone with sparks fanning up; intent.

**Home Ground:** The Wheel at The Whetstone, The Hundred Blades, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Rasping over the wheel's noise, terse and exact; he names a blade's maker before its owner's name. A rasp over the wheel's noise, terse and exact, a blade's maker named before its owner. Tell: his debt to the ghost mentioned and the crank slows.
**Combat Role:** none; he has a whetstone and a terrace, and the ghost fights for him.
**Relationship Hook:** Hand him your blade and name its flaw before he does; he whets it against the school you fear most.
personality: Core: never stops the wheel to talk; touches a blade's flaw first; argues with the ghost
Quirk: names the maker before the owner

npcs.name: Ascetic Mugen
npcs.info:
The new eldest of the ascetics on the peak, thirty, who took up the fast when Kakuzen died of it. He is thin to the bone and never leaves the caves. In person: young man; emaciated mountain ascetic; shaved head; bare bony chest; prayer beads; seated; calm.

**Home Ground:** Hermit Caves, After the War at Ascetics' Peak, The Fasting Peak, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Barely above a whisper, slow from hunger, every word a breath he can spare. A whisper between breaths, every word spent carefully. Tell: when hunger takes him mid-sentence he smiles, and the sentence ends there.
**Combat Role:** none; he will not break the fast to fight.
**Relationship Hook:** Share the fast with him, or find others who will, before it kills him.
personality: Core: speaks between breaths; smiles at hunger; will not touch rice
Quirk: counts the days in pebbles

npcs.name: Ascetics' Raiju
npcs.info:
A crackling wolf-shaped beast of lightning that sleeps in the hermits' caves between storms. The raiju sleeps in human navels in old stories; here it leaps at any metal in a storm. A stock foe, one of many. In person: raiju; crackling wolf-shaped beast made of blue lightning.

**Speaking Style:** Thunder in a throat. Thunder caught in a throat, crackling snarls, a sharp electric snap before each leap. Tell: at a drumbeat the crackle settles into a sleepy hum.
**Combat Role:** a leap of lightning at the nearest steel
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: sleeps in hollows; leaps at metal; fears the sound of the drum
Quirk: crackles

npcs.name: Ascetics' Raiju
npcs.info:
A wolf of lightning grown restless while the hermits fast to hold the beast under the temple; with no rice left for it, it prowls the chain path in every storm. A stock foe, one of many. In person: raiju; crackling wolf-shaped beast of blue lightning; ribs of sparks showing; scorched rice-offering bowls hung on its neck.

**Speaking Style:** Thunder in a throat. Thunder caught in a throat, crackling snarls, a sharp electric snap before each leap. Tell since the war: its crackle drops to a whine whenever it smells rice.
**Combat Role:** a leap of lightning at the nearest steel
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: prowls the chain path; leaps at metal; still fears the drum
Quirk: crackles

npcs.name: Ash Crow Flock
npcs.info:
A flock of grey-feathered crows that follow the dying across the Blight and peck the eyes of the living. Ash crow flocks mob anyone who comes near the roost's dead tree. A stock foe, one of many. In person: flock of grey-feathered ash crows mobbing around a dead tree.

**Speaking Style:** A hundred cawing voices out of time. Tell: when one falls, the whole flock goes silent.
**Combat Role:** a mob of grey wings
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: caws; follows the dying; steals
Quirk: mobs

npcs.name: Ash Plain Ghoul
npcs.info:
A grey, ash-caked ghoul walking in a line with others at dusk. Ghouls walk the Ash Plain in packs and are walking towards Haibara. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ashfall ghoul; grey ash-caked ghoul.

**Speaking Style:** A groan with a chewing rhythm, words dragged out of a dry throat. It sniffs between groans. Tell: at sunlight it shrieks and the groan breaks.
**Combat Role:** grasping packs
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: moans; never stops; breaks in sunlight
Quirk: walks in lines

npcs.name: Ash Plain Ghoul
npcs.location: The Ash Plain, The Wider Plain
npcs.info:
A grey, ash-caked ghoul in the rags of a war levy, walking in a line north past the old road where the plain has crept; the war's burned villages fed the lines. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ashfall ghoul; grey ash-caked ghoul; a levy's rotted jingasa hat; a broken spear dragged behind it.

**Speaking Style:** A groan with a chewing rhythm, words dragged out of a dry throat. It sniffs between groans. Tell since the war: it turns its head north mid-moan, as if it heard its name.
**Combat Role:** grasping packs
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: moans; walks north; breaks in sunlight
Quirk: walks in lines

npcs.name: Ash Plain Oni
npcs.info:
A huge red-skinned oni with horns and an iron club. Oni smash first and bargain over sake after. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge red-skinned horned ogre with an iron club.

**Speaking Style:** A rumbling roar under the words, short blunt sentences thrown like boulders. It laughs at small weapons. Tell: when someone stands their ground, the roar becomes a grin you can hear.
**Combat Role:** an iron club and a bellow
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs; loves sake; respects strength
Quirk: smashes

npcs.name: Ash Plain Oni
npcs.location: The Ash Plain, The Wider Plain
npcs.info:
A huge red-skinned oni with horns and an iron club, hiding deep in the burned basin from the Northern Court's oni-hunters; it bargains over sake with deserters now as well as smashing them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: oni; huge red-skinned horned ogre; a broken horn; an iron club bound with a Court shackle it tore free.

**Speaking Style:** A rumbling roar under the words, short blunt sentences thrown like boulders. It laughs at small weapons. Tell since the war: it rattles the torn shackle on its club whenever someone mentions the north.
**Combat Role:** an iron club and a bellow
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs less; bargains with deserters; respects strength
Quirk: smashes

npcs.name: Ash Plain Wanyudo
npcs.info:
A burning wheel that rolls the cairn line on the ash plain, a monk's face screaming at its hub. Wanyudo take the souls of those who see them and burn the cairns they roll past. A stock foe, one of many. In person: wanyudo; burning wheel with a screaming monk's face rolling.

**Speaking Style:** A tormented groan over crackling fire. Tell: near running water it screams and turns away.
**Combat Role:** a burning roll and a soul-taking stare
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: burns cairns; stares; screams
Quirk: rolls

npcs.name: Ash Road Gaki
npcs.info:
Hungry ghosts of pilgrims who died on the grey road without rites, reaching for every rice ball. Ash road gaki follow pilgrims and steal the offerings meant for them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gaki hungry ghosts.

**Speaking Style:** A dry starving moan, pilgrim prayers half remembered. Tell: given a rite, the moaning stops.
**Combat Role:** a swarm of grey grasping hands
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows; moans; shares grief
Quirk: reaches for food

npcs.name: Ash Road Hex-Seller
npcs.info:
A pilgrim-dressed curse sorcerer with a basket of straw dolls and nails, smiling at every traveller. Hex-sellers sell pilgrims curses on their enemies and lay one on anyone who refuses to buy. A stock foe, one of many. In person: curse sorcerer dressed as a pilgrim; basket of straw dolls and nails.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet and poisonous, prices in grudges. Tell: refused, her sweetness sharpens into a hiss.
**Combat Role:** a doll and a nail, then a curse on whoever struck her
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: names prices in grudges; sews while talking; curses refusals
Quirk: smiles at everyone

npcs.name: Ash-Tender Kaen
npcs.info:
The tender of the Fire Sanctum's ash field, who rakes the ash into lines the furnace's breath disturbs and rakes them again. He has never been burned and does not know why. In person: adult man; wiry and soot-streaked; shaved head; a leather apron; a long iron rake; unbothered.

**Home Ground:** The Ash Field at Fire Sanctum, The Five Sanctums, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse from heat and smoke, blunt and good-humoured; he says a thing once and rakes. Hoarse from heat, blunt and good-humoured, a thing said once and then the rake again. Tell: the kneeling shape mentioned and the raking stops.
**Combat Role:** a rake and a field of hot ash; he does not fight so much as let the field do it.
**Relationship Hook:** Pour your own water out at the edge before he asks and he tells you about the kneeling shape.
personality: Core: rakes while talking; says a thing once; pours out visitors' water for them
Quirk: never flinches at the furnace

npcs.name: Bamboo Jorogumo
npcs.info:
A beautiful woman with a biwa in the cut grove, her shadow on the bamboo showing eight legs. Bamboo jorogumo play for lost travellers and wrap the ones who sit too long. A stock foe, one of many. In person: beautiful woman; a spider-legged shadow.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and slow, every invitation a song. Tell: at a torch her music stops mid-note.
**Combat Role:** a charm in the music, then the silk
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: invites travellers to sit; laughs softly; hates fire
Quirk: plays the biwa

npcs.name: Bamboo Kamaitachi
npcs.info:
A weasel with sickle-claws riding a gust of wind. Sickle weasels cut travellers they never see. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kamaitachi; weasel yokai with sickle claws riding a gust.

**Speaking Style:** A whistling giggle that rides the wind, words sliced into pieces. It laughs mid-strike. Tell: three giggles in a row means three cuts.
**Combat Role:** three gusts, three cuts
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: cuts unseen; comes in threes; giggles
Quirk: rides the wind

npcs.name: Bamboo Kamaitachi
npcs.location: Whispering Bamboo, The Bamboo of Written Names
npcs.info:
A weasel with sickle-claws riding the wind through the bamboo, carving names into every stalk: soldiers', villages', the dead emperor's. It cuts travellers who cut the names out. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kamaitachi; weasel yokai with sickle claws; claws worn ragged; bamboo dust in its fur.

**Speaking Style:** A whistling giggle that rides the wind, words sliced into pieces. It laughs mid-strike. Tell since the war: they hiss a name in the wind each time they strike.
**Combat Role:** three gusts, three cuts
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: cuts names; comes in threes; giggles less
Quirk: rides the wind

npcs.name: Banner Duelist of the Nephew
npcs.info:
A swaggering duelist in the Nephew's Banner colours with two swords and a reform pamphlet in his sash. Banner duelists pick fights at the fords to prove the nephew's swords are the best on the plain. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swaggering samurai duelist; two swords; a pamphlet.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and sure of himself. Loud and sure, reform speeches quoted mid-fight. Tell: beaten fairly, he goes quiet and bows lower than he must.
**Combat Role:** two swords in the dueling-yard form, a formal challenge first
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: challenges anyone armed; polishes both swords; respects a clean win
Quirk: recites reform speeches

npcs.name: Barracks Cook Hiko of the Ferry
npcs.info:
A living man who cooks for the fortress barracks, though the officers rarely eat; he says the smell keeps them human. In person: hearty living cook stirring a pot.

**Home Ground:** Division Barracks at Black Ferry Fortress, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, a living cook who feeds the dead officers out of habit. Hearty and loud, a living laugh in a hall of the dead, ladle banging. Tell: repeating what the officers said, he drops to a conspirator's whisper.
**Combat Role:** a cleaver and a pot of boiling broth.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat his food at the barracks and he tells you what the officers said.
personality: Core: cooks for the dead; talks to empty chairs; remembers everything
Quirk: laughs too loud

npcs.name: Barracks Cook Hiko of the Ferry
npcs.location: Black Ferry Fortress, The Overrun Fortress
npcs.info:
The fortress barracks' cook after the war, who cooks for the living soldiers the Court deputised to ferry the dead. They eat. The officers watch them eat and remember. In person: hearty living cook; an army cauldron; steam; tired smile.

**Home Ground:** Division Barracks, After the War at Black Ferry Fortress, The Overrun Fortress, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud, a living cook who feeds the dead officers out of habit. Hearty and loud, a living laugh in a hall of the dead, ladle banging. Tell since the war: he calls the living ferrymen by name at every meal, loudly, so the officers hear the names.
**Combat Role:** a cleaver and a pot of boiling broth.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat his food at the barracks and he tells you what the officers said.
personality: Core: cooks for the dead; talks to empty chairs; remembers everything
Quirk: laughs too loud

npcs.name: Barricade Captain Tora
npcs.info:
The Straw Masks' captain of the Oiwake barricade, twenty-six, a farmer's daughter from the Hundred Fields who took the barrier with Old Gensai and held it when he fell. She stamps travellers' papers with a straw mask seal. In person: young woman; peasant army captain; short tousled hair; straw mask pushed up; patched farmer's clothes; a flail; grinning.

**Home Ground:** Toll Barrier, After the War at Oiwake Station, Behind the Barricade, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, rough and funny, a farm girl's shout trained into a captain's; she gives orders as jokes and means every one. A farm girl's shout trained into orders, a laugh first and the order after. Tell: when the Regent's raid is mentioned she stops laughing and speaks very quietly.
**Combat Role:** a flail at the barricade gap, forty farmers behind her.
**Relationship Hook:** Find the guard who sells papers and the barricade is yours to cross whenever you like.
personality: Core: chews rice straw; salutes Gensai's spear; stamps papers too hard
Quirk: laughs before she shouts

npcs.name: Barrow Gashadokuro
npcs.info:
A giant of fused warriors' bones crouched in the barrow mouth, still wearing broken armour plates. It comes out when the Veil thins and drags the living into the warriors' hall. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gashadokuro; giant skeleton of fused bones crouching.

**Speaking Style:** Armour and bone grinding. Armour plates and bone grinding together, a long low groan from many throats. Tell: at the ferry rite the groan becomes a sigh.
**Combat Role:** a grip and the drag into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: clatters; drags, never bites; stops at the ferry rite
Quirk: crouches like a hill

npcs.name: Barrow Gashadokuro
npcs.location: Old Battle Barrow, The Opened Barrow
npcs.info:
A giant of fused warriors' bones, grown by the war's dead the barrow's warriors brought back with them; it crouches on the bone throne with fresh armour plates fused among the old. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gashadokuro; giant skeleton of fused bones; this war's lacquered plates fused among the rusted; larger than before.

**Speaking Style:** Armour and bone grinding. Armour plates and bone grinding together, a long low groan from many throats. Tell since the war: its new bones clatter a beat after the old ones.
**Combat Role:** a grip and the drag into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: clatters; takes the dead into itself; stops at the ferry rite
Quirk: crouches like a hill

npcs.name: Barrow Hall Grudge Wraith
npcs.info:
A grey shape in the outline of a mounted warrior, rising off an empty bench in the barrow's hall. Barrow wraiths ride down anyone carrying a stolen grave-good and leave them cold in the passage. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge wraith; grey ghostly mounted warrior rising from a bench.

**Speaking Style:** An old war cry from far off. An old war cry heard from far off, words from a court nobody speaks now, hoofbeats under them. Tell: at his lord's name the cry breaks into a man's sob.
**Combat Role:** a ghost charge down the passage
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: smells stolen bronze; rides through walls; turns at his lord's name
Quirk: rises from empty benches

npcs.name: Barrow Hall Grudge Wraith
npcs.epithet: Wraith Who Rode to the War
npcs.location: Old Battle Barrow, The Opened Barrow
npcs.info:
A grey mounted warrior who came out of the opened barrow to fight in the war and did not go back in; he rides the moor with a fresh banner of a house he never served, still looking for his lord. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge wraith; grey ghostly mounted warrior; a rotted war banner of this war on his back; arrows of this war in his ghost armour.

**Speaking Style:** An old war cry from far off. An old war cry heard from far off, words from a court nobody speaks now, hoofbeats under them. Tell since the war: he reins in at any banner and reads its crest before he charges.
**Combat Role:** a ghost charge down the passage
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rides the moor now; smells stolen bronze; turns at his lord's line
Quirk: rises from empty benches

npcs.name: Barrow Relic-Bearer
npcs.info:
A grave-robber owned by the cursed sword he took from the barrow, its hilt grown into his hand. Relic-bearers fight for the relic and protect it from anyone who would take it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grave robber holding a cursed sword grown.

**Speaking Style:** Two voices at once: a robber begging and a general commanding. Tell: when the sword wins, only the general speaks.
**Combat Role:** the sword's old form through a robber's arms
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: cannot let go; begs between blows; fights like an old general
Quirk: speaks for the sword

npcs.name: Barrow-Robber Ronin
npcs.info:
A ronin with a dead lord's grave-sword on his hip and a crowbar on his back, working the barrow mouth. Barrow-robber ronin take the old warriors' blades to sell in the gorge, and fight for them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ragged ronin with an ornate old grave-sword and a crowbar.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and greedy, quick to put a price on things, a chuckle before a threat. Tell: when something moves behind him the chuckle stops and he talks faster.
**Combat Role:** the grave-sword drawn fast, the crowbar to finish
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: does not look behind him; tests every edge; laughs at curses
Quirk: sells to anyone

npcs.name: Barrow-Robber Ronin
npcs.location: Old Battle Barrow, The Opened Barrow
npcs.info:
A ronin who no longer needs a crowbar: the barrow opened from the inside, and he picks up what the risen warriors drop on the moor. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ragged ronin; two ornate old grave-swords now; a crowbar slung unused; frost on his shoulders that never melts.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and greedy, quick to put a price on things, a chuckle before a threat. Tell since the war: he glances over both shoulders before he speaks, one for each sword.
**Combat Role:** the grave-sword drawn fast, the crowbar to finish
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: looks behind him now; tests every edge; laughs at curses less
Quirk: sells to anyone

npcs.name: Bath-Keeper Nanae
npcs.info:
A woman who keeps the bathing hut at the snow monkey springs and lets hunters soak off the cold for a coin. In person: warm bath-keeper; snowy mountains; wooden hut.

**Home Ground:** Snow Monkey Springs: Steaming Pools at Snow Monkey Springs, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and drowsy as the steam, a bath-keeper who shares the pools with the monkeys. Warm and drowsy as the steam, a hum between words. Tell: about the old monkey's knife her hum stops.
**Combat Role:** none; the monkeys take her side.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the old monkey's knife and she names its owner.
personality: Core: shares with the monkeys; feeds the troop; knows every hunter's scars
Quirk: hums in the steam

npcs.name: Bay Umibozu
npcs.info:
A black, smooth-headed giant rising waist-deep from a calm sea, with eyes like two drowned moons. The umibozu rises on still nights and asks for a ladle; refuse it and it breaks the hull. A stock foe, one of many. In person: umibozu; enormous black smooth-headed sea giant rising from a calm night sea; pale glowing eyes.

**Speaking Style:** A voice like the sea floor shifting, each word a long swell with a pause after it. It speaks only once. Tell: refused, the pause breaks into a roar of breaking water.
**Combat Role:** a fist through the hull and the sea after it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks once; never speaks twice; sinks back at dawn
Quirk: rises without a ripple

npcs.name: Bay Umibozu
npcs.location: Pirate Graves Reef, The Wreck Reef
npcs.info:
A black, smooth-headed giant rising from the calm sea among the new war-junk wrecks; it no longer asks for a ladle before it breaks a hull. A stock foe, one of many. In person: umibozu; enormous black smooth-headed sea giant; pale glowing eyes; a war-junk's mast snapped across its shoulders.

**Speaking Style:** A voice like the sea floor shifting, each word a long swell with a pause after it. It speaks only once. Tell since the war: it rises without a ripple and does not ask.
**Combat Role:** a fist through the hull and the sea after it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks no ladle now; never speaks; sinks back at dawn
Quirk: rises without a ripple

npcs.name: Beach Temple Sohei
npcs.info:
A warrior monk of the ferry temple, a woman in black monk's robes and a white head wrap, with a naginata and a string of iron prayer beads. Beach sohei guard the ferry landing and turn back anyone carrying soul-steel. A stock foe, one of many. In person: female sohei warrior monk; black buddhist monk robes; white cloth hood wrapped around the head; naginata; iron prayer beads.

**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, half a prayer. Low and steady, every warning half a prayer. Tell: near soul-steel her prayer quickens.
**Combat Role:** a naginata sweep at the landing, a prayer first
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: checks every blade; offers a toll before a fight; never pursues into the water
Quirk: prays aloud before a fight

npcs.name: Beachcomber Sute
npcs.info:
A beachcomber on the Mask Shore, forty, who collects the broken white masks the tide brings in and sells them to collectors. In person: greedy beachcomber; rags; cloth-wrapped hands.

**Home Ground:** Beachcomber's Hut at Mask Shore, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Greedy and wheedling, too eager; he holds things out to you. Greedy and wheedling, always holding something out and naming its price before you look. He giggles at his own bargains. Tell: when the warm mask comes up he stops wheedling, puts it down, and sounds genuinely afraid.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws a mask and runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Take the warm mask off his hands before the devourer comes for it.
personality: Core: never goes out after a tide night; counts masks; wraps his hands in cloth
Quirk: holds things out to you

npcs.name: Beachcomber Sute
npcs.location: Mask Shore, Shore of Washed-Up Masks
npcs.info:
A beachcomber on the Mask Shore after the war, forty-two, who collects the masks the tide brings in by the dozen now. He wears one himself. In person: beachcomber in rags; cloth-wrapped hands; a pale mask pushed up on his forehead that he will not take off.

**Home Ground:** Beachcomber's Hut, After the War at Mask Shore, Shore of Washed-Up Masks, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Greedy and wheedling, too eager; he holds things out to you. Greedy and wheedling, always holding something out and naming its price before you look. He giggles at his own bargains. Tell since the war: he forgets the end of his own price mid-bargain, and touches the mask on his forehead.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws a mask and runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Take the warm mask off his hands before the devourer comes for it.
personality: Core: never goes out after a tide night; counts masks; wraps his hands in cloth
Quirk: holds things out to you

npcs.name: Bellkeeper Oto
npcs.info:
The old woman who rings the Fog Watch Tower's bell when the tide of the dead begins, seventy, wiry and stubborn. In person: wiry bellkeeper; grey hair whipping; sharp eyes; patched coat.

**Home Ground:** Bell Loft at Fog Watch Tower, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, suspicious and loud; she shouts over the wind out of habit. Shouts over a wind that is not blowing and asks suspicious questions in pairs. She punctuates with a tap on the bell rope. Tell: when the cut rope is mentioned she whispers for the first time, and her hand goes still on the rope.
**Combat Role:** a bell hammer.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch the rope-cutter and she rings the bell for you any time you ask.
personality: Core: sleeps in the bell loft; spliced the rope twice; trusts no officer
Quirk: shouts over the wind

npcs.name: Bellkeeper Oto
npcs.location: Fog Watch Tower, The Bell Rung for the Dead
npcs.info:
The Fog Watch Tower's bellkeeper after the war, seventy-two, wiry and stubborn, who rings the bell for every hundred dead ferried and counts them aloud. She has passed fifty thousand. In person: wiry bellkeeper; grey hair whipping; sharp eyes; rope-burned hands; patched coat.

**Home Ground:** Bell Loft, After the War at Fog Watch Tower, The Bell Rung for the Dead, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, suspicious and loud; she shouts over the wind out of habit. Shouts over a wind that is not blowing and asks suspicious questions in pairs. She punctuates with a tap on the bell rope. Tell since the war: she counts the dead aloud in hundreds between sentences, without noticing she does it.
**Combat Role:** a bell hammer.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch the rope-cutter and she rings the bell for you any time you ask.
personality: Core: sleeps in the bell loft; spliced the rope twice; trusts no officer
Quirk: shouts over the wind

npcs.name: Big Ushi
npcs.info:
Boss of the Porters' Lodge, forty, enormous and gentle, who decides which travellers are worth carrying and which are not. Every porter and palanquin bearer on the road answers to him. In person: huge gentle porter boss; shaved head; broad calm face; bare muscled arms; a carrying pole; calm.

**Home Ground:** Bunk Room at Porters' Lodge, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, deep and decisive; he speaks like a man setting down a heavy load. Slow, deep, final, each sentence set down like a crate. Grunts instead of agreeing. Tell: when he is afraid he says nothing at all.
**Combat Role:** picks you up and puts you somewhere else.
**Relationship Hook:** Treat his porters well and the road's whispers are yours.
personality: Core: never runs; feeds the young porters first; remembers every passenger's weight
Quirk: sets things down gently

npcs.name: Black Bear of the Ridge
npcs.info:
A huge black bear with a white crescent on her chest. Ridge bears leave travellers alone, except in spring and near cubs. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge black bear with a white crescent.

**Speaking Style:** A roar. A chest-deep roar in short bursts, then heavy snuffling. Its breath steams in grunts. Tell: before a charge it goes silent and pops its jaw.
**Combat Role:** a charge and a maul
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: guards cubs; eats everything; charges
Quirk: warns with a huff

npcs.name: Black Bear of the Ridge
npcs.location: Bear Den Ridge, The Oni's Ridge
npcs.info:
A huge black bear driven from the great den, where the oni now sells sake to both villages' patrols; she raids the patrols' camps for what they bring. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge black bear with a white crescent; an arrow scar on the shoulder; a torn patrol satchel in her jaws.

**Speaking Style:** A roar. A chest-deep roar in short bursts, then heavy snuffling. Its breath steams in grunts. Tell since the war: she huffs twice at the smell of sake.
**Combat Role:** a charge and a maul
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: raids camps; eats everything; charges
Quirk: warns with a huff

npcs.name: Blade Inspector Kaji Sota
npcs.info:
The guild's blade inspector, who tests every sword that leaves Hibana and stamps the ones that pass. In person: fussy guild inspector tapping a sword blade and listening; inspection room full of blades; stamps.

**Home Ground:** Inspection Room at Forge Guild Hall, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise and fussy, an inspector who taps every blade and judges it by the ring. Precise and fussy, a tap and a listen between words. Tell: near a deep-forge blade his voice shakes.
**Combat Role:** none; he rings the guild bell.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him a deep-forge blade and his hands shake.
personality: Core: taps every blade; listens to steel; hands shake near deep-forge blades
Quirk: fussy about stamps

npcs.name: Blade Inspector Kaji Sota
npcs.location: Forge Guild Hall, The Hall That Stopped Asking
npcs.info:
The guild's blade inspector after the war, who stamps war orders by the hundred and no longer listens to the blades. In person: fussy guild inspector with a stamp worn smooth; an inspection room crowded with war blades; cotton in his ears.

**Home Ground:** Inspection Room, After the War at Forge Guild Hall, The Hall That Stopped Asking, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise and fussy, an inspector who taps every blade and judges it by the ring. Precise and fussy, a tap and a listen between words. Tell since the war: he stamps a war order without tapping the blade first, and his hand hesitates where the tap used to be.
**Combat Role:** none; he rings the guild bell.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him a deep-forge blade and his hands shake.
personality: Core: taps every blade; listens to steel; hands shake near deep-forge blades
Quirk: fussy about stamps

npcs.name: Boatwright Hanzaemon
npcs.info:
A one-eyed boatwright, sixty, thick-handed, who works out of the ruined workshop because the light is good and nobody charges him rent. In person: sixty; thickset; grey cropped hair; a black eye-patch; a sawdust-covered work apron; forearms like ropes; an adze.

**Home Ground:** The Counter at The Workshop, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and blunt, a craftsman's contempt for bad work, a rare grin for good work. Blunt and dry, a craftsman's verdicts, a rare short grin for good work. Tell: when the cove comes up he lowers his voice and rubs the scar under the patch.
**Combat Role:** the adze's edge, then the mallet on the hand that held the knife.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him your hands and he will decide whether you are worth teaching how to fix the forge.
personality: Core: judges a person by their hands; says exactly what is wrong with your work and nothing about what is right
Quirk: rubs the scar under his eye-patch when he is thinking

npcs.name: Bone Gully Curse-Binder
npcs.info:
A gaunt curse-binder in a robe of tied bones with a grudge-ink brush and black-stained fingers. Curse-binders bind the robbers of the gully to their crimes and send the bound ones at travellers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gaunt curse binder; black-stained fingers; an ink brush.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and amused, writing in the air as he speaks. Tell: when a binding breaks he stops laughing.
**Combat Role:** a grudge-ink binding, and his bound robbers in front of him
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs at the bound; never touches the living; collects bones
Quirk: writes in the air

npcs.name: Bone-Picker Gorobei
npcs.info:
A Haibara ash-man, the only one who goes to the ruined kennels willingly: he picks the broken pens for fangs and bone whistles and sells them as charms against the dogs. In person: cold middle-aged bone-picker with a sack and a bone whistle; ashen sky; dog shadows.

**Home Ground:** Kennel Rows at Inugami Kennels, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and cold, a man who speaks to dogs warmly and people not at all. Cold to people, warm low murmurs to the dogs, a whistle never far from his lips. Tell: at his daughter's name the cold breaks.
**Combat Role:** a bone whistle and a fast retreat.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask where his fangs come from and he admits he picks the pens, and what it cost his daughter.
personality: Core: warm to dogs; counts the pens; keeps his daughter at the Vow Temple
Quirk: cold to people

npcs.name: Bone-Picker Gorobei
npcs.info:
A Haibara ash-man after the war, who still picks the kennels' broken pens for fangs, now that half the pens stand open and empty. He sells the charms to soldiers walking home past the dogs. In person: gaunt bone-picker; a sack of fangs; a bone whistle; ash to the knees; a dog bite healed white on his calf.

**Home Ground:** Kennel Rows, After the War at Inugami Kennels, The Unleashed Kennels, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and cold, a man who speaks to dogs warmly and people not at all. Cold to people, warm low murmurs to the dogs, a whistle never far from his lips. Tell since the war: at dusk he puts the whistle to his lips between sentences and does not blow it.
**Combat Role:** a bone whistle and a fast retreat.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask where his fangs come from and he admits he picks the pens, and what it cost his daughter.
personality: Core: warm to dogs; counts the pens; keeps his daughter at the Vow Temple
Quirk: cold to people

npcs.name: Bone-Picker's Daughter Sae
npcs.info:
The bone-picker's daughter, sixteen, kept at Haibara's Vow Temple since something in the kennel pens bit her a year ago. In person: teen girl with a bandaged wrist kneeling; pale; dog shadows.

**Home Ground:** Vow Temple at Haibara, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and strange, a girl whose voice drops into a growl when she is upset. Soft and strange, a girl's voice that drops into a growl at the ends when upset. Tell: at dusk the growl comes without her noticing.
**Combat Role:** at night, teeth.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch her at night and you see what the bite is doing.
personality: Core: growls when upset; keeps to the temple; sleeps through the day
Quirk: feeds stray dogs by hand

npcs.name: Bone-Picker's Daughter Sae
npcs.epithet: The Girl Who Walks at Night
npcs.info:
The bone-picker's daughter after the war, eighteen, still at the Vow Temple, the bite on her wrist gone grey to the elbow. The temple ties her to her mat at night. In person: pale young woman; a grey-stained bandage from wrist to elbow; rope marks; dog shadows.

**Home Ground:** Vow Temple, After the War at Haibara, On the Grudge Line, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and strange, a girl whose voice drops into a growl when she is upset. Soft and strange, a girl's voice that drops into a growl at the ends when upset. Tell since the war: she finishes sentences with a low sound she does not hear, and the dogs outside answer it.
**Combat Role:** at night, teeth.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch her at night and you see what the bite is doing.
personality: Core: growls when upset; keeps to the temple; sleeps through the day
Quirk: feeds stray dogs by hand

npcs.name: Book-Keeper Senzo
npcs.info:
The Book-Keeper of the Hundred-Duel Circuit, sixty, stooped and ink-fingered, who lodges at the Duelists' Teahouse and keeps the record of every duelist alive: their fights, their wounds, their styles. Duelists bring him their books to copy into the great register. In person: stooped scholarly book-keeper; thin grey hair; round spectacles; ink-stained fingers; plain grey robes; nervous.

**Home Ground:** Signing Room at Duelists' Teahouse, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, fussy and precise; he quotes duel records by number and sighs at sloppy calligraphy. Fussy, dry, quotes duel numbers and sighs at bad calligraphy. Clears his throat before each number. Tell: when frightened, he starts listing duels he has recorded, to calm himself.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides under the register table.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a duelist's signed book and he copies it; corner him about the copies and he begs you to keep his name out.
personality: Core: quotes records by number; sighs at bad handwriting; eats alone in the signing room
Quirk: flinches when a duelist draws

npcs.name: Book-Keeper Senzo
npcs.location: Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels
npcs.info:
The Book-Keeper of the Hundred-Duel Circuit after the war, sixty-two, who sold the great register to the armies and watched them draft the best duellists from it. Half the names in it are dead. In person: stooped book-keeper; spectacles; ink-stained fingers; grey robes; a register with black ribbons tucked between its pages.

**Home Ground:** Signing Room, After the War at Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, fussy and precise; he quotes duel records by number and sighs at sloppy calligraphy. Fussy, dry, quotes duel numbers and sighs at bad calligraphy. Clears his throat before each number. Tell since the war: reading out a duellist's record, he stops at the black ribbon and says which army took them.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides under the register table.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a duelist's signed book and he copies it; corner him about the copies and he begs you to keep his name out.
personality: Core: quotes records by number; sighs at bad handwriting; eats alone in the signing room
Quirk: flinches when a duelist draws

npcs.name: Border Watcher Masaki
npcs.info:
A Kagegi watcher who sits at the village's border stones and decides which strangers walk on and which walk back. In person: quiet shinobi watcher sitting; alert eyes.

**Home Ground:** Stone Line at Village Border Stones, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words, all of them true; a Kagegi watcher who answers questions with questions. Few words, questions for answers, a pebble tossed between them. Tell: about the woman with the child, he answers a question with silence.
**Combat Role:** a needle from cover, then he is gone.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the woman with the child and he asks how you know.
personality: Core: answers with questions; throws pebbles; watches the road
Quirk: never stands

npcs.name: Border Watcher Natsume
npcs.location: Village Border Stones, The Fortified Line
npcs.info:
Kagegi's new border watcher, nineteen, posted at the stones where Masaki was the first man killed in the village war. In person: young woman; shinobi watcher; short dark hair; dark grey gear; a signal mirror.

**Home Ground:** Stone Line, After the War at Village Border Stones, The Fortified Line, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and low, reports in a monotone, every sentence ending on the enemy's position. A flat report of positions, every sentence ending on the enemy. Tell: at Masaki's name she gives his last position too, as if he were still out there.
**Combat Role:** kunai from cover, then gone.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her who sent the wrong signal and she will tell you how the war started.
personality: Core: counts Hayate scouts on her fingers; never lights a fire; talks to the stones
Quirk: sleeps against Masaki's stone

npcs.name: Boss Dairoku
npcs.info:
Boss of the grave robbers mining Bone Gully for the old capital's gold teeth, forty-five, huge and filthy, with a pick on his shoulder and a sack of teeth on his belt. In person: huge filthy grave robber; shaved head; crude grin; a pick; a sack of teeth.

**Home Ground:** Deep Bones at The Gashadokuro Bed, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, crude and greedy; he laughs at the dead. Loud, crude laughter, greedy talk of gold teeth. Tell: when the coffin is mentioned, the laugh stops.
**Combat Role:** a pick and twenty diggers.
**Relationship Hook:** Stop him opening the coffin, or open it with him, and the Blight changes.
personality: Core: laughs at the dead; sleeps with his pick; never digs at dusk
Quirk: counts teeth

npcs.name: Boss Dairoku
npcs.location: Bone Gully, The Mass Grave Gully
npcs.info:
Boss of the grave robbers of Bone Gully after the war, forty-seven, huge and filthy, with fewer men than ever: something has been robbing the robbers. In person: huge filthy grave robber; shaved head; a crude grin gone thin; a pick; an empty sack.

**Home Ground:** Robbers' Camp, After the War at Bone Gully, The Mass Grave Gully, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, crude and greedy; he laughs at the dead. Loud, crude laughter, greedy talk of gold teeth. Tell since the war: he counts his men aloud before he boasts, and the count is always one short.
**Combat Role:** a pick and twenty diggers.
**Relationship Hook:** Stop him opening the coffin, or open it with him, and the Blight changes.
personality: Core: laughs at the dead; sleeps with his pick; never digs at dusk
Quirk: counts teeth

npcs.name: Boss Ganzo
npcs.info:
Boss of the plain loggers' camp pushing into the wood for the capital's lumber merchants, fifty, broad and impatient. In person: broad logger boss; beard; rolled sleeves; an axe.

**Home Ground:** Saw Line at Loggers' Camp, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, impatient and greedy; he talks about deadlines. Loud and impatient, talking in deadlines when work is on, his fist on the table for emphasis. He calls workers by their crew numbers. Tell: when the wood is mentioned he blusters louder, which is how you know he's scared.
**Combat Role:** an axe and thirty loggers.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him what the fox gift means before he insults the Court by ignoring it.
personality: Core: swears at trees; counts logs; keeps the fox gift unopened
Quirk: talks about deadlines

npcs.name: Boss Ganzo
npcs.info:
Boss of the loggers' camp after the war, fifty-two, broad and impatient still, cutting at the edge of a wood that grew back over his road. A handful of men stayed. In person: broad logger boss; beard gone grey; rolled sleeves; a notched axe; saplings shoulder-high behind him.

**Home Ground:** Saw Line, After the War at Loggers' Camp, The Swallowed Camp, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, impatient and greedy; he talks about deadlines. Loud and impatient, talking in deadlines when work is on, his fist on the table for emphasis. He calls workers by their crew numbers. Tell since the war: he counts saplings aloud the way he once counted crews, and swears at each one.
**Combat Role:** an axe and thirty loggers.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him what the fox gift means before he insults the Court by ignoring it.
personality: Core: swears at trees; counts logs; keeps the fox gift unopened
Quirk: talks about deadlines

npcs.name: Boulder-Keeper Tenzo
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Boulder, who sweeps the chips away each morning into a pile as tall as he is and says the boulder is slightly smaller than it was. He has watched a thousand hunters fail and never laughed. In person: adult man; lean and quiet; shaved head; a monk's grey robe with a straw broom; gentle.

**Home Ground:** The Cutting Ground at The Boulder, Sun Peak, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Soft-spoken and patient; he talks about the boulder the way other men talk about a difficult friend. Soft-spoken and patient, the boulder talked of like a difficult friend; nobody is laughed at. Tell: the new mark mentioned and his patience shakes.
**Combat Role:** a monk's staff, used mostly to lean on.
**Relationship Hook:** Sweep with him one morning and he shows you the new mark and asks what you make of it.
personality: Core: sweeps chips each dawn; talks of the boulder as a friend; never laughs at a failure
Quirk: measures the boulder with a knotted cord

npcs.name: Bounty Exile of the Hut
npcs.info:
A lean exile in patched officer's furs with two short swords and a bounty list on a cord. Bounty exiles hunt deserters for Warden coin and drink it at the officers' stove. A stock foe, one of many. In person: lean exile; two short swords; a bounty list.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and wry, the bounty list read like a menu. Tell: at her own name on the list she laughs too loud.
**Combat Role:** two short swords in close, a kick into the stove
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drinks on the job; fights dirty; never sits with her back to the door
Quirk: reads the list aloud

npcs.name: Breach Wrecker
npcs.info:
A raider in salt-stiff leathers with a boarding axe and a coil of grapnel rope, climbing in through the fort's breach. Wreckers strip the old fort of iron and bronze at low tide and gut anyone who finds them at it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: sea raider; climbing.

**Speaking Style:** Short orders over the surf. Short orders pitched over the surf, every word a count or a command, a two-note whistle for the crew. Tell: near the guns' old house crest she drops to a mutter.
**Combat Role:** up the breach on a grapnel, then the axe
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: weighs metal by hand; whistles to the crew; cuts rope rather than lose it
Quirk: climbs before she walks

npcs.name: Breach Wrecker
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
A raider who no longer climbs in through the breach: the garrison walked home and her crew works the abandoned fort's sea wall as a quay, landing Brine Tide cargo in daylight. A stock foe, one of many. In person: sea raider; salt-stiff leathers under a navy officer's stolen coat; a boarding axe; a coil of grapnel rope worn as a sash.

**Speaking Style:** Short orders over the surf. Short orders pitched over the surf, every word a count or a command, a two-note whistle for the crew. Tell since the war: she calls the fort my quay, and dares anyone to say otherwise.
**Combat Role:** up the breach on a grapnel, then the axe
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: weighs metal by hand; lands cargo in daylight; cuts rope rather than lose it
Quirk: climbs before she walks

npcs.name: Bridge Paper Crane Swarm
npcs.info:
A swarm of folded paper cranes woken by a careless student, slicing at anything on the bridge. Runaway crane swarms attack whoever crosses the bridge until the folder calls them back. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swarm of folded paper cranes with ink eyes slicing.

**Speaking Style:** A rustle of paper, a hundred tiny voices. Tell: near the letter the rustling softens.
**Combat Role:** a rustling swarm of paper cuts
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: slice; rustle; protect the letter
Quirk: swirl

npcs.name: Brine Tide Captain Sakon
npcs.info:
A Brine Tide captain, forty-four, who drinks openly in Ashiura's stilt market now that the Tide flies its own flags. In person: smuggler captain; scarred bald head; gold earring; navy coat taken from a dead officer; a bottle.

**Home Ground:** Stilt Market, After the War at Ashiura, Under Smugglers' Flags, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough and slow, a sea captain's growl that never bothers to threaten. A slow sea growl that never bothers to threaten. Tell: when the fishwife's son is mentioned he drinks before he answers.
**Combat Role:** a cutlass and his crew.
**Relationship Hook:** Free the crews he is about to lose and the fishwife's debt is paid.
personality: Core: drinks from the bottle; pays in navy silver; laughs at bounty notices
Quirk: never sits near the water

npcs.name: Brine Tide Smuggler
npcs.info:
A smuggler in salt-stained clothes with a boat knife and a coil of rope. Brine Tide smugglers run cargo through the marsh channels and fight only to save the cargo. A stock foe, one of many. In person: coast smuggler; a boat knife; rope.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and sly, smooth talk about 'cargo' and 'friends of the house'. Smugglers speak in winks. Tell: when the cargo is touched the easy talk becomes a blade.
**Combat Role:** a knife and a quick boat
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs at the navy; knows the channels; bribes first
Quirk: protects the cargo

npcs.name: Brine Tide Smuggler
npcs.location: The Drowned Lantern, Lantern of the New Masters
npcs.info:
A smuggler who drinks at the tap of the Brine Tide's open headquarters and runs cargo in daylight under the Tide's flag, laughing at a navy that is ash in the delta. A stock foe, one of many. In person: coast smuggler; a navy rope belt; a Brine Tide flag-cloth tied at the arm; a salvaged navy short sword.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and sly, smooth talk about 'cargo' and 'friends of the house'. Smugglers speak in winks. Tell since the war: he laughs at the navy out of habit, then looks at the burned ribs in the delta and stops.
**Combat Role:** a knife and a quick boat
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drinks in the open; knows the channels; asks about the crates now
Quirk: protects the cargo

npcs.name: Brother Ganseki
npcs.info:
A huge warrior monk who keeps the toll huts at the Hanging Bridge Pass and breaks the boulders that fall on the road with his bare hands. He carries a sword he has not drawn since he took his vows. In person: adult man; huge muscular monk; shaved head; kind broad face; saffron and grey monk robes with one sleeve tied back; prayer beads; a sheathed sword; smiling.

**Home Ground:** Toll Huts at Hanging Bridge Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Booming and kind, slow to speak, laughing deep in his chest; he blesses everyone who pays the toll. Booming and gentle, words rolled slowly in his chest, a blessing tacked onto everything. Tell: an insult and he cracks his knuckles before he forgives it.
**Combat Role:** open-hand and hilt strikes that land twice; armour and stone break on the second impact.
**Relationship Hook:** Break rocks with him for a day.
personality: Core: laughs deep in his chest; pays the toll for the poor; cracks his knuckles before thinking
Quirk: blesses toll-payers

npcs.name: Brother Ganseki
npcs.location: Hanging Bridge Pass, The War-Line Pass
npcs.info:
The huge warrior monk after the war, who keeps the toll huts at the Hanging Bridge Pass as neutral ground since Denpachi was killed on the bridge. Patrols of both villages cross under truce flags because he stands in the middle. He has not drawn his sword. In person: huge monk; shaved head; kind broad face gone grim; saffron and grey robes; prayer beads; a sheathed sword; truce flags behind him.

**Home Ground:** Toll Huts, After the War at Hanging Bridge Pass, The War-Line Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Booming and kind, slow to speak, laughing deep in his chest; he blesses everyone who pays the toll. Booming and gentle, words rolled slowly in his chest, a blessing tacked onto everything. Tell since the war: he says Denpachi's name with every blessing on the bridge, and the blessing gets shorter after it.
**Combat Role:** open-hand and hilt strikes that land twice; armour and stone break on the second impact.
**Relationship Hook:** Break rocks with him for a day.
personality: Core: laughs deep in his chest; pays the toll for the poor; cracks his knuckles before thinking
Quirk: blesses toll-payers

npcs.name: Brother Jikai of the Herbs
npcs.info:
A temple monk who tends the herb terraces below the mountain temple and argues with the one-eyed boar every night. In person: kind middle-aged monk tending mountain herb terraces with a basket; temple above.

**Home Ground:** Herb Terraces at Monks' Herb Fields, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and kind, a monk who names every herb and prays for the boar that eats them. Slow and kind, every herb named lovingly. Tell: about the far terrace he talks about mint a little too much.
**Combat Role:** a temple staff, gently.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the far terrace and he changes the subject to mint.
personality: Core: names every herb; prays for the boar; sells to a stranger
Quirk: smells of mint

npcs.name: Brother Jikai of the Herbs
npcs.location: Monks' Herb Fields, The Failed Fields
npcs.info:
The temple's herb monk after the war, whose terraces have failed two harvests running: the herb that dulls the beast's voice will not grow in ground that took this much blood. In person: kind monk with an empty basket; withered terraces; the boar's tracks among them.

**Home Ground:** Herb Terraces, After the War at Monks' Herb Fields, The Failed Fields, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and kind, a monk who names every herb and prays for the boar that eats them. Slow and kind, every herb named lovingly. Tell since the war: he names the herbs that no longer grow first, as if they were still on the terraces.
**Combat Role:** a temple staff, gently.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the far terrace and he changes the subject to mint.
personality: Core: names every herb; prays for the boar; sells to a stranger
Quirk: smells of mint

npcs.name: Brother Jun
npcs.info:
A curse-hunter of the Brotherhood, twenty-six, the elder's best student: tall, quiet, bound in prayer strips over a curse he carries on purpose so he can taste others. Shrines hire him; curse-layers know his face. He is courteous to everyone and close to no one, and he keeps every person at a vow's length. In person: tall quiet curse-hunter; black hair tied back; calm distant grey eyes; dark robes with arms bound; an iron-capped staff; reserved.

**Home Ground:** Record Room at Curse-Hunters' Chapterhouse, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, courteous and distant; every sentence keeps a vow's length between you. When it slips, he sounds his age. Courteous distance, formal phrasing, a vow's measured cadence. Tell: when he cares about someone, the formality slips and he sounds young and tired.
**Combat Role:** a curse turned back, iron strips that bind, and a staff; methodical and very hard to stop.
**Relationship Hook:** Hunt a curse-maker at his side and he trusts your hands; ask about his sister and the vow's length shrinks.
**Courtship Style:** Formal, careful and kind at arm's length; his courtship is letting you rewrap his prayer strips.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes perfectly courteous to the rival and very quiet with you; asks, later, whether you would rather he left.
personality: Core: rewraps his prayer strips at night; eats standing; says his sister's name only when he is alone
Quirk: keeps a vow's length

npcs.name: Brother Jun
npcs.info:
A curse-hunter of the Brotherhood after the war, twenty-eight, worked to exhaustion in the breaking hall: every curse the war left needs breaking. Elder Kanemitsu died breaking one, and Jun was there. In person: tall quiet curse-hunter; black hair tied back; distant grey eyes ringed with sleeplessness; prayer strips bound to both shoulders now; a sealed niche behind him.

**Home Ground:** Record Room, After the War at Curse-Hunters' Chapterhouse, Chapterhouse Under Siege, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, courteous and distant; every sentence keeps a vow's length between you. When it slips, he sounds his age. Courteous distance, formal phrasing, a vow's measured cadence. Tell since the war: when he prays aloud he stops a word early, as if waiting for something else to finish the line.
**Combat Role:** a curse turned back, iron strips that bind, and a staff; methodical and very hard to stop.
**Relationship Hook:** Hunt a curse-maker at his side and he trusts your hands; ask about his sister and the vow's length shrinks.
**Courtship Style:** Formal, careful and kind at arm's length; his courtship is letting you rewrap his prayer strips.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes perfectly courteous to the rival and very quiet with you; asks, later, whether you would rather he left.
personality: Core: rewraps his prayer strips at night; eats standing; says his sister's name only when he is alone
Quirk: keeps a vow's length

npcs.name: Brother Seiji
npcs.info:
A young curse-hunter, twenty-four, exploring the ruins of the old capital with a lantern and a notebook. In person: excited curse-hunter scholar; messy hair; ink-smeared notebook; prayer-strip bound sleeves.

**Home Ground:** Ruined Palace at Ruins of the Old Capital, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Excited, fast and reckless; he talks about the dead like a scholar on a dig. Excited, fast, scholar's enthusiasm, interrupts himself with discoveries. Tell: when the names are threatened, he becomes very serious and protective.
**Combat Role:** a curse-breaking chant and a short staff; he runs at the wrong moment.
**Relationship Hook:** Get the list out of the Blight safely and he gives it to whoever will use it to lay the dead to rest.
personality: Core: talks like a scholar; copies everything; forgets to be afraid
Quirk: keeps the list on his body

npcs.name: Brother Seiji
npcs.location: Ruins of the Old Capital, The Waking Ruins
npcs.info:
The young curse-hunter after the war, twenty-six, who leads the chapterhouse since Elder Kanemitsu died breaking a war curse. He is too young for it and knows it. In person: curse-hunter scholar; messy hair cut short; a notebook; prayer-strip sleeves; the elder's staff.

**Home Ground:** Ruined Palace, After the War at Ruins of the Old Capital, The Waking Ruins, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Excited, fast and reckless; he talks about the dead like a scholar on a dig. Excited, fast, scholar's enthusiasm, interrupts himself with discoveries. Tell since the war: he reads the names on his list in a whisper, and checks the doorway before each one.
**Combat Role:** a curse-breaking chant and a short staff; he runs at the wrong moment.
**Relationship Hook:** Get the list out of the Blight safely and he gives it to whoever will use it to lay the dead to rest.
personality: Core: talks like a scholar; copies everything; forgets to be afraid
Quirk: keeps the list on his body

npcs.name: Bunbuku the Shape-Thief
npcs.info:
A round young tanuki with a leaf on his head who practises other people's faces in the bamboo and sells the faces of travellers who sleep too deeply at the tanuki market. In person: round tanuki yokai; leaf; mischievous grin; patched straw coat.

**Home Ground:** Bamboo Corridor at Whispering Bamboo, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Giggling and fast, every sentence a dare. Giggling and fast, borrowed voices tried on mid-sentence, every line a dare. Tell: scared, he forgets which voice he is wearing and squeaks like a tanuki.
**Combat Role:** a puff of smoke and someone else's face.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the face he stole and he trades it back for a better joke.
personality: Core: never wears his own face in the market; trades in faces; flees from dogs
Quirk: giggles at his own jokes

npcs.name: Bunbuku the Shape-Thief
npcs.location: Whispering Bamboo, The Bamboo of Written Names
npcs.info:
A round young tanuki who no longer sells travellers' faces: he wears soldiers' faces now and collects back pay from the houses' paymasters, who paid half their armies in leaf money anyway. In person: round tanuki yokai; a soldier's straw hat over the leaf; a mischievous grin gone sly; a stolen paymaster's satchel.

**Home Ground:** Bamboo Corridor, After the War at Whispering Bamboo, The Bamboo of Written Names, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Giggling and fast, every sentence a dare. Giggling and fast, borrowed voices tried on mid-sentence, every line a dare. Tell since the war: he touches his sleeve, where the face is folded, whenever he lies.
**Combat Role:** a puff of smoke and someone else's face.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the face he stole and he trades it back for a better joke.
personality: Core: wears soldiers' faces; trades in back pay; flees from dogs
Quirk: giggles at his own jokes

npcs.name: Bunk-Hall Keeper Fuyu
npcs.info:
The keeper of the bunk hall behind the Lodges, who keeps the stove lit and the quiet kept for a yard of exhausted trainees. She knows who sleeps badly and why. In person: adult female; small and quiet; hair; a padded winter kimono; a lamp; gentle.

**Home Ground:** The Bunk Hall at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Hushed and kind; she speaks as if someone is always asleep nearby, which is true. A hush, kind and constant, as if someone is always asleep nearby. Tell: asked whose bunk the empty one is, she answers quieter still.
**Combat Role:** none; she wakes the hall and the hall deals with it.
**Relationship Hook:** Sleep badly and she brings you tea without asking why; ask whose the empty bunk is and she tells you, quietly.
personality: Core: speaks in a hush; knows who sleeps badly; keeps the stove going all night
Quirk: makes up the empty bunk daily

npcs.name: Bureau Petition-Clerk Tokiwa
npcs.info:
Petition-clerk at Seimei's lake gate, who takes the town's complaints about hauntings and runaway familiars and posts the ones the Bureau will pay to have settled. In person: adult woman; bureau petition clerk with talisman tags; dark green robes; salt dish.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post at Seimei, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and a little haunted; she lowers her voice for the names of spirits. Quiet and careful, almost a whisper for the names of spirits, a pinch of salt rattling. Tell: lying about a petition, she straightens papers that are already straight.
**Combat Role:** a ward-tag thrown and a run for the gate.
**Relationship Hook:** Settle a petition she renamed and she tells you whose familiar it really was.
personality: Core: lowers her voice for spirits; sorts petitions by colour; thanks hunters formally
Quirk: keeps a salt dish on the counter

npcs.name: Bureau Petition-Clerk Tokiwa
npcs.area: Lake Gate Post, After the War
npcs.info:
Petition-clerk at the lake gate after the war, who takes petitions from refugees on the shore through a slot in the gate and posts the ones the Bureau will pay to settle. Most it will not. In person: petition clerk; talisman tags; dark green robes faded; a salt dish; a stack of petitions she has not posted.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and a little haunted; she lowers her voice for the names of spirits. Quiet and careful, almost a whisper for the names of spirits, a pinch of salt rattling. Tell since the war: she reads a refugee's petition aloud in full before she says no, every time.
**Combat Role:** a ward-tag thrown and a run for the gate.
**Relationship Hook:** Settle a petition she renamed and she tells you whose familiar it really was.
personality: Core: lowers her voice for spirits; sorts petitions by colour; thanks hunters formally
Quirk: keeps a salt dish on the counter

npcs.name: Bureau Ward-Scribe
npcs.info:
