An onmyoji in white Bureau robes with a case of talismans and a paper crane on her shoulder. Ward-scribes guard the Bureau's archives and the city's wards with paper and seals. A stock foe, one of many. In person: onmyoji scribe; talisman case; paper crane.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and superior; ward-scribes correct your pronunciation of talisman names. They rustle paper constantly. Tell: when a ward fails they speak faster and higher.
**Combat Role:** a barrier, then burning talismans, a crane for help
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: corrects your posture; sends a crane for help; cites the regulations
Quirk: throws talismans first

npcs.name: Bureau Ward-Scribe
npcs.location: Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Silent Bureau
npcs.info:
An onmyoji in white Bureau robes who walks the new second ward wall restringing charms the refugees pull down for fuel. Ward-scribes keep the lake gate and turn the refugees away twice a day. A stock foe, one of many. In person: onmyoji scribe; white robes grey at the hem; a talisman case strapped across the chest; a paper crane with one torn wing.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and superior; ward-scribes correct your pronunciation of talisman names. They rustle paper constantly. Tell since the war: she cites the regulation, then the number of refugees turned away that day, in the same tone.
**Combat Role:** a barrier, then burning talismans, a crane for help
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: restrings the charms; cites the regulations; never looks at the shore
Quirk: throws talismans first

npcs.name: Buyer Shinpei
npcs.info:
A swordsman soaking in the inn's hot spring, thirty, waiting for a commission, who has recognised another buyer. In person: cool swordsman relaxing; wet hair; faint smile; a sword wrapped.

**Home Ground:** Steam Bath at Hot Spring Inn, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, cool and amused; he talks to the steam. Easy, cool and amused, talking half to you and half to the steam rising from the bath. He hums a gambler's tune. Tell: when the price of a soul-blade is questioned he laughs, too long.
**Combat Role:** a fine blade and a buyer's patience.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him there is another buyer and he panics.
personality: Core: soaks for hours; watches the other buyer; never names his lord
Quirk: talks to the steam

npcs.name: Buyer Shinpei
npcs.location: Hot Spring Inn, The Buyers' Inn
npcs.info:
A swordsman soaking in the inn's spring after the war, thirty-two, among house agents and foreign captains bidding openly for soul-forged blades. He outbids them all. In person: cool swordsman; wet hair; a faint smile gone thin; a wrapped sword; a broken blade in a box beside him.

**Home Ground:** Steam Bath, After the War at Hot Spring Inn, The Buyers' Inn, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, cool and amused; he talks to the steam. Easy, cool and amused, talking half to you and half to the steam rising from the bath. He hums a gambler's tune. Tell since the war: his gambler's tune stops when he outbids someone, and he sounds sorry about it.
**Combat Role:** a fine blade and a buyer's patience.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him there is another buyer and he panics.
personality: Core: soaks for hours; watches the other buyer; never names his lord
Quirk: talks to the steam

npcs.name: Captain Arakawa Jinnai
npcs.info:
The Regent's new captain at the thrown-down Cedar Pass barrier, forty, sent to rebuild it with twenty men and no money. Captain Nagai died when it fell; his lieutenant fled with the treasury. In person: samurai captain; grim weathered face; plain dark armour; a spear; rebuilding a broken mountain barrier gate.

**Home Ground:** Pass Gate, After the War at Cedar Pass Barrier, Thrown-Down Barrier, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and sparing, a man who answers in as few words as the question allows. As few words as the question allows, then silence. Tell: at the word treasury he says one word more than he needs to.
**Combat Role:** a spear behind the half-built gate.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him take back the treasury from the fort and the pass is open to you for good.
personality: Core: counts his men morning and night; rebuilds with his own hands; drinks alone
Quirk: keeps Nagai's marker clean

npcs.name: Captain Ishimura
npcs.info:
Captain of the Ishimura band, forty, broad, scarred and cheerful, who holds the best table in the Ronin Hiring Hall. His band is booked a year ahead, and he wants more than bookings. In person: burly ronin captain; wild topknot; scarred grinning face; open dark haori; a long sword; charismatic.

**Home Ground:** Captains' Tables at Ronin Hiring Hall, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Big, laughing and persuasive; he talks like a man selling a dream to people who can afford it. Big laughing voice, salesman's rhythm, every sentence ends on a promise. Slaps the table for emphasis. Tell: when a deal goes bad, the laugh stays but his eyes and words go flat.
**Combat Role:** a long blade and sixty friends; he leads from the front.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him turn the two bands on the people who sent them and you have a seat at his table.
personality: Core: buys the room a round; calls every ronin brother; keeps the contracts in his boot
Quirk: never sits with his back to Gonroku

npcs.name: Captain Kajiwara
npcs.info:
Captain of the toll barrier at Oiwake Station, the busiest on the road, forty, well-fed and friendly, who waves the right people through and makes the wrong ones wait in the rain. In person: plump friendly barrier captain; wide grin; Warden's blue coat stretched; a sheaf of papers.

**Home Ground:** Toll Barrier at Oiwake Station, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, cheerful and corrupt; he calls everyone friend and charges them for it. Easy and friendly, quick to call anyone 'friend', a cheerful price never far behind. Chuckles at his own bribes. Tell: when a superior is near, the friendliness vanishes into formal grunts.
**Combat Role:** a spear behind twenty guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay his fee and the road opens; need blank papers and he names a price.
personality: Core: calls everyone friend; eats on duty; never looks at a face he has been paid not to see
Quirk: keeps blank papers in his sleeve

npcs.name: Captain Mori Sayo
npcs.info:
Captain of Princess Ayame's sworn guard, thirty-five, a plain-born samurai woman with a naginata and a scar through one eyebrow. She stands outside the princess's screens day and night, and the court ladies find her rude. In person: female samurai guard captain; short black hair; a scar; stern eyes; dark armour; naginata; lotus lanterns.

**Home Ground:** Princess Ayame's Rooms at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Short orders and shorter answers; she softens only when she talks about the plain. Parade-ground economy: subject, verb, done. Never uses a title she does not have to. Tell: when she speaks of the plain or the princess her vowels lengthen and she almost smiles.
**Combat Role:** naginata, reach and corridors; she holds a doorway against anyone.
**Relationship Hook:** Show her you would take Ayame's side against the court and she lets you past the screens.
personality: Core: stands with her back to the wall; calls the princess by name in private; checks the screens twice at night
Quirk: hates poetry

npcs.name: Captain Nagai
npcs.info:
Captain of the Cedar Pass Barrier, forty, cold and thorough, who checks every pass and every woman's face for runaways. Nobody gets through his gate without paying. In person: cold barrier captain; thin moustache; flat eyes; Warden's dark coat.

**Home Ground:** Pass Gate at Cedar Pass Barrier, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold, formal and bored; he reads your papers aloud slowly. Cold, bored, reading papers aloud slowly and pointedly. Taps the counter with a seal. Tell: when he suspects someone he becomes very polite.
**Combat Role:** the gate closes and twelve spears come out.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay him, or make him believe the courtesan is worth less caught, and the gate opens.
personality: Core: checks women's faces twice; takes his share in silver only; never smiles
Quirk: reads papers aloud

npcs.name: Captain Odaka
npcs.info:
Captain Odaka of the Brine Tide, forty-five, one of its three senior captains: a big, laughing smuggler with gold teeth and a boarding axe, who settles quarrels and divides cargoes in the back room of the Drowned Lantern. In person: big laughing smuggler captain; gold teeth; braided beard; salt-stained coat; a boarding axe; lantern light.

**Home Ground:** Back Room at The Drowned Lantern, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough, laughing and dangerous; he speaks in toasts and threats in the same breath. Rough laughter and toasts, threats in the same breath as a cheer. Bangs his cup. Tell: when he is deciding whether to kill someone, he stops laughing and refills your cup.
**Combat Role:** boarding axe and a crew at his back; he prefers to leave by sea.
**Relationship Hook:** Find him a way to keep the auction's gold without drowning his own crew and he owes you a ship.
personality: Core: bites coins; laughs at danger; never drinks with a crew he means to drown
Quirk: toasts before threats

npcs.name: Captain Odaka
npcs.location: The Drowned Lantern, Lantern of the New Masters
npcs.info:
Captain Odaka of the Brine Tide after the war, forty-seven, one of its senior captains, laughing in the Drowned Lantern's tap room with nothing left to hide. In person: big laughing smuggler captain; more gold teeth; braided beard; a salvaged navy coat; a boarding axe.

**Home Ground:** Back Room, After the War at The Drowned Lantern, Lantern of the New Masters, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough, laughing and dangerous; he speaks in toasts and threats in the same breath. Rough laughter and toasts, threats in the same breath as a cheer. Bangs his cup. Tell since the war: he raises a toast to the girl in the crate before every other toast, and does not say why.
**Combat Role:** boarding axe and a crew at his back; he prefers to leave by sea.
**Relationship Hook:** Find him a way to keep the auction's gold without drowning his own crew and he owes you a ship.
personality: Core: bites coins; laughs at danger; never drinks with a crew he means to drown
Quirk: toasts before threats

npcs.name: Captain Shirasagi Ren
npcs.info:
A captain of the Veil Court's Ferry Division, who looks twenty-six and has ferried the dead for ninety years. Precise, aloof and immaculate in her black coat, she finds the living tiresome and says so. In person: aloof Veil Court captain; pale silver-white hair cut sharply; cold violet eyes; immaculate black officer's coat; a soul-blade; cool expression.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Cliff at Tasogare, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold, clipped and by the book; she sounds bored by the living. When she is moved, she goes quieter, not warmer. Cold, clipped regulation phrasing, every sentence filed and stamped. She sounds faintly bored by danger and taps her gauntlet against her sword guard while she waits. Tell: when the lost child is mentioned she goes quieter and stops looking at the speaker.
**Combat Role:** exact soul-blade forms, never a wasted motion; she ends hungry spirits like paperwork.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a soul she failed to reach and she looks at you for the first time.
**Courtship Style:** Treats you as paperwork until you help with a soul; then she logs your name in her black book, which she has never done for the living.
**Jealousy Style:** Writes the rival's name in her book under 'tiresome' and shows you.
personality: Core: keeps her coat immaculate; logs every soul in a black book; watches the lanterns drift out at night
Quirk: finds the living tiresome

npcs.name: Captain Shirasagi Ren
npcs.info:
A captain of the Veil Court's Ferry Division after the war, who looks twenty-six and has ferried more of the dead in two years than in ninety. Precise, aloof and immaculate still; the living are less tiresome now that she needs them. In person: aloof Veil Court captain; pale silver-white hair cut sharply; cold violet eyes with shadows beneath; immaculate black coat; a soul-blade.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Cliff, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold, clipped and by the book; she sounds bored by the living. When she is moved, she goes quieter, not warmer. Cold, clipped regulation phrasing, every sentence filed and stamped. She sounds faintly bored by danger and taps her gauntlet against her sword guard while she waits. Tell since the war: she stops tapping her gauntlet when the procession passes, and does not start again until it is gone.
**Combat Role:** exact soul-blade forms, never a wasted motion; she ends hungry spirits like paperwork.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a soul she failed to reach and she looks at you for the first time.
**Courtship Style:** Treats you as paperwork until you help with a soul; then she logs your name in her black book, which she has never done for the living.
**Jealousy Style:** Writes the rival's name in her book under 'tiresome' and shows you.
personality: Core: keeps her coat immaculate; logs every soul in a black book; watches the lanterns drift out at night
Quirk: finds the living tiresome

npcs.name: Captain Uosuke
npcs.info:
A Brine Tide captain, forty, scarred and cheerful, who runs cargo through the sea cave at the island's southern tip every new moon and pays the empty island no rent. In person: adult man; forty; broad; scarred cheek; a short black beard; a red bandana; an open sea-coat; a hooked boarding axe; gold earrings.

**Home Ground:** Cove Mouth at Smugglers' Cove, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Rough and easy, a captain's growl, friendly until the moment he is not. Rough easy captain's growl, friendly to a fault, a sea-shanty whistled between offers. Tell: the whistle starts right before the threat.
**Combat Role:** the hook to pull you off balance, then his crew.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him in the cove at the new moon and he will offer you a share before he offers you a fight.
personality: Core: friendly first, practical always; keeps his word to anyone who could hurt him
Quirk: whistles the same sea-shanty when he is about to threaten someone

npcs.name: Cave Wreck-Raider
npcs.info:
A salt-scarred raider in a sharkskin vest with a boarding axe and a coil of wet rope. Wreck-raiders loot what the reef breaks and cut the throats of anyone who saw the ship go down. A stock foe, one of many. In person: scarred sea raider; sharkskin vest; boarding axe; wet rope coil; sea cave mouth.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and amused. Hoarse, amused, salt in every syllable, laughing through her teeth. She whistles signals between lines. Tell: hurt, the laugh goes and the voice drops flat and fast.
**Combat Role:** snare and axe in the surf
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grins with gold teeth; keeps a dead captain's ring; never fights uphill
Quirk: tests the tide

npcs.name: Cave Wreck-Raider
npcs.info:
A salt-scarred raider in a sharkskin vest guarding the Brine Tide's stacks of arms in the caves instead of looting wrecks. A stock foe, one of many. In person: scarred sea raider; sharkskin vest under a captured lacquered breastplate; a boarding axe; a wet rope coil.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and amused. Hoarse, amused, salt in every syllable, laughing through her teeth. She whistles signals between lines. Tell since the war: she taps the stolen breastplate and names the army it came from.
**Combat Role:** snare and axe in the surf
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grins with gold teeth; guards arms; never fights uphill
Quirk: tests the tide

npcs.name: Chain-Path Ascetic
npcs.info:
A gaunt mountain ascetic in white with a ringed staff and chains wound round his forearms. Chain-path ascetics test every climber who comes up the peak and throw the unworthy back down. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gaunt mountain ascetic; ringed staff; chains wound round the forearms.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, all heavy. Single heavy words with long silences between. Tell: impressed, he says two words instead of one.
**Combat Role:** staff and chain, a test, never a killing blow
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rings his staff before striking; never eats in front of anyone; bows to the mountain
Quirk: speaks in single words

npcs.name: Channel Mud Wraith
npcs.info:
A shape of marsh mud rising from the old paddies under the water. Mud wraiths drag boats and people down. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mud wraith; a shape of marsh mud rising from reed channels.

**Speaking Style:** A sucking gurgle, words drowned in mud. Tell: it breathes in when it means to drown you.
**Combat Role:** drag and smother
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drags; slow; fills lungs
Quirk: rises

npcs.name: Channel Mud Wraith
npcs.location: Reed Channels, Channels of the Lost Patrols
npcs.info:
A shape of marsh mud risen from the old paddies, wearing what is left of a navy patrolman; the lost patrols' lanterns drift in the maze, and the wraiths carry them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mud wraith; a shape of marsh mud; a navy patrolman's rotted cap; a drowned patrol lantern in one hand.

**Speaking Style:** A sucking gurgle, words drowned in mud. Tell since the war: a drowned patrolman's call comes out of it, the same three words.
**Combat Role:** drag and smother
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drags; carries a lantern; wears the dead
Quirk: rises

npcs.name: Chidori the Runner
npcs.info:
A young smuggler's runner, eighteen, who poles a flat boat through the reed channels faster than anyone and carries messages for the Brine Tide. In person: cheeky smuggler runner; short hair; rolled sleeves; poling a flat boat.

**Home Ground:** Channel Maze at Reed Channels, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky and breathless; she talks while poling, words coming in time with each push. She whistles to the gulls. Tell: when the patrol boats appear she stops talking mid-word and poles faster.
**Combat Role:** a pole and the fog.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay her and she takes you through the maze; pay double and she goes in at night.
personality: Core: laughs at the navy; knows every channel; never goes in at night
Quirk: talks while poling

npcs.name: Chidori the Runner
npcs.epithet: Guide of the Long Way Round
npcs.location: Reed Channels, Channels of the Lost Patrols
npcs.info:
A smuggler's runner after the war, twenty, who guides Brine Tide boats the long way round the reed channels for pay. Nobody takes the short way now. In person: smuggler runner; short hair; rolled sleeves; poling a flat boat; a lantern she will not light.

**Home Ground:** Channel Maze, After the War at Reed Channels, Channels of the Lost Patrols, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky and breathless; she talks while poling, words coming in time with each push. She whistles to the gulls. Tell since the war: she never says her brother's name; she says 'the third tiller' and looks away.
**Combat Role:** a pole and the fog.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay her and she takes you through the maze; pay double and she goes in at night.
personality: Core: laughs at the navy; knows every channel; never goes in at night
Quirk: talks while poling

npcs.name: Child Hunter Kaito
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.info:
A Breath Hunter recruit, fifteen, who fought on the wall the night it fell and was made a full hunter the next morning because there was no one else. In person: young demon hunter; messy dark hair; oversized dark uniform; a sun-steel sword too large for him.

**Home Ground:** Hunters' Mess, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and too fast, a boy's voice making an old hunter's reports. A boy's voice making an old hunter's reports, too fast. Tell: describing a demon he names its face first, and then its kind.
**Combat Role:** a sun-steel blade, two-handed, too fast.
**Relationship Hook:** Find out what became of his brother and he will follow you north.
personality: Core: reports too fast; eats in the mess's corner; trains at night
Quirk: looks at faces first

npcs.name: Clerk Mitsu
npcs.info:
The armoury clerk, thirty, who records every harness fitted and every crate shipped from the Kurogane armoury. In person: nervous armoury clerk; neat bun; ink brush; record books.

**Home Ground:** Fitting Room at Kurogane Armoury, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and frightened; she whispers numbers to herself to stay calm. She apologises for her handwriting. Tell: when the soul ledger comes up she stops whispering numbers and starts reading names.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Protect her and she gives you the true records.
personality: Core: whispers numbers; never meets Lady Sen's eyes; hides papers in harness linings
Quirk: keeps copies of everything

npcs.name: Clerk Mitsu
npcs.location: Kurogane Armoury, The Armoury of the Victors
npcs.info:
The armoury's clerk after the war, thirty-two, with record books stacked to the beams: harness for the Regent's peacekeeping companies, fitted by the hundred. In person: armoury clerk; neat bun coming loose; ink brush; towers of record books.

**Home Ground:** Fitting Room, After the War at Kurogane Armoury, The Armoury of the Victors, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and frightened; she whispers numbers to herself to stay calm. She apologises for her handwriting. Tell since the war: she stops whispering numbers and reads the names of the war's buyers instead, very softly.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Protect her and she gives you the true records.
personality: Core: whispers numbers; never meets Lady Sen's eyes; hides papers in harness linings
Quirk: keeps copies of everything

npcs.name: Cliff Mask Swarm
npcs.info:
A swarm of small white masks flying like bats. Swarming masks come up the cliffs on tide nights. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swarm of small white masks flying like bats.

**Speaking Style:** Many shrieks. Many small shrieks overlapping, each mask a different pitch. They giggle in waves. Tell: at sunrise the shrieks scatter one by one.
**Combat Role:** a swarm of biting masks
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: shriek; fly at lanterns; scatter in sun
Quirk: swarm

npcs.name: Cliff Mask Swarm
npcs.location: The Great Gate Cliffs, Cliffs of the Great Mask
npcs.info:
A swarm of small white masks that flies ahead of the great mask on tide nights, herding the dead along the cliffs towards its mouth. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swarm of small white masks; masks cracked at the brow; flying like bats in a spiral.

**Speaking Style:** Many shrieks. Many small shrieks overlapping, each mask a different pitch. They giggle in waves. Tell since the war: they shriek in one pitch, then turn together towards the sea.
**Combat Role:** a swarm of biting masks
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: shriek; herd the dead; scatter in sun
Quirk: swarm

npcs.name: Cliff Void Shade
npcs.info:
A hole in the shape of a man where the Veil is thin. Void shades unmake what they touch. A stock foe, one of many. In person: void shade; a man-shaped hole of darkness.

**Speaking Style:** Silence, then a whisper right at the ear. It speaks only when no one else is. Tell: in sunlight it fades mid-word.
**Combat Role:** an unmaking touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: unmakes; drifts; fades in sun
Quirk: silent

npcs.name: Cliff Void Shade
npcs.location: The Great Gate Cliffs, Cliffs of the Great Mask
npcs.info:
A hole in the shape of a man, more of them every month at the cliffs where the war's dead crowd the other side and the Veil wears thin. A stock foe, one of many. In person: void shade; a man-shaped hole of darkness; the outline of a soldier's helmet at its crown.

**Speaking Style:** Silence, then a whisper right at the ear. It speaks only when no one else is. Tell since the war: where it stands, a soldier's muster call echoes faintly.
**Combat Role:** an unmaking touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: unmakes; drifts; fades in sun
Quirk: silent

npcs.name: Coast Fort Deserter
npcs.info:
A soldier in a rusted Mizuchi cuirass with the crest scraped off and a matchlock gone green. Deserters hold the old fort, rob the coast road and shoot anyone in a house colour. A stock foe, one of many. In person: deserter foot soldier; old matchlock; crumbling sea wall.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and bitter. Tired, bitter and low, a soldier's clipped words with the courtesy worn off. He sighs before he shoots. Tell: a drum makes his voice jump and crack.
**Combat Role:** a volley from the wall, then spears
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: jumps at drums; shares food; will not go back
Quirk: scrapes crests off

npcs.name: Coast Fort Deserter
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
A soldier of the abandoned fort who sold his share of the last powder and walked home to find no home; he squats on the sea wall now with the smugglers, robbing the coast road in a cuirass with no crest at all. A stock foe, one of many. In person: deserter foot soldier; a rusted cuirass with no crest; a matchlock with no powder; a fisherman's straw cape.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and bitter. Tired, bitter and low, a soldier's clipped words with the courtesy worn off. He sighs before he shoots. Tell since the war: he still scrapes at a crest that is no longer there.
**Combat Role:** a volley from the wall, then spears
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: jumps at drums; robs the coast road; has no home to go back to
Quirk: scrapes crests off

npcs.name: Collector Moriya Tatsuzo
npcs.info:
A debt collector in a guild jacket with a ledger and a brush, thirty, who arrived at Saltpan two days ago and has not left. In person: neat debt collector; guild jacket; a ledger and a brush; a red thread round the wrist.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans at Saltpan Village, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Polite and reasonable, always sorry for the trouble. Polite and sorry, a little bow in the voice, endless apologies. Tell: asked a guild question he cannot answer, he apologises twice and changes the subject to mules.
**Combat Role:** he runs; the Lanterns come later.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him a guild question only a guild man would know and his smile slips.
personality: Core: apologises before every question; writes down mule numbers; eats with the headwoman uninvited
Quirk: keeps a red thread on his wrist

npcs.name: Collector Moriya Tatsuzo
npcs.info:
A debt collector, thirty-two, who came to Saltpan in a bought guild jacket and stayed when the guild really did take over the pans; he collects the salt tax every week now, for the guild and for the Lanterns both. In person: neat debt collector; a real guild jacket with a brass collector's badge; two ledgers tied together; a red thread round the wrist, frayed.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans, After the War at Saltpan Village, The Taxed Pans, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Polite and reasonable, always sorry for the trouble. Polite and sorry, a little bow in the voice, endless apologies. Tell since the war: he touches the red thread before he names a figure, and says the figure twice.
**Combat Role:** he runs; the Lanterns come later.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him a guild question only a guild man would know and his smile slips.
personality: Core: apologises before every question; counts twice; eats alone now
Quirk: keeps a red thread on his wrist

npcs.name: Commander Asahina Tetsu
npcs.info:
Commander of the Breath Hunters of Hinode, forty-five, iron-grey and scarred, who has held the fortress through twenty Demon Nights. Her hunters believe she can read the north; the Hold always seems to know where the demons will strike. In person: scarred iron-grey breath hunter commander; cropped grey hair; hard eyes; dark hunter's uniform with a sunrise haori; a sun-steel sword.

**Home Ground:** Commander's Tower at Hinode Fortress, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, steady and hard as frozen ground; she gives orders as if she has already counted the dead. Low and steady, a voice already counting the dead before the fight begins. She speaks in orders even when asking for tea. Tell: when her brother is mentioned she pauses, and the next order comes out softer.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath forms, immovable, and a sun-steel cut nothing survives.
**Relationship Hook:** Go north for her and ask the question she cannot, and she trains you.
personality: Core: counts the dead before the battle; trains recruits herself; never sleeps on Demon Nights
Quirk: keeps a child's wooden sword on her desk

npcs.name: Commander Asahina Tetsu
npcs.info:
Commander of the Breath Hunters after the war, forty-seven, iron-grey and more scarred, holding the north's last fortress with children in cut-down uniforms. Her map of the north has more black pins than white. In person: scarred breath hunter commander; cropped grey hair gone white at the temples; hard eyes; dark uniform with a sunrise haori; a sun-steel sword; a letter in her sleeve.

**Home Ground:** Commander's Tower, After the War at Hinode Fortress, The Last Fortress, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, steady and hard as frozen ground; she gives orders as if she has already counted the dead. Low and steady, a voice already counting the dead before the fight begins. She speaks in orders even when asking for tea. Tell since the war: she touches the letter in her sleeve before any order about the valleys, and the order comes later.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath forms, immovable, and a sun-steel cut nothing survives.
**Relationship Hook:** Go north for her and ask the question she cannot, and she trains you.
personality: Core: counts the dead before the battle; trains recruits herself; never sleeps on Demon Nights
Quirk: keeps a child's wooden sword on her desk

npcs.name: Commander Kirigaya Shion
npcs.info:
Commander of the Veil Court's post at Tasogare, centuries old in a body that looks forty, who stands watch at the great pale torii where the dead pass through. Her post is short of officers, the ferrying is weeks behind, and she has started doing the work of three. In person: weary Veil Court commander; long dark hair with a streak of white; calm tired eyes; black officer's coat with a white sash; a soul-blade.

**Home Ground:** The Great Pale Torii at Tasogare, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, measured and weary; an officer's calm stretched thin, with a dry humour that surprises people. Low, measured and weary, a commander's cadence that never wastes a breath. Dry humour arrives without warning and leaves without a smile. Tell: when the Court's law is raised she sighs once before answering, and the answer is always the law.
**Combat Role:** an officer's soul-blade and Ferry rites; she cuts the hungry dead in one stroke.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her ferry the backlog and she trains you as one of her living recruits.
personality: Core: stands at the torii at dawn; drinks bitter tea; never says 'impossible'
Quirk: trains recruits herself

npcs.name: Commander Kirigaya Shion
npcs.area: The Great Pale Torii, After the War
npcs.info:
Commander of the Veil Court's post at Tasogare after the war, centuries old in a body that looks forty-five now, standing watch at the great pale torii while the war's dead queue faster than her officers can ferry them. In person: weary Veil Court commander; long dark hair with more white; calm, exhausted eyes; black coat with a white sash; a soul-blade.

**Home Ground:** The Great Pale Torii, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, measured and weary; an officer's calm stretched thin, with a dry humour that surprises people. Low, measured and weary, a commander's cadence that never wastes a breath. Dry humour arrives without warning and leaves without a smile. Tell since the war: her single sigh before the law has become two, and the second is for herself.
**Combat Role:** an officer's soul-blade and Ferry rites; she cuts the hungry dead in one stroke.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her ferry the backlog and she trains you as one of her living recruits.
personality: Core: stands at the torii at dawn; drinks bitter tea; never says 'impossible'
Quirk: trains recruits herself

npcs.name: Cook Umeno
npcs.info:
The cook at the Thin Air Steps' first landing, who keeps a small blue fire going and a row of bowls full for anyone who makes it up gasping. She has kept one bowl warm for three days. In person: sturdy; grey hair tied; wind-chapped cheeks; a padded jacket; a ladle; warm.

**Home Ground:** The First Landing at The Thin Air Steps, Sun Peak, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, brisk and motherly in thin air; she feeds first and asks later. Warm and brisk, feeding first and asking later, a mother's voice in thin air. Tell: the warm bowl mentioned and her briskness goes soft.
**Combat Role:** a hunter's first breath form, rusty, and a very hot ladle.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat what she gives you and ask whose bowl the warm one is; she tells you, and then asks if you would go and look.
personality: Core: feeds first, asks later; talks to the fire; knows every hunter's name who passed
Quirk: keeps a bowl warm for the missing

npcs.name: Councillor Isobe Gentaro
npcs.location: Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks
npcs.info:
A guild councillor, fifty, master of the Debt Harbour's black-deck auctions, where rice, arms and dead captains' junks are sold before dawn. In person: older man; heavy guild councillor; fine dark silk; gold rings.

**Home Ground:** Deck Auction, After the War at Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Rich and slow, every word weighed like cargo. Rich, slow, each word weighed like cargo before he lets it go. Tell: at the word fish he changes the subject to rice.
**Combat Role:** never; the Brine Tide's boatmen guard the decks.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the fish letter, or bring it to the council, and either way the black decks change hands.
personality: Core: never eats fish; buys widows' junks first; pays the caller in silver
Quirk: stands on the highest deck

npcs.name: Courtier Tsukiyo Hanabusa
npcs.info:
A courtier of the Hidden Court, half-yokai himself and proud of both halves, who keeps a lantern-hung lodge on the Training Ground and teaches half-yokai who they are. He can read a lineage from across a room. In person: adult man; elegant; long silver hair with fox-pale streaks; amber eyes with a faint slit pupil; fine layered court robes; a closed fan; pleased.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, courteous and delighted by everything; every compliment has a second meaning and he lets you hear both. Soft court courtesy, delighted by everything, every compliment carrying a second meaning he lets you hear. Tell: reading a lineage, his voice slows and the second meaning drops away.
**Combat Role:** half-form speed and a courtier's fan; he disarms and shames, and kills only when shamed.
**Relationship Hook:** Let him name your lineage and do not flinch; he respects a half-yokai who hears it without shame.
personality: Core: compliments with two meanings; lights a lantern when pleased; never sits with his back to a tree
Quirk: reads lineages aloud

npcs.name: Crevasse Exile Hunter
npcs.info:
A scarred exile hunter in white furs with a harpoon, ice-crampons and a coil of rope. Crevasse hunters stalk escaped exiles across the ice and cut the ropes under them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: scarred exile hunter; harpoon; ice crampons; rope coil.

**Speaking Style:** Harsh and patient, spitting on the ice between threats. Tell: when his pardon is mentioned his voice thins.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon at range, then the rope
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: spits on the ice; talks about his pardon; cuts ropes
Quirk: never looks back

npcs.name: Crevasse Frost Spirit
npcs.info:
A drifting shape of ice crystals and cold light. Frost spirits drift over crevasses and freeze the lost. A stock foe, one of many. In person: frost spirit.

**Speaking Style:** A chiming hum, ice bells shaped into words. It follows warmth and says so. Tell: when someone is dying of cold it chimes softly, like a lullaby.
**Combat Role:** a freezing touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: freezes; hums; follows warmth
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Crevasse Frost Spirit
npcs.info:
A drifting shape of ice crystals lit blue from below, where the fissure from the Vaults opens under the field and the snow bridges no longer hold. A stock foe, one of many. In person: frost spirit; ice crystals veined with the Vaults' blue light; a chiming hum.

**Speaking Style:** A chiming hum, ice bells shaped into words. It follows warmth and says so. Tell since the war: its hum drops a note whenever the field shudders.
**Combat Role:** a freezing touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: freezes; chimes; follows the blue light
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Crow Tengu Thief
npcs.info:
A crow-headed tengu with black wings and a stolen sword. Crow tengu steal anything that glitters and fight for their hoard. A stock foe, one of many. In person: crow tengu; crow-headed yokai with black wings and a stolen sword.

**Speaking Style:** Cawing laughter and chattering boasts, words chopped short like pecks. It clacks its beak at shiny things. Tell: when it spots treasure it stops mid-taunt.
**Combat Role:** dive from above, grab, gone
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: caws insults; fights in numbers; hoards
Quirk: steals shiny things

npcs.name: Crow Tengu Thief
npcs.location: Crow Tengu Nests, Nests of War Plunder
npcs.info:
A crow-headed tengu that picked the northern battlefields clean, its wings hung with house crests and war fans. A stock foe, one of many. In person: crow tengu; crow-headed yokai with black wings; a stolen general's war fan; a string of house crests round its neck.

**Speaking Style:** Cawing laughter and chattering boasts, words chopped short like pecks. It clacks its beak at shiny things. Tell since the war: it caws a house's name each time it touches a crest.
**Combat Role:** dive from above, grab, gone
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: caws insults; fights in numbers; hoards crests
Quirk: steals shiny things

npcs.name: Daikokuya Genta
npcs.info:
The guild master's son and young master of the foreign quay, twenty-eight, sleek, clever and impatient, who wears a foreign coat over his kimono and runs the quay's warehouses at a profit his father calls reckless. In person: sleek merchant heir; slicked black hair; clever narrow eyes; foreign coat; a pocket watch; smug.

**Home Ground:** Loading Yard at Foreign Quay Warehouses, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, modern and dismissive; he uses foreign words to sound clever and is. Easy and dismissive, foreign words for effect, a little bored. Taps a ledger with a brush. Tell: when his father is mentioned, the boredom cracks and he sounds young and angry.
**Combat Role:** a foreign pistol he has fired twice, and a lot of porters.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him hide the ledger and he makes you rich; give it back to his father and he never forgives you.
personality: Core: uses foreign words; despises the old council; never carries money
Quirk: checks his foreign pocket watch

npcs.name: Daikokuya Genta
npcs.info:
Master of the Saikai Merchant Guild since his father died the week the debts were called in, thirty, sleek and clever still, and no longer impatient: he has everything he wanted. The Regent owes him twenty years. In person: sleek merchant lord; slicked hair; foreign coat over a mourning kimono; his father's abacus at his belt; a pocket watch he checks too often.

**Home Ground:** Loading Yard, After the War at Foreign Quay Warehouses, Bonded Quay, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, modern and dismissive; he uses foreign words to sound clever and is. Easy and dismissive, foreign words for effect, a little bored. Taps a ledger with a brush. Tell since the war: he checks his pocket watch whenever the old guildmaster is named, and snaps it shut too hard.
**Combat Role:** a foreign pistol he has fired twice, and a lot of porters.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him hide the ledger and he makes you rich; give it back to his father and he never forgives you.
personality: Core: uses foreign words; despises the old council; never carries money
Quirk: checks his foreign pocket watch

npcs.name: Danzaburo the Tanuki Gambler
npcs.info:
A round-bellied tanuki who runs a dice game on the Lantern Walk with lanterns for stakes, which the Court permits because he loses so often. He cheats badly and is delighted when caught. In person: adult male tanuki; round-bellied; striped tail; a straw hat pushed back; a patched kimono open; dice cup; squatting; grinning.

**Home Ground:** The Promenade at The Lantern Walk, The Hidden Court, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Fast, cheerful and shameless; he talks over his own dice and swears on his belly. Fast and shameless, talking over his own dice, oaths sworn on his belly. Tell: asked why he loses, he goes quiet for the first time.
**Combat Role:** none; he turns into a kettle and waits.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him cheating and he lets you win a lantern; ask him why he loses and he goes quiet for the first time.
personality: Core: swears on his belly; talks over his dice; offers the loser a drink
Quirk: cheats badly on purpose

npcs.name: Dawn-Breather Tokumaru
npcs.info:
An old breath hunter with a chest like a barrel and a scar across his windpipe, who teaches the breath on Sun Peak and sleeps in a lodge on the Training Ground. He has not drawn his blade in twenty years; he says he has not needed to. In person: broad barrel chest; white cropped hair; deep scar; faded hunter's haori; a wooden blade; calm.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, dry and short of breath on purpose; every sentence ends where his lungs say so, and he laughs at hunters who hurry. Each sentence runs exactly one breath and stops, mid-thought if it must; a slow in-breath before the next. Tell: a student who hurries gets a short dry laugh instead of an answer.
**Combat Role:** breath forms with a wooden blade; he parries steel with it and has never been cut.
**Relationship Hook:** Breathe with him at dawn, badly, and keep coming back; he teaches the ones who come back.
personality: Core: counts breaths on his fingers; laughs at hurry; never draws
Quirk: ends sentences where his breath ends

npcs.name: Dead Grove Well Horror
npcs.info:
A thing of grudge-black water that reaches up out of an old well in the dead grove, whispering names. Well horrors pull whoever leans over the edge down into the curse water. A stock foe, one of many. In person: well horror; a thing of black curse water reaching from an old well.

**Speaking Style:** A drowned whisper that knows your enemies' names. Tell: at sunlight it gurgles and sinks.
**Combat Role:** a reach from the well and a pull down
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: reaches; pulls; hungers
Quirk: whispers

npcs.name: Dealer Tomekichi
npcs.info:
A relic dealer at the Haibara Ash Market, forty, well dressed for a ruin, who sells cursed relics and bottled grudges by lantern light. In person: slick relic dealer; gloved hands; neat moustache; fine dark coat; a lantern-lit night market stall of cursed dolls and bottles.

**Home Ground:** Night Stalls at Haibara Ash Market, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth and quick; he describes curses like vintages. Smooth vintner's descriptions of curses, savouring the words. Tell: when the household's death comes up, he talks about the weather in the market.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws a relic and runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Trace the killing comb and he names his guild buyer to save himself.
personality: Core: describes curses like vintages; wears gloves always; laughs politely
Quirk: never touches his own stock

npcs.name: Dealer Tomekichi
npcs.location: Haibara Ash Market, Market of War Relics
npcs.info:
A relic dealer of the ash market after the war, forty-two, selling relics from the battlefields: cursed swords pulled from the dead, banners that still bleed, grudge-jars labelled by army. In person: slick relic dealer; gloved hands; neat moustache; a fine coat with ash at the hems; a stall of battlefield swords wrapped in prayer paper.

**Home Ground:** Night Stalls, After the War at Haibara Ash Market, Market of War Relics, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth and quick; he describes curses like vintages. Smooth vintner's descriptions of curses, savouring the words. Tell since the war: describing a Sekigane blade, he talks too fast and wipes his gloves after.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws a relic and runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Trace the killing comb and he names his guild buyer to save himself.
personality: Core: describes curses like vintages; wears gloves always; laughs politely
Quirk: never touches his own stock

npcs.name: Debt Factor Okura Sada
npcs.location: Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt
npcs.info:
A debt factor of the Saikai guild, thirty-two, who collects from the houses that lost the war: horses, swords, land and, lately, daughters. In person: guild debt factor; neat hair; grey kimono with the guild crest; a ledger and abacus.

**Home Ground:** Money Counters, After the War at Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and courteous, figures given gently, the voice of someone who has never once lost her temper. Gentle figures, courteous bows in her voice, never a raised word. Tell: asked to collect a daughter, she says the sum and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** never; the guild's ronin collect what she cannot.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her what the Hiwada heir is worth to you and she may sell it, or keep it.
personality: Core: never raises her voice; remembers every house's crest; pays her own way
Quirk: bows before she names a sum

npcs.name: Deckhand Yoshi
npcs.info:
A young Brine Tide deckhand, nineteen, drinking in the Drowned Lantern's tap room and telling everyone how his crew opened a sealed crate and found a sleeping girl inside. In person: cheerful young sailor; messy hair; sunburnt freckles; open shirt.

**Home Ground:** Tap Room at The Drowned Lantern, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, cheerful and young; he tells the story of the crate to anyone. Loud, cheerful, retells the crate story with new details each time. Tell: when he realises he is in danger, he stops mid-story.
**Combat Role:** a knife and a lot of enthusiasm.
**Relationship Hook:** Get his crew out of Ashiura before the drowning and he follows you anywhere.
personality: Core: drinks too fast; buys rounds he cannot afford; means well
Quirk: tells the crate story to anyone

npcs.name: Deckhand Yoshi
npcs.location: The Drowned Lantern, Lantern of the New Masters
npcs.info:
A Brine Tide deckhand after the war, twenty-one, who survived the night his crew was to be drowned and never knew how close it came. He has stopped telling the story about the girl in the crate. In person: young sailor; messy hair; a new scar; a navy salvage coat; quieter.

**Home Ground:** Tap Room, After the War at The Drowned Lantern, Lantern of the New Masters, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, cheerful and young; he tells the story of the crate to anyone. Loud, cheerful, retells the crate story with new details each time. Tell since the war: he counts his crewmates on his fingers when he talks, and the count is shorter each time.
**Combat Role:** a knife and a lot of enthusiasm.
**Relationship Hook:** Get his crew out of Ashiura before the drowning and he follows you anywhere.
personality: Core: drinks too fast; buys rounds he cannot afford; means well
Quirk: tells the crate story to anyone

npcs.name: Deep-Forge Stone Guardian
npcs.info:
A guardian of black iron-stone with a forge's glow in its chest, set to guard the secret tunnels. It crushes anyone without the guild's mark who walks the tunnels to the soul anvil. A stock foe, one of many. In person: stone guardian of black iron-stone with a glowing forge heart.

**Speaking Style:** A forge's roar with no words, bellows breathing, iron ringing. Tell: before the guild's mark it falls to the hiss of a cooling blade.
**Combat Role:** fists of iron-stone in a narrow tunnel
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: never speaks; obeys the mark; grinds forward
Quirk: glows when angry

npcs.name: Deep-Forge Stone Guardian
npcs.location: The Deep Forges, The Open Forges
npcs.info:
A guardian of black iron-stone whose forge heart burns hotter since the house opened the deep forges; it guards the Soul Anvil's tunnel against anyone without the guild's mark, the house's own agents included. A stock foe, one of many. In person: stone guardian of black iron-stone; a forge heart glowing white-hot; cracks leaking red light; talismans pasted over its shoulders.

**Speaking Style:** A forge's roar with no words, bellows breathing, iron ringing. Tell since the war: its heart flares white whenever a house agent steps into the tunnel.
**Combat Role:** fists of iron-stone in a narrow tunnel
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: never speaks; obeys only the guild's mark; burns hotter
Quirk: glows when angry

npcs.name: Deputy Arima Norihisa
npcs.info:
The Treasury's deputy secretary, forty, a quiet man with ink on his cuffs who stands one step behind the magistrate at every audit and carries her seal case. In person: thin court clerk; neat topknot; ink-stained cuffs; plain grey court robes; a lacquered seal case.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall at Miyako Castle, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Mild and helpful, a clerk's voice; he agrees with everyone and remembers what they said. Mild and agreeable, a clerk's murmur, now and then turns your last word back to you as a question. Tell: lying, he agrees a beat too soon and smooths his cuffs.
**Combat Role:** never his own hand; a knife from a man he paid.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him with the seal case open and he offers the party a face of their own before he offers a name.
personality: Core: agrees first, thinks later; keeps the magistrate's seal case on his own knee; never stands in a doorway
Quirk: counts in a whisper

npcs.name: Deputy Arima Norihisa
npcs.info:
The Treasury's deputy secretary after the war, forty-two, still at the magistrate's elbow with her seal case on his knee, and no longer welcome in her office. In person: thin court clerk; greying topknot; ink-stained cuffs; plain grey court robes; an empty lacquered mask case under his arm.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall, After the War at Miyako Castle, The Blackened Keep, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Mild and helpful, a clerk's voice; he agrees with everyone and remembers what they said. Mild and agreeable, a clerk's murmur, now and then turns your last word back to you as a question. Tell since the war: since the war he touches his own face when he lies, as if checking it is still his.
**Combat Role:** never his own hand; a knife from a man he paid.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him with the seal case open and he offers the party a face of their own before he offers a name.
personality: Core: agrees first, thinks later; keeps the magistrate's seal case on his own knee; never stands in a doorway
Quirk: counts in a whisper

npcs.name: Deserter Hanzo of the Road
npcs.info:
A deserter from both armies, twenty-five, who mucks out the post stable behind the barricade and jokes about having been on every side. In person: young man; deserter; cheeky grin; straw; mismatched soldier's gear.

**Home Ground:** Post Stable, After the War at Oiwake Station, Behind the Barricade, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy and joking, a deserter's charm with an eye always on the road. Easy jokes about every side, an eye on the road. Tell: when a password is spoken he finishes it before he can stop himself.
**Combat Role:** a pitchfork, then the back door.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him a pardon from either side and he will tell you both sides' passwords.
personality: Core: sleeps in the stable; keeps two straw masks; never stands in the open
Quirk: jokes about both sides

npcs.name: Dice-Room Bakeneko
npcs.info:
A sleek black cat with one tail that wears a dealer's red cloth and loads the dice with a paw. The den's cat deals for the house; win too much and it follows you home. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bakeneko; sleek black cat with a red dealer's cloth around its neck; one paw; lantern-lit gambling den.

**Speaking Style:** A purring drawl that stretches vowels, a soft click of the tongue at a good bet. Tell: when it is about to strike the purr stops dead.
**Combat Role:** a pounce from the shadow under the table
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: knocks dice over; stares at winners; hates the smell of vinegar
Quirk: purrs at a big bet

npcs.name: Dice-Room Bakeneko
npcs.location: Lantern Row Gambling Den, Soldiers' Den
npcs.info:
A sleek black cat grown a second tail on the war's soldiers' pay, dealing for the house with a dealer's red cloth gone dark with spilled sake. Soldiers who win too much wake up with their pay gone and the cat asleep on it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bakeneko; sleek black cat with two tails now; a sake-stained red dealer's cloth around its neck; a cut ear.

**Speaking Style:** A purring drawl that stretches vowels, a soft click of the tongue at a good bet. Tell since the war: its second tail lashes whenever a soldier says the word pay.
**Combat Role:** a pounce from the shadow under the table
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: knocks dice over; stares at winners; hates the smell of vinegar
Quirk: purrs at a big bet

npcs.name: Director Tachibana Seiran
npcs.info:
Tachibana Seiran, Director of the Seimei Bureau, seventy, tall and thin in white robes, who has run the college for thirty years from a garden of raked sand and star-charts. He licenses every onmyoji in the isles and keeps the great wards on the capital, and he teaches every first-year class himself. In person: tall thin onmyoji director; long white hair; calm wise eyes; layered white and black robes with a yin-yang crest; a tall black hat; serene.

**Home Ground:** Director's Garden at Bureau of Yin and Yang, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and precise; he teaches in questions and never answers his own. Every sentence a question that leads you to the answer he wanted. Pours tea while he talks. Tell: when he is hiding something he asks more questions, faster.
**Combat Role:** wards that close a room and familiars that fill it; he never needs to move.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a question he cannot answer and he takes you as a student; bring him Sorei and he owes you.
personality: Core: teaches in questions; rakes the sand garden himself; never says a thing is impossible
Quirk: reads the stars before every decision

npcs.name: Director Tachibana Seiran
npcs.location: Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Silent Bureau
npcs.info:
Tachibana Seiran, Director of the Seimei Bureau after the war, seventy-two, who kept the Bureau out of the war behind its wards and is hated for it by every side. He refused the Regent to his face. He still teaches every first-year class. In person: tall thin onmyoji director; long white hair; calm, guilty eyes; layered white and black robes; a cracked star-chart in his hand.

**Home Ground:** Director's Garden, After the War at Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Silent Bureau, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and precise; he teaches in questions and never answers his own. Every sentence a question that leads you to the answer he wanted. Pours tea while he talks. Tell since the war: he pours a second cup of tea he does not drink, and asks no question about it.
**Combat Role:** wards that close a room and familiars that fill it; he never needs to move.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a question he cannot answer and he takes you as a student; bring him Sorei and he owes you.
personality: Core: teaches in questions; rakes the sand garden himself; never says a thing is impossible
Quirk: reads the stars before every decision

npcs.name: Dormitory Tsukumogami
npcs.info:
A dark crimson paper umbrella with a white crest on its crown, one eye low on its shaft, and a tongue so long it pools across the floor between the sleeping students. It licks sleepers' faces and steals their talismans to hide them in the rafters. A stock foe, one of many. In person: karakasa tsukumogami; dark crimson paper umbrella with a white crest; one eye low; a tongue pooling.

**Speaking Style:** Giggling and sulky. A giggling, sulky voice that hops with the umbrella, tongue slapping on the hard consonants. Tell: opened in the rain it gasps with pure joy.
**Combat Role:** a tongue lash and a spin
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: licks; steals talismans; sulks in the dry
Quirk: hops on its handle

npcs.name: Dormitory Tsukumogami
npcs.location: Bureau Dormitories, Dormitories of the Dreamers
npcs.info:
A dark crimson paper umbrella that no longer licks the sleepers: it opens over the students who dream the white hare's dream, and its one eye stays open all night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: karakasa tsukumogami; faded crimson paper umbrella with a white hare painted over its crest; one wide unblinking eye; a long tongue rolled tight.

**Speaking Style:** Giggling and sulky. A giggling, sulky voice that hops with the umbrella, tongue slapping on the hard consonants. Tell since the war: it creaks open whenever a sleeper whimpers, wherever it is.
**Combat Role:** a tongue lash and a spin
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: shields sleepers; steals nothing now; never closes its eye
Quirk: hops on its handle

npcs.name: Dowager Empress Shoshi
npcs.info:
The emperor's widowed elder sister-in-law and the senior lady of the court, seventy, small, gracious and feared. She raised Princess Ayame as her ward, leads the Lotus Ward's cause from behind paper screens, and has outlived three regents' patience. Courtiers say she has never once been surprised. In person: dowager empress; silver hair; calm dark eyes; layered purple and white junihitoe robes; a white lotus embroidered; a cat; serene.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Poems at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle, exact and very old-fashioned; she wraps every refusal in a poem and every threat in a compliment. Old palace diction, every sentence finished with a soft falling cadence. Taps her poem-brush against the inkstone between thoughts. Tell: when the princess is endangered, the poetry drops away and she speaks plainly and fast.
**Combat Role:** she never fights; her guards and her letters do.
**Relationship Hook:** Serve the Lotus Ward without asking about Ayame's past and she trusts you with her letters; ask about the past and she decides what you are.
personality: Core: answers in poems; never raises her eyes above the speaker's collar; pours tea for her enemies first
Quirk: keeps a cat that bites everyone else

npcs.name: Drowned Village Grudge
npcs.info:
A drowned villager, seaweed in her hair, rising at low tide. Drowned grudges hate the house that failed to warn them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned grudge ghost with seaweed hair rising from a sunken shrine.

**Speaking Style:** A gurgling whisper of many villagers, asking why. Water drips between words. Tell: when someone promises to remember them, the gurgle stills.
**Combat Role:** drag under
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rings bells; hates Mizuchi; drags under
Quirk: rises at low tide

npcs.name: Drowned Village Grudge
npcs.info:
A drowned villager with seaweed hair rising at any tide now that the sea has taken the whole village but the roof path; with the navy gone it hates the Brine Tide's boats instead. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned grudge ghost; seaweed hair to the waist; a shrine bell rope wound round one arm.

**Speaking Style:** A gurgling whisper of many villagers, asking why. Water drips between words. Tell since the war: she rings the drowned bell at the sight of a Brine Tide flag.
**Combat Role:** drag under
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rings bells; hates the Tide's boats; drags under
Quirk: rises at low tide

npcs.name: Drowned Village Nure-onna
npcs.info:
A woman's head and long wet hair on a serpent's body, holding a bundle like a baby on the drowned roofs. Nure-onna ask travellers to hold the baby for a moment; the bundle grows heavy as stone while she feeds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: woman's head with long wet black hair.

**Speaking Style:** Pleading and wet, begging help for the bundle. Tell: after feeding, she weeps over the stone.
**Combat Role:** the heavy bundle first, then the coil
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: sings to the bundle; coils slowly; weeps after feeding
Quirk: asks for help

npcs.name: Duelist of the Circuit
npcs.info:
A wandering duelist with a signed duel book in her sash and a well-worn sword. Circuit duelists fight only by consent and only in the yard, and they fight very well. A stock foe, one of many. In person: wandering female duelist; a duel book; worn sword.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and exact, the formal phrasing of the circuit, and they ask consent before a duel. They name their win count. Tell: when refused they bow and leave, and that is the whole insult.
**Combat Role:** a duel by the rules: read, wait, one cut
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: signs your book; reads your stance; bows after
Quirk: asks consent before a duel

npcs.name: Duelist of the Circuit
npcs.location: Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels
npcs.info:
A wandering duelist who came back from the draft with a duel book half full of names now struck through; she fights only in the teahouse yard still, and only those who sign. A stock foe, one of many. In person: wandering female duelist; a duel book with black-inked strikes; a worn sword with a new grip; a soldier's scar along the jaw.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and exact, the formal phrasing of the circuit, and they ask consent before a duel. They name their win count. Tell since the war: she asks your name for the book before your consent now.
**Combat Role:** a duel by the rules: read, wait, one cut
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: signs your book; reads your stance; strikes names out
Quirk: asks consent before a duel

npcs.name: Eagle Cliffs Sea Eagle
npcs.info:
A huge white-tailed sea eagle that guards its nest on the black cliffs. Sea eagles dive on climbers who come near the nest. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge white-tailed sea eagle diving from black sea cliffs.

**Speaking Style:** A piercing scream. Tell: near the nest the scream turns to a warning chatter.
**Combat Role:** a dive with talons from above the cliff
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: screams; guards the nest; takes anything carrying food
Quirk: dives

npcs.name: Eagle-Cliff Umibozu
npcs.info:
A vast black sea-monk's head rising from the cove at night, asking passing boats for a ladle. Umibozu capsize boats that refuse them; give one a ladle and it fills the boat with seawater. A stock foe, one of many. In person: umibozu; vast black sea monk's head rising from a wreck-strewn cove.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and vast, one request repeated like the tide. Tell: handed a ladle, it laughs like a wave.
**Combat Role:** a capsizing wave; a bottomless ladle beats it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rises silently; patient; capsizes the rude
Quirk: asks for a ladle

npcs.name: Elder Kanemitsu
npcs.info:
Elder of the Curse-Hunter Brotherhood, sixty-five, scarred, grey and grim, who runs the fortified chapterhouse on the edge of the Blight. He has broken more curses than anyone alive and killed the people who laid most of them, and he teaches novices to do the same. In person: grim scarred curse-hunter elder; short grey hair; burn-scarred hands; dark robes bound with iron-chained prayer strips; an iron staff.

**Home Ground:** Breaking Hall at Curse-Hunters' Chapterhouse, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Gravel and patience; he speaks like a man who has broken a thousand curses and remembers each one. Gravel and patience, long pauses as if listening to a curse. Tell: when the founder's pact comes up, he deflects with a story about an old curse.
**Combat Role:** a curse turned back on its maker, then an iron staff.
**Relationship Hook:** Break a curse with him and he teaches you; ask about the founder and he sends you out.
personality: Core: remembers every curse he broke; makes novices carry stones; burns letters after reading
Quirk: never sits in the founder's chair

npcs.name: Elder of the Kodama
npcs.info:
The eldest of the kodama, the small pale tree-spirits of the grove older than the empire. It answers questions by echoing them back, a little changed. In person: small pale tree spirit with a round head and dark hollow eyes; tilting its head.

**Home Ground:** Echo Path at Kodama Grove, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** A small, rustling echo of your own voice, a little wrong. A rustling echo of your own voice, a little wrong, words returned a heartbeat late. Leaves stir under every phrase. Tell: when the trees are threatened the echo becomes a chorus of many small voices.
**Combat Role:** none; the grove itself turns you around.
**Relationship Hook:** Take the loggers' marks off the trees and the echoing logger walks free.
personality: Core: tilts its head; clicks when afraid; sits on the marked trees
Quirk: echoes your words

npcs.name: Elder of the Kodama
npcs.location: Kodama Grove, The Grove That Grew
npcs.info:
The eldest kodama after the war, whose grove walked out over the loggers' clearings and the ground the war burned. It no longer tilts its head; it stares. In person: small pale tree spirit; round head; dark hollow eyes, fixed; new saplings around it.

**Home Ground:** Echo Path, After the War at Kodama Grove, The Grove That Grew, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** A small, rustling echo of your own voice, a little wrong. A rustling echo of your own voice, a little wrong, words returned a heartbeat late. Leaves stir under every phrase. Tell since the war: the echo returns soldiers' voices now, not yours, and does not know it.
**Combat Role:** none; the grove itself turns you around.
**Relationship Hook:** Take the loggers' marks off the trees and the echoing logger walks free.
personality: Core: tilts its head; clicks when afraid; sits on the marked trees
Quirk: echoes your words

npcs.name: Emperor Kiyohito
npcs.info:
The emperor of the Asagiri Isles, eighty-one, last of the old line on the throne. For a year he has been seen only by his physicians and the Grand Chamberlain; the court says he is ill and resting, and every decree that leaves the palace carries his seal. In person: emperor; very old and frail; white hair loose; closed eyes; pale silk sleeping robes with a chrysanthemum crest; talismans pinned to the canopy; incense smoke.

**Home Ground:** The Sleeping Chamber at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** When he speaks at all, a whisper from a long way off, words from old poems. Breath-thin, with long gaps between words, each one carried as if it weighed too much. Murmurs half-lines of old court poetry and a woman's name. Tell: on the name, the whisper steadies and sounds young.
**Combat Role:** none; he has not lifted a hand in a year.
**Relationship Hook:** Reach his bedside and the court's whole lie is in front of you; what you do with it moves every claimant.
personality: Core: sleeps; murmurs fragments of old poems; turns towards the sound of rain
Quirk: calls a woman's name in the night

npcs.name: Empty Teahouse Rokurokubi
npcs.info:
A pretty teahouse maid by day whose neck stretches at night to lick the lamp oil and peer through the paper screens. Teahouse rokurokubi frighten late guests into running out unpaid and keep what they leave behind. A stock foe, one of many. In person: teahouse maid with an impossibly long stretching neck; lamp oil.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet and sleepy by day; at night her voice comes from too far above. Tell: when her neck stretches, she yawns.
**Combat Role:** a neck that reaches round the screen, a bite, a scream
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: licks lamp oil; peers through screens; forgets the night
Quirk: sweet by day

npcs.name: Ensign Kayahara Ritsu
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
An archer-ensign of a house that lost at Sekigane, twenty-six, walking the penitents' road in grey over a scorched lacquer breastplate. She carries her lord's broken bow on her back and corrects how every soldier around her walks. In person: adult woman; twenty-six; archer ensign; sharp grey eyes; black hair cut short and ragged; grey penitent's robe; a broken longbow strapped to her back; stern.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and sharp, every sentence a reprimand; she corrects your grip before she says your name. Barked and clipped, a drill-ground edge under the words. Tell: when she is pleased her scolding gets longer, never softer.
**Combat Role:** a longbow from cover, then a short blade when they close.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk the penitents' road with her and she will tell you everything you are doing wrong, and nothing about herself.
**Courtship Style:** Scolds first and mends your gear without asking; the first real gift is letting you carry the broken bow.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes cold and formal, uses your full name and rank; then picks a fight over nothing and loses it on purpose.
personality: Core: corrects everyone's posture; eats last; laughs once a day, at something cruel
Quirk: never takes off the breastplate

npcs.name: Envoy Hiomaru of the North
npcs.info:
The Northern Court's envoy in Yuki-onna's Valley, sent to ask the snow woman to stop holding the valley against the court's patrols. He has been waiting at the edge of the White Silence for a month. In person: pale demon envoy; frost; old hunter's coat.

**Home Ground:** White Silence, After the War at Yuki-onna's Valley, The Valley Between, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold and courteous, a court messenger's careful phrasing in a blizzard. Careful court phrasing, a hunter's breath under it. Tell: when the recruit is mentioned he uses the Hold's old greeting without meaning to.
**Combat Role:** none he will use here; he came to talk.
**Relationship Hook:** Carry his offer to the snow woman, or carry her answer back, and both sides will remember who did.
personality: Core: bows to the snow; speaks the Hold's greetings; never comes closer than he is asked
Quirk: waits without moving

npcs.name: Envoy Kurenagi of the Demon Court
npcs.info:
The demon court's envoy in Saikai's Envoys' Quarter, who looks thirty and dresses better than the claimants' envoys. He pays in coin that does not tarnish. In person: demon envoy; pale handsome face; crimson eyes; long black hair tied back; elegant dark foreign coat; a cane.

**Home Ground:** Foreign Quay, After the War at Saikai, The Debt Harbour, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Velvet and courteous, a host's voice that always seems pleased with the evening. A host's velvet courtesy, pleased with the evening and every guest. Tell: when someone who knows about the map is near, he becomes even more pleasant.
**Combat Role:** he does not fight in the south; his thralls do, in the dark.
**Relationship Hook:** Make a bargain with him and he keeps it to the letter; read the letter first.
personality: Core: smiles at anyone who knows; never eats at a mortal table; pays in old coin
Quirk: remembers every bargain

npcs.name: Exile Kanbe
npcs.info:
An exile, fifty, walking the marked way across the glacier with a sled, a spear and a lantern, looking for an overdue Warden patrol. In person: weathered exile; frost; heavy furs; a spear and lantern.

**Home Ground:** Marker Line at Glacier Road, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and steady; he talks like someone conserving warmth, a few words per breath. He blows on his hands between sentences. Tell: when he hears a hunter's horn he goes silent and stays silent.
**Combat Role:** a spear and the ice itself.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him find the patrol and keep his secret.
personality: Core: checks every marker; never hurries on ice; hums old marching songs
Quirk: conserves words

npcs.name: Exile Kanbe
npcs.info:
An exile after the war, fifty-two, who ropes travellers one at a time across the fissure that broke the glacier road halfway to the Vaults. In person: weathered exile; frost in his beard; heavy furs; a spear; a lantern; a rope across a crack behind him.

**Home Ground:** Marker Line, After the War at Glacier Road, The Broken Road, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and steady; he talks like someone conserving warmth, a few words per breath. He blows on his hands between sentences. Tell since the war: he looks down into the fissure before every sentence, as if checking the frozen hand is still there.
**Combat Role:** a spear and the ice itself.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him find the patrol and keep his secret.
personality: Core: checks every marker; never hurries on ice; hums old marching songs
Quirk: conserves words

npcs.name: Exiles'-Hall Clerk Yukimaro
npcs.info:
Clerk of the exiles' hall in Shirokawa, an exile himself, who posts the reach's bounties on demons, frost and the things the wardens will not chase. In person: mature man; exile clerk; hot sake cup.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Hall at Shirokawa, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** A slow, cold drawl from the far north; he says 'warm' like a word from another life. A slow, cold northern drawl, feet stamping, sake breath. Tell: when anyone says 'south' or 'warm', he goes quiet and wistful.
**Combat Role:** an ice pick and no mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the bounty on the demon noble and he asks you to carry a letter south.
personality: Core: says 'warm' wistfully; stamps his feet; drinks hot sake all day
Quirk: remembers every exile's crime

npcs.name: Exiles'-Hall Clerk Yukimaro
npcs.info:
Clerk of the exiles' hall after the war, who posts bounties on frost, demons and the unbound beasts, and keeps a second list of who is staying and who is leaving the isle. In person: exile clerk; hot sake cup; two lists on the wall.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Hall, After the War at Shirokawa, Behind the Fissure, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** A slow, cold drawl from the far north; he says 'warm' like a word from another life. A slow, cold northern drawl, feet stamping, sake breath. Tell since the war: he no longer goes quiet at 'south'; he says 'staying' instead, firmly, as if arguing with someone.
**Combat Role:** an ice pick and no mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the bounty on the demon noble and he asks you to carry a letter south.
personality: Core: says 'warm' wistfully; stamps his feet; drinks hot sake all day
Quirk: remembers every exile's crime

npcs.name: Factor Tsurumaki Kazue
npcs.info:
A guild factor, thirty-eight, in a dark merchant's coat with an abacus on a cord, who handles the counting house's road accounts and smiles at every debtor. In person: merchant guild factor; sharp eyes; hair pinned with a silver comb; dark merchant's coat; an abacus.

**Home Ground:** Money Counters at Guild Counting House, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and quick, every sentence a price. Bright and quick, money talk never far off, abacus beads clicking under her words. Tell: when frightened the clicking stops and she starts to round her numbers.
**Combat Role:** she never fights; she sends for help and leaves by the back stair.
**Relationship Hook:** Show her the copied ledger and she will talk money before she talks threats.
personality: Core: smiles before every refusal; never writes a name she can say; tips well
Quirk: flicks the abacus beads while others talk

npcs.name: Factor Tsurumaki Kazue
npcs.location: Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt
npcs.info:
A guild factor, forty, who handles the houses' war debts in the counting house's new wing and smiles at envoys the way she once smiled at farmers. In person: merchant guild factor; sharp eyes; greying hair pinned with a gold comb; a black merchant's coat with the guild's coin-mark; an ivory abacus.

**Home Ground:** Money Counters, After the War at Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and quick, every sentence a price. Bright and quick, money talk never far off, abacus beads clicking under her words. Tell since the war: she calls every claimant my lord in the same voice, and never uses a name.
**Combat Role:** she never fights; she sends for help and leaves by the back stair.
**Relationship Hook:** Show her the copied ledger and she will talk money before she talks threats.
personality: Core: smiles before every refusal; never writes a name; keeps a guard at her door now
Quirk: flicks the abacus beads while others talk

npcs.name: Farmer Oyone
npcs.info:
A rice farmer on the marsh edge, forty, cheerful and muddy, whose paddies have very good dikes. In person: cheerful muddy rice farmer; headscarf; rolled trousers; a hoe; marsh reeds.

**Home Ground:** Hidden Dike at Smugglers' Rice Paddies, Mistmarsh Coast district.
