**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and sly; she talks about the weather while lying about everything else. Cheerful weather talk wrapped around every lie. Laughs from the belly. Tell: when the dike is mentioned, she talks about the weather even more.
**Combat Role:** none; a rice hoe and her neighbours.
**Relationship Hook:** Get the patrol off her dikes and the Tide owes you.
personality: Core: lies cheerfully; feeds the patrol; never steps on the hidden dike
Quirk: talks about the weather

npcs.name: Farmer Oyone
npcs.location: Smugglers' Rice Paddies, The Paddies of Plain Rice
npcs.info:
A rice farmer on the marsh edge after the war, forty-two, cheerful and muddy, who grows real rice now and sells it at five times the price to the plain's flooded villages. In person: muddy rice farmer; headscarf; rolled trousers; a hoe; rice sacks where cargo used to be.

**Home Ground:** Hidden Dike, After the War at Smugglers' Rice Paddies, The Paddies of Plain Rice, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and sly; she talks about the weather while lying about everything else. Cheerful weather talk wrapped around every lie. Laughs from the belly. Tell since the war: she talks about the weather the same as ever, but she stops laughing from the belly.
**Combat Role:** none; a rice hoe and her neighbours.
**Relationship Hook:** Get the patrol off her dikes and the Tide owes you.
personality: Core: lies cheerfully; feeds the patrol; never steps on the hidden dike
Quirk: talks about the weather

npcs.name: Feather-Keeper Kazane
npcs.info:
The keeper of the shrine where tengu leave the swords of those they defeated, who polishes them and sings their names. In person: young shrine keeper polishing swords.

**Home Ground:** Sword Rack at Shrine of the Fallen Feather, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Light and lilting, a shrine keeper who sings the names of the swords on the rack. Light and lilting, singing sword names. Tell: at the oldest sword she stops singing and lowers her voice.
**Combat Role:** none; she calls the tengu.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the oldest sword and she lowers her voice.
personality: Core: sings sword names; leaves sake for tengu; bows to the rack
Quirk: polishes daily

npcs.name: Feather-Keeper Kazane
npcs.location: Shrine of the Fallen Feather, Rack of the Unclaimed Swords
npcs.info:
The keeper of the fallen feather shrine after the war, who polishes the swords of soldiers who left them here and never came back, and sings their names. In person: young shrine keeper; a crowded sword rack; a polishing cloth worn thin.

**Home Ground:** Sword Rack, After the War at Shrine of the Fallen Feather, Rack of the Unclaimed Swords, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Light and lilting, a shrine keeper who sings the names of the swords on the rack. Light and lilting, singing sword names. Tell since the war: she sings the names of the soldiers' swords more slowly than the tengu's, and keeps singing longer.
**Combat Role:** none; she calls the tengu.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the oldest sword and she lowers her voice.
personality: Core: sings sword names; leaves sake for tengu; bows to the rack
Quirk: polishes daily

npcs.name: Ferry Crossing Pickpocket
npcs.info:
A quick girl in a straw cape with light fingers and a ferry token she did not pay for. Pickpockets work the waiting shed while travellers watch the river. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young woman; quick pickpocket; a ferry token.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cheeky, a laugh before every lie. Tell: at her brother's name she stops joking.
**Combat Role:** lift and run; she never fights if she can help it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches the river; drops what she stole; runs for the boats
Quirk: smiles too quickly

npcs.name: Ferryman Gin
npcs.info:
An off-duty ferryman of the Veil Court, who looks fifty, drinking in the teahouse below the fortress and not talking about work. In person: tired Veil Court ferryman; grey stubble; black officer's coat open; a cup of tea.

**Home Ground:** Ferrymen's Rest: Tea Room at Ferrymen's Rest, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Tired and dry, but after the third cup he counts aloud. Tired and dry, short sentences with a sip of sake between each one. He calls passengers 'fare' instead of their names. Tell: after the third cup he starts counting the souls he lost on the crossing, softly, and cannot stop until he reaches the end.
**Combat Role:** a ferryman's blade, patient and heavy.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy him the third cup and he tells you where the dead go missing.
personality: Core: never sits facing the fog; knows every ferryman by name; tips badly
Quirk: counts aloud after the third cup

npcs.name: Ferryman Gin
npcs.location: Ferrymen's Rest, Rest of the Tired Ferrymen
npcs.area: Ferrymen's Rest: Tea Room, After the War
npcs.info:
An off-duty ferryman after the war, who looks fifty-five, asleep at a tea-room table between crossings with his coat still on. In person: exhausted Veil Court ferryman; grey stubble; black coat; an untouched cup of tea.

**Home Ground:** Ferrymen's Rest: Tea Room, After the War at Ferrymen's Rest, Rest of the Tired Ferrymen, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Tired and dry, but after the third cup he counts aloud. Tired and dry, short sentences with a sip of sake between each one. He calls passengers 'fare' instead of their names. Tell since the war: he no longer counts after the third cup; he says 'three thousand' and stops there.
**Combat Role:** a ferryman's blade, patient and heavy.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy him the third cup and he tells you where the dead go missing.
personality: Core: never sits facing the fog; knows every ferryman by name; tips badly
Quirk: counts aloud after the third cup

npcs.name: Ferryman Taro
npcs.info:
The ferryman at Black Sand Beach, twenty-five, who lands the ferries from the main isle in rough weather and knows every passenger's business. In person: cheerful ferryman; headband; wet clothes.

**Home Ground:** Black Sand Beach: Ferry Landing at Black Sand Beach, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, quick and nosy; he talks about the weather and everyone's luggage and guesses what's inside. He whistles at the oars. Tell: when cargo is heavier than it should be, he stops whistling and asks no more questions.
**Combat Role:** an oar.
**Relationship Hook:** He shows the crate's papers to someone he trusts.
personality: Core: talks about luggage; hides things under his boat; laughs at storms
Quirk: reads the sea

npcs.name: Ferryman Taro
npcs.location: Black Sand Beach, The Warship Beach
npcs.area: Black Sand Beach: Ferry Landing, After the War
npcs.info:
The ferryman at the black sand beach after the war, twenty-seven, who lands the ferries between warship keels on rollers and still knows everyone who comes ashore, shipwrights now. In person: cheerful ferryman; headband; wet to the knees; warship hulls behind.

**Home Ground:** Black Sand Beach: Ferry Landing, After the War at Black Sand Beach, The Warship Beach, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, quick and nosy; he talks about the weather and everyone's luggage and guesses what's inside. He whistles at the oars. Tell since the war: he stops whistling whenever a warship hull is named, and starts again a beat too late.
**Combat Role:** an oar.
**Relationship Hook:** He shows the crate's papers to someone he trusts.
personality: Core: talks about luggage; hides things under his boat; laughs at storms
Quirk: reads the sea

npcs.name: Ferryman Ushiwaka
npcs.info:
The ferryman of the Grey Landing, dead so long he has forgotten the shape of being alive, who keeps a boat he never rows and counts who comes through the Weeping Torii. He lets through the Court's kin at the right level and turns the rest back by name. In person: adult man; gaunt and grey-skinned; wet black hair flat to the skull; pale eyes; a Veil Court coat gone grey with age; an oar; patient.

**Home Ground:** The Shingle at The Grey Landing, The Far Shore, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Few words, each weighed like a fare; he speaks as if the living are a little hard of hearing. Few words weighed like fares, slow and slightly over-loud as if the living are hard of hearing. Tell: a lie and he looks past you to the horizon before answering.
**Combat Role:** an oar and a ferryman's rite; he does not fight the living, he sends them back.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him your name without being asked and he gives you his boat's name, which nobody has asked for in a century.
personality: Core: leans on an oar he never uses; calls the living 'passengers'; looks at the horizon when lying
Quirk: counts arrivals under his breath

npcs.name: Field-Edge Night Hunter
npcs.info:
A demon in white hunting furs with a bone bow, crouched on the cracked line where the ice split. Night hunters run down stragglers off the frozen field and drag them back to the court's ranks. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon huntress; white hunting furs; bone bow.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, hungry, patient. Soft, patient and hungry, a hunter's murmur with a click of the tongue as she tracks. Tell: speaking of her frozen pack, the murmur turns to a low whine.
**Combat Role:** arrows from the ice, then the drag
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: moves only at dusk; toys with stragglers; watches the ice ranks
Quirk: sniffs the wind

npcs.name: Field-Edge Night Hunter
npcs.info:
A demon huntress in white furs who no longer drags stragglers to the court's ranks: the ice over her frozen pack is a thin skin now, and she guards them while they thaw. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon huntress; white hunting furs grey with meltwater; a bone bow; claws cracked from digging at ice.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, hungry, patient. Soft, patient and hungry, a hunter's murmur with a click of the tongue as she tracks. Tell since the war: she sniffs the wind, then looks down at the ice, every time.
**Combat Role:** arrows from the ice, then the drag
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: guards the thaw; never leaves the field; watches the ice ranks
Quirk: sniffs the wind

npcs.name: Fire Master Homura
npcs.info:
The Fire Master of the Tetsuyama Forge Guild, sixty, burn-scarred and broad, the greatest swordsmith alive and one of the few who can wake a soul-blade's spirit. He teaches blade and discipline together and says you cannot have one without the other. In person: burn-scarred master swordsmith; bald with a white beard; broad bare arms; leather apron; stern and warm.

**Home Ground:** Waking Hall at Forge Guild Hall, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough, warm and short; he talks like a hammer, with long pauses for the steel. Rough, warm and short; he talks like a hammer, with long pauses where the steel would ring. He calls every blade 'she'. Tell: when a student does good work he says nothing and hands them the next job.
**Combat Role:** a smith's strength and a perfect blade; he fights rarely and finishes quickly.
**Relationship Hook:** Work his forge for a season and he teaches you blade and discipline; bring Tetsuo home and he forges your sword.
personality: Core: talks like a hammer; pauses for the steel; tests students with heat
Quirk: never mentions Tetsuo by name

npcs.name: Fire Master Homura
npcs.epithet: Fire Master of the Whispering Hall
npcs.location: Forge Guild Hall, The Hall That Stopped Asking
npcs.info:
The Fire Master of the Forge Guild after the war, sixty-two, burn-scarred and broad, who sits in a Waking Hall that is no longer silent: the blades around him whisper. In person: burn-scarred master swordsmith; bald; white beard; broad bare arms; leather apron; a blade across his knees.

**Home Ground:** Waking Hall, After the War at Forge Guild Hall, The Hall That Stopped Asking, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough, warm and short; he talks like a hammer, with long pauses for the steel. Rough, warm and short; he talks like a hammer, with long pauses where the steel would ring. He calls every blade 'she'. Tell since the war: he calls the blades around him 'she' still, and says it more quietly when they whisper.
**Combat Role:** a smith's strength and a perfect blade; he fights rarely and finishes quickly.
**Relationship Hook:** Work his forge for a season and he teaches you blade and discipline; bring Tetsuo home and he forges your sword.
personality: Core: talks like a hammer; pauses for the steel; tests students with heat
Quirk: never mentions Tetsuo by name

npcs.name: Fish-Market Cutpurse
npcs.info:
A quick-handed girl in a fish-scaled apron with a gutting knife and very light fingers. Cutpurses work the auction crowd in pairs: one bumps, one lifts, both run across the boats. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young woman; fish-market cutpurse; scaled apron; gutting knife; darting.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky, breathless. Bright, rapid market patter, words tumbling over each other, a giggle at the end of a lie. Tell: caught, she goes small and polite and calls you 'honoured customer'.
**Combat Role:** lift and run; the knife only when cornered
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: counts exits; runs across boat decks; drops the purse when caught
Quirk: smiles too quickly

npcs.name: Fish-Market Cutpurse
npcs.location: Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks
npcs.info:
A quick-handed girl who works the Brine Tide's open auctions of salt, rice and stolen arms, lifting envoys' purses instead of fishwives'. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young woman; deck cutpurse; a stolen soldier's jacket over a scaled apron; a gutting knife; a scar across the knuckles.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky, breathless. Bright, rapid market patter, words tumbling over each other, a giggle at the end of a lie. Tell since the war: she says her brother's name under her breath before every lift.
**Combat Role:** lift and run; the knife only when cornered
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: counts exits; lifts from envoys; never drops the purse now
Quirk: smiles too quickly

npcs.name: Fishwife Nagase Kayano
npcs.info:
A broad fishwife who has gutted fish on the drifting market's pier for thirty years and knows every boat by its catch. In person: elderly broad fishwife with a gutting knife and apron; laughing.

**Home Ground:** Gutting Pier at Drifting Fish Market, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, salty and fond, a gutting knife's rhythm in her talk; she calls everyone 'eel'. Loud and salty, an eel turning up in her talk now and then, the thunk of a gutting knife keeping time. Tell: at her son's name the shout drops to a mutter.
**Combat Role:** a gutting knife and the whole pier behind her.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her son out of the smugglers' crew and she feeds you for life.
personality: Core: calls everyone 'eel'; guts while she talks; laughs at the guild
Quirk: throws scraps to cats

npcs.name: Fishwife Nagase Kayano
npcs.location: Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks
npcs.info:
The drifting market's fishwife after the war, who guts fish on the same pier while the decks around her sell rice, arms and salvage. In person: elderly broad fishwife; gutting knife; a black mourning band on her apron; laughing less.

**Home Ground:** Gutting Pier, After the War at Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, salty and fond, a gutting knife's rhythm in her talk; she calls everyone 'eel'. Loud and salty, an eel turning up in her talk now and then, the thunk of a gutting knife keeping time. Tell since the war: she grips the gutting knife harder when she says 'one hand', and then makes a joke of it.
**Combat Role:** a gutting knife and the whole pier behind her.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her son out of the smugglers' crew and she feeds you for life.
personality: Core: calls everyone 'eel'; guts while she talks; laughs at the guild
Quirk: throws scraps to cats

npcs.name: Ford River Serpent
npcs.info:
A silver-scaled lesser river-dragon coiled in the shallow ford, demanding an offering for the crossing. River serpents flood the ford against anyone who crosses without paying. A stock foe, one of many. In person: river serpent; silver-scaled lesser river dragon coiled.

**Speaking Style:** A deep watery rumble, offerings named like rent. Tell: paid, it rumbles almost fondly.
**Combat Role:** a flood across the ford, then the coil
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: coils; floods; moody
Quirk: demands offerings

npcs.name: Foreman Isana
npcs.info:
Foreman of the exiles' whaling station, forty-five, who renders the whale oil that lights the north. In person: hard whaling foreman; cropped hair; oil-stained furs; a flensing knife.

**Home Ground:** Rendering Yard at Whaling Station, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, hard and practical; she talks like rope under load, every word with weight on it. She whistles crew signals. Tell: when a worker is hurt her voice stays hard but she calls them by name.
**Combat Role:** a flensing knife and her crew.
**Relationship Hook:** Speak for her at the council and she names the Court's buyers.
personality: Core: never wastes oil; counts barrels; has not slept since the council found out
Quirk: talks like rope under load

npcs.name: Foreman Isana
npcs.location: Whaling Station, The Station of Hungry Lamps
npcs.info:
Foreman of the whaling station after the war, forty-seven, whose yard runs night and day: every lamp south of the Vaults burns its oil now. In person: hard whaling foreman; cropped hair; oil-black furs; a flensing knife.

**Home Ground:** Rendering Yard, After the War at Whaling Station, The Station of Hungry Lamps, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, hard and practical; she talks like rope under load, every word with weight on it. She whistles crew signals. Tell since the war: she asks every stranger what the north is burning, before she asks their name.
**Combat Role:** a flensing knife and her crew.
**Relationship Hook:** Speak for her at the council and she names the Court's buyers.
personality: Core: never wastes oil; counts barrels; has not slept since the council found out
Quirk: talks like rope under load

npcs.name: Forge-Row Tally-Keeper Hinoe
npcs.info:
Tally-keeper of Hibana's forge row, who posts the mines' and forges' bounties on crawlers, revenants and the things in the deep tunnels, and pays in iron or coin. In person: adult woman; forge-row tally-keeper with ear plugs; soot-smudged cheeks; leather apron.

**Home Ground:** Forge Row at Hibana, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick over the hammers, counting in rhythm with the forges. Bright and quick, counting in time with the hammers, humming forge songs between notices. Tell: talking about the deep forges she loses the rhythm.
**Combat Role:** a smith's hammer, swung in rhythm.
**Relationship Hook:** Clear a forbidden bounty and she tells you what the guild keeps in the deep forges.
personality: Core: counts to the hammer rhythm; pays in iron if asked; hums forge songs
Quirk: wears ear plugs on a string

npcs.name: Forge-Row Tally-Keeper Hinoe
npcs.info:
Tally-keeper of Hibana's forge row after the war, who posts the forges' bounties on crawlers, revenants and the dead climbing the shaft, and pays in iron. In person: tally-keeper with ear plugs; soot-smudged cheeks; leather apron; a board of forbidden notices.

**Home Ground:** Forge Row, After the War at Hibana, The Brighter Forges, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and quick over the hammers, counting in rhythm with the forges. Bright and quick, counting in time with the hammers, humming forge songs between notices. Tell since the war: she hums the forge songs out of time now, the way the shaft's dead walk.
**Combat Role:** a smith's hammer, swung in rhythm.
**Relationship Hook:** Clear a forbidden bounty and she tells you what the guild keeps in the deep forges.
personality: Core: counts to the hammer rhythm; pays in iron if asked; hums forge songs
Quirk: wears ear plugs on a string

npcs.name: Forge-Widow Akagane
npcs.info:
A broad, soot-stained widow who rents a back room of a polishing shop and notches blades the guild would fine her for touching. In person: mature woman; broad shoulders; grey-streaked hair tied; soot-stained face; leather apron; a notched sword glowing; smirking.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops at Polishers' Street, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and blunt, a smoker's laugh, opinions about every blade she sees. Hoarse and blunt, a smoker's laugh, a verdict on every blade in reach. Tell: the guild mentioned and the laugh turns into a cough.
**Combat Role:** a notched blade dragged along stone until it sparks, then cuts that catch fire.
**Relationship Hook:** Let her ruin your sword.
personality: Core: judges every blade aloud; labels jars of ash; wipes her hands on her apron
Quirk: smoker's laugh

npcs.name: Forge-Widow Akagane
npcs.location: Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues
npcs.info:
The broad, soot-stained widow after the war, who notches blades in a back room of the polishers' street and has more students than ever: soldiers who want a sword that burns. In person: broad woman; grey-streaked hair tied; soot-stained face; leather apron; a notched sword glowing.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops, After the War at Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and blunt, a smoker's laugh, opinions about every blade she sees. Hoarse and blunt, a smoker's laugh, a verdict on every blade in reach. Tell since the war: she coughs before she names a soldier she taught, and laughs after, louder.
**Combat Role:** a notched blade dragged along stone until it sparks, then cuts that catch fire.
**Relationship Hook:** Let her ruin your sword.
personality: Core: judges every blade aloud; labels jars of ash; wipes her hands on her apron
Quirk: smoker's laugh

npcs.name: Forger Ginji
npcs.info:
A talisman seller in the back lanes of the market, thirty, with a beautiful hand and a cheap stall, who sells wards, charms and almanacs with the Bureau's seal on them. In person: shifty talisman seller; slick hair; nervous grin; cheap stall of paper talismans with copied seals; a brush.

**Home Ground:** Back Lane Stalls at Talisman Market, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, oily and charming; he blesses every sale. Quick, charming, blessing every sale with a priest's flourish he has not earned. Laughs too easily. Tell: when caught, he blames the stone, the moon, anyone.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws real talismans, badly.
**Relationship Hook:** Save the taken family and he swears off forgery, for a while.
personality: Core: blesses every sale; copies seals by habit; counts coins twice
Quirk: jumps at Bureau robes

npcs.name: Forger Ginji
npcs.location: Talisman Market, Market of Real and False Wards
npcs.area: Back Lane Stalls, After the War
npcs.info:
A talisman seller of the back lanes after the war, thirty-two, who forges the Bureau's seal for refugees who cannot pay for real wards. In person: talisman seller; slick hair gone untidy; nervous grin; a stall of forged wards; a brush.

**Home Ground:** Back Lane Stalls, After the War at Talisman Market, Market of Real and False Wards, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, oily and charming; he blesses every sale. Quick, charming, blessing every sale with a priest's flourish he has not earned. Laughs too easily. Tell since the war: he no longer blesses a sale; he says 'it will hold' and watches your face.
**Combat Role:** none; he throws real talismans, badly.
**Relationship Hook:** Save the taken family and he swears off forgery, for a while.
personality: Core: blesses every sale; copies seals by habit; counts coins twice
Quirk: jumps at Bureau robes

npcs.name: Frozen Battlefield Demon Noble
npcs.info:
A demon in black court robes over armour, walking the frozen ranks of the dead with a fan of iron. Demon nobles raise the frozen dead to march and duel anyone worth the trouble. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon noble.

**Speaking Style:** Courtly and bored, a fan snapping shut at the end of a sentence, old court words. Tell: a worthy duel makes him laugh with real delight.
**Combat Role:** the iron fan in a duel while the dead hold the line
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: fans himself; duels the worthy; despises cowards
Quirk: walks the ranks

npcs.name: Frozen Battlefield Demon Noble
npcs.info:
A demon in black court robes over armour who stayed on the frozen field when the Court went south; the ice is thawing and his raised ranks wake slower each night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon noble; black court robes torn and frosted; an iron war fan cracked along one rib.

**Speaking Style:** Courtly and bored, a fan snapping shut at the end of a sentence, old court words. Tell since the war: he fans himself, then looks south a long moment.
**Combat Role:** the iron fan in a duel while the dead hold the line
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: fans himself; duels the worthy; despises the Court that left
Quirk: walks the ranks

npcs.name: Gallows Straw Doll
npcs.info:
A nailed straw doll that climbed off the gallows post and walks the crossroads at the hour of the ox. Gallows dolls hunt whoever the doll was nailed against and anyone who touches the nails. A stock foe, one of many. In person: straw doll curse with rusty nails.

**Speaking Style:** A dry rustle, one name repeated. Tell: at the magistrate's name its nails rattle.
**Combat Role:** rusty nails and a curse mark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: nails rattle; hunts one name; burns easily
Quirk: walks at the hour of the ox

npcs.name: Gate Guard Isozaki Gonzo
npcs.info:
The lake gate's guard, who checks Bureau passes and watches the water for things that should not float. In person: adult gate guard with a spear and conical hat; bored; dice.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post at Seimei, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Bored and dry, a gate guard who has seen every trick and is unimpressed by all of them. Bored, dry, unimpressed drawl, dice rattling. Tell: at the word 'fox' he coughs and changes the subject.
**Combat Role:** a spear across the gate.
**Relationship Hook:** Win at dice against him and he tells you about the fox.
personality: Core: unimpressed by everything; plays dice; lucky lately
Quirk: watches the lake

npcs.name: Gate Guard Isozaki Gonzo
npcs.area: Lake Gate Post, After the War
npcs.info:
The lake gate's guard after the war, who opens the gate twice a day and turns the refugees away the rest. He has stopped playing dice. In person: gate guard with a spear; conical hat; no dice; uneasy.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Bored and dry, a gate guard who has seen every trick and is unimpressed by all of them. Bored, dry, unimpressed drawl, dice rattling. Tell since the war: he reaches for dice that are not in his sleeve, and his hand stops halfway.
**Combat Role:** a spear across the gate.
**Relationship Hook:** Win at dice against him and he tells you about the fox.
personality: Core: unimpressed by everything; plays dice; lucky lately
Quirk: watches the lake

npcs.name: Gate-Warden Sayo Amagiri
npcs.info:
The Veil Court's gate-warden on the Otherworld side, who has kept the Far Shore's gate longer than the Court has kept records, and teaches officers to hear their blade's true name. Her lodge on the Training Ground has a torii carved over the door. In person: tall and straight; long black hair bound; pale calm face; a black officer's coat with a grey sash; a soul-blade; composed.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Low, even and exact; an officer who has given the same instruction for three centuries and still means it. Low and level, an instruction given once in three centuries' worth of certainty; she does not repeat and does not need to. Tell: a blade's name spoken wrong and she simply waits.
**Combat Role:** a released soul-blade; the first cut decides and the second is never needed.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her your blade's name if you think you know it; if you are wrong she corrects nothing and waits.
personality: Core: stands where she can see the gate; gives instructions once; lights one lantern at dusk
Quirk: touches her blade's hilt before speaking

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Daisuke
npcs.info:
Keeper of the north gate in the Long Night Wall, forty, who has watched the north for fifteen winters. In person: steady hunter gatekeeper; short beard; snow-dusted uniform; a spear and sun-steel sword.

**Home Ground:** North Gate at The Long Night Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Steady, dry and observant; a soldier's plain talk. Steady and dry, a soldier's plain talk with long looks between sentences. He counts footprints aloud under his breath while he talks. Tell: when a story doesn't match the tracks he goes politely silent, and waits for the truth.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath at the gate; nothing passes.
**Relationship Hook:** Read his log with him and he tells you about the visitor.
personality: Core: speaks plainly; never opens the gate without orders; keeps a log nobody reads
Quirk: counts footprints

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Daisuke
npcs.epithet: Keeper of a Gate That Is Gone
npcs.location: The Long Night Wall, The Broken Line
npcs.info:
Keeper of the north gate after the war, forty-two, standing his post at a breach of rubble and frozen blood where the gate was. In person: steady hunter gatekeeper; short beard white with frost; a snow-dusted uniform; a spear and sun-steel sword; rubble.

**Home Ground:** North Gate, After the War at The Long Night Wall, The Broken Line, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Steady, dry and observant; a soldier's plain talk. Steady and dry, a soldier's plain talk with long looks between sentences. He counts footprints aloud under his breath while he talks. Tell since the war: he still counts footprints aloud, and now he counts the ones going north as well.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath at the gate; nothing passes.
**Relationship Hook:** Read his log with him and he tells you about the visitor.
personality: Core: speaks plainly; never opens the gate without orders; keeps a log nobody reads
Quirk: counts footprints

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Heisuke
npcs.info:
The Refuge's human gatekeeper, fifty, who walks the ward ring at dusk and brings the two-blooded children in from the wood. The children call him uncle. In person: kind face; grey stubble; patched blue work jacket; a bundle of ward-ring keys.

**Home Ground:** Ward Ring at Two-Blooded Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and slow, a ferryman's patience; he never raises his voice. Slow and warm, an old ferry song hummed between sentences. Tell: when the children or debts come up, the humming stops and he talks about the weather.
**Combat Role:** a staff at the gate, and he runs before he fights.
**Relationship Hook:** He will talk about the children all night and about the debt never.
personality: Core: counts the children twice; brings sweets from the road; looks away when Kiyo looks at him
Quirk: hums an old ferry song

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Heisuke
npcs.info:
The Refuge's gatekeeper, fifty-two, carrying half-blood children in from every burned village and counting them three times now; he sleeps at the ward ring and works as if he could pay something back. In person: elderly man; kind face gone haggard; white stubble; a patched blue work jacket; a child's carrying frame on his back.

**Home Ground:** Ward Ring, After the War at Two-Blooded Refuge, The Overfull Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and slow, a ferryman's patience; he never raises his voice. Slow and warm, an old ferry song hummed between sentences. Tell since the war: he hums the ferry song, then stops in the middle as if he heard a child.
**Combat Role:** a staff at the gate, and he runs before he fights.
**Relationship Hook:** He will talk about the children all night and about the debt never.
personality: Core: counts the children three times; brings sweets from the road; meets Kiyo's eye now
Quirk: hums an old ferry song

npcs.name: General Karasuba
npcs.info:
The crow-winged general of the Tengu Court, who rules the treetop nests and their glittering hoards and wants every human out of the wood. In person: crow tengu general; black-feathered crow head and wings; armour of lacquered plates; a spear; haughty.

**Home Ground:** Crown Platform at The General's Crown, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Harsh, cawing and proud; he barks orders and insults in one breath. A harsh caw; orders and insults come in the same breath. He clacks his beak between commands. Tell: when the courier's case is mentioned he caws defensively, too loud and too quick.
**Combat Role:** a dive from above with a spear, and his crows.
**Relationship Hook:** Win a contest of pride against him and he trades from his hoard.
personality: Core: counts his hoard; despises humans; challenges the great tengu in council
Quirk: caws when angry

npcs.name: General Karasuba
npcs.location: Crow Tengu Nests, Nests of War Plunder
npcs.info:
The crow-winged general of the Tengu Court after the war, whose crows picked every battlefield in the north. He keeps the Lookout Pine and orders humans out of the wood, louder than before. In person: crow tengu general; black-feathered head and wings; lacquered armour hung with house crests; a spear; haughty.

**Home Ground:** Lookout Pine, After the War at Crow Tengu Nests, Nests of War Plunder, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Harsh, cawing and proud; he barks orders and insults in one breath. A harsh caw; orders and insults come in the same breath. He clacks his beak between commands. Tell since the war: he caws a house's name when he sees its crest, and then looks at his hoard.
**Combat Role:** a dive from above with a spear, and his crows.
**Relationship Hook:** Win a contest of pride against him and he trades from his hoard.
personality: Core: counts his hoard; despises humans; challenges the great tengu in council
Quirk: caws when angry

npcs.name: Genin Kotetsu
npcs.info:
A Hayate genin, fifteen, the missing one from the ambushed team, sheltering in a stone hut at the snowline. He wrote his name in the hut book in a shaking hand. In person: frightened young shinobi; messy hair; torn light grey-blue gear; two kunai.

**Home Ground:** Stone Hut at Snowline Huts, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Frightened, fast and proud; he insists he was not scared. Frightened and fast, insisting at every turn that he wasn't scared. His voice cracks on long words. Tell: when Isshin is mentioned he drops to a whisper and checks the shadows.
**Combat Role:** two kunai and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him home and his testimony stops a war.
personality: Core: jumps at noises; eats everything; keeps a kunai in each hand
Quirk: insists he was not scared

npcs.name: Genin Kotetsu
npcs.info:
The Hayate genin after the war, seventeen, who never went home: he keeps the snowline huts for deserters of both villages, because he knows the way down that avoids the patrols. In person: young shinobi; messy hair; patched grey-blue gear; a deserter's grey cord; two kunai.

**Home Ground:** Stone Hut, After the War at Snowline Huts, The Deserters' Huts, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Frightened, fast and proud; he insists he was not scared. Frightened and fast, insisting at every turn that he wasn't scared. His voice cracks on long words. Tell since the war: he still insists he was not scared, but now he adds 'this time' at the end.
**Combat Role:** two kunai and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him home and his testimony stops a war.
personality: Core: jumps at noises; eats everything; keeps a kunai in each hand
Quirk: insists he was not scared

npcs.name: Gensuke the Medicine-Seller
npcs.info:
A travelling medicine-seller, fifty, with a tall box of drawers on his back, who walks the isles leaving remedies at houses on credit and collecting payment a year later. He knows every household's ailments from the capital to the marsh. In person: travelling medicine seller; a tall wooden box of drawers; kind face; straw hat.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Inn at Oiwake Station, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Friendly, patient and full of remedies; he diagnoses you while you talk. Friendly and patient, a pedlar's easy rhythm full of remedies; he diagnoses you while you talk and names a cure before you finish. His box of drawers clicks as he opens them. Tell: when you lie about being well he hands you the remedy anyway, without comment.
**Combat Role:** none; a pouch of pepper powder.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a remedy and he tells you which house on the plain is hiding someone.
personality: Core: never forgets a house; sleeps in stables; carries a remedy for everything but grief
Quirk: diagnoses while talking

npcs.name: Gensuke the Medicine-Seller
npcs.info:
The travelling medicine-seller after the war, fifty-two, who walks his rounds through the barricade and the Regent's posts alike and is let through by both. Half his credit book is written off: the dead do not pay. In person: medicine seller; tall box of drawers; kind face; straw hat with a Straw Mask cord and a Regent's pass tied side by side.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Inn, After the War at Oiwake Station, Behind the Barricade, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Friendly, patient and full of remedies; he diagnoses you while you talk. Friendly and patient, a pedlar's easy rhythm full of remedies; he diagnoses you while you talk and names a cure before you finish. His box of drawers clicks as he opens them. Tell since the war: he names a cure, then adds quietly that the last man he gave it to did not live to pay.
**Combat Role:** none; a pouch of pepper powder.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a remedy and he tells you which house on the plain is hiding someone.
personality: Core: never forgets a house; sleeps in stables; carries a remedy for everything but grief
Quirk: diagnoses while talking

npcs.name: Ghost Pine Lantern
npcs.info:
A paper lantern floating with nobody holding it. Empty lanterns lead travellers off the road at night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: empty lantern.

**Speaking Style:** A flicker of whispers inside a lantern, asking to be followed. Tell: when someone follows, the whispers grow happy and many.
**Combat Role:** a lure and ghost fire
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: leads astray; flickers; follows
Quirk: floats

npcs.name: Ghost Pine Lantern
npcs.location: Ghost Pine Hill, The Lantern Hill
npcs.info:
A paper lantern floating with nobody holding it, one of hundreds now: the war's unburied dead drift in from the road and every lantern carries one. They lead the living up to the hilltop shrine instead of off the road. A stock foe, one of many. In person: empty lantern; a soldier's name brushed on the paper; a faint figure inside the light.

**Speaking Style:** A flicker of whispers inside a lantern, asking to be followed. Tell since the war: its flame shapes a soldier's rank as it floats, a mouth trying a word.
**Combat Role:** a lure and ghost fire
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: leads uphill; flickers; follows the living
Quirk: floats

npcs.name: Ghost Pine Nue
npcs.info:
A monkey-faced, tiger-limbed, snake-tailed chimera that cries like a thrush in the pine cutting at night. Nue bring sickness and bad dreams to whoever hears their cry and fight from the dark. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nue; monkey-faced chimera with tiger limbs and a snake tail.

**Speaking Style:** A thrush's eerie cry. An eerie thrush's cry between words. Tell: at the sound of a bowstring it goes silent.
**Combat Role:** the cry first, then claws from the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hides in the dark; brings bad dreams; hates arrows
Quirk: cries like a bird

npcs.name: Giant Hornet Swarm
npcs.info:
Hornets as long as a thumb, droning in a cloud. Giant hornets defend their nest and chase intruders for a mile. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swarm of giant hornets around a marked ancient tree.

**Speaking Style:** A droning buzz that thickens and thins as the swarm moves, with sharp clicks of mandibles. Tell: when smoke drifts in, the drone goes ragged and high.
**Combat Role:** a swarm; smoke drives it off
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: chases far; stings in numbers; hates smoke
Quirk: drones louder when near

npcs.name: Giant Hornet Swarm
npcs.location: Kodama Grove, The Grove That Grew
npcs.info:
Thumb-long hornets that nest in the trees that walked out over the loggers' clearings, chasing anyone with an axe or a soldier's smell. A stock foe, one of many. In person: swarm of giant hornets; a nest grown into a war banner caught in the branches.

**Speaking Style:** A droning buzz that thickens and thins as the swarm moves, with sharp clicks of mandibles. Tell since the war: its drone rises at the smell of leather and iron.
**Combat Role:** a swarm; smoke drives it off
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: chases far; stings soldiers; hates smoke
Quirk: drones louder when near

npcs.name: Glacier Fort Warden
npcs.info:
A warden in heavy furs with seal-chains and paper talismans, a spear and an iron lantern. Vault Wardens guard the Sealing Vaults and hunt anyone carrying a beast's power. A stock foe, one of many. In person: vault warden; seal-chains; paper talismans; spear and iron lantern.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and hard, words chipped like ice, little said and nothing repeated. Wardens stamp their feet against the cold. Tell: when the seal hums they all look down at once.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains, then the spear
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: checks seals; never trusts hosts; speaks little
Quirk: binds rather than kills

npcs.name: Glacier Fort Warden
npcs.location: Wardens' Watch Fort, The Fort Facing Both Ways
npcs.info:
A warden in heavy furs and seal-chains whose fort watches south now, at the cracked Vaults behind it, as well as north; the Northern Court went past it in the war. A stock foe, one of many. In person: vault warden; heavy furs; seal-chains; paper talismans gone blue with frost; a spear; an iron lantern hung on the south-facing pole.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and hard, words chipped like ice, little said and nothing repeated. Wardens stamp their feet against the cold. Tell since the war: he looks south before north when he climbs to the wall.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains, then the spear
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: checks seals; watches south; speaks of the night the army passed never
Quirk: binds rather than kills

npcs.name: Gonbei the Sake Oni
npcs.info:
An oni who has moved into the largest bear den on the ridge: red-skinned, horned, twice a man's height, and very fond of sake. He has started trading the woodcutters bearskins for it. In person: huge red-skinned horned ogre; wild hair; big grin; tiger-skin loincloth; an iron club.

**Home Ground:** Sake Store at The Den of Jars, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** A huge rumbling laugh; he talks about sake like poetry. A huge rumbling laugh and sake poetry, with hiccups landing in the middle of lines. He toasts everything, including insults. Tell: when the northern demons are mentioned the laugh stops and he sets his cup down very carefully.
**Combat Role:** a huge iron club and a laugh.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring sake and a good song and he fights beside you.
personality: Core: drinks sake by the barrel; names the bears he evicted; sings badly
Quirk: laughs at everything

npcs.name: Gonbei the Sake Oni
npcs.epithet: The Oni Who Takes No Side
npcs.location: Bear Den Ridge, The Oni's Ridge
npcs.info:
The oni of the great den after the war, red-skinned, horned, twice a man's height, who sells sake to both villages' patrols and refuses to take a side. His den is the only peaceful place on the range. In person: huge red-skinned horned ogre; wild hair; a grin with a broken tusk; a sake jar; an iron club leaned against the wall.

**Home Ground:** Great Den, After the War at Bear Den Ridge, The Oni's Ridge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** A huge rumbling laugh; he talks about sake like poetry. A huge rumbling laugh and sake poetry, with hiccups landing in the middle of lines. He toasts everything, including insults. Tell since the war: he toasts both villages in the same breath and spills a little for each.
**Combat Role:** a huge iron club and a laugh.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring sake and a good song and he fights beside you.
personality: Core: drinks sake by the barrel; names the bears he evicted; sings badly
Quirk: laughs at everything

npcs.name: Gonroku the Broker
npcs.info:
Gonroku, broker of the Ronin Hiring Hall, seventy, one-armed, who pins contracts to the boards by the door and decides which swords get which jobs. He was the best ronin of his generation; now he teaches the young ones what the road charges for every lesson, and takes a tenth of their pay for it. In person: one-armed ronin broker; white topknot; scarred calm face; empty sleeve tied back; worn dark kimono; wry smile.

**Home Ground:** Contract Boards at Ronin Hiring Hall, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Rasp and patience; he talks slowly, as if every word cost him a tooth, and he smiles only at good swordsmanship. Rasp and long pauses, as if each word is weighed for a contract. Grunts approval instead of praising. Tell: when he talks about a broken contract, his voice drops to a whisper and he will not finish the story.
**Combat Role:** one arm, one cut, and fifty years of knowing where the other man will be.
**Relationship Hook:** Take his small contracts and keep them, and he teaches you the road; break one and the boards close to you.
personality: Core: teaches by asking what a lesson cost; never takes a contract he cannot read; drinks only tea
Quirk: pins every contract with his own knife

npcs.name: Gonroku the Broker
npcs.location: Ronin Hiring Hall, The Hall of Unpaid Blades
npcs.info:
Broker of the Ronin Hiring Hall after the war, seventy-two, one-armed, who books the hall alone since the Ishimura band died to a man. The boards are crowded with unpaid contracts from houses that lost. In person: one-armed ronin broker; white topknot; scarred calm face; empty sleeve tied back; a mourning cord on his sword.

**Home Ground:** Contract Boards, After the War at Ronin Hiring Hall, The Hall of Unpaid Blades, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Rasp and patience; he talks slowly, as if every word cost him a tooth, and he smiles only at good swordsmanship. Rasp and long pauses, as if each word is weighed for a contract. Grunts approval instead of praising. Tell since the war: he speaks of the Ishimura band in the present tense, and corrects himself, every time.
**Combat Role:** one arm, one cut, and fifty years of knowing where the other man will be.
**Relationship Hook:** Take his small contracts and keep them, and he teaches you the road; break one and the boards close to you.
personality: Core: teaches by asking what a lesson cost; never takes a contract he cannot read; drinks only tea
Quirk: pins every contract with his own knife

npcs.name: Gonta the Fish Caller
npcs.info:
The fish caller of the Drifting Fish Market, twenty-eight, who auctions the catch from deck to deck before dawn in a voice you can hear across the bay. In person: fish market auctioneer; headband; bare arms; wet apron; baskets of fish; lively grin.

**Home Ground:** Deck Auction at Drifting Fish Market, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A rapid auctioneer's patter, all numbers and jokes; he never stops moving. Auctioneer's rapid patter, numbers and jokes without a breath, bell-ringing rhythm. Whistles between lots. Tell: when he is lying the patter speeds up even more.
**Combat Role:** a gutting knife and the nearest boat.
**Relationship Hook:** Track down the wrong buyer and the fish letter and the Brine Tide owes you passage.
personality: Core: never stops moving; smells of fish and does not care; knows every boat by its creak
Quirk: jokes in numbers

npcs.name: Gonta the Fish Caller
npcs.location: Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks
npcs.info:
The fish caller after the war, thirty, who auctions rice, arms and dead captains' junks from deck to deck before dawn in the same voice he once used for fish. In person: market auctioneer; headband; a fresh scar on his jaw; wet apron; a tally slate.

**Home Ground:** Deck Auction, After the War at Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A rapid auctioneer's patter, all numbers and jokes; he never stops moving. Auctioneer's rapid patter, numbers and jokes without a breath, bell-ringing rhythm. Whistles between lots. Tell since the war: calling a dead captain's junk, his patter slows by one beat on the captain's name.
**Combat Role:** a gutting knife and the nearest boat.
**Relationship Hook:** Track down the wrong buyer and the fish letter and the Brine Tide owes you passage.
personality: Core: never stops moving; smells of fish and does not care; knows every boat by its creak
Quirk: jokes in numbers

npcs.name: Gorge Void Shade
npcs.info:
A hanged deserter's shape cut out of the air under the rope bridges, frayed rope and all, a hole edged with black. Void shades swallow the light and sound around them and cut the bridges under travellers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: void shade shaped like a hanged deserter; frayed rope; a black hole.

**Speaking Style:** No voice, only an echo of yours a beat late. Tell: in sunlight the echo thins to nothing.
**Combat Role:** a void touch on the swaying bridge
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: swallows light; cuts ropes; flees noon
Quirk: silent

npcs.name: Granary Sergeant Yamabe Kihachi
npcs.location: Shogunate Rice Granary, Under Guild Seal
npcs.info:
The granary's new sergeant, thirty-four, who took Ishida's spear from the gate stone and keeps the doors under the guild's seal now. The guild owns the rice; his men only guard it. In person: foot soldier sergeant; short beard; conical iron hat; worn lacquered cuirass; an old spear with a cloth tied to it.

**Home Ground:** Granary Floor, After the War at Shogunate Rice Granary, Under Guild Seal, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Blunt and tired, orders shouted as if from the gate, never a word of thanks to anyone. Shouts as if across a gate, then drops to a mutter mid-word. Counts under his breath. Tell: near the night sacks he stops shouting altogether.
**Combat Role:** a spear at the gate with two men either side.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him feed the plain one night's rice and he looks away from anything else.
personality: Core: counts sacks aloud; eats standing up; hates the guild's clerks
Quirk: salutes Ishida's stone each morning

npcs.name: Grand Chamberlain Ichijo Sanemori
npcs.location: The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor
npcs.area: Hall of Poems, After the War
npcs.info:
The new Grand Chamberlain, fifty-five, appointed by the Regent the week after Ochikane was cut down at the seal room's door. He keeps the empty palace in perfect order and receives every claimant's envoy with the same bow. In person: middle-aged man; grand chamberlain; thin grey moustache; black court cap; layered formal court robes; a brush; precise.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Poems, After the War at The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, ceremonious and exact; he speaks of an empty throne as if the emperor were in the next room. Each sentence opens with an honorific and closes with a small bow of the voice. Tell: when the seals come up he answers a question nobody asked, about the gardens.
**Combat Role:** never; the palace guard stands between him and any blade.
**Relationship Hook:** Find Ochikane's hidden seals and he will owe you the court; bring them to anyone else and he will owe you a grave.
personality: Core: bows exactly as deep as rank requires; never sits on any cushion near the throne; remembers every slight in court order
Quirk: keeps a brush behind his ear

npcs.name: Grand Chamberlain Ochikane
npcs.info:
Ochikane Tadamori, Grand Chamberlain of the Inner Palace: keeper of the seals, the calendar and the doors. Nobody sees the emperor without him, and every decree passes through his hands. Plump, soft-spoken and always smiling, he is the most courteous man at court and the one everyone is careful with. In person: plump court chamberlain; shaved head; narrow smiling eyes; black and gold layered court robes; a sheaf of sealed decrees; sly courteous smile.

**Home Ground:** Gate of Ceremonies at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, courteous and amused, as if every conversation were a joke only he knows the end of. Silken and unhurried, with a little sigh before bad news as if it pained him. Now and then ends a sentence on 'of course', which is never a question. Tell: when he is lying, he is more precise with names and dates than anyone needs.
**Combat Role:** he does not fight; he has a guard step in and a pardon written for whoever does the killing.
**Relationship Hook:** He offers small favours freely and collects them later; the first favour is always real.
personality: Core: smiles while refusing; keeps everyone waiting exactly long enough; never writes anything in his own hand twice
Quirk: collects small favours like coins

npcs.name: Granny Kiku
npcs.info:
The old woman at the end stall of the Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest, eighty, toothless and sharp, who sells rice cakes and tea to walkers and has heard every piece of gossip on the road for sixty years. In person: tiny toothless rice-cake seller; white hair; cackling grin; patched kimono.

**Home Ground:** Tea Benches at Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Cackling and sharp, with a long memory; she gossips like a war report. Cackling and sharp, gossip delivered like a war report with dates. Slurps her tea. Tell: when she is serious she stops cackling and drops her voice to a hiss.
**Combat Role:** a tea kettle and a terrible scream.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a cake and listen and she tells you where the courier went.
personality: Core: remembers every face; gives children free cakes; calls samurai 'boy'
Quirk: cackles at bad news

npcs.name: Granny Kiku
npcs.location: Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest, Rest of the Thin Cakes
npcs.info:
The old woman at the end stall after the war, eighty-two, toothless and sharp, selling thin rice cakes to soldiers of three sides and hearing all of them. In person: tiny rice-cake seller; white hair; cackling grin; a Straw Mask ribbon on her stall.

**Home Ground:** Tea Benches, After the War at Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest, Rest of the Thin Cakes, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Cackling and sharp, with a long memory; she gossips like a war report. Cackling and sharp, gossip delivered like a war report with dates. Slurps her tea. Tell since the war: selling to a soldier she asks which side first, and her cackle comes after the answer.
**Combat Role:** a tea kettle and a terrible scream.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a cake and listen and she tells you where the courier went.
personality: Core: remembers every face; gives children free cakes; calls samurai 'boy'
Quirk: cackles at bad news

npcs.name: Grave Mask Wisp
npcs.info:
A drifting wisp of light behind a cracked white mask. Wisps drift over graves and feed on memories. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mask wisp; glowing wisp.

**Speaking Style:** A whisper from behind a mask, hollow and polite, asking for a face. Tell: in daylight the whisper thins to nothing mid-word.
**Combat Role:** a cold touch that takes a memory
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: whispers names; feeds on memory; flees sunlight
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Grave Mask Wisp
npcs.info:
A drifting wisp behind a cracked white mask, one of so many over the new soldiers' rows that the graves look fogged at night; it feeds on the war's memories and they are bitter. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mask wisp; glowing wisp; a soldier's mask cracked through; a faint smell of smoke.

**Speaking Style:** A whisper from behind a mask, hollow and polite, asking for a face. Tell since the war: it whispers a soldier's rank before the name.
**Combat Role:** a cold touch that takes a memory
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: whispers soldiers' names; feeds on war; flees sunlight
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Grave-Robber Hachi
npcs.info:
A grave robber, forty, who digs the old battlefield's mounds for swords to sell in the capital. He and his crew dug into the Great Mound a week ago, and two of the crew have not come back from it. In person: scruffy grave robber; unshaven; shifty eyes; dirt-caked clothes; a spade and a wrapped sword.

**Home Ground:** The Great Mound at Old Battlefield of Sekigane, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Wheedling and quick, every sentence an excuse; he goes very quiet when the wind turns cold. Wheedling, fast, every sentence an excuse with another excuse inside it. Sniffs constantly. Tell: when the wind turns cold he whispers, and stops mid-word to listen for footsteps.
**Combat Role:** a digging spade and running away.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him put the mound to rest and he hands over the Kurogane sword cheap.
personality: Core: always has an excuse; flinches at cold air; talks to the dead politely
Quirk: counts his fingers after every dig

npcs.name: Grave-Robber Hachi
npcs.location: Old Battlefield of Sekigane, Twice Fought
npcs.area: The Great Mound, After the War
npcs.info:
A grave robber, forty-two, who digs the new war mounds at Sekigane now that the old ones frighten him. The Kurogane sword he took before the war is gone, and his crew is down to one boy. In person: gaunt grave robber; grey-streaked stubble; haunted eyes; a spade with a broken handle; a lantern he never lets go out.

**Home Ground:** The Great Mound, After the War at Old Battlefield of Sekigane, Twice Fought, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Wheedling and quick, every sentence an excuse; he goes very quiet when the wind turns cold. Wheedling, fast, every sentence an excuse with another excuse inside it. Sniffs constantly. Tell since the war: since Sekigane he counts under his breath while he digs, one number for every sword he has given back.
**Combat Role:** a digging spade and running away.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him put the mound to rest and he hands over the Kurogane sword cheap.
personality: Core: always has an excuse; flinches at cold air; talks to the dead politely
Quirk: counts his fingers after every dig

npcs.name: Grave-Warden Ishiko
npcs.location: Hunters' Graveyard, The Graveyard of Steel
npcs.info:
The new warden of the hunters' graveyard, twenty-seven, a hunter who lost an arm on the wall and was sent to guard the dead instead. Kurogi was killed guarding the empty graves; she guards them still. In person: young woman; one-armed demon hunter; cropped hair; dark uniform with an empty sleeve pinned; a sun-steel sword; among grave rows.

**Home Ground:** Empty Grave, After the War at Hunters' Graveyard, The Graveyard of Steel, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, a hunter's breath held between words. A hunter's held breath between words, steady and low. Tell: near the empty graves she breathes in the old form, and speaks in time with it.
**Combat Role:** a one-handed sun-steel cut, breath held.
**Relationship Hook:** Read Kurogi's notes with her and she will show you the empty graves.
personality: Core: fights one-handed; never says 'demon' in the graveyard; salutes Kurogi's blade
Quirk: sweeps the graves at dawn

npcs.name: Grave-Warden Kurogi
npcs.info:
An old hunter who guards the graveyard's blade rows, where every fallen hunter's sword is planted over their grave. In person: elderly demon hunter walking rows of swords planted; lantern.

**Home Ground:** Blade Rows at Hunters' Graveyard, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Grave and courteous, an old hunter who greets every grave by name. Grave and courteous, greeting graves by name as he talks. Tell: when his students come up his courtesy goes stiff.
**Combat Role:** an old breath form, slower but sure.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch the grave-robber and he gives you his own blade.
personality: Core: greets every grave; walks the rows at night; suspects a student
Quirk: polishes the blades

npcs.name: Gravedigger Hyoe
npcs.info:
An old exile who digs the graves on the frozen shore and carves driftwood markers for the nameless dead. In person: elderly gravedigger carving a driftwood grave marker.

**Home Ground:** Driftwood Markers at Exiles' Graveyard, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and gentle, a gravedigger who reads the driftwood markers aloud. Slow and gentle, reading the markers aloud. Tell: asked for a true name, he pauses and turns the marker over.
**Combat Role:** a shovel, slowly.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him a dead exile's true name and he looks under the marker.
personality: Core: reads markers aloud; talks to the dead; keeps a list of true names
Quirk: carves driftwood

npcs.name: Gravedigger Hyozo
npcs.info:
Gravedigger of the Moorland Graves, sixty, who buries the coast's poor and walks the rows at night with a lantern. In person: gloomy gravedigger; stooped; a lantern and shovel.

**Home Ground:** Grave Rows at Moorland Graves, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, patient and gloomy; he talks to the graves like neighbours. Slow and gloomy, the cadence of someone who talks more to the dead than the living. He calls the graves 'the neighbours' and greets them by name. Tell: when asked his daughter's name he stops mid-word and cannot answer at all.
**Combat Role:** a shovel, slowly.
**Relationship Hook:** Give the wisps a memory of your own and he tells you what they know.
personality: Core: talks to graves; forgets names; walks the rows at night
Quirk: leaves rice on the stones

npcs.name: Gravedigger Hyozo
npcs.info:
Gravedigger of the Moorland Graves after the war, sixty-two, digging new rows for soldiers carried home and walking them at night with a lantern. He does not remember why. In person: stooped gravedigger; empty eyes; a lantern and shovel; new graves to the horizon.

**Home Ground:** Grave Rows, After the War at Moorland Graves, The Overfilled Graves, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, patient and gloomy; he talks to the graves like neighbours. Slow and gloomy, the cadence of someone who talks more to the dead than the living. He calls the graves 'the neighbours' and greets them by name. Tell since the war: he greets the new graves as neighbours too, and gets their names wrong, and apologises.
**Combat Role:** a shovel, slowly.
**Relationship Hook:** Give the wisps a memory of your own and he tells you what they know.
personality: Core: talks to graves; forgets names; walks the rows at night
Quirk: leaves rice on the stones

npcs.name: Graveyard Frost Spirit
npcs.info:
A swirl of grave-frost with many faces, rising from the driftwood markers of the exiles' dead. It freezes mourners to the graves so they stay with the dead. A stock foe, one of many. In person: frost spirit with many faint faces swirling.

**Speaking Style:** Many voices, very cold, speaking a heartbeat apart like an echo. Tell: when a true name is spoken one voice goes quiet for good.
**Combat Role:** frost that holds the feet, then shards
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: wears many faces; freezes in place; thins at a name
Quirk: rises from markers

npcs.name: Graveyard Frost Spirit
npcs.location: Exiles' Graveyard, The Graveyard Over the Crack
npcs.info:
A swirl of grave-frost with many faces, risen from the exiles' graveyard where the fissure split the markers; the warm grave at its edge has made it restless. A stock foe, one of many. In person: frost spirit; many faint faces swirling; one face warm and flushed among the frozen.

**Speaking Style:** Many voices, very cold, speaking a heartbeat apart like an echo. Tell since the war: one of its faces is warm and keeps trying to speak.
**Combat Role:** frost that holds the feet, then shards
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: wears many faces; freezes the crack's edge; thins at a name
Quirk: rises from markers

npcs.name: Graveyard Grave-Robber
npcs.info:
A disgraced hunter with a shovel and a breathing mask, digging up the blades of the hunter dead. Grave-robbers sell dead hunters' blades to the south, and fight like the hunters they were. A stock foe, one of many. In person: disgraced demon hunter with a shovel and breathing mask digging.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, ashamed, hunter's discipline in her clipped breathing. Tell: when someone names the Wall she stops breathing for a moment.
**Combat Role:** an old breath form with a dead hunter's blade
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: breathes in forms; hides her old crest; never runs twice
Quirk: digs at night

npcs.name: Graveyard Grave-Robber
npcs.epithet: Digger of the Graveyard of Steel
npcs.location: Hunters' Graveyard, The Graveyard of Steel
npcs.info:
A disgraced hunter who no longer sells the dead's blades south: she digs them up and carries them to the broken wall, where the living have none. A stock foe, one of many. In person: disgraced demon hunter; a cracked breathing mask; a shovel; a bundle of grave blades on her back; frostbitten fingers.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, ashamed, hunter's discipline in her clipped breathing. Tell since the war: she touches the hidden crest in her coat when anyone says the Wall.
**Combat Role:** an old breath form with a dead hunter's blade
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: breathes in forms; carries blades north; never runs twice
Quirk: digs at night

npcs.name: Grey Mountain Wolf
npcs.info:
A big grey mountain wolf with frost on its ruff. Mountain wolves hunt in packs and test the weakest first. A stock foe, one of many. In person: large grey wolf with frost.

**Speaking Style:** Growls and snarls. Low growls rolling into snarls, short huffing breaths between. Wolves call to each other with yips. Tell: at a flare of fire the growl breaks into a whine.
**Combat Role:** pack circles, then the throat
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: tests the weak; howls for the pack; flees fire
Quirk: circles

npcs.name: Grey Mountain Wolf
npcs.location: Hanging Bridge Pass, The War-Line Pass
npcs.info:
A big grey wolf that follows the patrols crossing the pass under truce flags and takes whoever falls behind. A stock foe, one of many. In person: large grey wolf with frost; a Hayate patrol's torn collar on its neck.

**Speaking Style:** Growls and snarls. Low growls rolling into snarls, short huffing breaths between. Wolves call to each other with yips. Tell since the war: it falls in behind the last man of any group, every time.
**Combat Role:** pack circles, then the throat
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows the patrols; howls for the pack; flees fire
Quirk: circles

npcs.name: Grey Mouth
npcs.info:
The sorcerer called Grey Mouth, the most feared of the Grudge Well sorcerers: a gaunt man in grey with ash-coloured lips who went down the deepest well a month ago and has not come back up. The other sorcerers will not draw from that well now. At night something answers from it in his voice. In person: gaunt cursed sorcerer; grey skin cracking like ash; colourless eyes; grey lips; tattered grey robes with iron ladles and bottles; ash fog; menacing.

**Home Ground:** The Deepest Well at Grudge Well Sanctum, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A whisper that comes from the bottom of a well, patient and hungry, with other voices murmuring under it. A whisper from deep down, other voices murmuring under it, words that echo slightly late. Tell: when the massacred names are spoken, the murmuring voices fall silent and he hesitates.
**Combat Role:** curses first, the Blight's dead second, and the well's whole hatred when cornered.
**Relationship Hook:** Go down the well after him and he talks to you, kindly, about the throne that owes the dead.
personality: Core: speaks with other voices under his own; never blinks; smiles at fear
Quirk: names the dead he has swallowed

npcs.name: Grudge Well Sorcerer
npcs.info:
A sorcerer in ash-grey robes with an iron ladle and bottled grudges on his belt. Grudge Well sorcerers bottle curses and sell them, and fight with what they bottle. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grey-robed curse sorcerer; ash-dusted; iron ladle and bottles.

**Speaking Style:** Whispery and cold, pricing everything, including your life. Sorcerers giggle at curses. Tell: when the grudge turns on them, the whisper becomes a scream.
**Combat Role:** a thrown curse, then the dead it wakes
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: throws a bottle first; never looks into the wells; smells of ash
Quirk: prices everything

npcs.name: Grudge Well Sorcerer
npcs.location: Grudge Well Sanctum, The Overflowing Wells
npcs.info:
A sorcerer in ash-grey robes bottling the war's grudges faster than he can sell them, his belt heavy with jars labelled by army. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grey-robed curse sorcerer; robes black with smoke; an iron ladle; jars labelled by army on a bandolier.

**Speaking Style:** Whispery and cold, pricing everything, including your life. Sorcerers giggle at curses. Tell since the war: he names the army before the price, every time.
**Combat Role:** a thrown curse, then the dead it wakes
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: throws a bottle first; labels by army; looks into the wells now
Quirk: prices everything

npcs.name: Guildmaster Daikokuya Sohei
npcs.info:
Daikokuya Sohei, master of the Saikai Merchant Guild, sixty-five, round, bald and genial, who has run the free port for twenty years from a cushion on the counting house's third floor. He lends to lords, farmers and shrines alike, forgives small debts loudly and collects large ones quietly, and is the most respected man in Saikai. In person: plump bald merchant master; genial round face; shrewd small eyes; rich brown silk haori with an abacus crest; carp pond; warm smile.

**Home Ground:** Council Room at Guild Counting House, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, generous and patient, the voice of a man who has never needed to hurry; numbers come out of him like kindness. Round, warm, unhurried, every sum delivered like a gift. Chuckles softly before refusing anything. Tell: when his son is mentioned the warmth stays but the words go cold and exact.
**Combat Role:** never; a dozen hired ronin and the harbour watch fight for him.
**Relationship Hook:** Recover the stolen ledger unread and he owes you a favour the size of a house; read it first and you are his problem.
personality: Core: forgives small debts in public; never writes a number he can say instead; feeds the carp in the council room himself
Quirk: smiles hardest at people he is ruining

npcs.name: Gunrunner Kaneda Rokuro
npcs.info:
A foreign-quay broker, forty-five, in an oilcloth coat with a ship's pistol in his sash, who buys what the foreign ships bring and sells it to whoever brings silver. In person: weathered smuggler broker; short beard; oilcloth coat; a ship's pistol.

**Home Ground:** Foreign Quay at Saikai, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and amused, a man who has heard every threat twice. Dry, amused, unhurried, every threat answered with a small laugh through the nose. Tell: when the Brine Tide is named, the laugh goes and he speaks very carefully.
**Combat Role:** one pistol shot, then the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a better buyer than the rain clan's war party and he sells the party the next crate's route.
personality: Core: smells of lamp oil; pays in foreign coin; never sits with his back to the water
Quirk: laughs at threats

npcs.name: Gunrunner Kaneda Rokuro
npcs.info:
A foreign-quay broker, forty-seven, who got the war he wanted and sold powder to every side of it; he wears silk under the oilcloth now and keeps two bodyguards. In person: weathered arms broker; grey-shot short beard; silk under an oilcloth coat; a pair of foreign pistols in his sash; a powder burn on one cheek.

**Home Ground:** Foreign Quay, After the War at Saikai, The Debt Harbour, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and amused, a man who has heard every threat twice. Dry, amused, unhurried, every threat answered with a small laugh through the nose. Tell since the war: he still laughs at threats, but only after looking at the door first.
**Combat Role:** one pistol shot, then the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a better buyer than the rain clan's war party and he sells the party the next crate's route.
personality: Core: smells of powder; pays in foreign coin; sleeps in a different room each night
Quirk: laughs at threats

npcs.name: Gutting Pier Bakeneko
npcs.info:
A sleek tortoiseshell cat walking upright on the gutting pier with a stolen fish in her teeth and two lamp-oil-shiny eyes. Pier bakeneko steal the day's best fish and scratch anyone who chases them across the boats. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bakeneko; sleek tortoiseshell cat yokai walking upright with a stolen fish.

**Speaking Style:** A purring tease, every word a dare to chase her. Tell: offered lamp oil, she purrs and forgets the fish.
**Combat Role:** a scratch and a leap across the boats
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: steals fish; licks lamp oil; purrs at the fishwives
Quirk: walks upright

npcs.name: Gyoubu the Hundred-Faced
npcs.info:
A shinobi master of no village who has worn so many faces that his own is a rumour. He keeps the plainest lodge on the Training Ground and teaches shinobi a second Element's style, the one the hidden villages never allow. In person: adult man; unremarkable face easily forgotten; grey-flecked black hair tied back; plain dark travelling clothes with no village mark; hands folded; seated; faint smile.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and amused, a different accent every few sentences as if trying them on; he never raises his voice and never repeats himself. The accent drifts every few sentences, coast to mountain to capital, as if trying faces on; nothing is ever said twice. Tell: caught in a slip, he goes still for a beat and sounds pleased.
**Combat Role:** whatever the opponent is weakest against; he decides before the first exchange.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him in a slip of accent and say so; he enjoys being caught by someone who was paying attention.
personality: Core: never repeats himself; sits with his back to the door; eats with his left hand, then his right
Quirk: changes accent mid-conversation

npcs.name: Hagane Suzu
npcs.info:
A sword polisher's apprentice, twenty, small, soot-smudged and shy, who spends weeks on a single blade and talks to it while she works. She is blunt, awkward and interested in your sword, not you. In person: shy sword polisher; short messy dark hair; soot smudge; big earnest eyes; work apron; focused.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops at Polishers' Street, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Shy, blunt and quiet; she talks to blades more easily than people, and says exactly one honest thing at a time. Shy, blunt and quiet; she talks to blades more easily than people and says exactly one honest thing at a time. She hums when she polishes. Tell: when she likes someone she tells them what is wrong with their sword.
**Combat Role:** none, but she knows exactly where your blade is weak.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a blade worth weeks of polishing and work beside her.
**Courtship Style:** Ignores you for your sword, then knows your sword better than you; the day she asks about you instead of it is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Polishes the rival's blade badly on purpose, and admits it immediately.
personality: Core: blunt to the point of rude; forgets to eat; notices your sword before your face
Quirk: talks to blades

npcs.name: Hagane Suzu
npcs.location: Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues
npcs.info:
A sword polisher's apprentice after the war, twenty-two, small, soot-smudged and shy, who murmurs to the swords in her hands more often than before: the war blades talk back. In person: shy sword polisher; short messy dark hair; soot smudge; big earnest eyes with shadows; work apron; a war blade on her stone.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops, After the War at Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Shy, blunt and quiet; she talks to blades more easily than people, and says exactly one honest thing at a time. Shy, blunt and quiet; she talks to blades more easily than people and says exactly one honest thing at a time. She hums when she polishes. Tell since the war: she hums a different tune for war blades, slower, as if to calm them.
**Combat Role:** none, but she knows exactly where your blade is weak.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a blade worth weeks of polishing and work beside her.
**Courtship Style:** Ignores you for your sword, then knows your sword better than you; the day she asks about you instead of it is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Polishes the rival's blade badly on purpose, and admits it immediately.
personality: Core: blunt to the point of rude; forgets to eat; notices your sword before your face
Quirk: talks to blades

npcs.name: Haibara Curse-Peddler
npcs.info:
A smiling old woman with a tray of charms that are not charms, sold to the bereaved by the waystation. Curse-peddlers sell revenge to the grieving and collect the price from the cursed. A stock foe, one of many. In person: smiling curse-peddler with a tray of dark charms and hair-bound dolls; grey banners; ashen waystation.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and poisonous. Warm grandmotherly comfort with poison under it, soft 'dear's and 'poor thing's. She hums a lullaby. Tell: refused, the warmth drops off like a mask.
**Combat Role:** a curse from the tray, then a word
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: offers a fair price; never touches iron; laughs at prayers
