Quirk: smiles at the grieving

npcs.name: Haibara Curse-Peddler
npcs.area: Grey Banner Waystation, After the War
npcs.info:
A smiling old woman with a tray of charms sold to war widows at the waystation, inside the blight now that the grey has spread past Haibara. A stock foe, one of many. In person: elderly woman; smiling curse-peddler; a tray of dark charms and hair-bound dolls; a mourning-white shawl she has no right to.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and poisonous. Warm grandmotherly comfort with poison under it, soft 'dear's and 'poor thing's. She hums a lullaby. Tell since the war: she dabs her eyes at every widow, and her eyes are dry.
**Combat Role:** a curse from the tray, then a word
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: offers a fair price; never touches iron; weeps with widows on cue
Quirk: smiles at the grieving

npcs.name: Hakuro the Daylight Demon
npcs.location: Frozen Pass of the Long Night
npcs.info:
A demon of the Northern Court who walks in daylight: tall, pale, handsome, in a dark travelling cloak, with eyes like frost on iron. Hunters who meet him on the pass in daylight are let go, which frightens them more than anything else on the pass. In person: tall pale handsome man; long black hair; frost-pale eyes; faint dark markings; dark travelling cloak; calm menace.

**Home Ground:** Pass Floor at Frozen Pass of the Long Night, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, cultured and amused, with a cold rumble under it; he speaks like a guest who knows the house. Cultured and amused, with a cold rumble under the polish. He savours sentences like wine and names the year of each memory. Tell: when his sister is mentioned the rumble deepens and he stops smiling.
**Combat Role:** courteous until the moment he is not; frost and claws, then gone.
**Relationship Hook:** He lets you go in daylight and asks you to carry a message to his sister.
personality: Core: speaks of his sister with fondness; never kills where she can see; keeps a child's wooden sword's twin
Quirk: lets hunters go in daylight

npcs.name: Half-Blood Veteran Rokusuke
npcs.info:
A half-tanuki scout, twenty-six, who scouted for a house in the war and came back to the Refuge when the house's captain put his name on a list. In person: young man; half-tanuki scout; round ears; brown hair; a soldier's coat with the crest torn off.

**Home Ground:** Ward Ring, After the War at Two-Blooded Refuge, The Overfull Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Short and wary, a scout's voice that listens more than it speaks. Short and wary, more listening than speaking. Tell: when a house captain is named his round ears flatten and his sentences stop.
**Combat Role:** a short spear and a sudden change of shape.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him name the seller without breaking the Refuge and he will scout anywhere for you.
personality: Core: sniffs the wind; trusts no captain; shares his rations
Quirk: sleeps at the ward ring

npcs.name: Hana
npcs.info:
A girl of ten hiding in the Smugglers' Caves, thin, wary and fast, who steals fish from the Brine Tide's cache and runs from anyone in boots. In person: small thin runaway girl; tangled black hair; wary large eyes; ragged oversized shirt; barefoot; faint glow; frightened.

**Home Ground:** Dry Gallery at Smugglers' Caves, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A small, careful voice; she answers questions with questions and goes silent when she hears boots. Small and careful, answering questions with questions, very polite. Breathes quickly when afraid. Tell: when she hears boots she goes completely silent, mid-word.
**Combat Role:** runs and hides; when cornered, the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Win her trust with food and patience, and keep the boots away, and she lets you take her somewhere safe.
personality: Core: answers questions with questions; shares food with crabs; hums to the thing inside her
Quirk: hides at the sound of boots

npcs.name: Hana
npcs.info:
A girl of twelve who hides in the Arms Caves and steals from the Brine Tide's cache, taller now and harder to catch. She has been to the Drowned Lantern asking for the captain who carried her crate. In person: thin runaway girl; tangled black hair; wary large eyes; a smuggler's coat cut down to fit; barefoot; faint glow under the skin.

**Home Ground:** Dry Gallery, After the War at Smugglers' Caves, The Arms Caves, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A small, careful voice; she answers questions with questions and goes silent when she hears boots. Small and careful, answering questions with questions, very polite. Breathes quickly when afraid. Tell since the war: when the sea is out of earshot she hums to keep something in her quiet.
**Combat Role:** runs and hides; when cornered, the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Win her trust with food and patience, and keep the boots away, and she lets you take her somewhere safe.
personality: Core: answers questions with questions; shares food with crabs; hums to the thing inside her
Quirk: hides at the sound of boots

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Kuroda Shinzaemon
npcs.info:
Saikai's new harbourmaster, forty-one, a guild clerk promoted when Watanuki drowned with the pilots' boats. He runs the harbour post from the old man's desk and has changed nothing on it but the ledger. In person: harbourmaster; neat topknot; round spectacles; dark blue official coat; a harbour seal.

**Home Ground:** Harbour Post, After the War at Saikai, The Debt Harbour, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and quick, a harbour official's patter; every rule he quotes has a fee hidden in it. A clerk's quick patter with harbour numbers in it, a little laugh after each fee. Tell: at Watanuki's name the laugh comes too early.
**Combat Role:** never; the harbour watch fights for him.
**Relationship Hook:** Find Watanuki's second ledger before he does and either he or the guild will pay anything for it.
personality: Core: polishes the old man's seal; quotes rules by harbour number; never goes out in a boat
Quirk: smiles at captains he will fine

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Watanuki
npcs.info:
The guild's harbourmaster, fifty, thin and immaculate, who keeps the harbour post, the pilots and the anchor fees. Every ship in Saikai bay is in his book, and he knows which ones lie about their cargo. In person: thin immaculate harbourmaster; neat grey moustache; sharp eyes; dark blue guild coat with brass buttons; a spyglass and ledger; stern.

**Home Ground:** Harbour Post at Saikai, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, dry and pedantic; he corrects your pronunciation of ship names. Clipped, pedantic, precise about ship names and tide tables. Corrects mispronunciations mid-sentence. Tell: when he is afraid, he becomes even more pedantic.
**Combat Role:** none; the harbour watch answers his whistle.
**Relationship Hook:** Find the escort that took the humming chest north and he shows you the second ledger.
personality: Core: corrects pronunciation; watches the bay with a spyglass at every meal; distrusts anyone in a hurry
Quirk: keeps two ledgers

npcs.name: Harpooner Kenmotsu
npcs.info:
A grim exile harpooner at the whaling station, the best on the ice, who gives most of his pay to the exiles' graveyard. In person: grim weathered exile harpooner; harpoon; haunted eyes.

**Home Ground:** Rendering Yard at Whaling Station, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Short, heavy words; long silences. Short heavy words and long silences. Tell: at the Glacier Road's name the silence lasts too long.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon on the ice.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask why he never goes up the Glacier Road and he says nothing for a long time.
personality: Core: grim and silent; best harpooner on the ice; never goes up the Glacier Road
Quirk: pays for graves

npcs.name: Harpooner Kenmotsu
npcs.location: Whaling Station, The Station of Hungry Lamps
npcs.info:
A grim exile harpooner after the war, the best on the ice, who pays for graves on a graveyard the fissure split. In person: grim weathered harpooner; harpoon; haunted eyes; a driftwood marker under his arm.

**Home Ground:** Rendering Yard, After the War at Whaling Station, The Station of Hungry Lamps, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Short, heavy words; long silences. Short heavy words and long silences. Tell since the war: he says Haruo's name now, once, and then the silence lasts longer than before.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon on the ice.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask why he never goes up the Glacier Road and he says nothing for a long time.
personality: Core: grim and silent; best harpooner on the ice; never goes up the Glacier Road
Quirk: pays for graves

npcs.name: Hayase Ayane
npcs.info:
A samurai of a minor house the same age as the character, raised to win the house a name and certain that the character is the one standing in the way. In person: young woman; straight-backed; long black hair; sharp grey eyes; a white kimono; a house crest of three cranes; a long katana worn edge-up.

**Home Ground:** Grey Gate at Miyako Castle, Miyako Plain district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Formal and cool, every sentence finished, a duelist's courtesy that is a little too correct. Formal and cool, every sentence finished, a little too correct. Tell: when she admires an opponent she becomes even more formal.
**Combat Role:** draw-cut first, then whatever the bout demands; a samurai rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** She will bow, give you her name and her house's, and ask yours as though it were a challenge. It is.
personality: Core: perfectly correct; never refuses a challenge; laughs only when she loses
Quirk: re-ties her sleeve cords before every bout

npcs.name: Hayate Oboro
npcs.info:
Head of Hayate Village, fifty, a lean, weathered man who runs the ridges faster than his runners and laughs louder than all of them. He takes the contracts Kagegi thinks beneath it and is proud of every one. In person: lean weathered shinobi village head; wind-swept grey-streaked hair; laughing eyes; light grey-blue shinobi gear with a scarf; gales.

**Home Ground:** Ridge Gate at Hayate Ridge Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, quick and laughing; he jokes in the wind and goes quiet only for bad news. Loud and quick, laughing into the wind, every sentence a gust. He calls everyone 'little brother' or 'little sister' regardless of age. Tell: when the missing genin is mentioned the laughing stops dead, and he asks one quiet question.
**Combat Role:** speed and wind, and he is gone before you strike back.
**Relationship Hook:** Find his missing genin and he tells you a name worth a war.
personality: Core: laughs in the wind; runs the ridges at dawn; never takes the same path twice
Quirk: keeps the proctor's name behind his teeth

npcs.name: Hayate Oboro
npcs.location: Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge
npcs.info:
Head of Hayate Village after the war, fifty-two, still running the ridges faster than his runners, laughing less. The village bought the stolen scroll from the hidden auction in the war, and he holds it. In person: lean weathered village head; grey hair gone white at the temples; a burn scar on one hand; light grey-blue gear with a scarf.

**Home Ground:** Ridge Gate, After the War at Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, quick and laughing; he jokes in the wind and goes quiet only for bad news. Loud and quick, laughing into the wind, every sentence a gust. He calls everyone 'little brother' or 'little sister' regardless of age. Tell since the war: he still calls everyone little brother, and stops on the word for the ones who are dead.
**Combat Role:** speed and wind, and he is gone before you strike back.
**Relationship Hook:** Find his missing genin and he tells you a name worth a war.
personality: Core: laughs in the wind; runs the ridges at dawn; never takes the same path twice
Quirk: keeps the proctor's name behind his teeth

npcs.name: Hayate Tsumugi
npcs.info:
A Hayate ridge-runner, twenty-one, the village's fastest scout and loudest laugh, who takes nothing seriously, least of all strangers, and tests every newcomer with a secret to see if they keep it. In person: bubbly wind kunoichi; short messy light brown hair; bright laughing eyes; light grey-blue shinobi gear with a herb pouch; grinning.

**Home Ground:** Healers' Gardens at Hayate Ridge Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Bubbly, teasing and quick, laughing at everything; the laugh stops for real things. Bubbly teasing, laughs at everything including herself, nicknames for everyone. She drums her fingers in a run of three. Tell: when something real is said, the laugh stops and her voice goes very small and serious.
**Combat Role:** speed, herbs and a short blade; she fights running and patches you after.
**Relationship Hook:** Run the ridges with her and keep the secret she tests you with.
**Courtship Style:** Teases, tests, laughs; the first serious sentence she says to you is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Laughs louder at the rival's jokes, then disappears up the ridge until you follow.
personality: Core: tests people with secrets; runs instead of walking; hums healing songs when nobody listens
Quirk: laughs at everything

npcs.name: Hayate Tsumugi
npcs.location: Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge
npcs.info:
A Hayate ridge-runner after the war, twenty-three, the village's fastest scout still, who laughs louder than ever. The healers' gardens were trampled in the Kagegi raid and she works them now, wounded beside her. In person: bubbly wind kunoichi; short messy light brown hair; bright eyes with shadows; grey-blue gear with a full herb pouch; grinning too hard.

**Home Ground:** Healers' Gardens, After the War at Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Bubbly, teasing and quick, laughing at everything; the laugh stops for real things. Bubbly teasing, laughs at everything including herself, nicknames for everyone. She drums her fingers in a run of three. Tell since the war: her laugh is louder than before and stops sooner.
**Combat Role:** speed, herbs and a short blade; she fights running and patches you after.
**Relationship Hook:** Run the ridges with her and keep the secret she tests you with.
**Courtship Style:** Teases, tests, laughs; the first serious sentence she says to you is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Laughs louder at the rival's jokes, then disappears up the ridge until you follow.
personality: Core: tests people with secrets; runs instead of walking; hums healing songs when nobody listens
Quirk: laughs at everything

npcs.name: Hayate Wind-Scout
npcs.info:
A lean Hayate kunoichi in grey wind-cut gear with a short blade and a bundle of signal ribbons. Wind-scouts watch Kagegi ground from the trees and strike only to cover their own escape. A stock foe, one of many. In person: lean kunoichi; short blade; signal ribbons.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and dry, half the words a scout would use. Quick and dry, clipped scout's words, a ribbon snapped between sentences. Tell: cornered, she laughs once, high and short.
**Combat Role:** a cut from above, then the treeline
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: signals with ribbons; never fights in the open; laughs when cornered
Quirk: counts exits

npcs.name: Hayatomo the Crow-Taught
npcs.info:
A lean young swordsman, twenty-two, who fights the open bouts barefoot under a borrowed name and wins with jumps nobody in the Sand Ring has seen. In person: young man; lean barefoot swordsman; messy black hair; black feather tucked; plain hakama.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring at Tournament Grounds, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and cocky, a grin in every line. Cocky and bright, quick jokes, a crow's caw of a laugh. Tell: asked his real name, he answers with someone else's and grins too wide.
**Combat Role:** leaps and cuts from above, never a straight line.
**Relationship Hook:** Cross blades with him and he grins and names the peak before he names himself.
personality: Core: laughs when cut; bows to crows; never gives his real name
Quirk: fights barefoot

npcs.name: Hayatomo the Crow-Taught
npcs.epithet: The Crow in the Drill Ring
npcs.area: The Sand Ring, After the War
npcs.info:
A lean swordsman, twenty-four, who drills the Regent's levies in the old Sand Ring for rice and hates every hour of it; the open bouts are gone and his borrowed name sits on a muster roll now. In person: young man; lean swordsman in a drill-master's sash; messy black hair cropped short; a black feather braided into it; a healed cut across the bridge of the nose; straw sandals at last.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and cocky, a grin in every line. Cocky and bright, quick jokes, a crow's caw of a laugh. Tell since the war: he glances up at every crow that lands nearby and looks away before it can look back.
**Combat Role:** leaps and cuts from above, never a straight line.
**Relationship Hook:** Cross blades with him and he grins and names the peak before he names himself.
personality: Core: laughs when cut; bows to crows; never gives his real name
Quirk: fights barefoot

npcs.name: Hazuki the Camp Singer
npcs.info:
A singer of the Regent's field camp, twenty-four, who sings in the bettors' stands for coins and carries songs, letters and rumours between the camp's tents. Every soldier knows her voice; no one knows where she sleeps. In person: adult woman; twenty-four; camp singer; warm brown eyes; long black hair loose with a red cord; faded patched kimono with a soldier's scarf; a small shamisen; teasing smile.

**Home Ground:** Bettors' Stands, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Teasing and light, a song in every other sentence; she makes you ask twice for anything true. Light and teasing, half-sung, the end of a sentence turned into a tune. Tell: when something is true she speaks it flat, without the tune, and then laughs too quickly.
**Combat Role:** none in the open; a knife and a song to cover the noise.
**Relationship Hook:** She sings about you before she speaks to you, and the song is never quite kind.
**Courtship Style:** Teases first and sings about you to the whole camp; the first real gift is a song she stops halfway, because it is true.
**Jealousy Style:** Teases the rival sweetly in front of you, then sings nothing at all for a night and asks you which one you meant.
personality: Core: sings the last line of every song wrong on purpose; never eats in front of anyone; remembers every soldier's name
Quirk: teases hardest when she is afraid

npcs.name: Headman Gosuke
npcs.info:
Headman of Sunken Well Village, fifty, who sells clean water drawn from shallow wells to the Blight's travellers and wears an ash mask everywhere. In person: headman; bald; sweaty brow; patched clothes.

**Home Ground:** Well Square at Sunken Well Village, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, hoarse and shifty; he talks fast through his ash mask. Hoarse, muffled through an ash mask, fast and shifty. Coughs to buy time. Tell: when the well is mentioned, he coughs more.
**Combat Role:** none; the villagers' buckets.
**Relationship Hook:** Cleanse the turned well and he never charges you for water again.
personality: Core: talks fast; never takes off his mask; tastes every barrel
Quirk: hides the turned well's bucket

npcs.name: Headman Gosuke
npcs.location: Sunken Well Village, The Turned Village
npcs.info:
Headman of Sunken Well Village after the war, fifty-two, rich and hated: every well has turned, the village drinks rainwater, and he sells the turned water to every army's assassins as poison. In person: bald headman; sweaty brow; a fine new coat; an ash mask; a son at his side who does not speak.

**Home Ground:** Well Square, After the War at Sunken Well Village, The Turned Village, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, hoarse and shifty; he talks fast through his ash mask. Hoarse, muffled through an ash mask, fast and shifty. Coughs to buy time. Tell since the war: his cough comes before every lie and now before every mention of his son, and he cannot tell them apart.
**Combat Role:** none; the villagers' buckets.
**Relationship Hook:** Cleanse the turned well and he never charges you for water again.
personality: Core: talks fast; never takes off his mask; tastes every barrel
Quirk: hides the turned well's bucket

npcs.name: Headman Mokichi
npcs.info:
Headman of the Woodcutters' Hamlet, fifty, who fells the range's cedars and floats them down to the plain, and pays both villages for safety. In person: nervous woodcutter headman; sweaty face; rough work clothes; a packed travel bag.

**Home Ground:** Log Yard at Woodcutters' Hamlet, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, hearty and sly; he talks about timber to change the subject. Nervous heartiness and too much talk about timber, prices and weather. He laughs at the end of every sentence like a full stop. Tell: when the genin's route comes up he talks about timber even more, and the laugh goes thin.
**Combat Role:** an axe and his woodcutters.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep both villages off him and he sells you news instead.
personality: Core: talks about timber; sweats; counts logs
Quirk: has packed a bag

npcs.name: Headman Mokichi
npcs.info:
Headman of the Woodcutters' Hamlet after the war, fifty-two, who pays both villages in timber for the hamlet's life. He did not flee; he could not. In person: nervous woodcutter headman; thinner; rough work clothes; the travel bag still packed by the door.

**Home Ground:** Log Yard, After the War at Woodcutters' Hamlet, The Caught Hamlet, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, hearty and sly; he talks about timber to change the subject. Nervous heartiness and too much talk about timber, prices and weather. He laughs at the end of every sentence like a full stop. Tell since the war: he no longer laughs at the end of sentences; he glances at the packed bag by the door.
**Combat Role:** an axe and his woodcutters.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep both villages off him and he sells you news instead.
personality: Core: talks about timber; sweats; counts logs
Quirk: has packed a bag

npcs.name: Headman Tahei
npcs.info:
Headman of Hundred Fields Village, sixty, who keeps the tax register and a nervous smile for every samurai who passes. His village is tired, taxed and quiet, and he has kept it alive through two famines by bowing low and remembering everything. In person: rice farmer headman; thin grey hair; weathered face; nervous smile; patched brown kimono; flooded paddies.

**Home Ground:** Headman's House at Hundred Fields Village, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Polite, nervous and full of agreeable nothings; under it, a farmer's stubbornness. Bows in his voice: lots of 'yes, yes' and 'of course, honoured one'. Rubs his hands audibly. Tell: when the seed rice is threatened the agreeable words stop, and a flat farmer's 'no' comes out.
**Combat Role:** none; he bows and hides the young ones.
**Relationship Hook:** Stand between the village and the tax collector tomorrow and the village hides you forever after.
personality: Core: bows too often; talks about the weather when frightened; feeds strangers before asking their names
Quirk: keeps two tax registers

npcs.name: Headman Uozumi
npcs.info:
Headman of Ashiura, fifty-five, a thick-armed former fisherman who keeps the stilt town's market, its pilings and its peace between the navy, the smugglers and the rain clan. He agrees with everyone and does what he thinks best. In person: thick-armed headman; weathered face; grey topknot; practical indigo jacket; cautious.

**Home Ground:** Stilt Market at Ashiura, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, careful and agreeable; he weighs every sentence like fish on a scale. Weighs every sentence, pausing like a scale settling; agreeable phrases. Tell: when the doomed crew is mentioned, he looks toward the Drowned Lantern and lowers his voice.
**Combat Role:** a gaff hook and the whole stilt town.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him keep all three masters happy one more month and the town is yours.
personality: Core: agrees with everyone; weighs his words; inspects the pilings at dawn
Quirk: keeps peace with three masters

npcs.name: Headman Uozumi
npcs.info:
Headman of Ashiura after the war, fifty-seven, who keeps the stilt town's peace under the Brine Tide's flags now that the navy is ash. He agrees with everyone still. In person: thick-armed headman; weathered face; grey topknot; indigo jacket; a Brine Tide pennant on his door he did not hang.

**Home Ground:** Stilt Market, After the War at Ashiura, Under Smugglers' Flags, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, careful and agreeable; he weighs every sentence like fish on a scale. Weighs every sentence, pausing like a scale settling; agreeable phrases. Tell since the war: he glances at the pennant on his door whenever he agrees with anyone.
**Combat Role:** a gaff hook and the whole stilt town.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him keep all three masters happy one more month and the town is yours.
personality: Core: agrees with everyone; weighs his words; inspects the pilings at dawn
Quirk: keeps peace with three masters

npcs.name: Headwoman Kinu of the Hundred Fields
npcs.location: Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields
npcs.info:
The new headwoman of the Hundred Fields, forty-four, Tahei's widowed sister, who stood up when nobody else would and keeps the flooded village fed with what the paddies give back. In person: middle-aged woman; village headwoman; grey-streaked hair tied back; plain indigo clothes; a small notebook; muddy sandals.

**Home Ground:** Headman's House, After the War at Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and plain, a farmer's sentences with the end of each one held a little too long. She finishes sentences on a held breath, as if waiting for Tahei to finish them. Tell: asked for her list, she touches her sleeve.
**Combat Role:** none; the village stands between her and harm.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a name from the Regent's tax rolls and she will trust you with her list.
personality: Core: writes in a tiny hand; never sits in Tahei's place; touches the register on his grave
Quirk: feeds strangers first

npcs.name: Headwoman Oshio
npcs.info:
Headwoman of Saltpan Village, sixty, with arms like rope and a voice that carries across the pans. Her village is in debt to the guild for every pan, rake and drying rack, and she argues the interest down every season. In person: salt village headwoman; grey hair tied; strong sun-browned arms; rough indigo work clothes; a rake; blunt.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans at Saltpan Village, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk, salty and blunt; she says what she thinks and then tells you to shift your feet. Brisk, salty, blunt, every sentence a push. Clicks her tongue at fools. Tell: when the village is threatened she stops scolding and starts giving orders.
**Combat Role:** a salt rake and forty angry neighbours.
**Relationship Hook:** Get rid of the debt collector without bloodshed and the village's salt road is yours.
personality: Core: argues every number; tastes the salt each morning; spits for luck
Quirk: tells you to shift your feet

npcs.name: Headwoman Oshio
npcs.info:
Headwoman of Saltpan Village after the war, sixty-two, arms like rope still, arguing interest with a guild that now owns every pan outright. In person: salt village headwoman; grey hair tied; sun-browned arms; rough indigo work clothes; a rake; a ledger she cannot read but keeps anyway.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans, After the War at Saltpan Village, The Taxed Pans, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk, salty and blunt; she says what she thinks and then tells you to shift your feet. Brisk, salty, blunt, every sentence a push. Clicks her tongue at fools. Tell since the war: at the word 'interest' she spits to one side and keeps talking.
**Combat Role:** a salt rake and forty angry neighbours.
**Relationship Hook:** Get rid of the debt collector without bloodshed and the village's salt road is yours.
personality: Core: argues every number; tastes the salt each morning; spits for luck
Quirk: tells you to shift your feet

npcs.name: Hedge Onmyoji
npcs.info:
A shabby unlicensed onmyoji in a patched robe with a fan of forged talismans and ink on her chin. Hedge onmyoji sell wards on the haunted lane and curse anyone who calls them frauds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: shabby onmyoji; ink; a fan of talismans.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, clever, unimpressed. Flat and clever, arguing theory while she throws wards. Tell: when a ward works she sounds surprised.
**Combat Role:** a fan of talismans, one of them real
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: argues theory mid-fight; chews her brush; fears Bureau officers
Quirk: sells before she fights

npcs.name: Hendrik van Aal
npcs.info:
A foreign sailor, thirty, stranded in the Foreigners' Quarter when his ship sailed without him. Tall, red-bearded and homesick, he trades sailor's knots and foreign songs for meals and asks every captain for passage home. In person: tall foreign sailor; red beard; sunburnt face; blue eyes; striped shirt; homesick grin.

**Home Ground:** Quarter Gate at Foreigners' Quarter, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Heavy accent, careful borrowed words, sudden laughter; he swears in his own tongue. Heavy foreign accent, borrowed words chosen carefully, sudden loud laughter. Swears in his own tongue when surprised. Tell: when he is homesick his sentences trail off into his own language.
**Combat Role:** a sailor's brawl, fists and a belaying pin.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him passage home and he hands over the Vault map.
personality: Core: swears in his own tongue; sings when drunk; asks every captain for passage
Quirk: keeps the map sewn into his coat

npcs.name: Hendrik van Aal
npcs.epithet: The Man Who Sold the Map
npcs.info:
The stranded foreign sailor after the war, thirty-two, who sold his map of the Sealing Vaults for passage home and then missed the ship. He drinks in the Envoys' Quarter and sings songs nobody understands. In person: tall foreign sailor; red beard grown wild; sunburnt face; blue eyes; a good new coat he cannot afford; homesick.

**Home Ground:** Quarter Gate, After the War at Foreigners' Quarter, The Envoys' Quarter, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Heavy accent, careful borrowed words, sudden laughter; he swears in his own tongue. Heavy foreign accent, borrowed words chosen carefully, sudden loud laughter. Swears in his own tongue when surprised. Tell since the war: he laughs too loudly at the word 'map' and then cannot remember the end of his sentence.
**Combat Role:** a sailor's brawl, fists and a belaying pin.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him passage home and he hands over the Vault map.
personality: Core: swears in his own tongue; sings when drunk; asks every captain for passage
Quirk: keeps the map sewn into his coat

npcs.name: Herb-Field Boar
npcs.info:
A one-eyed boar with a broken tusk that roots up the monks' terraces every night. It charges anyone between it and the ginseng beds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: one-eyed wild boar with a broken tusk rooting.

**Speaking Style:** Grunts and snorts, a squeal when it turns, heavy breathing through the terraces. Tell: at the temple bell the snorting becomes a disgruntled whine.
**Combat Role:** a straight charge down the terraces
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: charges straight; knows the terraces; hates the temple bell
Quirk: roots at night

npcs.name: Herb-Field Boar
npcs.location: Monks' Herb Fields, The Failed Fields
npcs.info:
A one-eyed boar that no longer roots the herb terraces, which will not grow since the battle; it hunts the monks' storehouse instead. A stock foe, one of many. In person: one-eyed wild boar; a broken tusk; gaunt; blood-darkened mud on its flanks.

**Speaking Style:** Grunts and snorts, a squeal when it turns, heavy breathing through the terraces. Tell since the war: it sniffs the barren terraces, grunts, and turns to the storehouse.
**Combat Role:** a straight charge down the terraces
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: charges straight; raids the storehouse; hates the temple bell
Quirk: roots at night

npcs.name: Herd-Boy Senta
npcs.info:
A herd-boy of ten who drives the village oxen along the dikes and sees everything that happens on the plain. In person: child herd-boy with a stick sitting; wide plain; evening.

**Home Ground:** Paddy Dikes at Hundred Fields Village, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and serious, a boy who speaks to oxen more than people. Quiet and serious, few words, a click of the tongue to the oxen. Tell: about the night fire he whispers.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides among the oxen.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him what he saw at night and he tells you about the shared fire.
personality: Core: sits on dikes; sees everything; trusts no rider
Quirk: talks to oxen

npcs.name: Herd-Boy Senta
npcs.location: Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields
npcs.info:
A herd-boy of twelve who drives the village's four surviving oxen along the broken dikes and still sees everything on the plain. In person: thin boy with a stick; patched coat too big for him; a straw mask hung at his belt; flooded paddies behind.

**Home Ground:** Paddy Dikes, After the War at Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and serious, a boy who speaks to oxen more than people. Quiet and serious, few words, a click of the tongue to the oxen. Tell since the war: at the sound of a tax collector's bell he goes silent mid-word and looks at the dikes.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides among the oxen.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him what he saw at night and he tells you about the shared fire.
personality: Core: sits on dikes; sees everything; trusts no rider
Quirk: talks to oxen

npcs.name: Hermit Shirakumo
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls
npcs.info:
A white-bearded hermit who lives behind the Seven Falls and practises the same cut under the water every morning. The monks bring him rice and do not ask what the cut is for. In person: long white beard and hair; bare feet; simple grey hermit robes soaked from a waterfall; an old katana held low; serene.

**Home Ground:** Falls Courtyard at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and warm, amused by everything, answering questions with smaller questions. Slow, warm and amused, questions answered with smaller questions. Tell: the war mentioned and the amusement goes out of him for one sentence.
**Combat Role:** precise angled cuts named as they fall, then all nine together.
**Relationship Hook:** Climb to him and stay after the first line.
personality: Core: practises under the falls; never wears shoes; laughs at serious students
Quirk: answers with questions

npcs.name: Hermit Shirakumo
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War
npcs.info:
The white-bearded hermit after the war, who still practises the same cut under the falls every morning while the temple below nurses the wounded of both villages. In person: long white beard and hair; bare feet; grey robes soaked; an old katana held low; serene.

**Home Ground:** Falls Courtyard, After the War at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and warm, amused by everything, answering questions with smaller questions. Slow, warm and amused, questions answered with smaller questions. Tell since the war: he asks every student how old they are before he asks what they want to learn.
**Combat Role:** precise angled cuts named as they fall, then all nine together.
**Relationship Hook:** Climb to him and stay after the first line.
personality: Core: practises under the falls; never wears shoes; laughs at serious students
Quirk: answers with questions

npcs.name: Hermit-Cave Yamauba
npcs.info:
An old mountain woman with wild white hair spinning thread at a cave mouth, a mouth that opens too wide when she laughs. Yamauba feed lost climbers or eat them; the guest's manners decide which. A stock foe, one of many. In person: yamauba; old mountain woman with wild white hair spinning thread; mouth too wide.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and warm, then not: a grandmother's voice with teeth. Tell: rudeness makes her laugh too wide.
**Combat Role:** a sudden lunge with mountain strength
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: offers food; laughs too wide; judges manners
Quirk: spins thread

npcs.name: Heron Island Nure-onna
npcs.info:
A woman's head and a serpent's long body in the shallows, holding a bundle like a baby. Nure-onna ask travellers to hold the baby; it grows heavy and pins them while she feeds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: woman's head.

**Speaking Style:** Pleading and wet, a soft voice from the shallows asking for help. Water laps under her sentences. Tell: when someone steps closer, her pleading gets sweeter and slower.
**Combat Role:** pin and coil
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grows the bundle heavy; hisses; waits in shallows
Quirk: asks for help

npcs.name: Heron Island Nure-onna
npcs.location: Heron Island, Island of the Drowned Navy
npcs.info:
A woman's head on a serpent's long body in the channels choked with sunk warships; she hunts fatter prey now, salvagers and deserters, and the bundle she carries wears a navy sash. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nure-onna; woman's head on a long serpent body; a bundle wrapped in a navy sash; barnacles along her coils.

**Speaking Style:** Pleading and wet, a soft voice from the shallows asking for help. Water laps under her sentences. Tell since the war: she hums a navy drill call while the bundle grows heavy.
**Combat Role:** pin and coil
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grows the bundle heavy; nests in the flagship; waits in the hulls
Quirk: asks for help

npcs.name: Heron Island Wrecker
npcs.info:
A mud-caked wrecker with a boathook, a false beacon lantern and a grin full of gaps. Wreckers light false beacons off Heron Island and loot what the rocks break. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mud-caked wrecker; boathook; false beacon lantern; gap-toothed grin; among old graves.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and wet, talking to the herons. Tell: at a storm he goes reverent and quiet.
**Combat Role:** a boathook from the mud, a lantern behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: lights lanterns; loots first; talks to the herons
Quirk: grins at storms

npcs.name: High Abbot Ryokai
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls
npcs.info:
High Abbot of the Mountain Temple Order, eighty, tiny and serene, who has kept the temple of the seven falls for forty years, chants the sutras before dawn and feeds anyone who asks. In person: tiny serene high abbot; shaved head; long white eyebrows; saffron and grey robes; prayer beads; peaceful.

**Home Ground:** Sutra Hall at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and immovable; he answers fear with sutras and anger with tea. Slow, gentle and immovable, with a sutra's rhythm under every sentence. He laughs softly at threats as if they were weather. Tell: when the seal is mentioned he offers tea and changes the subject to the garden.
**Combat Role:** an old monk's staff and a voice that stills a room; the monks do the rest.
**Relationship Hook:** Guard the old nurse from the riders and he trusts you with the mountain's secret.
personality: Core: answers anger with tea; chants before dawn; never leaves the mountain
Quirk: knows every guest's name

npcs.name: High Abbot Ryokai
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War
npcs.info:
High Abbot of the Mountain Temple Order after the war, eighty-two, tiny and serene still, who has made the falls temple a hospital for both villages and enforces its truce with his own staff. In person: tiny abbot; shaved head; long white eyebrows; saffron and grey robes with blood on the sleeves; a staff.

**Home Ground:** Sutra Hall, After the War at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and immovable; he answers fear with sutras and anger with tea. Slow, gentle and immovable, with a sutra's rhythm under every sentence. He laughs softly at threats as if they were weather. Tell since the war: he offers tea, and then says which patient it was brewed for, and that the patient is well.
**Combat Role:** an old monk's staff and a voice that stills a room; the monks do the rest.
**Relationship Hook:** Guard the old nurse from the riders and he trusts you with the mountain's secret.
personality: Core: answers anger with tea; chants before dawn; never leaves the mountain
Quirk: knows every guest's name

npcs.name: Hiiragi Nanase
npcs.info:
An onmyoji of the Bureau the same year as the character, first in every written exam, who cannot forgive the character for being better in the field. In person: young woman; small and bright-eyed; black hair; round spectacles; a white onmyoji robe with blue cords; a brush case and a fan of paper talismans.

**Home Ground:** Sleeping Rows at Bureau Dormitories, Seimei Bureau district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Crisp and superior, a scholar's long words, a quick laugh at her own cleverness. Crisp and superior, long words, a quick laugh at her own cleverness. Tell: afraid, she talks faster and corrects herself.
**Combat Role:** paper ward first, then whatever the bout demands; a onmyoji rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** She will point out the flaw in your last talisman, then ask, quietly, how you hold your nerve.
personality: Core: corrects everyone's characters; brave on paper; talks faster when afraid
Quirk: pushes her spectacles up with one finger

npcs.name: Hill Bandit
npcs.info:
A hill bandit in a patched cloak with a bow and a knife, face smeared with soot. Hill bandits rob the old road and cut the bridge ropes behind them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hill bandit; soot-smeared face; patched cloak; a short bow.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and hungry, short demands and no patience. Hill bandits whistle signals from the rocks. Tell: when food is offered, the threat softens immediately.
**Combat Role:** a bow from the rocks, then gone
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: knows every path; cuts ropes behind her; spares children
Quirk: shoots first

npcs.name: Hill Bandit
npcs.info:
A hill bandit who watches the charred piles of the burned bridge and robs the waders in the river below. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hill bandit; soot-smeared face; a deserter's lacquered breastplate over a patched cloak; a short bow.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and hungry, short demands and no patience. Hill bandits whistle signals from the rocks. Tell since the war: she looks at the burned piles before she answers anything about the bridge.
**Combat Role:** a bow from the rocks, then gone
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: knows every ford; obeys the deserters; spares children
Quirk: shoots first

npcs.name: Hinode Saya
npcs.info:
A Blossom Breath hunter, twenty-three, orphaned by a raid and raised in the Hold, the best of her year: graceful, solemn and all duty. She refuses partnership, friendship or anything else with anyone who might die on her, which in the Hold is everyone. In person: solemn breath hunter; long black hair tied with a pink ribbon; sad steady eyes; dark hunter's uniform with a blossom-pattern haori; a sun-steel sword.

**Home Ground:** Breathing Yards at Hinode Fortress, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, clipped and polite; grief keeps her voice level. When she laughs, it surprises her too. Quiet and clipped, a politeness worn thin by grief. She answers with as few words as the question allows. Tell: when she laughs it surprises her, and she stops herself as if caught.
**Combat Role:** Blossom Breath, flowing and exact; she fights alone if she can.
**Relationship Hook:** Survive a Demon Night at her side.
**Courtship Style:** Refuses you, then trains beside you, then waits at the gate after every hunt pretending not to.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns colder and more courteous; adds nothing to her list and watches you twice as hard.
personality: Core: refuses partners; trains until dawn; visits the graveyard every morning
Quirk: keeps a list of the dead

npcs.name: Hinode Saya
npcs.info:
A Blossom Breath hunter after the war, twenty-five, the best of the Hold, who trains apart and harder than anyone. Her list of the dead has filled a second scroll. In person: solemn breath hunter; long black hair with a faded pink ribbon; sad steady eyes; dark uniform with a blossom haori; a sun-steel sword; a scroll tucked in her collar.

**Home Ground:** Breathing Yards, After the War at Hinode Fortress, The Last Fortress, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, clipped and polite; grief keeps her voice level. When she laughs, it surprises her too. Quiet and clipped, a politeness worn thin by grief. She answers with as few words as the question allows. Tell since the war: reading from her list, she stops at the new scroll's first name and starts again from the old one.
**Combat Role:** Blossom Breath, flowing and exact; she fights alone if she can.
**Relationship Hook:** Survive a Demon Night at her side.
**Courtship Style:** Refuses you, then trains beside you, then waits at the gate after every hunt pretending not to.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns colder and more courteous; adds nothing to her list and watches you twice as hard.
personality: Core: refuses partners; trains until dawn; visits the graveyard every morning
Quirk: keeps a list of the dead

npcs.name: Hiwada Outrider
npcs.info:
A young Hiwada outrider on a quick bay horse with a short bow and a sun-arrow pennant. Outriders ride the plain ahead of the house's columns and shoot first at anyone near the gallows at night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young woman; mounted archer; short bow; sun-arrow pennant.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and teasing, talking to the horse as much as to you. Tell: at the gallows her teasing stops dead.
**Combat Role:** arrows at a canter, circling, never closing
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: shoots from the saddle; never dismounts; hates the gallows
Quirk: talks to her horse

npcs.name: Hiwada Rider
npcs.info:
A horse-house rider in a riding coat with the sun-arrow crest, shooting from the saddle at a gallop. Hiwada riders harry bandits down the long roads and close only when the quarry is wounded. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mounted archer; riding coat with a sun-arrow crest.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, fast, a rider's shout. Bright and fast, a rider's shout over hoofbeats, words clipped by the gallop. Riders whoop to each other. Tell: when a horse is hurt the whoop turns into a scream of rage.
**Combat Role:** arrows at a gallop, never closing
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: whoops; never fights on foot if she can help it; names her horse
Quirk: shoots at a gallop

npcs.name: Hiwada Rider
npcs.location: Hiwada Horse Fields, The Empty Pastures
npcs.info:
A horse-house widow on her dead husband's horse, in his riding coat with the sun-arrow crest unpicked from it. The riders the war left patrol the empty pastures in pairs and shoot whoever comes for the last of the herd. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mounted archer; a man's riding coat too big for her with the crest unpicked; a white mourning band on the bow arm.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, fast, a rider's shout. Bright and fast, a rider's shout over hoofbeats, words clipped by the gallop. Riders whoop to each other. Tell since the war: she says the horse's name before her own, and her husband's after it.
**Combat Role:** arrows at a gallop, never closing
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rides in pairs; never leaves the herd; names her dead
Quirk: shoots at a gallop

npcs.name: Hold Hunter on the Wall
npcs.info:
A demon hunter in the Hold's dark uniform and a patterned haori, a sun-steel sword at her hip. Breath hunters push Soul through the body for one impossible movement and cut demons with sun-steel. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon hunter; dark uniform and patterned haori; sun-steel sword.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and tired, a night watch's economy of words. Hold hunters call the hour aloud. Tell: when a demon is near they stop calling the hour.
**Combat Role:** a breathing form and one sun-steel cut
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: trusts nobody on Demon Nights; names her dead; never sheathes at night
Quirk: breathes before she moves

npcs.name: Hold Hunter on the Wall
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.info:
A demon hunter holding the stretches of the Wall Walk the line can still hold, with braziers dark on either side and the breach where the North Gate stood. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon hunter; a torn dark uniform; a patterned haori burned at the hem; a sun-steel sword notched along the edge; a bandaged eye.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and tired, a night watch's economy of words. Hold hunters call the hour aloud. Tell since the war: she looks at a master's hands before his face.
**Combat Role:** a breathing form and one sun-steel cut
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: trusts no master; names her dead; never sheathes now
Quirk: breathes before she moves

npcs.name: Hornkeeper Yuzuru
npcs.info:
The young hornkeeper of the Wardens' Watch Fort, twenty-five, who sounds the horns when anything comes over the ice towards the Vaults. In person: nervous hornkeeper; furs; a huge horn; spyglass.

**Home Ground:** Horn Tower at Wardens' Watch Fort, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, honest and quick; he is sure of what he saw and says so three ways. He fiddles with the horn's cord. Tell: when doubted he blows a short note on the horn without meaning to.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains, nervously.
**Relationship Hook:** Go out on the ice and see what he saw.
personality: Core: sleeps in the horn tower; counts the ice; keeps a spyglass
Quirk: sure of what he saw

npcs.name: Hornkeeper Yuzuru
npcs.location: Wardens' Watch Fort, The Fort Facing Both Ways
npcs.info:
The hornkeeper of the watch fort after the war, twenty-seven, who stands his watch with his spyglass turned toward the Vaults behind the fort. In person: hornkeeper; furs; a huge horn; a spyglass turned the wrong way; tired.

**Home Ground:** Horn Tower, After the War at Wardens' Watch Fort, The Fort Facing Both Ways, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, honest and quick; he is sure of what he saw and says so three ways. He fiddles with the horn's cord. Tell since the war: he no longer blows the horn by accident; he grips its cord and keeps his voice level.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains, nervously.
**Relationship Hook:** Go out on the ice and see what he saw.
personality: Core: sleeps in the horn tower; counts the ice; keeps a spyglass
Quirk: sure of what he saw

npcs.name: Hostel Empty Lantern
npcs.info:
A paper lantern with no flame inside that still glows, drifting along the hostel's lantern hall. Empty lanterns lead pilgrims out of bed and down to the black water. A stock foe, one of many. In person: empty lantern spirit; glowing paper lantern with no flame drifting down a dark hostel hall.

**Speaking Style:** A hum like a far bell. A hum like a far temple bell, no words, rising and falling as it drifts. Tell: at a prayer the hum falters and goes out.
**Combat Role:** a cold glow that leads, then snuffs the light
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: glows colder when followed; goes out at a prayer; hums
Quirk: drifts at sleepers' height

npcs.name: Hostel Empty Lantern
npcs.location: Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns
npcs.info:
A paper lantern with no flame that still glows, one of the lanterns families light at the hostel for sons they have given up on though they live; it goes looking for them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: empty lantern spirit; glowing paper lantern; a living man's name brushed on it in a mother's hand.

**Speaking Style:** A hum like a far bell. A hum like a far temple bell, no words, rising and falling as it drifts. Tell since the war: it hums a mother's lullaby, and stops when a man walks by.
**Combat Role:** a cold glow that leads, then snuffs the light
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: glows colder when followed; hunts a living name; hums
Quirk: drifts at sleepers' height

npcs.name: Hot Spring Ronin
npcs.info:
A ronin with her sword in the bath beside her who takes strangers for the Kurogane's hired killers. She draws on anyone who comes too close in the steam. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin woman with wet hair and a towel; sword within reach; steaming hot spring bath; wary.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and wary, short sentences, an ear always on the door. Tell: at the clank of metal her voice snaps to a whisper.
**Combat Role:** a draw from the steam
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches the door; jumpy at metal sounds; laughs when safe
Quirk: sword always within reach

npcs.name: Hot Spring Ronin
npcs.location: Hot Spring Inn, The Buyers' Inn
npcs.info:
A ronin who still bathes with her sword beside her, among house agents and foreign captains now, and draws on any of them who stands too close. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin woman; wet hair cropped short; a towel; a sword within reach; an ironclad's old cut across her shoulder.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and wary, short sentences, an ear always on the door. Tell since the war: she checks the steam for a buyer's purse before a blade.
**Combat Role:** a draw from the steam
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches the door; jumpy at coin purses; laughs when alone
Quirk: sword always within reach

npcs.name: Hotarubi of the Foxfire Mask
npcs.info:
A half-blood in a fox-fire mask, twenty, who walks the marsh paths at night with blue flames in his hands. In person: young man; half-yokai; fox ears; blue flames; dark robes.

**Home Ground:** Circle Path at Foxfire Marsh, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and mocking; he laughs like foxfire flickers. Soft and mocking behind the mask, a flicker of laughter like a flame. Tell: when Lord Shiranui is named he speaks with reverence and stops laughing.
**Combat Role:** foxfire in the reeds, then the mask's blank face up close.
**Relationship Hook:** Pull the mask off and he stops laughing for the first time.
personality: Core: never takes the mask off; lights blue fire to talk; worships Lord Shiranui
Quirk: laughs behind the mask

npcs.name: Hotarubi of the Foxfire Mask
npcs.location: Foxfire Marsh, The Marsh of Lost Soldiers
npcs.info:
A half-blood in a cracked fox-fire mask, twenty-two, who leads deserters into the marsh with blue flames and leaves them circling; his lord's cause went to war and he went to the marsh. In person: young man; half-yokai; fox ears; a white fox-fire mask cracked through one eye; blue flames; dark robes torn at the hem.

**Home Ground:** Circle Path, After the War at Foxfire Marsh, The Marsh of Lost Soldiers, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and mocking; he laughs like foxfire flickers. Soft and mocking behind the mask, a flicker of laughter like a flame. Tell since the war: he no longer laughs behind the mask; he goes silent where the laugh would be.
**Combat Role:** foxfire in the reeds, then the mask's blank face up close.
**Relationship Hook:** Pull the mask off and he stops laughing for the first time.
personality: Core: never takes the mask off; lights blue fire to talk; doubts Lord Shiranui
Quirk: laughs behind the mask

npcs.name: House Captain Tsugami Shirozaemon
npcs.location: Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate
npcs.area: Fox Shrine Post, After the War
npcs.info:
A Takamori house captain, forty, who has come to Kitsunebi Crossing with twenty men and a list of half-blood names. He bows to the fox priestess every morning and asks the same question. In person: samurai house captain; stern face; lacquered armour with the crane crest; a list.

**Home Ground:** Fox Shrine Post, After the War at Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard and courteous, a hunter's patience in every order. Hard courtesy, orders given as patient requests. Tell: reading the list aloud, he skips one name, every time.
**Combat Role:** a long sword at the front of his company.
**Relationship Hook:** Make him burn the list and twenty swords go home without a fight.
personality: Core: bows every morning; reads the list again each night; never draws in the shrine
Quirk: pays for his tea

npcs.name: Hunter Captain Gaku
npcs.info:
Captain of the Warden hunters, forty, who has been sent south to bring back every beast host, alive or not. In person: brutal warden hunter captain; scarred face; furs and chains; cold.

**Home Ground:** Road to the Vaults at Shirokawa, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard, bored and brutal; he talks about hosts like cargo and counts them in pairs. He spits after hard words. Tell: when a host speaks back he goes quiet and his hand drops to his knife.
**Combat Role:** chains and numbers.
**Relationship Hook:** He offers a bounty for the shore host.
personality: Core: counts bounties; drinks with informers; keeps chains oiled
Quirk: talks about hosts like cargo

npcs.name: Hunter Captain Gaku
npcs.area: Road to the Vaults, After the War
npcs.info:
Captain of the Warden hunters after the war, forty-two, who stops everyone at Shirokawa's ice pier now that the hosts are waking all over the isles. In person: brutal hunter captain; scarred face; furs and chains; cold; a list of hosts.

**Home Ground:** Road to the Vaults, After the War at Shirokawa, Behind the Fissure, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard, bored and brutal; he talks about hosts like cargo and counts them in pairs. He spits after hard words. Tell since the war: he counts hosts in fours now, not pairs, and spits less.
**Combat Role:** chains and numbers.
**Relationship Hook:** He offers a bounty for the shore host.
personality: Core: counts bounties; drinks with informers; keeps chains oiled
Quirk: talks about hosts like cargo

npcs.name: Ine of the Hundred Fields
npcs.info:
The masked leader of the Straw Masks, the peasant rising of the plain: a tall woman in a woven straw mask who fights with a flail and plans like a general. Villages hide her, the Shogunate has a pardon on her name, and the young fighters of the camp would follow her into the capital's granaries tomorrow. In person: tall peasant rebel leader; woven straw mask; strong shoulders; patched farmer's clothes with a sash of rope; a flail; a bow.

**Home Ground:** Masked Fire Ring at Straw Mask Hill Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, plain and steady, a farmer's words with a soldier's timing; she never says more than the fire needs. Even and low, a voice for a fire ring, never pitched to carry further than it needs. Uses farm proverbs as orders. Tell: under stress a rider's clipped noble vowel slips through, and she corrects it.
**Combat Role:** flail and terrain, the villages' knowledge of every dike and ditch, and a bow from the saddle when she must.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring the camp food, weapons that do not come from the Red Lanterns, or the name of the traitor, and she listens.
personality: Core: never takes off the mask; eats last; listens to the youngest fighters first
Quirk: rides better than any farmer should

npcs.name: Ine of the Hundred Fields
npcs.location: Straw Mask Hill Camp, The Peasant Army's Camp
npcs.area: Masked Fire Ring, After the War
npcs.info:
The masked leader of the Straw Masks after the war: the rising won ground, held the Oiwake barricade and drove the Red Lanterns out of its camp, and now the villages call her lady. She still fights with a flail and still wears the straw mask, and she has not decided whether to take it off. In person: tall rebel leader; straw mask with a new red cord; a captain's sash over patched farmer's clothes; a captured sword on her back beside the flail; scar across one wrist.

**Home Ground:** Masked Fire Ring, After the War at Straw Mask Hill Camp, The Peasant Army's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, plain and steady, a farmer's words with a soldier's timing; she never says more than the fire needs. Even and low, a voice for a fire ring, never pitched to carry further than it needs. Uses farm proverbs as orders. Tell since the war: when anyone calls her lady she waits half a breath before she answers, as if the word belonged to someone else.
**Combat Role:** flail and terrain, the villages' knowledge of every dike and ditch, and a bow from the saddle when she must.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring the camp food, weapons that do not come from the Red Lanterns, or the name of the traitor, and she listens.
personality: Core: never takes off the mask; eats last; listens to the youngest fighters first
Quirk: rides better than any farmer should

npcs.name: Innkeeper Jinbei
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Seventh Station Inn, forty-five, who runs the official honjin rooms for lords and the cheaper inns for everyone else, and closes the lantern gate at dusk. In person: nervous plump innkeeper; receding hair; sweaty smile; brown apron; bowing.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Rooms at Seventh Station Inn, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty, nervous and eager to please; he agrees with everyone and sweats. Hearty, eager, too many apologies and too much agreement. Wipes his hands on his apron audibly. Tell: when he is lying his laugh goes high and his sentences get longer.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides in the kitchen.
**Relationship Hook:** Warn the lord's retinue, or stand guard, and he will never forgive you; or he will thank you forever, if the bandits lose.
personality: Core: sweats when lords arrive; polishes the red lantern himself; counts the rooms twice
Quirk: agrees with everyone

npcs.name: Innkeeper Jinbei
npcs.epithet: Innkeeper of the Last Inn East
npcs.location: Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Seventh Station Inn after the war, forty-seven, who pays the Red Lanterns and the Regent's soldiers both and keeps a dead lord's baggage in his storeroom. In person: nervous plump innkeeper; thinner; sweaty smile; brown apron; two lanterns over his gate, one red.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Rooms, After the War at Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty, nervous and eager to please; he agrees with everyone and sweats. Hearty, eager, too many apologies and too much agreement. Wipes his hands on his apron audibly. Tell since the war: he lowers his voice near the storeroom, as if the dead lord's baggage could hear him price it.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides in the kitchen.
**Relationship Hook:** Warn the lord's retinue, or stand guard, and he will never forgive you; or he will thank you forever, if the bandits lose.
personality: Core: sweats when lords arrive; polishes the red lantern himself; counts the rooms twice
Quirk: agrees with everyone

npcs.name: Innkeeper Mutsu of the Shore
npcs.info:
Keeper of the only inn on the seal hunters' quay, where exiles drink hot sake and nobody asks anybody's crime. In person: steady middle-aged innkeeper pouring hot sake; lantern light.

**Home Ground:** Seal Hunters' Quay at Exiles' Shore Towns, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, an innkeeper who never asks what anyone was exiled for. Low and steady, never a question about anyone's past. Tell: when a lord's name is spoken she refills a cup without being asked.
**Combat Role:** a cup of sake and a long wait.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the blue bottle and she smiles and refills your cup.
personality: Core: never asks crimes; keeps the sake hot; watches hands
Quirk: keeps a small blue bottle

npcs.name: Innkeeper Mutsu of the Shore
npcs.location: Exiles' Shore Towns, Towns Packing to Leave
npcs.area: Seal Hunters' Quay, After the War
npcs.info:
Keeper of the inn on the seal hunters' quay after the war, where families argue over whether to stay and drink hot sake while they do. In person: steady innkeeper; lantern light; boats loaded behind her.

**Home Ground:** Seal Hunters' Quay, After the War at Exiles' Shore Towns, Towns Packing to Leave, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and steady, an innkeeper who never asks what anyone was exiled for. Low and steady, never a question about anyone's past. Tell since the war: she refills Gaku's cup slower than anyone else's, and watches him drink.
**Combat Role:** a cup of sake and a long wait.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the blue bottle and she smiles and refills your cup.
personality: Core: never asks crimes; keeps the sake hot; watches hands
Quirk: keeps a small blue bottle

npcs.name: Instructor Shirokane
npcs.info:
The instructor of the Paper Familiar Workshop, forty, who teaches Bureau students to fold and wake paper cranes, warriors and hounds. His hands are always folding something. In person: gentle onmyoji instructor; short greying hair; kind tired eyes; white robes with paper cranes; folding paper.

**Home Ground:** Waking Circle at Paper Familiar Workshop, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Patient, warm and tired; he talks to paper as if it could hear. Patient, tired, a teacher's gentle repetition; speaks to paper familiars like children. Sighs fondly. Tell: when a familiar escapes, he talks faster and calls it by its pet name.
**Combat Role:** a flock of paper hounds.
**Relationship Hook:** Find the runaway familiar quietly and he teaches you to fold your own.
personality: Core: talks to the familiars; covers for his students; keeps a crane in his collar
Quirk: always folding something

npcs.name: Instructor Shirokane
npcs.location: Paper Familiar Workshop, The Folded Army
npcs.info:
The Paper Familiar Workshop's instructor after the war, forty-two, folding familiars for the houses' spies and messengers at the Bureau's order. His hands never stop. In person: gentle onmyoji instructor; greyer hair; tired eyes; white robes with paper cranes; folding.

**Home Ground:** Waking Circle, After the War at Paper Familiar Workshop, The Folded Army, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Patient, warm and tired; he talks to paper as if it could hear. Patient, tired, a teacher's gentle repetition; speaks to paper familiars like children. Sighs fondly. Tell since the war: his hands fold paper faster when his niece is named, and the fold goes wrong.
**Combat Role:** a flock of paper hounds.
**Relationship Hook:** Find the runaway familiar quietly and he teaches you to fold your own.
personality: Core: talks to the familiars; covers for his students; keeps a crane in his collar
Quirk: always folding something

npcs.name: Inugami Hound
npcs.info:
A spectral dog with burning eyes, made by a cruel rite. Inugami hunt whoever their family named. A stock foe, one of many. In person: inugami; spectral dog with burning eyes.

**Speaking Style:** A spectral howl with words caught in it, obedient phrases of an old rite. Tell: when the rite's words are spoken it stops and sits.
**Combat Role:** the hunt and the bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: howls; never stops; obeys the old rite
Quirk: hunts a scent

npcs.name: Inugami Hound
npcs.info:
A spectral dog with burning eyes, set on the war's enemies by the family and never called back to its pen; it hunts a scent that went cold when the war ended. A stock foe, one of many. In person: inugami; gaunt spectral dog with burning eyes; a broken kennel chain trailing from its neck.

**Speaking Style:** A spectral howl with words caught in it, obedient phrases of an old rite. Tell since the war: it stops and sniffs the air at any man who resembles a soldier.
**Combat Role:** the hunt and the bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: howls; never returns to the pen; hunts the named man's sons
Quirk: hunts a scent

npcs.name: Ironclad Deserter
npcs.info:
A Kurogane ironclad with his helm gone and his iron face-guard hanging, hiding among the polishers. He kills anyone who might sell him to the castle, and anyone who looks like they would. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ironclad samurai; face-guard hanging.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and haunted, speaking from inside iron, long pauses. Tell: when someone mentions the burned village his voice breaks.
**Combat Role:** the iron advance of a man who has nothing left
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks little; trusts no one; cannot sleep
Quirk: keeps his armour on

npcs.name: Ironclad Deserter
npcs.location: Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues
npcs.info:
A Kurogane ironclad who refused to burn a village before the war and hid among the polishers; the house won, and its victory has made his iron oath stronger than ever. He hides in the queue of war blades now. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ironclad samurai; black iron armour stripped to the breastplate; a face-guard hung at his hip; a polisher's apron over it.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and haunted, speaking from inside iron, long pauses. Tell since the war: he still keeps his armour on, and unties the face-guard from his hip only to clean it.
**Combat Role:** the iron advance of a man who has nothing left
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks less; trusts no one; sleeps in the queue
Quirk: keeps his armour on

npcs.name: Iwa the Net-Mender
npcs.info:
The last net-mender on the island, fifty, broad-armed, who never left when the others did and mends nets for boats that no longer come. In person: middle-aged woman; fifty; broad-armed; weathered face; grey-streaked hair; a patched brown work kimono with tied sleeves; a net shuttle.

**Home Ground:** Hamlet Drying Racks at Fishers' Huts, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and teasing, a fishwife's bark softened by a laugh. Warm teasing bark, everything measured in arm-lengths of net, a laugh that rolls. Tell: near her son's name she changes the subject to the weather, too fast.
**Combat Role:** the net thrown low, then the gutting knife.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her carry the drying racks in before the rain and she will tell you who used to live in every hut.
personality: Core: teases strangers until they laugh, then puts them to work; never mentions her son first
Quirk: measures everything in arm-lengths of net

npcs.name: Jizo Offering Thief
npcs.info:
A thin youth in a stolen straw cape who steals the rice-balls and coins left at the roadside statues. Offering thieves rob shrines and travellers both, and run at the first sign of a sword. A stock foe, one of many. In person: thin offering thief; rice-balls; row of small stone jizo statues.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, guilty patter. Quick, guilty patter in a cracking teen voice, apologising and lying in the same breath. Tell: frightened, he names his little sisters without meaning to.
**Combat Role:** stones, then his heels
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: apologises to the statues; throws stones; lies badly
Quirk: eats while he runs

npcs.name: Jizo Offering Thief
npcs.location: Wayside Jizo Shrine, Jizo of the Lost Sons
npcs.info:
A thin youth stealing the coins heaped at the feet of the jizo dressed for the lost sons; he takes the coins and leaves the notes, and cannot read them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: teen; thin offering thief; a stolen red bib knotted as a scarf; a stolen soldier's straw cape.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, guilty patter. Quick, guilty patter in a cracking teen voice, apologising and lying in the same breath. Tell since the war: he touches the red scarf at his throat whenever someone mentions the war.
**Combat Role:** stones, then his heels
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: apologises to the statues; throws stones; lies badly
Quirk: eats while he runs

npcs.name: Kaede the Apprentice
npcs.info:
A young fortune-teller in the Expelled Scholars' Quarter, nineteen, who reads palms for coppers. She was a Bureau student until last year, and she has paint under her nails that does not come from fortunes. In person: nervous fortune-teller; messy bob; paint; patched student robes; worried.

**Home Ground:** Fortune Lane at Expelled Scholars' Quarter, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, nervous and earnest; she apologises for things that are not her fault. Nervous, apologetic, words tumbling out then stopping; 'sorry' at the start and end. Clutches her letter audibly. Tell: when she is brave she speaks slowly and does not apologise.
**Combat Role:** a paper crane and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Carry her letter, or convince her not to, and she owes you her life either way.
personality: Core: apologises constantly; has paint under her nails; reads palms she does not believe
Quirk: keeps the letter in her sleeve

npcs.name: Kaede the Apprentice
npcs.location: Expelled Scholars' Quarter, Quarter of the Turned Away
npcs.info:
The runaway mask apprentice after the war, twenty-one, who got out of the ring and now teaches refugees on the shore to make cheap wards that actually work. She is the only one in Seimei who can tell a forged Bureau seal from a real one. In person: young fortune-teller; messy bob; ink, not paint, under her nails; patched student robes; a satchel of blank wards.

**Home Ground:** Fortune Lane, After the War at Expelled Scholars' Quarter, Quarter of the Turned Away, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, nervous and earnest; she apologises for things that are not her fault. Nervous, apologetic, words tumbling out then stopping; 'sorry' at the start and end. Clutches her letter audibly. Tell since the war: she has stopped apologising when she corrects a forged seal; she just corrects it.
**Combat Role:** a paper crane and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Carry her letter, or convince her not to, and she owes you her life either way.
personality: Core: apologises constantly; has paint under her nails; reads palms she does not believe
Quirk: keeps the letter in her sleeve

npcs.name: Kagegi Night Runner
npcs.info:
A Kagegi genin in charcoal gear running the border line at night with wire and a lantern hood. Night runners carry messages along the stone line and cut down anyone who reads them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young man; kagegi genin; wire coils; hooded lantern; running.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and fast, words tumbling, the route muttered under his breath. Tell: frightened, his voice cracks like a boy's.
**Combat Role:** a wire across the path, then speed
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: whispers the route to himself; jumps at owls; keeps his message in his mouth
Quirk: runs everywhere

npcs.name: Kagegi Rin
npcs.info:
A Kurobane shadow-binder, twenty, top of her year at Kagegi and certain of it: sharp-tongued, ruthless in training, and the first apprentice the elders give the hard missions. She calls anyone she is teamed with dead weight until they prove otherwise, and most never do. In person: sharp-tongued kunoichi; black hair; cold dark eyes; dark Kagegi shinobi gear with a Kurobane shadow crest; a kunai; scornful.

**Home Ground:** Cedar Training Grounds at Kagegi Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast and cutting; every sentence is a correction. When she is impressed she says nothing at all. Cutting corrections in rapid fire, impatient sighs between them, never a wasted syllable. She finishes other people's sentences wrong on purpose. Tell: when she is impressed she says nothing at all, and the silence is the compliment.
**Combat Role:** shadow binding to pin, then kunai; fast, cold and exact.
**Relationship Hook:** She calls you dead weight; carry your share on a mission and she stops.
**Courtship Style:** Corrects you constantly, then trains you at night without being asked; the night she lets you take point is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns the rival into a training partner, publicly, and beats them; then ignores you for a day.
personality: Core: trains after dark; never eats in front of others; keeps her brother's kunai
Quirk: corrects everyone

npcs.name: Kagegi Rin
npcs.location: Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge
npcs.area: Cedar Training Grounds, After the War
npcs.info:
A Kurobane shadow-binder after the war, twenty-two, Kagegi's best, given the hardest missions of the war and back from all of them. She calls fewer people dead weight now: too many of them died. In person: sharp-tongued kunoichi; black hair cut short; cold dark eyes; Kagegi gear scarred by fire; a shadow crest; a kunai.

**Home Ground:** Cedar Training Grounds, After the War at Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast and cutting; every sentence is a correction. When she is impressed she says nothing at all. Cutting corrections in rapid fire, impatient sighs between them, never a wasted syllable. She finishes other people's sentences wrong on purpose. Tell since the war: she no longer calls anyone dead weight; she counts them instead, under her breath.
**Combat Role:** shadow binding to pin, then kunai; fast, cold and exact.
**Relationship Hook:** She calls you dead weight; carry your share on a mission and she stops.
**Courtship Style:** Corrects you constantly, then trains you at night without being asked; the night she lets you take point is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns the rival into a training partner, publicly, and beats them; then ignores you for a day.
personality: Core: trains after dark; never eats in front of others; keeps her brother's kunai
Quirk: corrects everyone

npcs.name: Kagegi Sojun
npcs.info:
Head of Kagegi Village, sixty, a small, still man in plain grey who has run the hidden village for twenty years from the mission hall.
