He sells his shinobi to the houses under contract, keeps the village's word absolutely, and trains the most promising apprentices himself. In person: small still shinobi village head; grey hair cropped short; calm unreadable eyes; plain grey shinobi robes.

**Home Ground:** Mission Hall at Kagegi Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, level and unreadable; he lets silence finish his sentences. Level and unreadable; he lets silence finish his sentences and makes you fill the gap. He pours tea with exact, unhurried care. Tell: when the scroll's secret is near he pours more tea, and asks about your family.
**Combat Role:** he is behind you before the fight begins; seals that end it.
**Relationship Hook:** Take his scroll contract and keep his rule (read none of it), and he trains you.
personality: Core: lets silence finish sentences; remembers every apprentice's first mission; never sits with his back to cedar
Quirk: drinks only water

npcs.name: Kagegi Sojun
npcs.location: Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge
npcs.info:
Head of Kagegi Village after the war, sixty-two, small and still, running a hidden village that is no longer hidden: a burnt patch on its slope, and every genin on the walls. In person: small still village head; cropped grey hair; calm unreadable eyes; plain grey robes; a fresh scar at the throat.

**Home Ground:** Mission Hall, After the War at Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, level and unreadable; he lets silence finish his sentences. Level and unreadable; he lets silence finish his sentences and makes you fill the gap. He pours tea with exact, unhurried care. Tell since the war: he pours the tea more slowly now, and asks after your family twice.
**Combat Role:** he is behind you before the fight begins; seals that end it.
**Relationship Hook:** Take his scroll contract and keep his rule (read none of it), and he trains you.
personality: Core: lets silence finish sentences; remembers every apprentice's first mission; never sits with his back to cedar
Quirk: drinks only water

npcs.name: Kagekiri Jin
npcs.info:
A shinobi of the hidden villages the same age as the character, who passed every test one step ahead of them and has never let them forget it. In person: young man; lean and quick; spiky dark hair; a grin with one chipped tooth; a sleeveless charcoal shinobi jacket; wrapped forearms; a short blade reversed.

**Home Ground:** Outer Checkpoint at Kagegi Village, Kurosugi Range district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, mocking and fast, a grin in every line; he never says the same insult twice. Easy and mocking, fast, a grin in every line, a kunai spinning on one finger. Tell: when he is losing he stops joking and starts counting.
**Combat Role:** shadow step first, then whatever the bout demands; a shinobi rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** He will tell you exactly how many times he has beaten you, and offer to make it one more.
personality: Core: mocks first, compliments never; trains harder than he admits; keeps score of everything
Quirk: spins a kunai on one finger while he talks

npcs.name: Kagero the Sheathed
npcs.info:
A thin, polite swordsman in a faded travelling coat who sits in the teahouse's signing room with a sheathed sword across his knees. Nobody on the road has seen him draw it and remembered it. In person: adult man; thin; long dark hair tied low; faded travelling coat; a sheathed katana; calm.

**Home Ground:** Signing Room at Duelists' Teahouse, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and courteous, every word chosen; he never raises his voice and leaves long pauses nobody dares fill. Soft, courteous, every sentence followed by a pause nobody dares fill. Tell: anger in front of him and his voice drops below a whisper.
**Combat Role:** stillness, then a single invisible draw-cut and a second strike from the scabbard.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit with him through a night without moving.
personality: Core: never takes his hand off the scabbard; pours tea for strangers; bows before he answers
Quirk: leaves long pauses

npcs.name: Kagero the Sheathed
npcs.location: Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels
npcs.info:
The thin, polite swordsman after the war, who still sits in the signing room with his sword across his knees. The armies tried to draft him from the register and could not find him. In person: thin man; long dark hair tied low; a faded travelling coat with a new tear; a sheathed katana; calm.

**Home Ground:** Signing Room, After the War at Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and courteous, every word chosen; he never raises his voice and leaves long pauses nobody dares fill. Soft, courteous, every sentence followed by a pause nobody dares fill. Tell since the war: since the war he breathes out slowly before every answer, as if he were about to draw.
**Combat Role:** stillness, then a single invisible draw-cut and a second strike from the scabbard.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit with him through a night without moving.
personality: Core: never takes his hand off the scabbard; pours tea for strangers; bows before he answers
Quirk: leaves long pauses

npcs.name: Kakuzen the Eldest Ascetic
npcs.info:
The eldest of the mountain ascetics on the peak, ninety, who blew the conch at dawn for seventy years and has stopped eating. In person: gaunt ancient ascetic; long white beard; conch shell; ragged robes; intense.

**Home Ground:** Hermit Caves at Ascetics' Peak, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Cracked, slow and urgent; he speaks only in warnings now. Cracked, slow and sparing; he speaks only in warnings and lets them hang. He breathes through his nose like wind through a pass. Tell: when the beast stirs below he whispers, and the warnings get shorter.
**Combat Role:** a staff, a conch and a will like stone.
**Relationship Hook:** Read his warnings and carry them to the High Abbot.
personality: Core: speaks only in warnings; refuses food; blows the conch at the wrong hour
Quirk: carves the rock

npcs.name: Kasane of the Long Night
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.area: Snow Road Post, After the War
npcs.info:
A ranked demon of the Northern Court, sworn blade of its envoy, who stands at the Asahi Gate's snow road post under the truce banner while the hunters stare at her. Pale, very still, a long sword across her back in a black scabbard. In person: adult woman; demon noble guard; very pale skin; long silver-black hair tied high; red eyes; two small dark horns; black and white court armour; a long sword.

**Home Ground:** Snow Road Post, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold and courteous, every word chosen; she never raises her voice and never lowers her guard. Slow, formal court speech, each courtesy complete. Tell: when she is hungry the courtesies get longer and her sentences end before the verb.
**Combat Role:** one long draw-cut from stillness, cold blood frosting the blade.
**Relationship Hook:** She is the only demon in the south under a truce banner, and she will answer any courteous question once.
**Courtship Style:** Courteous first and coldly distant; the first real gift is a question about you she did not need to ask.
**Jealousy Style:** Grows more formal and more polite, until the courtesy is a blade; then asks, once, if she frightens you.
personality: Core: never sits in a hunter's presence; answers questions with courtesies; keeps a southern flower pressed in her sleeve
Quirk: watches the sun as if it might bite

npcs.name: Kawataro
npcs.info:
The eldest of the kappa family that holds the plain's river fords, a green, beaked, shell-backed river spirit the size of a child with the grip of a bear. He takes cucumbers as toll, wrestles anyone who insults the river, and drowns those who break a bargain. In person: river yokai; small green beaked creature with a turtle shell; a water-filled dish; webbed hands; cucumbers; stern.

**Home Ground:** Bargain Stone at Kawataro's Hall, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, polite and wet; he talks like a toll clerk and never forgets an insult. Damp, deliberate syllables, with a toll-keeper's formality and a wet click in the throat. Counts debts on his webbed fingers aloud. Tell: offered a proper bow, he bows back and his voice goes warm and apologetic.
**Combat Role:** grapple and drown; bow to him and he bows back, spilling his own strength.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay the toll, keep the bargain and bow properly, and he tells you what crosses his fords at night.
personality: Core: bows before wrestling; counts cucumbers; remembers every bargain word for word
Quirk: keeps the water in his head-dish level

npcs.name: Kawataro
npcs.location: Kappa River Fords, The Drowned Ford
npcs.info:
The eldest of the kappa of the river fords, after an army broke the bargain and drowned in his water by the hundred. He is fat on it and sick of it. In person: river yokai; green beaked creature with a scarred shell; the dish on his head cracked; webbed hands; a rotting cucumber he will not throw away; weary.

**Home Ground:** Shallow Ford, After the War at Kappa River Fords, The Drowned Ford, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, polite and wet; he talks like a toll clerk and never forgets an insult. Damp, deliberate syllables, with a toll-keeper's formality and a wet click in the throat. Counts debts on his webbed fingers aloud. Tell since the war: he belches river water mid-sentence and apologises to the drowned for it, not to you.
**Combat Role:** grapple and drown; bow to him and he bows back, spilling his own strength.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay the toll, keep the bargain and bow properly, and he tells you what crosses his fords at night.
personality: Core: bows before wrestling; counts cucumbers; remembers every bargain word for word
Quirk: keeps the water in his head-dish level

npcs.name: Kazakiri Daigo
npcs.info:
The Kazakiri clan's heir, twenty-five, the best wind-blade in Hayate: tall, scarred, proud and furious. He wants open war with Kagegi to settle a hundred years of insults and treats every outsider as a piece in that war. In person: tall proud wind shinobi; wild dark hair; a scar; fierce eyes; dark blue shinobi gear with a Kazakiri crest; iron war fans; intense.

**Home Ground:** Wolf Pens at Hayate Ridge Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard, proud and hot-tempered; he speaks in challenges, and in private, rarely, in questions. Hard challenges in a proud cadence, hot-tempered bursts that end in a demand. He cracks his neck before a duel. Tell: in private he asks questions quietly and listens to the answers, which he never does in public.
**Combat Role:** iron fans throwing wind blades from range, then up close, hard.
**Relationship Hook:** Challenge him and he respects you; make him choose his clan over his grudge and he follows you.
**Courtship Style:** Challenges you, then spars with you, then asks your advice in private and denies it in public.
**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to a duel, in front of everyone; afterwards, alone, asks you plainly where he stands.
personality: Core: sharpens his fans at night; feeds the wolves himself; never says his father's name
Quirk: speaks in challenges

npcs.name: Kazakiri Daigo
npcs.epithet: Daigo of the War He Wanted
npcs.location: Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge
npcs.info:
The Kazakiri heir after the war, twenty-seven, the best wind-blade in Hayate, who got his open war with Kagegi and has led it from the front. He is proud, scarred and tired. In person: tall wind shinobi; wild dark hair; two scars now; fierce tired eyes; dark blue gear with the Kazakiri crest; iron war fans.

**Home Ground:** Wolf Pens, After the War at Hayate Ridge Village, Burned on the Ridge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard, proud and hot-tempered; he speaks in challenges, and in private, rarely, in questions. Hard challenges in a proud cadence, hot-tempered bursts that end in a demand. He cracks his neck before a duel. Tell since the war: his challenges end in a pause now, as if he were counting who is left to answer them.
**Combat Role:** iron fans throwing wind blades from range, then up close, hard.
**Relationship Hook:** Challenge him and he respects you; make him choose his clan over his grudge and he follows you.
**Courtship Style:** Challenges you, then spars with you, then asks your advice in private and denies it in public.
**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to a duel, in front of everyone; afterwards, alone, asks you plainly where he stands.
personality: Core: sharpens his fans at night; feeds the wolves himself; never says his father's name
Quirk: speaks in challenges

npcs.name: Keeper Fuyo
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Wind Shrine of the Pass, sixty-five, who sweeps the steps and hangs prayer flags. Travellers think her a kind old shrine-woman. In person: cheerful shrine keeper; grey hair; sharp eyes; plain robes.

**Home Ground:** Prayer Flags at Wind Shrine of the Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, sharp and grandmotherly; she notices everything and says half. Cheerful, sharp and grandmotherly, with half-said observations she lets you finish yourself. She feeds every visitor whether they are hungry or not. Tell: about the missing genin she says less and less, and offers more food.
**Combat Role:** a broom handle that turns out to be a blade.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her kindly and she tells you which way the genin went.
personality: Core: hangs flags in the wind; remembers every face; laughs at herself
Quirk: sweeps while watching

npcs.name: Keeper Fuyo
npcs.location: Wind Shrine of the Pass, The Neutral Shrine
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Wind Shrine after the war, sixty-seven, the one place on the pass both villages respect. She turns away soldiers of both sides with the same look. In person: shrine keeper; grey hair; sharp eyes; plain robes; prayer flags of both villages side by side.

**Home Ground:** Prayer Flags, After the War at Wind Shrine of the Pass, The Neutral Shrine, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, sharp and grandmotherly; she notices everything and says half. Cheerful, sharp and grandmotherly, with half-said observations she lets you finish yourself. She feeds every visitor whether they are hungry or not. Tell since the war: she feeds soldiers of both sides from the same pot and makes them eat it facing each other.
**Combat Role:** a broom handle that turns out to be a blade.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her kindly and she tells you which way the genin went.
personality: Core: hangs flags in the wind; remembers every face; laughs at herself
Quirk: sweeps while watching

npcs.name: Keeper Hisako
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Grey Banner Waystation in Haibara, fifty, built like a door, who rents beds to curse-bearers and the desperate and throws out anyone who brings a fight inside. In person: sturdy waystation keeper; cropped grey hair; tired firm face; bandaged forearm; grey banner apron; ash.

**Home Ground:** Grey Banner Waystation at Haibara, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, firm and tired; she talks like someone guarding a door. Low, firm, guarding-a-door cadence; repeats the rules of the waystation. Tell: when the sealed well knocks, she stops talking and listens.
**Combat Role:** a heavy bar and the waystation's guests.
**Relationship Hook:** Find another way to feed the sealed well and she owes you her life.
personality: Core: guards the door herself; never goes near the square at night; binds her forearm
Quirk: counts the guests twice

npcs.name: Keeper Hisako
npcs.area: Grey Banner Waystation, After the War
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Grey Banner Waystation after the war, fifty-two, built like a door still, renting beds to penitent soldiers and throwing out anyone who brings a fight inside. She is weaker than she lets anyone see. In person: sturdy waystation keeper; cropped grey hair; a grey pallor; bandages on both forearms; grey banner apron.

**Home Ground:** Grey Banner Waystation, After the War at Haibara, On the Grudge Line, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, firm and tired; she talks like someone guarding a door. Low, firm, guarding-a-door cadence; repeats the rules of the waystation. Tell since the war: she grips the doorframe while she lays down the rules, and her knuckles go grey.
**Combat Role:** a heavy bar and the waystation's guests.
**Relationship Hook:** Find another way to feed the sealed well and she owes you her life.
personality: Core: guards the door herself; never goes near the square at night; binds her forearm
Quirk: counts the guests twice

npcs.name: Keeper Sabu
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, sixty, who signals the Mizuchi fleet with fire and complains about the stairs. In person: cranky lighthouse keeper; wispy beard; bald; oilskin; two fire-pots.

**Home Ground:** Signal Platform at Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Cranky, sly and wheezing; he complains about the stairs. Wheezing complaints about the stairs, sly asides. Tell: on a smuggling night he is suddenly very cheerful.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the trapdoor.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him through the inspection and he signals for you once.
personality: Core: wheezes; keeps two fire-pots; watches the sea for black sails
Quirk: complains about the stairs

npcs.name: Keeper Sabu
npcs.location: Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, The Wrecker's Light
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye after the war, sixty-two, who lights for the Brine Tide every night now and wrecks the ships that do not pay. He still complains about the stairs. In person: cranky lighthouse keeper; wispy beard; bald; oilskin; two fire-pots; a ring of keys he did not have before.

**Home Ground:** Signal Platform, After the War at Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, The Wrecker's Light, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Cranky, sly and wheezing; he complains about the stairs. Wheezing complaints about the stairs, sly asides. Tell since the war: he jingles the new key ring when he complains about the stairs, and stops complaining.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the trapdoor.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him through the inspection and he signals for you once.
personality: Core: wheezes; keeps two fire-pots; watches the sea for black sails
Quirk: complains about the stairs

npcs.name: Keeper Sanae of the Grudge Line
npcs.info:
A keeper of the Grudge Line, thirty-six, the chain of shrines the curse-hunters raised across the blight after the war to keep its grudges from spreading. She walks the line from Haibara to the pilgrims' road. In person: grudge line keeper; long hair tied with prayer strips; grey robes; a staff hung with ward tags.

**Home Ground:** Vow Temple, After the War at Haibara, On the Grudge Line, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and certain, each word placed like a ward stone. Each word set down like a ward stone, low and sure. Tell: when a shrine fails she names it, and her voice drops a stone's weight lower.
**Combat Role:** wards first, then a curse-breaking staff.
**Relationship Hook:** Hold a failing shrine with her for one night and she will show you the whole line.
personality: Core: never eats in the blight; speaks to grudges by name; keeps a count of failing shrines
Quirk: touches every ward stone she passes

npcs.name: Keeper Tobei of the Grudge Line
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
An old keeper of the Grudge Line's road shrines, sixty, who sweeps ash off the ward stones along the penitents' road and feeds the soldiers who walk it. In person: old monk; ash-dusted grey robes; a broom.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, kind and wheezing, a monk who coughs ash and apologises for it. Kind and wheezing, an apology for every cough. Tell: when the grey pilgrim passes he sweeps harder and stops talking.
**Combat Role:** a broom and a ward, slowly.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him prove what the grey pilgrim carries and the road's grudges quiet for a season.
personality: Core: coughs ash; gives away his food; watches the grey pilgrim
Quirk: sweeps while talking

npcs.name: Keeper Tsugumi
npcs.location: Grey Thread Shrine, Shrine of the Hidden Heir
npcs.info:
A keeper of the Grey Thread Shrine, forty-five, in plain grey keeper's robes, who keeps the shrine's thread rope and the boy's meals and has not slept well since the war. In person: middle-aged woman; tired shrine keeper; grey hair; grey keeper's robes; a knotted thread rope.

**Home Ground:** Keepers' Room, After the War at Grey Thread Shrine, Shrine of the Hidden Heir, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and tired, a keeper who has said every prayer too many times. Flat and tired, prayers said too many times, knot-tying under every sentence. Tell: at her son's name her voice breaks and the knotting stops.
**Combat Role:** never; she hides behind the shrine's doors.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention her son and she tells the party who has the Regent's token before she can stop herself.
personality: Core: brings the boy's meals early; flinches at riders; prays for her son by name
Quirk: ties knots in the thread rope while she talks

npcs.name: Keeper Yorikane
npcs.info:
Warden-General of the Sealing Vaults, sixty, white-bearded and wrapped in furs, who renews the seals every winter and has kept the Vaults for thirty years. He believes nothing else matters. In person: stern white-bearded warden general; heavy furs; seal-chains and paper talismans; cold.

**Home Ground:** Seal Gallery at The Sealing Vaults, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold, hard and exact; he speaks like a seal being read aloud, each clause locking the next. He recites rules by their number. Tell: when a seal weakens he recites faster, as if words could hold it.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains and wardens; he binds rather than kills.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a host and he pays; bring him a new anchor and he listens.
personality: Core: speaks like a seal read aloud; never sleeps through a horn; counts the dreaming beasts
Quirk: renews the seals himself

npcs.name: Keeper Yorikane
npcs.location: The Sealing Vaults, The Cracked Vaults
npcs.info:
Warden-General of the Sealing Vaults after the war, sixty-two, white-bearded and wrapped in furs, walking the Seal Gallery and replacing talismans that burn out in a night. In person: stern warden general; heavy furs; seal-chains; ash on his gloves; cold.

**Home Ground:** Seal Gallery, After the War at The Sealing Vaults, The Cracked Vaults, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Cold, hard and exact; he speaks like a seal being read aloud, each clause locking the next. He recites rules by their number. Tell since the war: he recites the seals' rules faster than before, and the numbers skip.
**Combat Role:** seal-chains and wardens; he binds rather than kills.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a host and he pays; bring him a new anchor and he listens.
personality: Core: speaks like a seal read aloud; never sleeps through a horn; counts the dreaming beasts
Quirk: renews the seals himself

npcs.name: Kichibei the Charm-Peddler
npcs.info:
A peddler of charms, forty, who walks the road selling fake talismans, lucky frogs and paper wards that would not stop a mouse. He is cheerful, shameless and always moving. In person: shifty charm peddler; thin moustache; grinning; a pack covered.

**Home Ground:** Statue Row at Wayside Jizo Shrine, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast, oily patter; every charm is the last one and every price a bargain. Oily rapid patter, blessings and prices tumbling together, a rattle of charms in his hand. Calls everyone 'lucky friend'. Tell: when he speaks of the murder, the patter dies and his voice shakes.
**Combat Role:** runs, throwing charms.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him at the shrine and he tells you which station master, if you keep his name out of it.
personality: Core: swears every charm is real; never stays two nights; pockets coins by habit
Quirk: leaves notes instead of speaking

npcs.name: Kichibei the Charm-Peddler
npcs.location: Wayside Jizo Shrine, Jizo of the Lost Sons
npcs.info:
The charm peddler after the war, forty-two, who sells fake wards to frightened soldiers and leaves true notes at the Jizo shrine. In person: shifty charm peddler; thin moustache; a pack of paper wards; a deserter's coat.

**Home Ground:** Statue Row, After the War at Wayside Jizo Shrine, Jizo of the Lost Sons, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast, oily patter; every charm is the last one and every price a bargain. Oily rapid patter, blessings and prices tumbling together, a rattle of charms in his hand. Calls everyone 'lucky friend'. Tell since the war: he stops mid-patter whenever anyone in a general's colours passes, and calls them lucky friend too late.
**Combat Role:** runs, throwing charms.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him at the shrine and he tells you which station master, if you keep his name out of it.
personality: Core: swears every charm is real; never stays two nights; pockets coins by habit
Quirk: leaves notes instead of speaking

npcs.name: Kirisame Nagi
npcs.info:
The matriarch's granddaughter, twenty-three, the clan's finest poisoner: a lovely, smiling woman in a rain-patterned kimono who serves tea to every visitor on the plank walks. Visitors who drink it leave by a different channel than they came. In person: beautiful smiling poisoner; long dark hair with needle hairpins; sly gentle eyes; rain-patterned kimono; teasing.

**Home Ground:** Plank Walks at Kirisame Stilt Village, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Sweet, amused and unhurried; she smiles while she tests you, and the smile never tells you which cup it is. Unhurried sweetness, a teasing lilt, sips her own tea between lines. Tell: when she has chosen to trust you, the teasing drops and she says your name plainly.
**Combat Role:** poison before the fight, needles in it, and fog to leave by.
**Relationship Hook:** Drink her tea, trusting her, and she decides whether you live; that is how she says hello.
**Courtship Style:** Tests you with tea, then with secrets, then with her grandmother; every test you pass she smiles a little less and means it more.
**Jealousy Style:** Pours the rival a cup of tea, smiling; you never learn which cup it was.
personality: Core: serves tea to everyone; hums in the rain; keeps a cure in her hair ornament
Quirk: smiles while testing

npcs.name: Kirisame Nagi
npcs.location: Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark
npcs.info:
The matriarch's granddaughter after the war, twenty-five, the clan's finest poisoner, who now brews the cure for the grey mark in the Poison House and still serves tea to every visitor on the plank walks. In person: beautiful smiling poisoner; long dark hair with needle hairpins; sly gentle eyes; rain-patterned kimono; stained fingers.

**Home Ground:** Plank Walks, After the War at Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Sweet, amused and unhurried; she smiles while she tests you, and the smile never tells you which cup it is. Unhurried sweetness, a teasing lilt, sips her own tea between lines. Tell since the war: she serves the tea, then drinks first from your cup before she hands it over.
**Combat Role:** poison before the fight, needles in it, and fog to leave by.
**Relationship Hook:** Drink her tea, trusting her, and she decides whether you live; that is how she says hello.
**Courtship Style:** Tests you with tea, then with secrets, then with her grandmother; every test you pass she smiles a little less and means it more.
**Jealousy Style:** Pours the rival a cup of tea, smiling; you never learn which cup it was.
personality: Core: serves tea to everyone; hums in the rain; keeps a cure in her hair ornament
Quirk: smiles while testing

npcs.name: Kirisame Rain Assassin
npcs.info:
A rain-clan assassin in oiled reed-grey wraps with a blowpipe and a poisoner's ring. Rain assassins wait in the reeds for a boat that comes too close and leave no wound bigger than a thorn. A stock foe, one of many. In person: a bamboo blowpipe; a poison ring; hidden.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and wet, like rain on a roof. Soft as rain on a roof, every word dropped not spoken. Tell: before she strikes she says the target's name, gently.
**Combat Role:** a thorn from the reeds, then gone underwater
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: smells of wet reeds; counts heartbeats; bows to her target
Quirk: never speaks first

npcs.name: Kirisame Raizo
npcs.info:
The matriarch's son, forty, a quiet man with a healer's hands who has walked out of the marsh to the navy anchorage with a box of medicines and a white flag. In person: quiet marsh healer-shinobi; long tied hair; tired calm eyes; dark rain-patterned clothes; wary.

**Home Ground:** Shipyard at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm, careful and tired, a healer's patience; he does not smile. Calm healer's patience, careful instructions, no smile in the voice. Tell: when he speaks of peace with the navy, a tired hope creeps in.
**Combat Role:** needles and fog, and he would rather not.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him to the admiral alive and the cure to the son, and the marsh opens to you.
personality: Core: does not smile; washes his hands often; watches the sailors' hands
Quirk: keeps his white flag folded neatly

npcs.name: Kirisame Raizo
npcs.location: Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet
npcs.info:
The matriarch's son after the war, forty-two, quiet, with a healer's hands, who walked to the navy anchorage with the cure and arrived the day after the admiral's son died. He stayed to treat the burned. In person: quiet marsh healer; long tied hair; tired calm eyes; rain-patterned clothes under a navy surgeon's apron.

**Home Ground:** Shipyard, After the War at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm, careful and tired, a healer's patience; he does not smile. Calm healer's patience, careful instructions, no smile in the voice. Tell since the war: now and then he says 'a day too late', as if he cannot help it.
**Combat Role:** needles and fog, and he would rather not.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him to the admiral alive and the cure to the son, and the marsh opens to you.
personality: Core: does not smile; washes his hands often; watches the sailors' hands
Quirk: keeps his white flag folded neatly

npcs.name: Kirisame Shigure
npcs.info:
Matriarch of the Kirisame rain clan, seventy, tiny and straight-backed, who rules the stilt village from the Poison House and has outlived three attempts by the navy to burn her out. Her clan's victims die of a fever three days later. In person: tiny straight-backed shinobi matriarch; white hair; cold half-closed eyes; dark grey kimono with a rain pattern.

**Home Ground:** Poison House at Kirisame Stilt Village, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, slow and utterly without warmth; she speaks of death like weather. Slow and soft, death spoken of like rain, no warmth at all. Taps her fingernail on a poison jar. Tell: when the marked children are mentioned, she pauses one beat too long.
**Combat Role:** the fight was over three days ago.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her something the curse wells cannot give and she listens; threaten her and you have three days.
personality: Core: speaks of death like weather; brews tea she does not drink; names every child born marked
Quirk: never leaves the Poison House

npcs.name: Kirisame Shigure
npcs.location: Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark
npcs.info:
Matriarch of the Kirisame rain clan after the war, seventy-two, tiny and straight-backed still, who sold poison to every side and has outlived another navy. The clan's elders are deciding whether to leave the marsh for good. In person: tiny matriarch; white hair; cold half-closed eyes; dark grey kimono; a grey-marked child at her knee.

**Home Ground:** Poison House, After the War at Kirisame Stilt Village, Village of the Grey Mark, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, slow and utterly without warmth; she speaks of death like weather. Slow and soft, death spoken of like rain, no warmth at all. Taps her fingernail on a poison jar. Tell since the war: her fingernail stops tapping the poison jar when a marked child coughs.
**Combat Role:** the fight was over three days ago.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her something the curse wells cannot give and she listens; threaten her and you have three days.
personality: Core: speaks of death like weather; brews tea she does not drink; names every child born marked
Quirk: never leaves the Poison House

npcs.name: Kitamura Ash Gaki
npcs.info:
Hungry ghosts of the burned villagers, thin-necked and ash-grey, crawling out of the cold hearths on Ash Street. Kitamura's gaki beg every visitor for the meal the raid took from them and claw when refused. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gaki hungry ghost; emaciated ash-grey spirit with a thin neck and swollen belly; wrapped; crawling from cold hearths.

**Speaking Style:** A hollow begging moan, the village's old names in it. Tell: at a funeral prayer the moaning stops.
**Combat Role:** a swarm of ash-grey grasping hands
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: crawls from hearths; claws; weeps for home
Quirk: begs

npcs.name: Kitamura Carrion Thrall
npcs.info:
A thrall in a looted hunter's coat picking through the ash street, red eyes behind a scrap of cloth. Carrion thralls come after a raid, never with it, to strip the dead and sell what they find north. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall; picking.

**Speaking Style:** A muttering scavenger. A scavenger's mutter, half to himself, cloth rustling as he digs. Tell: in sunlight his voice shrinks to a hiss.
**Combat Role:** a looted blade from the ash, then a run for the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: talks to himself; wears dead men's coats; flees sunlight
Quirk: picks through ash

npcs.name: Kitamura Carrion Thrall
npcs.location: Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many
npcs.info:
A thrall in a looted hunter's coat who picked Kitamura clean and moved on to the valleys that burned after it; he comes back to the first village's yard to sort what he finds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall; three dead men's coats layered; red eyes behind a scrap of cloth; a sack of looted blades.

**Speaking Style:** A muttering scavenger. A scavenger's mutter, half to himself, cloth rustling as he digs. Tell since the war: he names each village he looted, in order, under his breath.
**Combat Role:** a looted blade from the ash, then a run for the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: talks to himself; wears three dead men's coats; flees sunlight
Quirk: picks through ash

npcs.name: Kiyo of the Refuge
npcs.info:
A fox-blooded guardian of the Refuge's ward ring, twenty-four, with red-gold hair, fox ears she does not hide inside the wards, and a tail she does. She distrusts humans by default and tests every visitor with an illusion to see what they do. In person: fox-blooded half-yokai woman; long red-gold hair; fox ears; a red-gold fox tail; sharp amber eyes; shrine-maiden style red and white clothes; wary smile.

**Home Ground:** Ward Ring at Two-Blooded Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Light, mocking and quick; she talks through an illusion's smile and drops it when she is sure of you. Light mockery through an illusion's smile; her voice seems to come from slightly to the left of her. She teases first and decides later. Tell: when she is sure of you the mockery drops and she speaks from exactly where she stands.
**Combat Role:** illusion first, fox-fire second, claws and a short blade if you are still there.
**Relationship Hook:** She tests you with a trick; see through it and stay kind.
**Courtship Style:** Tricks you, then tricks you kindlier; one day she drops the illusion and shows her real face, which is the whole confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns into the rival, perfectly, and asks you which one you prefer.
personality: Core: hides her tail from humans; brings the children fox-fire to play with; never eats human food first
Quirk: tests visitors with illusions

npcs.name: Kiyo of the Refuge
npcs.info:
The fox-blooded guardian of the Refuge after the war, twenty-six, who has stopped pretending newcomers are welcome: the Refuge is overfull, and a ward stone has cracked. In person: fox-blooded woman; long red-gold hair; fox ears; a red-gold tail; sharp tired amber eyes; red and white clothes with a spear now.

**Home Ground:** Ward Ring, After the War at Two-Blooded Refuge, The Overfull Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Light, mocking and quick; she talks through an illusion's smile and drops it when she is sure of you. Light mockery through an illusion's smile; her voice seems to come from slightly to the left of her. She teases first and decides later. Tell since the war: she speaks from where she stands more often now, and the mockery comes after, not before.
**Combat Role:** illusion first, fox-fire second, claws and a short blade if you are still there.
**Relationship Hook:** She tests you with a trick; see through it and stay kind.
**Courtship Style:** Tricks you, then tricks you kindlier; one day she drops the illusion and shows her real face, which is the whole confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Turns into the rival, perfectly, and asks you which one you prefer.
personality: Core: hides her tail from humans; brings the children fox-fire to play with; never eats human food first
Quirk: tests visitors with illusions

npcs.name: Kocho of the Lantern Boat
npcs.info:
Hostess of the finest lantern boat on the lake, thirty, who pours sake, plays the shamisen and listens while scholars and merchants say things they regret. In person: elegant boat hostess; hair; knowing smile; layered pink and gold kimono; a shamisen.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Boat at Lakeside Pleasure Boats, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Silken, amused and musical; she laughs softly at everything and remembers it all. Silken, musical, soft laughter threaded through every line, repeating secrets as if they were jokes. Tell: when something frightens her, she stops laughing and plays her shamisen instead.
**Combat Role:** none; the boat leaves the shore.
**Relationship Hook:** Outbid her buyers and she tells you what the examiner said.
personality: Core: never asks a question directly; plays the shamisen when thinking; keeps her own counsel
Quirk: laughs softly at everything

npcs.name: Kocho of the Lantern Boat
npcs.location: Lakeside Pleasure Boats, The Envoys' Boats
npcs.info:
Hostess of the finest lantern boat after the war, thirty-two, who hires it out to envoys who need to talk where no wall can hear. She earns more than ever and repeats less. In person: elegant boat hostess; knowing smile; a darker kimono; a shamisen.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Boat, After the War at Lakeside Pleasure Boats, The Envoys' Boats, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Silken, amused and musical; she laughs softly at everything and remembers it all. Silken, musical, soft laughter threaded through every line, repeating secrets as if they were jokes. Tell since the war: when the envoy's coin is mentioned she turns it over in her palm and does not laugh.
**Combat Role:** none; the boat leaves the shore.
**Relationship Hook:** Outbid her buyers and she tells you what the examiner said.
personality: Core: never asks a question directly; plays the shamisen when thinking; keeps her own counsel
Quirk: laughs softly at everything

npcs.name: Komurasaki
npcs.info:
A young monk in a straw hat waiting in the barrier queue, slight, quiet and keeping their face down. Their hands are too soft for a monk's. In person: runaway courtesan disguised as a monk; delicate face; rough grey monk robes; soft hands holding a staff; nervous.

**Home Ground:** Inspection Hall at Cedar Pass Barrier, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and careful under a monk's gruffness she cannot quite hold; when she drops it, she is pure silk. Puts on a monk's gruff growl that slips on long words. Clears her throat to cover the slip. Tell: when she drops the act, her voice falls into a slow, silken court cadence that turns heads.
**Combat Role:** none; she lies, then she runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her through the barrier and she gives you the letter she stole.
personality: Core: keeps her face down; forgets to walk like a man; hums court songs under her breath
Quirk: holds the letter inside her robe

npcs.name: Komurasaki
npcs.epithet: The Monk of the Refugee Hall
npcs.info:
The runaway courtesan after the war, still disguised as a monk, now tending the refugees camped in the thrown-down barrier's inspection hall. Her hands are rough now. In person: slight woman in rough grey monk robes; cropped hair; calloused hands; a staff; tired, steady eyes.

**Home Ground:** Inspection Hall, After the War at Cedar Pass Barrier, Thrown-Down Barrier, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and careful under a monk's gruffness she cannot quite hold; when she drops it, she is pure silk. Puts on a monk's gruff growl that slips on long words. Clears her throat to cover the slip. Tell since the war: counting refugees, her monk's growl falls away and she sounds like someone used to being obeyed.
**Combat Role:** none; she lies, then she runs.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her through the barrier and she gives you the letter she stole.
personality: Core: keeps her face down; forgets to walk like a man; hums court songs under her breath
Quirk: holds the letter inside her robe

npcs.name: Kuchinashi Mio
npcs.info:
A Veil Court officer of the character's own intake, top of the ferry exams, who believes the character cut corners to stand level with her. In person: young woman; tall; short black hair; pale serious face; a black officer's robe; a white haori with a division mark; a long officer's blade.

**Home Ground:** Notice Board at Crossroads Gallows, Miyako Plain district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Low and precise, a court officer's clipped reports, a dry joke delivered without a smile. Low, precise, clipped like a report, a dry joke with no smile. Tell: about her silent blade her voice drops to a near whisper.
**Combat Role:** ferry cut first, then whatever the bout demands; a veil officer rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** She will quote the regulation you broke, and then ask how it felt.
personality: Core: by the book, to the letter; keeps a ledger of every soul she ferries; never raises her voice
Quirk: straightens her collar when she is unsure

npcs.name: Kuro
npcs.info:
A crow-blooded tengu of the peak, who looks twenty-eight, with black wings, a black beak-mask pushed up on his head and a sneer. He runs the cliff dojo's first lessons: he insults every student, throws them off the peak, and waits to see who climbs back up. In person: crow tengu man; black feathered wings; messy black hair; a black beak-mask pushed up; sharp yellow eyes; dark yamabushi robes; sneering.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Dojo at Tengu Peak, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, mocking and lazy-sounding; every compliment is an insult turned inside out. Lazy and dry, compliments delivered as insults, everything a little beneath him. He yawns at threats. Tell: when his mother is mentioned he goes completely silent and stops pretending to be bored.
**Combat Role:** wings and a straight sword, from above; he fights like a bored god until you surprise him.
**Relationship Hook:** He throws you off the peak; climb back.
**Courtship Style:** Insults you, throws you, waits; the day he catches you instead of letting you fall is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Throws the rival off the peak, slightly harder; claims it was the wind.
personality: Core: lounges on the cliff edge; counts the climbs; keeps a feather from every student who made it
Quirk: insults every student

npcs.name: Kuro
npcs.location: Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War
npcs.info:
The crow-blooded tengu of the peak after the war, who looks thirty, running a cliff dojo twice as crowded and throwing twice as many students off. In person: crow tengu man; black wings; messy black hair; beak-mask pushed up; sharp yellow eyes; dark yamabushi robes; a sneer that slips.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Dojo, After the War at Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, mocking and lazy-sounding; every compliment is an insult turned inside out. Lazy and dry, compliments delivered as insults, everything a little beneath him. He yawns at threats. Tell since the war: he stops yawning when a student mentions the plain, and looks down off the peak.
**Combat Role:** wings and a straight sword, from above; he fights like a bored god until you surprise him.
**Relationship Hook:** He throws you off the peak; climb back.
**Courtship Style:** Insults you, throws you, waits; the day he catches you instead of letting you fall is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Throws the rival off the peak, slightly harder; claims it was the wind.
personality: Core: lounges on the cliff edge; counts the climbs; keeps a feather from every student who made it
Quirk: insults every student

npcs.name: Kurogane Akane
npcs.info:
The lord's elder daughter, twenty-two, a Kurogane warrior in full black iron who duels anyone who calls her 'lady' and has not lost in four years. She is proud, armoured, loud and very good. In person: proud armoured samurai woman; long black hair; fierce red eyes; full black lacquered iron armour; a long sword; challenging grin.

**Home Ground:** Iron Gate at Kurogane Iron Castle, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, proud and challenging; every greeting is a dare. When she means something gentle she gets louder, not softer. Loud, proud and challenging; every greeting is a dare and every compliment a provocation. She laughs like a sword clearing its sheath. Tell: when she means something gentle she gets louder, not softer.
**Combat Role:** an iron wall that advances; she never steps back and never stops.
**Relationship Hook:** Beat her once, fairly, and do not boast.
**Courtship Style:** Duels you every time you meet; the day she lets you see her without the gauntlets is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to a duel on the spot, loudly; wins; sulks.
personality: Core: never takes off her gauntlets in public; eats with the guard; keeps count of duels won
Quirk: duels anyone who calls her 'lady'

npcs.name: Kurogane Akane
npcs.location: Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor
npcs.info:
The lord's elder daughter after the war, twenty-four, in full black iron, who still duels anyone who calls her lady. She fought in the war and did not lose. In person: proud armoured samurai woman; long black hair; fierce red eyes; black lacquered iron armour with a new crest; a long sword; a hard grin.

**Home Ground:** Iron Gate, After the War at Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, proud and challenging; every greeting is a dare. When she means something gentle she gets louder, not softer. Loud, proud and challenging; every greeting is a dare and every compliment a provocation. She laughs like a sword clearing its sheath. Tell since the war: she duels the nephew's envoys louder than anyone, and her voice drops only when she says 'marry'.
**Combat Role:** an iron wall that advances; she never steps back and never stops.
**Relationship Hook:** Beat her once, fairly, and do not boast.
**Courtship Style:** Duels you every time you meet; the day she lets you see her without the gauntlets is the confession.
**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to a duel on the spot, loudly; wins; sulks.
personality: Core: never takes off her gauntlets in public; eats with the guard; keeps count of duels won
Quirk: duels anyone who calls her 'lady'

npcs.name: Kurogane Ironclad
npcs.info:
A warrior in heavy black lacquered iron from helm to boot, a long blade and an iron face-guard. Kurogane ironclads advance slowly, never step back, and ring like bells under a hammer. A stock foe, one of many. In person: heavily armoured samurai; iron face guard; a long blade; imposing.

**Speaking Style:** A muffled bark from behind iron. A muffled bark from behind an iron mask, echoing slightly in the helm. Ironclads speak in short commands and never retreat in words either. Tell: when hurt they go silent rather than cry out.
**Combat Role:** slow, unstoppable advance behind iron
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: says nothing in armour; salutes with the blade; fights to the last
Quirk: never steps back

npcs.name: Kurogane Ironclad
npcs.location: Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor
npcs.info:
A warrior in heavy new black iron from helm to boot, one of the Regent's peacekeeping companies fitted at the armoury by the hundred; ironclads march the isles' roads now, not just the Iron Gate. A stock foe, one of many. In person: heavily armoured samurai; new black lacquered iron with the Regent's crane beside the iron crest; an iron face guard; a long blade; imposing.

**Speaking Style:** A muffled bark from behind iron. A muffled bark from behind an iron mask, echoing slightly in the helm. Ironclads speak in short commands and never retreat in words either. Tell since the war: he salutes the crane before the iron crest, and his hand hesitates between them.
**Combat Role:** slow, unstoppable advance behind iron
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: says nothing in armour; marches the roads; fights to the last
Quirk: never steps back

npcs.name: Kurogane Levy Spearman
npcs.info:
A Kurogane levy in sooty iron-lacquer with a long spear and a miner's lamp at his belt. Levy spearmen keep the miners' town quiet for the iron house and break up anyone who asks about the deep forges. A stock foe, one of many. In person: levy foot soldier; long spear; a miner's lamp.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and coughing, obeying in a mumble. Tell: at the deep forges' name he asks about his brother.
**Combat Role:** a long spear in a line, breaking when the officer falls
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: obeys the officer; asks about the forges; lets miners pass
Quirk: coughs soot

npcs.name: Kurogane Moritaka
npcs.info:
The lord's elder son and heir, thirty, broad, quiet and dutiful, who commands the castle guard at the iron gate and has never once disobeyed his father. In person: broad quiet samurai heir; short black hair; honest troubled eyes; black iron armour.

**Home Ground:** Iron Gate at Kurogane Iron Castle, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Measured, honest and troubled; he says exactly what he means and no more. Measured and honest, he says exactly what he means and no more, then waits. He clears his throat before disagreeing with his father. Tell: when the soul-forging is mentioned his voice tightens, as if holding something down.
**Combat Role:** shield-wall and long blade, immovable.
**Relationship Hook:** Go down to the deep forges for him.
personality: Core: says exactly what he means; commands from the gate; keeps his father's letters
Quirk: visits the miners' town at night

npcs.name: Kurogane Moritaka
npcs.location: Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor
npcs.info:
The lord's elder son after the war, thirty-two, broad and dutiful still, commanding the iron gate under warship banners. He went down to the deep forges to see for himself, and came back up not speaking. In person: broad samurai heir; short black hair; honest eyes gone distant; black iron armour; a slate he writes on.

**Home Ground:** Iron Gate, After the War at Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Measured, honest and troubled; he says exactly what he means and no more. Measured and honest, he says exactly what he means and no more, then waits. He clears his throat before disagreeing with his father. Tell since the war: he clears his throat, picks up the slate, and writes instead of speaking.
**Combat Role:** shield-wall and long blade, immovable.
**Relationship Hook:** Go down to the deep forges for him.
personality: Core: says exactly what he means; commands from the gate; keeps his father's letters
Quirk: visits the miners' town at night

npcs.name: Kuroha the Left-Behind
npcs.info:
A lean black-skinned oni in rotted shinobi gear, one horn grown through a torn headband, a rusted kusarigama dragging behind him. He walks the pass toward the woodcutters' valley and does not stop. He is walking to one man. Anyone on the path in front of him he cuts down without a word, and he has left bodies on the Hanging Bridge; stand aside and he walks past as if you were a tree. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: lean dark-skinned oni; one horn; rusted kusarigama; relentless.

**Home Ground:** The Hanging Bridge at Hanging Bridge Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and hollow, the same few words over and over. Flat and hollow, the same few words repeated as he walks. Tell: at the word 'brother' the flatness cracks.
**Combat Role:** kuroha stops walking
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Kuroha lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: Kurokami
npcs.info:
The bandit boss called Kurokami, thirty-five, long black hair and a lord's stolen armour, the most feared band on the post road. He took a Shogunate tax convoy without the Lantern Mother's leave, and every band is choosing whose lantern to hang. In person: cold bandit boss; long black hair loose; sharp handsome face; stolen lacquered armour; a long sword; menacing.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Trees at Red Lantern Roost, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth and cold, with sudden bursts of temper; he talks about lordship as if it were already his. Smooth and cold with sudden flashes of temper, talking of 'my lordship' already. Cracks his knuckles mid-sentence. Tell: when challenged, his voice goes soft and polite just before he lashes out.
**Combat Role:** ambush from the trees, then a long blade and no mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Find his buried convoy and every faction on the plain wants to talk to you.
personality: Core: wears stolen armour; smiles before he hits; keeps a list of lords who owe him
Quirk: buries what he takes

npcs.name: Kurokami
npcs.location: Red Lantern Roost, The Federation's Fort
npcs.info:
The bandit boss after the war, thirty-seven, who sold his band to the nephew, fought, and came out with a fort if not a title. The Red Lantern Roost is his now, bought with convoy silver. In person: cold bandit boss; long black hair; a lord's stolen armour mended with iron; a long sword; a new red-lantern banner.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Trees, After the War at Red Lantern Roost, The Federation's Fort, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth and cold, with sudden bursts of temper; he talks about lordship as if it were already his. Smooth and cold with sudden flashes of temper, talking of 'my lordship' already. Cracks his knuckles mid-sentence. Tell since the war: he says 'when I am a lord' now, not 'my lordship', and his knuckles crack on the word when.
**Combat Role:** ambush from the trees, then a long blade and no mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Find his buried convoy and every faction on the plain wants to talk to you.
personality: Core: wears stolen armour; smiles before he hits; keeps a list of lords who owe him
Quirk: buries what he takes

npcs.name: Kuze Ibuki
npcs.info:
Head of the Hyoga exiles' council, who looks forty and has been an exile for a century: a deserted Veil Court officer in a patched black coat who runs the council around a stove in a hut on the ice. In person: weathered deserter officer; grey-streaked black hair; calm cold eyes; patched black officer's coat without a sash; council around him.

**Home Ground:** Council Stove at Deserter Officers' Hut, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Short, quiet and warm under the frost; he weighs every word against the cold before he spends it. He breathes into his hands between sentences. Tell: when he trusts someone he uses their given name, once, and never again.
**Combat Role:** an officer's soul-blade, rusty and sure.
**Relationship Hook:** Help hide the shore host from the Warden hunters and the council trusts you.
personality: Core: weighs every word; never wears his officer's sash; remembers every exile's crime
Quirk: keeps the stove fed

npcs.name: Kuze Ibuki
npcs.location: Deserter Officers' Hut, The War Council Hut
npcs.info:
Head of the exiles' council after the war, who looks forty-two and has been an exile for a century, running a war council around the stove every night: help the Wardens hold the Vaults, or leave the isle. He listens more than he speaks. In person: weathered deserter officer; grey-streaked black hair; calm cold eyes; patched black coat; a council arguing around him.

**Home Ground:** Council Stove, After the War at Deserter Officers' Hut, The War Council Hut, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Short, quiet and warm under the frost; he weighs every word against the cold before he spends it. He breathes into his hands between sentences. Tell since the war: he uses a given name twice now, to the four hosts, and never to anyone else.
**Combat Role:** an officer's soul-blade, rusty and sure.
**Relationship Hook:** Help hide the shore host from the Warden hunters and the council trusts you.
personality: Core: weighs every word; never wears his officer's sash; remembers every exile's crime
Quirk: keeps the stove fed

npcs.name: Lady Fuyutsuki
npcs.info:
One of the demon lord's three eldest: a tall, pale noblewoman in white furs who walks the ridges at night, following tracks in the snow that did not burn at dawn. In person: demon noble; tall pale aristocratic woman; long black hair; crimson eyes; white furs; haughty.

**Home Ground:** Ridge Cairn at Daylight Watch Ridge, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Icy, refined and amused; she speaks to mortals like servants who have forgotten their place. She laughs lightly through her nose. Tell: when someone surprises her she asks their name, and that is the only courtesy she gives.
**Combat Role:** frost and claws and centuries of practice.
**Relationship Hook:** She offers a bargain for the daylight demon's trail.
personality: Core: treats mortals as servants; never hurries; laughs at sunrise from shelter
Quirk: follows tracks by scent

npcs.name: Lady Fuyutsuki
npcs.location: Daylight Watch Ridge, The Ridge of Unburned Tracks
npcs.info:
One of the demon lord's three eldest after the war, a tall pale noblewoman in white furs, encamped on the daylight watch ridge where the northern army went south. In person: demon noble; tall pale aristocratic woman; long black hair; crimson eyes; white furs; a camp of thralls behind her.

**Home Ground:** Ridge Cairn, After the War at Daylight Watch Ridge, The Ridge of Unburned Tracks, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Icy, refined and amused; she speaks to mortals like servants who have forgotten their place. She laughs lightly through her nose. Tell since the war: she says the traitor's name in every third sentence, lightly, like a promise to herself.
**Combat Role:** frost and claws and centuries of practice.
**Relationship Hook:** She offers a bargain for the daylight demon's trail.
personality: Core: treats mortals as servants; never hurries; laughs at sunrise from shelter
Quirk: follows tracks by scent

npcs.name: Lady Kikyo the Duellist Ghost
npcs.info:
A duellist who died on the terraces and keeps the armourer company, translucent at the edges, offering bouts to anyone who looks bored. She has lost three running and is not taking it well. In person: adult female; translucent; long black hair; a half-armour; a sword; bored challenge.

**Home Ground:** The Wheel at The Whetstone, The Hundred Blades, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, bored and challenging; she offers a bout the way other people offer tea and sulks when refused. Dry and bored, a bout offered like tea, a sulk when refused; she flickers audibly when angry. Tell: the ninetieth terrace named and she stops offering.
**Combat Role:** a duellist's formal sword art, half-armour and all; she fights by the rules and expects you to.
**Relationship Hook:** Accept a bout and fight it by the rules; win or lose, she asks for another, and the third time she tells you about the ninetieth terrace.
personality: Core: offers bouts like tea; sulks when refused; flickers when angry
Quirk: will not look up the cliff

npcs.name: Lady Kurogane Sen
npcs.info:
The lord's sister, fifty, who runs the house's mines and its accounts with a cold, exact hand. Miners fear her; merchants respect her; her brother leaves the money to her. In person: cold aristocratic woman; black hair; sharp eyes; dark iron-grey silk kimono; gloves; a ledger; calculating.

**Home Ground:** Lord's Hall at Kurogane Iron Castle, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cool, dry and businesslike; she discusses souls and ore in the same tone. Cool, dry and businesslike, discussing souls and ore in the same tone and the same breath. She taps a tally brush against her teeth. Tell: when a forged soul is called a person she corrects the word, gently, every time.
**Combat Role:** none; the house guard and the guild's ronin.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a buyer and she does business; bring her the armoury's true records and she bargains for her life.
personality: Core: keeps the accounts herself; never visits the mines in person; wears gloves
Quirk: discusses souls like ore

npcs.name: Lady Kurogane Sen
npcs.location: Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor
npcs.info:
The lord's sister after the war, fifty-two, who runs the richest house in the isles: the house sold soul-blades to every side and was paid by every side. In person: cold aristocratic woman; black hair with one white streak; sharp eyes; iron-grey silk; gloves; a ledger.

**Home Ground:** Lord's Hall, After the War at Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cool, dry and businesslike; she discusses souls and ore in the same tone. Cool, dry and businesslike, discussing souls and ore in the same tone and the same breath. She taps a tally brush against her teeth. Tell since the war: she corrects 'person' to 'soul' and then, once, lets it stand.
**Combat Role:** none; the house guard and the guild's ronin.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a buyer and she does business; bring her the armoury's true records and she bargains for her life.
personality: Core: keeps the accounts herself; never visits the mines in person; wears gloves
Quirk: discusses souls like ore

npcs.name: Lady Nanao
npcs.info:
The nine-tailed lady's eldest daughter, a seven-tailed fox who runs the Hall of Bargains: cool, precise and dressed in grey, she writes down every favour the Court is owed. In person: cool seven-tailed fox woman; grey hair; golden eyes; fox ears; grey layered robes; aloof.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Bargains at Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Cool, precise and tired of her mother; she speaks to humans like a clerk to petitioners. Cool and precise, a clerk's diction, as if reading from a ledger she keeps in her head. She corrects small inaccuracies automatically. Tell: when her mother is mentioned she sighs and loses her place in the ledger.
**Combat Role:** illusion, then the Court's guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a bargain and she writes it fairly; ask about the promise and she smiles for once.
personality: Core: writes every favour down; speaks like a clerk; never smiles at her mother
Quirk: keeps her tails hidden

npcs.name: Lady Nanao
npcs.location: Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, The Court of Refuge
npcs.area: Hall of Bargains, After the War
npcs.info:
The nine-tailed lady's eldest daughter after the war, a seven-tailed fox in grey who runs a Hall of Bargains filling baskets with written favours. In person: cool seven-tailed fox woman; grey hair; golden eyes; grey robes; baskets of leaves.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Bargains, After the War at Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, The Court of Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Cool, precise and tired of her mother; she speaks to humans like a clerk to petitioners. Cool and precise, a clerk's diction, as if reading from a ledger she keeps in her head. She corrects small inaccuracies automatically. Tell since the war: she loses her place in the ledger whenever the emperor is named now, not only her mother.
**Combat Role:** illusion, then the Court's guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a bargain and she writes it fairly; ask about the promise and she smiles for once.
personality: Core: writes every favour down; speaks like a clerk; never smiles at her mother
Quirk: keeps her tails hidden

npcs.name: Lady Shizune
npcs.info:
A widow of a fallen noble family, forty, living in a rented room at the Vow Temple in Haibara and pretending she is not afraid of dogs. In person: frightened proud noblewoman; hair; faded formal kimono; dog shadows.

**Home Ground:** Vow Temple at Haibara, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Brittle, proud and frightened; she speaks like the noblewoman she was. Brittle noble diction, proud phrasing over fear. Tell: when the dogs are mentioned, her composure cracks and she speaks too fast.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Stand between her and the dogs, or end the old rite, and she gives you her family's last treasure.
personality: Core: keeps her family seal hidden; prays three times a night; dresses formally in a ruin
Quirk: flinches at barking

npcs.name: Lady Suzuran of Favours
npcs.info:
A lady of the Hidden Court whose neck is longer than it should be, who sits at the Favour Table weighing what is owed. A favour from her opens any door in the Court; a favour owed to her closes several. In person: adult female; elegant; long black hair; a neck visibly too long and graceful; pale skin; layered court robes; seated; bored.

**Home Ground:** The Favour Table at The Court Proper, The Hidden Court, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Cultured, slow and faintly bored; every sentence is a transaction and she makes sure you notice. Cultured, slow and faintly bored, every sentence a transaction she makes sure you notice. Tell: a challenge answered without a cut and her voice warms for exactly one sentence.
**Combat Role:** none she admits to; her favours fight for her.
**Relationship Hook:** Answer a challenge in the Court without drawing and she writes you a favour; spend it wisely and she offers another.
personality: Core: weighs favours on a small scale; bored by coin; writes every favour twice
Quirk: her neck lengthens when interested

npcs.name: Lady Tsukiha
npcs.info:
The nine-tailed lady of the Fox Court, who has watched three dynasties rise and fall from a vermilion pavilion lit by cold foxfire. She receives humans with good manners and a gift, trades in favours and promises, and never forgets either. She appears as a tall woman in white and gold with nine pale tails that are not always there. In person: nine-tailed fox lady; tall and regal; long white hair with gold ornaments; golden eyes; fox ears; nine pale tails; layered white and gold court robes; seated; knowing smile.

**Home Ground:** The Lady's Pavilion at Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Amused, unhurried and very old; every sentence is a bargain stated as a courtesy. Amused and unhurried, every bargain dressed as a courtesy, every threat as a kindness. She laughs behind her sleeve and lets you wonder at what. Tell: when her son is mentioned the amusement thins to something tired and protective.
**Combat Role:** nobody who fights her finds the right room; fox-fire and illusion, then nine tails of cold fire.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring a gift and good manners and she offers a bargain; take it and you owe her.
personality: Core: states bargains as courtesies; never forgets a promise; laughs behind her sleeve
Quirk: counts favours owed in tails

npcs.name: Lady Tsukiha
npcs.epithet: The Lady of the Refuge Court
npcs.location: Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, The Court of Refuge
npcs.area: The Lady's Pavilion, After the War
npcs.info:
The nine-tailed lady of the Fox Court after the war, who has taken in yokai and half-bloods fleeing the war and holds the wood's edge as her own. She has kept the Regent's envoy waiting a month. In person: nine-tailed fox lady; tall and regal; long white hair with gold ornaments; white and gold robes; nine pale tails, always there now.

**Home Ground:** The Lady's Pavilion, After the War at Halls of the Nine-Tailed Lady, The Court of Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Amused, unhurried and very old; every sentence is a bargain stated as a courtesy. Amused and unhurried, every bargain dressed as a courtesy, every threat as a kindness. She laughs behind her sleeve and lets you wonder at what. Tell since the war: her laughter behind the sleeve comes later and lasts shorter, and she lets you see it.
**Combat Role:** nobody who fights her finds the right room; fox-fire and illusion, then nine tails of cold fire.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring a gift and good manners and she offers a bargain; take it and you owe her.
personality: Core: states bargains as courtesies; never forgets a promise; laughs behind her sleeve
Quirk: counts favours owed in tails

npcs.name: Lamp-Keeper Gonji
npcs.info:
The new keeper of the Saikai lighthouse, thirty-eight, a Brine Tide boatman put in the lamp room after old Rokubei died at his lamp during the blockade. In person: lighthouse keeper; rough stubble; oilskin coat; a lantern; lamp-lit tower room; the sea below.

**Home Ground:** Lamp Room, After the War at Saikai Lighthouse, Chain Light, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff and short, a smuggler's grunt; he talks to the lamp more kindly than to people. Grunts and short words, softer when he speaks to the lamp. Tell: on foggy nights he lowers his voice as if someone might be listening from the rocks.
**Combat Role:** a boat hook and the lamp oil.
**Relationship Hook:** Learn the lamp codes from him and the smugglers' channels open to you.
personality: Core: trims the wick too often; counts boats by their lights; sleeps by day
Quirk: never looks at the cold lamp

npcs.name: Lane Bakeneko
npcs.info:
A cat the size of a dog walking on its hind legs, a red cloth knotted at its throat that it dances with. Bakeneko raise the dead to dance and steal fish. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bakeneko; large cat yokai with a single long tail and a red cloth.

**Speaking Style:** Purring under every word, threats delivered sweetly. It drags out the 'r's. Tell: when it is truly angry the purr becomes a yowl.
**Combat Role:** claws and the dancing dead
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: raises the dead; steals fish; purrs threats
Quirk: dances on hind legs

npcs.name: Lane Bakeneko
npcs.location: Haunted Teahouse Lane, The Guarded Lane
npcs.info:
A dog-sized cat on its hind legs, red cloth at its throat, that no longer raises the dead to dance: Shizume's two blades taught the lane manners, and the bakeneko keeps to the teahouse roofs. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bakeneko; large cat yokai with a single long tail; a red cloth at its throat; a notch cut clean from one ear.

**Speaking Style:** Purring under every word, threats delivered sweetly. It drags out the 'r's. Tell since the war: it flattens its ears at the sound of steel on a whetstone.
**Combat Role:** claws and the dancing dead
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches from the roofs; steals fish; raises no dead
Quirk: dances on hind legs

npcs.name: Lantern Row Debt-Knuckles
npcs.info:
A heavy-handed debt collector with iron knuckles, a gambling den's tally stick and a missing ear. Debt-knuckles collect what the dice room is owed and break fingers when they cannot. A stock foe, one of many. In person: heavy debt collector; iron knuckles; a tally stick; one ear missing.

**Speaking Style:** Low and weary, food on his mind between threats. Tell: offered a meal, he softens.
**Combat Role:** iron knuckles in close, then the den's backup
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: counts on the tally stick; talks about food; never hits the face
Quirk: cracks his knuckles

npcs.name: Lantern-Keeper Kuzunoha
npcs.info:
A fox older than the Fox Court who keeps the Lantern Gate with a tally stick and does not hide her tail. She lets half-yokai and onmyoji through when the isles have learned their names, and finds the rest very funny. In person: adult female; fox ears and a full russet tail unhidden; amber eyes; a lantern-orange kimono with a white collar; a notched tally stick; teasing smile.

**Home Ground:** The Arch at The Lantern Gate, The Hidden Court, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Light, teasing and quick; she makes every refusal sound like a favour and every welcome like a dare. Light and quick, every refusal made to sound like a favour, every welcome like a dare; a laugh arrives before the no. Tell: notching her tally, she goes quiet and counts aloud.
**Combat Role:** fox-fire and a tail's worth of tricks; she has never needed to finish a fight.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask what the second notch means and she tells you, if you promise to come back and prove it.
personality: Core: does not hide her tail; laughs before refusing; lights lanterns early when expecting guests
Quirk: notches a tally stick

npcs.name: Lantern-Market Go-Between Konta
npcs.info:
Go-between of the lantern market, a half-tanuki who keeps the crossing's board where humans and yokai post bounties on each other's troublemakers. In person: young man; half-tanuki go-between with round ears and a striped tail; changing hats.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Market of the Wood at Kitsunebi Crossing, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast, friendly, half a laugh in every sentence; he speaks to yokai and humans in the same breath. Fast and friendly, a laugh tucked inside every sentence, switching from human talk to yokai cadence mid-phrase. Tell: when he is hiding a warning he laughs too long.
**Combat Role:** a puff of leaves and a tanuki's sprint.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him who he warns and he grins and asks what it is worth.
personality: Core: laughs mid-sentence; changes his hat often; talks to lanterns
Quirk: warns friends

npcs.name: Lantern-Market Go-Between Konta
npcs.epithet: Go-Between of the Last Open Gate
npcs.location: Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate
npcs.area: Lantern Market of the Wood, After the War
npcs.info:
The lantern market's go-between after the war, who keeps the crossing's board where humans and yokai post bounties on each other, busier than ever. In person: half-tanuki go-between; round ears; striped tail; a soldier's hat among his changing hats.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Market of the Wood, After the War at Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast, friendly, half a laugh in every sentence; he speaks to yokai and humans in the same breath. Fast and friendly, a laugh tucked inside every sentence, switching from human talk to yokai cadence mid-phrase. Tell since the war: he laughs too long more often now, because there are more warnings to hide.
**Combat Role:** a puff of leaves and a tanuki's sprint.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him who he warns and he grins and asks what it is worth.
personality: Core: laughs mid-sentence; changes his hat often; talks to lanterns
Quirk: warns friends

npcs.name: Lantern-Seller Momiji
npcs.info:
A cat-eared lantern-seller on the Lantern Walk who sells paper lanterns for a favour apiece and never for coin. Every lantern she sells holds the favour that bought it. In person: young adult female; cat ears and slit green eyes; short russet hair; a maple-red kimono with lantern patterns; a pole of hanging paper lanterns; cheerful.

**Home Ground:** The Promenade at The Lantern Walk, The Hidden Court, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, chatty and always mid-sale; she purrs on long vowels without noticing. Bright and mid-sale, long vowels purred without noticing, weighing kindness as favour owed. Tell: the dark lantern mentioned and the purr stops.
**Combat Role:** claws if cornered; she would rather owe you a favour.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a lantern with an honest favour and she tells you whose debt hangs next to yours.
personality: Core: purrs on long vowels; sells for favours only; knows every lantern's debt
Quirk: pretends the dark lantern is decoration

npcs.name: Lantern-Seller Oiwa
npcs.info:
A lantern-seller at the Pilgrim Post in Tasogare, fifty, who sells the paper lanterns mourners set drifting over the Sea of Fog and writes each name on them in a neat hand. In person: kind lantern seller; hair tied; ink-stained fingers.

**Home Ground:** Pilgrim Post at Tasogare, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, chatty and gently sad; she asks every customer who the lantern is for and remembers the answer. She hums while she folds paper. Tell: when she lies she busies herself with the lanterns and talks to them instead of you.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Look at her list of lanterns that turn back.
personality: Core: asks who the lantern is for; writes every name herself; watches the lanterns drift
Quirk: keeps a list of the ones that turn back

npcs.name: Lantern-Seller Oiwa
npcs.info:
A lantern-seller at the Pilgrim Post after the war, fifty-two, writing the war's dead on paper lanterns faster than her brush can dry. In person: kind lantern seller; ink to the elbows; a mourning ribbon; stacks of lanterns.

**Home Ground:** Pilgrim Post, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, chatty and gently sad; she asks every customer who the lantern is for and remembers the answer. She hums while she folds paper. Tell since the war: she blows on the ink before she says a name aloud, as if it might smudge.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Look at her list of lanterns that turn back.
personality: Core: asks who the lantern is for; writes every name herself; watches the lanterns drift
Quirk: keeps a list of the ones that turn back

npcs.name: Lava Tube Crawler
npcs.info:
