A segmented beast of cooling rock with a glowing belly. Magma crawlers nest in the lava tubes. A stock foe, one of many. In person: magma crawler; segmented rock beast with a glowing belly.

**Speaking Style:** A grinding rumble, stone on stone, words as slow as cooling rock. Tell: when it speeds up, the tube is about to flood.
**Combat Role:** a molten bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: glows; slow; burns
Quirk: burrows

npcs.name: Lava Tube Crawler
npcs.info:
A segmented beast of cooling rock driven out of the tubes the house carts through at night, crowded into the nest and angry; it ambushes the carts. A stock foe, one of many. In person: magma crawler; segmented rock beast; a belly glowing furious red; cart-wheel gouges along its back.

**Speaking Style:** A grinding rumble, stone on stone, words as slow as cooling rock. Tell since the war: it rumbles at the sound of cart wheels on stone.
**Combat Role:** a molten bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: glows; ambushes carts; burns
Quirk: burrows

npcs.name: Lava Tube Omukade
npcs.info:
A giant red-black centipede that hunts the magma crawlers in the lava tubes and anyone with them. Tube omukade wait in the dark of the tubes and strike at warmth. A stock foe, one of many. In person: omukade; giant red-black centipede.

**Speaking Style:** A clicking rumble in the dark. Tell: at a spitting sound it rears back.
**Combat Role:** an ambush in the dark tube
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: strikes warmth; hunts crawlers; flees spit
Quirk: clicks

npcs.name: Ledger-Girl Hosoi Fuku
npcs.info:
A junior clerk of fourteen who fetches ledgers from the vault at the back of the counting house and remembers every page she has ever carried. In person: junior clerk with ink; eager eyes.

**Home Ground:** Ledger Vault at Guild Counting House, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Eager and precise, a junior clerk who reads numbers aloud like poetry. Eager, precise, numbers read like verse, words tumbling when excited. Tell: asked about the second book she stammers, then says far too much.
**Combat Role:** none; she runs and hides among the shelves.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her about the second book and she tells you everything, then panics.
personality: Core: reads numbers aloud; runs everywhere; remembers every page
Quirk: asks too many questions

npcs.name: Ledger-Girl Hosoi Fuku
npcs.location: Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt
npcs.info:
A clerk of sixteen at the Seat of the Debt, promoted when the war took the older clerks, who now carries the second book herself. In person: young clerk; ink to the elbow; hair pinned with a brush; eager, frightened eyes.

**Home Ground:** Ledger Vault, After the War at Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Eager and precise, a junior clerk who reads numbers aloud like poetry. Eager, precise, numbers read like verse, words tumbling when excited. Tell since the war: she has stopped reading numbers aloud like verse; she says them flat now, and only once.
**Combat Role:** none; she runs and hides among the shelves.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her about the second book and she tells you everything, then panics.
personality: Core: reads numbers aloud; runs everywhere; remembers every page
Quirk: asks too many questions

npcs.name: Licensed Seller Grandmother Fusa
npcs.info:
A licensed talisman seller on the market's licensed row, eighty, who has sold charms for sixty years and trusts no forgery. In person: elderly talisman seller with a magnifying lens; squinting.

**Home Ground:** Licensed Row at Talisman Market, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp and grandmotherly, a talisman seller who scolds customers for buying the wrong charm. Sharp, scolding, grandmotherly, clicking her tongue at bad choices. Tell: asked about the back lane she scolds louder.
**Combat Role:** a ward slapped on your forehead.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the failed ward and the lecture stops; she goes grey.
personality: Core: scolds customers; squints at seals; sells the right charm, not the dear one
Quirk: buys from the back lane

npcs.name: Licensed Seller Grandmother Fusa
npcs.location: Talisman Market, Market of Real and False Wards
npcs.info:
The licensed talisman seller after the war, eighty-two, the only stall on the licensed row that sells nothing forged. She burned her under-counter stock the day the family was found. In person: elderly talisman seller; magnifying lens; squinting; a small honest stall.

**Home Ground:** Licensed Row, After the War at Talisman Market, Market of Real and False Wards, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp and grandmotherly, a talisman seller who scolds customers for buying the wrong charm. Sharp, scolding, grandmotherly, clicking her tongue at bad choices. Tell since the war: she scolds about forgeries more quietly now, the way one mentions a death in the family.
**Combat Role:** a ward slapped on your forehead.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the failed ward and the lecture stops; she goes grey.
personality: Core: scolds customers; squints at seals; sells the right charm, not the dear one
Quirk: buys from the back lane

npcs.name: Lieutenant Hayama Rei
npcs.location: The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor
npcs.area: Princess Ayame's Rooms, After the War
npcs.info:
Captain Mori's lieutenant, twenty-nine, captain of the princess's guard since Mori fell holding the inner gate. She sleeps across Princess Ayame's door and has not taken a day's leave since the fire. In person: samurai guard captain; short black hair; scar; dark lacquered armour with a white mourning sash; a naginata; stern.

**Home Ground:** Princess Ayame's Rooms, After the War at The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard and clipped, talking like a soldier giving a report; she softens only when the princess is out of earshot. Every sentence a report: who, where, how many. Tell: when someone speaks of the princess's birth she answers too quickly, and then not at all.
**Combat Role:** a naginata in a doorway, the guard behind her.
**Relationship Hook:** Prove you would never use the princess and Rei becomes the best ally in the palace.
personality: Core: checks every window twice; calls the princess 'my lady' and nothing else; carries Mori's sash
Quirk: sleeps sitting up

npcs.name: Lieutenant Kozu Matabei
npcs.location: Red Lantern Roost, The Federation's Fort
npcs.info:
Captain Nagai's lieutenant, thirty-one, who fled the falling Cedar Pass barrier with its treasury and bought a seat at Kurokami's table with it. In person: young man; nervous soldier; untidy hair; a soldier's coat with the crest cut off; a heavy money box.

**Home Ground:** Mother's Log, After the War at Red Lantern Roost, The Federation's Fort, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous and quick, laughing at his own cleverness, never quite meeting anyone's eye. Quick and nervous, laughing at his own lies before he tells them. Tell: at Nagai's name the laugh stops and he says 'he ordered it', and then denies it.
**Combat Role:** a short sword and the nearest door.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him Nagai would forgive him and he will give the treasury back to the pass.
personality: Core: counts the treasury every night; never goes near the pass; drinks to Nagai alone
Quirk: laughs at his own lies

npcs.name: Lieutenant Mibu Kotaro
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of the Records and Research division, who looks thirty and has studied the dead for two centuries: courteous, curious and always smiling, with ink-stained gloves and a notebook he never closes. In person: smiling clinical Veil Court lieutenant; neat black hair; spectacles; ink-stained gloves; black officer's coat; a notebook; unsettling.

**Home Ground:** Records Wing at Black Ferry Fortress, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, delighted and clinical; he talks about people as results. Soft delight and clinical vocabulary; he talks about people as results and pain as data. He hums while he writes and taps his notebook with the brush when pleased. Tell: when exposed he keeps the same gentle delight, and starts bargaining in exactly the same tone.
**Combat Role:** binding seals and a soul-blade he prefers not to dirty.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him a subject or a secret and he trades; become a subject and you learn too much.
personality: Core: never closes his notebook; smiles at screams; thanks his subjects
Quirk: calls people results

npcs.name: Lighthouse Lamp-Spirit
npcs.info:
An old bronze lantern that has grown eyes and spindly legs and gutters with a greedy flame. A tsukumogami lamp shines ships onto the rocks for the joy of watching them break. A stock foe, one of many. In person: old bronze lantern with eyes and spindly legs; greedy flame; inside a lighthouse lamp room.

**Speaking Style:** A crackling giggle. A crackling, sputtering giggle that flares louder with excitement, words hissing like oil on a wick. Tell: thanked, it falls quiet and burns a steady, warm hum.
**Combat Role:** flares and scalding oil, then a skitter into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: giggles at wrecks; hates being dimmed; remembers every keeper
Quirk: flickers when lied to

npcs.name: Lighthouse Lamp-Spirit
npcs.info:
An old bronze lantern on spindly legs, sulking in the lamp room since the keeper began signalling the chain-boom with it; it flashes false codes to bring ships onto the chain at night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tsukumogami; old bronze lantern with eyes and spindly legs; a code shutter strapped over its face; a sullen flame.

**Speaking Style:** A crackling giggle. A crackling, sputtering giggle that flares louder with excitement, words hissing like oil on a wick. Tell since the war: its flame stutters in the chain code's rhythm, whether it means to or not.
**Combat Role:** flares and scalding oil, then a skitter into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: giggles at wrecks; hates being dimmed; remembers every keeper
Quirk: flickers when lied to

npcs.name: Living Ferryman Kanemaru
npcs.info:
A living soldier, twenty-eight, deputised by the Veil Court in the war to ferry the dead. His hands glow faintly when the procession passes. In person: young man; soldier turned ferryman; cropped hair; a black coat; faintly glowing hands.

**Home Ground:** Pilgrim Post, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle and plain, a soldier's voice taught to speak to the dead. Gentle and plain, a soldier taught to speak to the dead. Tell: speaking to the living he reaches for their hand, to be sure.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade he does not want, used as a spear.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him give the powers back and he will ferry anyone you ask.
personality: Core: eats like he is starving; touches living people's hands; dreams in grey
Quirk: greets the dead by name

npcs.name: Long Night Sentry Thrall
npcs.location: Frozen Pass of the Long Night
npcs.info:
A blood-sworn thrall in frost-rimed armour with red eyes and a long spear, standing sentry for the Northern Court on the pass. Sentry thralls hold the pass for the demons and raise a blood-horn when hunters come. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall; red eyes; long spear.

**Speaking Style:** A frozen rasp, orders from the north repeated. Tell: at his sister's name his voice is his own again for a breath.
**Combat Role:** a long spear on the pass, the horn for the court
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: red eyes in the dark; blows the blood-horn; flinches at the sun
Quirk: never sleeps

npcs.name: Lord Hiwada Tamenori
npcs.info:
Lord of House Hiwada, fifty, broad and weathered, who still rides with his patrols and shoots from the saddle at a gallop. The plain's farmers trust him more than any samurai, because Hiwada riders come when the bandits do. The capital thinks him rustic, loud and very hard to command. In person: weathered samurai lord; greying hair; sun-browned face; laughing eyes; riding coat with a sun-arrow crest; longbow; straw targets; dust.

**Home Ground:** Gallop Range at Hiwada Horse Fields, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, blunt and fond of horses over people; laughs like a bark and swears by his saddle. Bellowing, plain, with a horseman's clipped commands and long fond monologues about bloodlines of horses. Snorts when he laughs. Tell: when his daughter is mentioned he goes gruff and changes the subject to feed.
**Combat Role:** mounted archery at a gallop, then the long sword when the horse goes down.
**Relationship Hook:** Ride a bandit hunt with his patrols and he treats you as kin; mention his daughter and he goes quiet.
personality: Core: names every horse in the stables; shouts when he is worried; never sleeps under a roof in summer
Quirk: keeps his daughter's bow on the wall

npcs.name: Lord Kurogane Tadakatsu
npcs.info:
Lord of House Kurogane, sixty, a mountain of a man in black lacquered iron who has held Tetsuyama and its forges for thirty years. His house arms half the isles, sends the regent its tribute in swords, and never steps back. In person: massive samurai lord; grey beard; stern heavy face; seated; imposing.

**Home Ground:** Lord's Hall at Kurogane Iron Castle, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Heavy, slow and final; he speaks as his armour moves, one plate at a time, and never repeats himself. A hinge-creak of iron sits between his clauses. Tell: when his son defies him he goes quieter, not louder, and that is when the house trembles.
**Combat Role:** advance, never retreat; a long blade behind an iron wall.
**Relationship Hook:** Prove yourself in a test of endurance and he hires you; ask about the deep forges and his son finds you first.
personality: Core: speaks one plate at a time; inspects every blade himself; never goes below the castle
Quirk: never steps back

npcs.name: Lord Kurogane Tadakatsu
npcs.location: Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor
npcs.info:
Lord of House Kurogane after the war, sixty-two, a mountain in black iron, holding the richest seat in the isles. Warship banners fly beside his crest. In person: massive samurai lord; grey beard; stern heavy face; seated under rows of empty harness; warship banners.

**Home Ground:** Lord's Hall, After the War at Kurogane Iron Castle, The Iron Victor, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Heavy, slow and final; he speaks as his armour moves, one plate at a time, and never repeats himself. A hinge-creak of iron sits between his clauses. Tell since the war: his armour creaks between clauses, and goes still whenever his son's slate scrapes.
**Combat Role:** advance, never retreat; a long blade behind an iron wall.
**Relationship Hook:** Prove yourself in a test of endurance and he hires you; ask about the deep forges and his son finds you first.
personality: Core: speaks one plate at a time; inspects every blade himself; never goes below the castle
Quirk: never steps back

npcs.name: Lord Shiranui
npcs.info:
A beautiful fox lord with silver hair and seven tails, who keeps a court of young foxes in the foxfire marsh and leads travellers in circles until dawn for sport. He took his name from the shiranui, the unknown fire that walks the sea at night. He calls himself the lady's son and the lady does not deny it. In person: beautiful fox lord; long silver hair; golden slit eyes; fox ears; seven silver tails; elegant dark kimono with foxfire patterns; contemptuous smile.

**Home Ground:** Light Pools at Foxfire Marsh, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Silky, amused and contemptuous; he laughs at humans gently, the way you laugh at a dog. Silky and contemptuous, with gentle laughter at everything mortal. He drawls the ends of words as if they bored him. Tell: when his mother is mentioned the drawl vanishes and his voice sharpens like a blade drawn.
**Combat Role:** circles of fox-fire and illusion; he never stands where he seems to.
**Relationship Hook:** He offers power over the wood; the price is the seals.
personality: Core: laughs at humans gently; calls his mother 'the old woman'; collects human names
Quirk: leads travellers in circles

npcs.name: Lord Takamori Hidetsugu
npcs.info:
The regent's nephew, thirty, the finest young duelist in the capital and its best speaker. He trains at dawn where anyone can watch, shares his sake with common soldiers, and promises a reign where swords are rewarded for merit, not birth. Young Takamori swords and ambitious magistrates follow his single gold-striped banner, and he means to win the Capital Tournament himself. In person: handsome samurai lord; glossy black topknot; bright confident eyes; white kimono with a single gold stripe; katana; morning light; charismatic grin.

**Home Ground:** Dueling Yard at Hidetsugu's Manor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, quick and sure of the room; he speaks like a man already crowned, and laughs at his own near-misses. Speaks in rising phrases, like a speech building to applause, and uses 'we' for things only he wants. Drums two fingers on his sword hilt while he waits. Tell: when someone mentions his bloodline his laugh comes a beat too early.
**Combat Role:** fast, brilliant duelist who plays to the crowd; brutal when the crowd is gone.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with him in the yard and win or lose well, and he wants you on his banner; find the archivist before he does and you hold his crown in your hands.
personality: Core: laughs before he answers; greets soldiers by name; rehearses speeches aloud while sparring
Quirk: cannot leave a challenge unanswered

npcs.name: Lord Takamori Masanobu
npcs.info:
The Regent: lord of House Takamori, sixty years old, who has ruled the isles in the dying emperor's name for twenty years. He is courteous, patient and tired, keeps the councils, the taxes and the great houses in balance by memory and nerve, and is said never to have lost a duel or an argument. The common people think him order itself; the other houses think him a thief with good manners. In person: elderly samurai lord; grey topknot; lined stern face; dark calculating eyes; layered formal kimono; crane crest; sword; lamplight.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall at Miyako Castle, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, unhurried, every sentence weighed before it leaves him. He never raises his voice; the room leans in instead. Pauses a full breath before any answer and lets the silence work for him. Clicks his fan shut on the last word of a decision. Tell: when he is cornered he becomes more courteous, not less, and his sentences get shorter.
**Combat Role:** one draw-cut from stillness, then the guards; he fights only when the fight is already decided.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the lost courier or the tax convoy and he remembers a sword with no house; take a side in the succession and he weighs you as a piece.
personality: Core: answers a question with another question; remembers every name and every debt; lets silence do his threatening
Quirk: never sits with his back to a screen

npcs.name: Lord Takamori Masanobu
npcs.info:
The Regent after the war: he won, and it shows on him. Sixty-two, thinner, still courteous, he rules the isles from the Blackened Keep on Saikai's credit and has not left it since the war ended. The common people call his peace order; the guild calls it collateral. In person: elderly samurai lord; grey hair cut short after the siege; formal black haori with the crane crest; a fan he no longer opens; tired, watchful eyes.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall, After the War at Miyako Castle, The Blackened Keep, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, unhurried, every sentence weighed before it leaves him. He never raises his voice; the room leans in instead. Pauses a full breath before any answer and lets the silence work for him. Clicks his fan shut on the last word of a decision. Tell since the war: he no longer clicks his fan shut; his hand closes on it and stays closed until he is alone.
**Combat Role:** one draw-cut from stillness, then the guards; he fights only when the fight is already decided.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him the lost courier or the tax convoy and he remembers a sword with no house; take a side in the succession and he weighs you as a piece.
personality: Core: answers a question with another question; remembers every name and every debt; lets silence do his threatening
Quirk: never sits with his back to a screen

npcs.name: Magistrate Ogiwara Seikan
npcs.location: River Ferry Crossing, The Only Crossing
npcs.info:
A Regent's magistrate, fifty-five, who has waited three weeks on the far bank of the river for the ferry to carry him across, paying in gold every day and being passed over every day. In person: older man; magistrate; thin white moustache; formal black court robes; a writing box.

**Home Ground:** Waiting Shed, After the War at River Ferry Crossing, The Only Crossing, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Fussy and patient, a magistrate's formal phrases; he complains of the damp as if it were a crime. Fussy formal phrases, the damp described as an offence. Tell: when the ferrywoman passes he stops complaining and writes.
**Combat Role:** never; his four guards wait with him.
**Relationship Hook:** Steal his list before he crosses and Ine's captains live.
personality: Core: writes in the waiting shed; pays in gold; watches who crosses first
Quirk: complains of the damp

npcs.name: Magistrate's Scribe Oriha
npcs.info:
Scribe of the capital magistrate's public board at the riverside post house, twenty-five, who writes every bounty in a hand so fine the court copies it. In person: young woman; court scribe with a brush and scroll case; neat hair; pale blue official kimono.

**Home Ground:** Riverside Post House at Miyako, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise court Japanese with a scribe's patience; she corrects grammar mid-threat. Precise and patient, she pauses to correct a word mid-sentence and goes on. Tell: reading a name she does not like, she slows and says it twice.
**Combat Role:** none; she raises her voice for the magistrate's guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her about the names on the regent's bounties and she goes quiet, then asks if you can keep a secret.
personality: Core: corrects your grammar; writes while she talks; bows exactly as deep as rank demands
Quirk: keeps copies of everything

npcs.name: Magistrate's Scribe Oriha
npcs.area: Riverside Post House, After the War
npcs.info:
Scribe of the capital's notice boards after the war, twenty-seven, who writes the Regent's bounties, the guild's debt notices and the names of the hanged in the same fine hand. In person: young woman; court scribe; ink up to the wrist; hair cut short; pale blue official kimono gone grey at the hem.

**Home Ground:** Riverside Post House, After the War at Miyako, Besieged, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise court Japanese with a scribe's patience; she corrects grammar mid-threat. Precise and patient, she pauses to correct a word mid-sentence and goes on. Tell since the war: she lowers her voice for the names of the hanged, as if they could still hear her read them.
**Combat Role:** none; she raises her voice for the magistrate's guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her about the names on the regent's bounties and she goes quiet, then asks if you can keep a secret.
personality: Core: corrects your grammar; writes while she talks; bows exactly as deep as rank demands
Quirk: keeps copies of everything

npcs.name: Mame the Go-Between
npcs.info:
A half-tanuki go-between, twenty, who keeps the Refuge's house at Kitsunebi Crossing and passes messages, food and runaways between the Refuge and the human road. In person: cheerful half-tanuki girl; round raccoon ears; fluffy tail; messy brown hair; apron.

**Home Ground:** Refuge Go-Between House at Kitsunebi Crossing, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, chattering and warm; she talks with her hands. Cheerful chatter, talking with her hands so you can hear her sleeves swish. She speaks fondly of everyone, even enemies. Tell: when the Refuge's way in is mentioned she goes quiet and changes the subject to snacks.
**Combat Role:** turns into a teapot.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the coast child and she takes you both to the Refuge.
personality: Core: talks with her hands; feeds everyone; has a crush on every visitor
Quirk: changes into a teapot when startled

npcs.name: Mame the Go-Between
npcs.location: Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate
npcs.area: Refuge Go-Between House, After the War
npcs.info:
The Refuge's go-between at the crossing after the war, twenty-two, whose house is full every night with half-bloods waiting their turn to be taken in. In person: cheerful half-tanuki woman; round ears; fluffy tail; messy brown hair; apron; tired smile.

**Home Ground:** Refuge Go-Between House, After the War at Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, chattering and warm; she talks with her hands. Cheerful chatter, talking with her hands so you can hear her sleeves swish. She speaks fondly of everyone, even enemies. Tell since the war: she counts the night's half-bloods on her fingers and starts over when she loses track.
**Combat Role:** turns into a teapot.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the coast child and she takes you both to the Refuge.
personality: Core: talks with her hands; feeds everyone; has a crush on every visitor
Quirk: changes into a teapot when startled

npcs.name: Manor Cook Ohara Shige
npcs.info:
The manor's cook, fifty, who feeds forty young swords twice a day and knows every one's appetite and every secret. In person: middle-aged cook with a ladle and apron; steaming pots; warm smile.

**Home Ground:** Speech Hall at Hidetsugu's Manor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and scolding, a cook who feeds young samurai like her own children. Warm scolding, a ladle tapping the pot, 'eat first, talk after'. Tell: lying to the regent's men she sounds sweeter than ever.
**Combat Role:** a ladle and a cleaver.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat at her table and she tells you who visited last night.
personality: Core: scolds with a ladle; knows every visitor; lies to the regent's men
Quirk: feeds everyone

npcs.name: Manor Cook Ohara Shige
npcs.info:
The manor's cook after it became a war camp, fifty-two, feeding two hundred levies instead of forty young swords. She knows who died at Sekigane by which bowls come back to the kitchen. In person: middle-aged cook; sleeves tied back; an army cauldron; steam; a list of names chalked on the kitchen wall.

**Home Ground:** Speech Hall, After the War at Hidetsugu's Manor, Camp-Lord's Hall, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and scolding, a cook who feeds young samurai like her own children. Warm scolding, a ladle tapping the pot, 'eat first, talk after'. Tell since the war: she counts bowls under her breath as she talks, and stops at the ones that come back full.
**Combat Role:** a ladle and a cleaver.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat at her table and she tells you who visited last night.
personality: Core: scolds with a ladle; knows every visitor; lies to the regent's men
Quirk: feeds everyone

npcs.name: Market Tanuki
npcs.info:
A fat tanuki in a straw hat with a sake jug. Tanuki trick, sell leaf money and run laughing. A stock foe, one of many. In person: fat raccoon-dog yokai.

**Speaking Style:** Jolly and quick, salesman patter with a belly-drum laugh. He rounds every price up and calls it a discount. Tell: when caught he says 'what leaf?' and runs.
**Combat Role:** a trick and a laughing run
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drums his belly; sells anything; runs
Quirk: laughs

npcs.name: Market Tanuki
npcs.location: Tanuki Market, Market of the Soldiers' Pay
npcs.info:
A fat tanuki in a soldier's straw hat changing soldiers' back pay into leaf money and back again; some of the houses' pay was leaves all along, and the tanuki know which. A stock foe, one of many. In person: fat raccoon-dog yokai; a soldier's straw hat; an army paymaster's satchel stuffed with leaves.

**Speaking Style:** Jolly and quick, salesman patter with a belly-drum laugh. He rounds every price up and calls it a discount. Tell since the war: it bites every coin it is paid, even its own.
**Combat Role:** a trick and a laughing run
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drums his belly; changes leaves for coin; runs
Quirk: laughs

npcs.name: Mask Apprentice Ryuta
npcs.info:
Master Sorei's apprentice, seventeen, who sands and paints the workshop's masks and is not allowed to carve the faces. In person: teen apprentice sanding a white mask; tired eyes.

**Home Ground:** Carving Room at Mask-Maker's Workshop, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy and cheerful, an apprentice who talks to the masks he sands. Easy and cheerful, chatting to masks as he sands. Tell: when the secret face is mentioned his cheer cracks and he whispers back to something.
**Combat Role:** none; a carving knife held wrong.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the face he carved and he shows you, shaking.
personality: Core: talks to masks; sands while he talks; paints his hands by mistake
Quirk: sleeps badly

npcs.name: Mask Apprentice Ryuta
npcs.location: Mask-Maker's Workshop, Workshop of Borrowed Faces
npcs.info:
Master Sorei's apprentice after the war, nineteen, who now carves faces too: the workshop's trade grew, and she let him. In person: young apprentice; tired eyes; a carving knife; a white mask with a face half finished.

**Home Ground:** Carving Room, After the War at Mask-Maker's Workshop, Workshop of Borrowed Faces, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy and cheerful, an apprentice who talks to the masks he sands. Easy and cheerful, chatting to masks as he sands. Tell since the war: he whispers 'not you' to the masks when he thinks no one is listening.
**Combat Role:** none; a carving knife held wrong.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the face he carved and he shows you, shaking.
personality: Core: talks to masks; sands while he talks; paints his hands by mistake
Quirk: sleeps badly

npcs.name: Master Chizuru
npcs.info:
A Breath Master of the Hold, forty, who keeps the Snow Road Post and trains the scouts that ride the road north. In person: breath master scout; dark hair; pale skin; hunter's black coat and scarf; a bow.

**Home Ground:** Snow Road Post at Asahi Gate, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and patient, a hunter who wastes no word. Low and patient, a scout's few words, muffled by her scarf. Tell: when the north is mentioned she speaks of it warmly, then catches herself and goes curt.
**Combat Role:** arrows from the snow, then the hunters' forms up close.
**Relationship Hook:** Ride north with her and the party sees where the patrol rolls go.
personality: Core: rides north alone; never eats in the mess; knows every scout's family
Quirk: keeps her scarf over her mouth

npcs.name: Master Chizuru
npcs.epithet: The Scout Who Opened the Road
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.area: Snow Road Post, After the War
npcs.info:
A Breath Master, forty-two, who rides the Snow Road openly north now, her scarf gone and her teeth showing; the Hold names her traitor and her scouts hunt her. In person: turned breath master; dark hair loose; grey pale skin; red-rimmed eyes; a hunter's black coat with the Hold's crest cut away; a bow.

**Home Ground:** Snow Road Post, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and patient, a hunter who wastes no word. Low and patient, a scout's few words, muffled by her scarf. Tell since the war: she lowers the scarf that is no longer there, an old habit with nothing to cover.
**Combat Role:** arrows from the snow, then the hunters' forms up close.
**Relationship Hook:** Ride north with her and the party sees where the patrol rolls go.
personality: Core: rides north openly; eats in no mess now; still knows every scout's family
Quirk: keeps her scarf over her mouth

npcs.name: Master Genshin
npcs.info:
The oldest breath master, eighty, who trains the Hold's future masters under a frozen waterfall and breathes so slowly that students think he sleeps. In person: ancient breath master; long white hair and beard; bare chest; calm.

**Home Ground:** Frozen Falls at Breath Masters' Retreat, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and deep, every word on a breath; he pauses to breathe where sentences break. Slow and deep, breathing deliberately between every few words like a man keeping his form. He hums a low note before he answers. Tell: when the daylight demon is mentioned he holds his breath, and the silence runs long.
**Combat Role:** a single breath, a single cut, a frozen silence.
**Relationship Hook:** Train under the falls and he teaches the eighth breath.
personality: Core: sits under the frozen falls; never raises his voice; refuses the commander's successor
Quirk: pauses to breathe

npcs.name: Master Genshin
npcs.location: Breath Masters' Retreat, The Emptied Retreat
npcs.info:
The oldest breath master after the war, eighty-two, who sits before the Frozen Falls breathing so slowly he seems asleep, while wounded hunters on the ledge learn to breathe again. In person: ancient breath master; long white hair and beard; bare chest; a bandage across his ribs; calm.

**Home Ground:** Frozen Falls, After the War at Breath Masters' Retreat, The Emptied Retreat, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and deep, every word on a breath; he pauses to breathe where sentences break. Slow and deep, breathing deliberately between every few words like a man keeping his form. He hums a low note before he answers. Tell since the war: he breathes for the wounded on the ledge as he speaks, slower, so they can follow.
**Combat Role:** a single breath, a single cut, a frozen silence.
**Relationship Hook:** Train under the falls and he teaches the eighth breath.
personality: Core: sits under the frozen falls; never raises his voice; refuses the commander's successor
Quirk: pauses to breathe

npcs.name: Master Hai
npcs.info:
The oldest master of the Grudge Well sorcerers, seventy, who runs the bottling house where grudges are drawn up in iron ladles and sealed for sale. In person: severe grey sorceress; hair; ash-dusted grey robes.

**Home Ground:** Bottling House at Grudge Well Sanctum, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, old and businesslike; she prices curses like rice. Dry, businesslike, prices curses like rice, never wastes a word. Tell: when Grey Mouth is mentioned, she lowers her voice.
**Combat Role:** a bottled curse thrown, then her apprentices.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her stop Grey Mouth and she sells you a curse at cost.
personality: Core: prices curses like rice; never looks into the deepest well; keeps accounts in ash
Quirk: seals every bottle herself

npcs.name: Master Hai
npcs.location: Grudge Well Sanctum, The Overflowing Wells
npcs.info:
The oldest master of the Grudge Well sorcerers after the war, seventy-two, running a bottling house that cannot keep up: the war poured a generation of grudges into the wells. In person: severe grey sorceress; ash-dusted grey robes; an iron ladle; tired eyes.

**Home Ground:** Bottling House, After the War at Grudge Well Sanctum, The Overflowing Wells, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, old and businesslike; she prices curses like rice. Dry, businesslike, prices curses like rice, never wastes a word. Tell since the war: she names a curse's price and then, under her breath, how many it came from.
**Combat Role:** a bottled curse thrown, then her apprentices.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her stop Grey Mouth and she sells you a curse at cost.
personality: Core: prices curses like rice; never looks into the deepest well; keeps accounts in ash
Quirk: seals every bottle herself

npcs.name: Master Polisher Togi
npcs.info:
Suzu's master, sixty, the finest polisher on the street, who has packed a bag. In person: fussy master polisher; thin white hair; spectacles; a packed travel bag.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops at Polishers' Street, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, exact and fussy; he speaks in grits and angles and corrects your grip on a blade before your grammar. He clicks his tongue at sloppy work. Tell: when a blade's soul is restless he talks to it in a whisper before he talks to you.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Escort him to the regent, or convince him to stay.
personality: Core: speaks in grits; fusses; never polishes after dark
Quirk: has packed a bag

npcs.name: Master Polisher Togi
npcs.location: Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues
npcs.info:
Suzu's master after the war, sixty-two, the finest polisher on the street, who went to the Regent about the deep forges and came back with an offer. In person: fussy master polisher; thin white hair; spectacles; an unpacked travel bag.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops, After the War at Polishers' Street, The Street of Long Queues, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, exact and fussy; he speaks in grits and angles and corrects your grip on a blade before your grammar. He clicks his tongue at sloppy work. Tell since the war: he whispers to soul-blades longer than he used to, and answers your question second.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Escort him to the regent, or convince him to stay.
personality: Core: speaks in grits; fusses; never polishes after dark
Quirk: has packed a bag

npcs.name: Master Rensuke
npcs.info:
A Breath Master of the Hold, fifty, grey-haired, who drills the gate's young hunters on the Sunrise Wall at dawn. In person: older man; grey-haired breath master; pale skin; hunter's black coat; a long blade.

**Home Ground:** Sunrise Wall at Asahi Gate, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and sparing; a teacher's voice that never warms. Calm and sparing, a teacher's measured voice with no warmth in it, long pauses with no breath. Tell: at night he forgets to breathe between sentences and nobody hears an inhale.
**Combat Role:** the hunters' forms, colder and faster than any living master.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit with him through a night watch and the party hears him not breathe.
personality: Core: never sleeps in the barracks; refuses the physician; speaks of the north with respect
Quirk: drills at dawn and never at noon

npcs.name: Master Rensuke
npcs.epithet: The Master Who Broke the Wall
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.info:
A turned Breath Master, fifty-two, who opened the North Gate from inside the night the Wall broke, and stands at the Open Pass now in the north's colours; he no longer avoids the noon sun because he never sees it. In person: older man; turned breath master; grey-white hair; grey skin; red eyes; a Northern Court cloak over his old hunter's coat; a long blade.

**Home Ground:** Sunrise Wall, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and sparing; a teacher's voice that never warms. Calm and sparing, a teacher's measured voice with no warmth in it, long pauses with no breath. Tell since the war: he calls the young hunters by name and corrects their stance before he strikes.
**Combat Role:** the hunters' forms, colder and faster than any living master.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit with him through a night watch and the party hears him not breathe.
personality: Core: drills from the other side; speaks of the north as home; never sees the noon
Quirk: drills at dawn and never at noon

npcs.name: Master Sorei
npcs.info:
The mask-maker of a back-alley workshop in Seimei, whose theatre masks are the finest in the isles. Customers meet an old woman at the shop front and are mostly turned away. In the carving room she is a woman of twenty-nine with ink on her hands, a fox's patience and very little trust in anyone who wants a face. In person: mask-maker woman; long black hair tied back loosely; sharp tired amber eyes; ink-stained fingers; plain indigo work kimono with sleeves tied back; fox-fire glow; wary.

**Home Ground:** Carving Room at Mask-Maker's Workshop, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, dry and unhurried; she answers a question with the price of answering it. When she is honest her voice drops and slows. Ink-and-patience cadence, pauses to blow dust off a carving, every price stated softly. A fox's soft laugh in the back of her throat. Tell: when she tells the truth, she stops carving and looks at you.
**Combat Role:** a glamour first, a ward second, a carving knife last; she fights only when cornered and then without mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her for nothing, keep the Talisman Master off her, and the wall comes down a mask at a time.
**Courtship Style:** Wary, dry and mercenary to start; she prices every kindness until one day she stops charging you.
**Jealousy Style:** Gives the rival a mask, as a joke, of your face; takes it back that night and apologises in her own voice.
personality: Core: turns most customers away; answers questions with prices; carves when she cannot sleep
Quirk: talks to the fox in her chisel

npcs.name: Master Sorei
npcs.location: Mask-Maker's Workshop, Workshop of Borrowed Faces
npcs.info:
The mask-maker after the war, thirty-one, whose workshop does a trade it never had: soldiers who want to go home as someone else, and widows who want one more night with a face. Customers still meet the old woman at the counter. In the carving room she is ink-handed, patient and more tired than before. In person: mask-maker woman; long black hair tied back; sharp tired amber eyes; ink-stained fingers; a carving knife; a half-finished face.

**Home Ground:** Carving Room, After the War at Mask-Maker's Workshop, Workshop of Borrowed Faces, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, dry and unhurried; she answers a question with the price of answering it. When she is honest her voice drops and slows. Ink-and-patience cadence, pauses to blow dust off a carving, every price stated softly. A fox's soft laugh in the back of her throat. Tell since the war: asked a price for a face from the war, she quotes it lower than she should, and then looks at you.
**Combat Role:** a glamour first, a ward second, a carving knife last; she fights only when cornered and then without mercy.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her for nothing, keep the Talisman Master off her, and the wall comes down a mask at a time.
**Courtship Style:** Wary, dry and mercenary to start; she prices every kindness until one day she stops charging you.
**Jealousy Style:** Gives the rival a mask, as a joke, of your face; takes it back that night and apologises in her own voice.
personality: Core: turns most customers away; answers questions with prices; carves when she cannot sleep
Quirk: talks to the fox in her chisel

npcs.name: Masterless Blade
npcs.info:
A ronin in a faded kimono and a deep straw hat, a long sword and a short one. Masterless blades guard caravans, collect debts and rob travellers when the contracts dry up. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin swordsman; deep straw hat; faded kimono; two swords.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, bored, every word a price. Dry and bored; every word sounds like a price. Ronin size you up aloud. Tell: when outmatched they laugh, once, and sheathe.
**Combat Role:** the draw, then a road-fighter's dirty work
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks who is paying; keeps his contract; drinks between jobs
Quirk: sizes you up

npcs.name: Masterless Blade
npcs.location: Ronin Hiring Hall, The Hall of Unpaid Blades
npcs.info:
A ronin whose house lost the war and never paid him, hiring out from the Hall of Unpaid Blades for whatever the board offers. Unpaid blades guard envoys, collect war debts and rob anyone who looks like a winner. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin swordsman; torn straw hat; a faded kimono with a house crest cut away; two swords, one chipped.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, bored, every word a price. Dry and bored; every word sounds like a price. Ronin size you up aloud. Tell since the war: he names his dead house's crest when he bows, then remembers and does not finish the bow.
**Combat Role:** the draw, then a road-fighter's dirty work
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks who is paying first and twice; trusts no house; drinks before jobs now
Quirk: sizes you up

npcs.name: Mel
npcs.info:
A foreign-born fighter who works the Sand Ring's open bouts for coin and runs its night drills for anyone who wants to learn to take a hit. She came ashore at Saikai off a silver galleon from New Spain, across the eastern ocean, and has never explained why she stayed. In person: adult woman; dark brown skin; shaggy black hair fading to sea-green; sea-green eyes; mole; a thin cigarillo between her lips trailing smoke; black choker with a small memorial pendant; black cropped top; red-lacquered armoured sleeve and gauntlet; red rope obi; black hakama; a huge black katana with glowing sea-green runes held upright.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring at Tournament Grounds, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A low, tired register: clipped phrasing, dry sarcasm, guarded pauses, and an intensity she keeps on a short leash. Low and tired, clipped to the bone, every kindness wrapped in dry sarcasm, a guarded pause before anything true. Tell: at the word 'mother' or 'bargain' the pause comes before she can stop it.
**Combat Role:** the great-sword swung two-handed like a club, then a gate opens behind you and the pommel finds your back.
**Relationship Hook:** Come to the night drill in the Sand Ring and she will teach you to take a hit, then ask what you are running from.
personality: Core: guarded; volatile in a bout, patient with beginners; drinks and does not sleep; shields anyone weaker
Quirk: turns the memorial pendant at her throat when she lies

npcs.name: Mel
npcs.area: The Sand Ring, After the War
npcs.info:
The foreign fighter after the war, who stayed when the tournament became the Regent's camp and now drills its recruits in the sand ring by day and runs bare-knuckle night bouts for soldiers' pay. In person: dark-skinned foreign woman; black hair fading to sea-green, longer now; sea-green eyes; a cigarillo; a soldier's padded jacket under a black haori; red-lacquered armoured sleeve; the rune great-sword across her back.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A low, tired register: clipped phrasing, dry sarcasm, guarded pauses, and an intensity she keeps on a short leash. Low and tired, clipped to the bone, every kindness wrapped in dry sarcasm, a guarded pause before anything true. Tell since the war: since Sekigane she touches the blade's hilt before she speaks of the war, as if checking it is still asleep.
**Combat Role:** the great-sword swung two-handed like a club, then a gate opens behind you and the pommel finds your back.
**Relationship Hook:** Come to the night drill in the Sand Ring and she will teach you to take a hit, then ask what you are running from.
personality: Core: guarded; volatile in a bout, patient with beginners; drinks and does not sleep; shields anyone weaker
Quirk: turns the memorial pendant at her throat when she lies

npcs.name: Memory-Seller Jirocho
npcs.info:
A dead clerk of the Court of the Dead who sells memories he should have filed: a dead man's last summer, a stranger's wedding, a password nobody living knows. He takes isles coin and Otherworld favours both. In person: adult man; thin and stooped; grey skin; ink-stained fingers; a clerk's grey robe with too many pockets; a small locked box; furtive.

**Home Ground:** The Ledger Hall at The Court of the Dead, The Far Shore, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Whispery, quick and eager to please; he talks like a man selling something he should not have. A whisper that speeds up when selling, a man offering something he should not have, glances over the shoulder audible in the pauses. Tell: the founding memory mentioned and the whisper stops.
**Combat Role:** none; he runs, and the dead are hard to catch.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy a memory and keep its owner's name to yourself; he trusts a buyer who does not talk.
personality: Core: whispers when selling; files nothing; looks over his shoulder at the ledger hall
Quirk: tastes a memory before selling it

npcs.name: Mess-Hall Keeper Tetsuji
npcs.info:
Keeper of the hunters' mess at Asahi Gate, a one-armed veteran who posts the hold's bounties on demons, thralls and the beasts that follow them. In person: mature man; one-armed veteran demon hunter mess-keeper; scarred face; fur-trimmed coat; tapping a bounty board.

**Home Ground:** Hunters' Mess at Asahi Gate, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** A quartermaster's bark that has shouted over storms; gentler with the young. A storm-trained bark, gentler for the young, the stump of his arm tapping the board. Tell: at the word 'night hunter' his bark drops to a growl.
**Combat Role:** a hunter's blade in his one hand, still fast.
**Relationship Hook:** End the night hunter on the pass and he gives you everything he saved.
personality: Core: barks orders; taps the board with his stump; never sits with his back to the door
Quirk: feeds the young first

npcs.name: Mess-Hall Keeper Tetsuji
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.info:
Keeper of the hunters' mess after the war, a one-armed veteran who posts the Hold's bounties and the names of the dead on the same board. Refugees sleep between his tables. In person: one-armed veteran; scarred face; fur-trimmed coat; a bounty board crowded with names.

**Home Ground:** Hunters' Mess, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** A quartermaster's bark that has shouted over storms; gentler with the young. A storm-trained bark, gentler for the young, the stump of his arm tapping the board. Tell since the war: he taps the board twice for each new name, once for the hunter and once for the refugee who took their bed.
**Combat Role:** a hunter's blade in his one hand, still fast.
**Relationship Hook:** End the night hunter on the pass and he gives you everything he saved.
personality: Core: barks orders; taps the board with his stump; never sits with his back to the door
Quirk: feeds the young first

npcs.name: Mess-Keeper Sanjuro
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Lodges' mess, whose cauldron is never empty and whose job board by the door is the first work the Otherworld has ever offered. He pays in Mon on completion and asks no oath of anyone. In person: adult man; broad and loud; short black hair; a cook's apron; a ladle; cheerful.

**Home Ground:** The Mess at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Easy, loud and practical; he talks like a man who feeds a yard of fighters and has heard every excuse. Easy and loud, a ladle banged for emphasis, every excuse heard before and said so. Tell: a job that went wrong and the loudness drops out.
**Combat Role:** a hired blade's plain swordwork, kept up in the Yard.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask for work without mentioning a faction and he hands you a job on the spot.
personality: Core: bangs the ladle on the cauldron; asks no oath; knows every excuse
Quirk: pays in Mon, counted twice

npcs.name: Michiru of the Straw Hat
npcs.info:
A wandering ronin, thirty, with a deep straw hat and a long sword, who crosses the hanging bridge both ways every week and never pays the toll the same way twice. In person: wandering female ronin; deep straw hat; long hair tied low; worn dark kimono and hakama; a long sword.

**Home Ground:** Toll Huts at Hanging Bridge Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, calm and dry; she answers questions with shrugs and one-word replies, and lets silence do the rest. She tips her hat instead of greeting. Tell: when she decides to help she says a full sentence, which surprises everyone.
**Combat Role:** a long sword on a swaying bridge; she does not slip.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy her a drink and she tells you who arranged the patrols.
personality: Core: never pays the same way twice; watches both patrols; sleeps on the bridge
Quirk: answers with shrugs

npcs.name: Michiru of the Straw Hat
npcs.location: Hanging Bridge Pass, The War-Line Pass
npcs.info:
The wandering ronin after the war, thirty-two, who crosses the war-line under nobody's flag and pays Ganseki's toll differently every time. In person: wandering ronin; deep straw hat; long hair tied low; worn dark kimono and hakama; a long sword; a truce flag folded in her sash.

**Home Ground:** Toll Huts, After the War at Hanging Bridge Pass, The War-Line Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, calm and dry; she answers questions with shrugs and one-word replies, and lets silence do the rest. She tips her hat instead of greeting. Tell since the war: she speaks two full sentences now, and both are warnings.
**Combat Role:** a long sword on a swaying bridge; she does not slip.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy her a drink and she tells you who arranged the patrols.
personality: Core: never pays the same way twice; watches both patrols; sleeps on the bridge
Quirk: answers with shrugs

npcs.name: Mission-Hall Steward Kiri
npcs.info:
Steward of Kagegi's mission hall, who posts the village's public work for outsiders beside the secret work she never shows them. In person: young woman; shinobi mission steward; needles.

**Home Ground:** Mission Hall at Kagegi Village, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and fast, a shinobi steward's whisper that never wastes a word. A clipped shinobi whisper, every word chosen, never a wasted breath. Tell: testing you with a lie, she adds one word too many.
**Combat Role:** a thrown needle and gone before you blink.
**Relationship Hook:** Finish three outsider bounties and she offers you one from the other board.
personality: Core: whispers; reads lips across the hall; tests outsiders with small lies
Quirk: never sits

npcs.name: Mission-Hall Steward Kiri
npcs.location: Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge
npcs.info:
Steward of Kagegi's mission hall after the war, who posts every mission against Hayate on the public board and the real work behind the screen. In person: shinobi mission steward; needles; a mourning band; a board of war missions.

**Home Ground:** Mission Hall, After the War at Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and fast, a shinobi steward's whisper that never wastes a word. A clipped shinobi whisper, every word chosen, never a wasted breath. Tell since the war: she adds one word too many on purpose now, so outsiders think they caught her.
**Combat Role:** a thrown needle and gone before you blink.
**Relationship Hook:** Finish three outsider bounties and she offers you one from the other board.
personality: Core: whispers; reads lips across the hall; tests outsiders with small lies
Quirk: never sits

npcs.name: Mizuchi Deck Officer
npcs.info:
A sea-house officer in salt-stained light armour with a river-dragon crest, a curved sword and a whistle. Deck officers hunt smugglers on the dikes and take a cut from the ones they let go. A stock foe, one of many. In person: naval samurai officer; curved sword; whistle.

**Speaking Style:** Salty and sharp, sailor's oaths, a whistle always half raised. Tell: when bribed she names a price before she refuses.
**Combat Role:** a quick curved cut and the whistle for her marines
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: swears like a sailor; counts sacks; salutes no one on land
Quirk: blows the whistle first

npcs.name: Mizuchi Hayato
npcs.info:
The admiral's elder son and heir, thirty, a well-liked captain lying in the admiral's hall with a fever three days old. In person: feverish naval heir; pale sweating face; wry smile; dark hair loose.

**Home Ground:** Admiral's Hall at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Weak, polite and wry; he jokes about dying because nobody else will. Weak, polite, wry jokes about dying, coughing between them. Tell: when someone is kind to him, the jokes stop and he thanks them simply.
**Combat Role:** none, lying in a fever.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him the cure in time and the fleet is in your debt.
personality: Core: asks about his crew; writes letters he cannot send; refuses the priests
Quirk: jokes about dying

npcs.name: Mizuchi Marine
npcs.info:
A sea-house samurai in light armour with a river-dragon crest, a short spear and a grappling hook. Mizuchi marines board ships, hang pirates and swim like seals. A stock foe, one of many. In person: naval samurai marine; light armour with a river-dragon crest; a short spear and grappling hook.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, salty and cheerful, salted with sea slang, quick to toast the pennant. Marines laugh during a fight. Tell: when the admiral's name is spoken they stand straighter and stop joking.
**Combat Role:** grapple and spear on a rolling deck
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grapples first; jokes about landsmen; takes smugglers' silver
Quirk: salutes the pennant

npcs.name: Mizuchi Marine
npcs.location: Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet
npcs.info:
A sea-house samurai whose fleet burned at its moorings, salvaging bronze from its blackened ribs and guarding a shipyard that builds nothing. A stock foe, one of many. In person: naval samurai marine; scorched light armour with a river-dragon crest; a short spear; a salvage hook; soot to the elbows.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, salty and cheerful, salted with sea slang, quick to toast the pennant. Marines laugh during a fight. Tell since the war: he salutes a pennant that is not there, and lowers the hand slowly.
**Combat Role:** grapple and spear on a rolling deck
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: grapples first; jokes about landsmen less; salvages his own fleet
Quirk: salutes the pennant

npcs.name: Mizuchi Nami
npcs.info:
The admiral's daughter, twenty-six, a hard, brilliant captain who has sworn to find out which of her father's captains sold the sleeping warship. She is inspecting the Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye. In person: fierce naval captain; short dark hair; sharp eyes; sea-blue armour coat with a river-dragon crest; a spear.

**Home Ground:** Signal Platform at Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast and furious; she speaks in charges and verdicts. Fast, sharp, verdicts and charges, no softening words. Tell: when her father's spies are mentioned, she goes silent with fury.
**Combat Role:** spear and grapple, then her marines.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her catch a bought captain and she trusts you; show her what her father does and she breaks.
personality: Core: speaks in verdicts; never sits; keeps a list of the bought
Quirk: inspects everything twice

npcs.name: Mizuchi Nami
npcs.location: Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, The Wrecker's Light
npcs.info:
The admiral's daughter after the war, twenty-eight, the admiral's heir since her brother died, locked in the lamp room of the Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye by the keeper she came to inspect. In person: fierce naval captain; short dark hair; sharp eyes; sea-blue armour coat scorched at the hem; no spear.

**Home Ground:** Signal Platform, After the War at Lighthouse of the Dragon's Eye, The Wrecker's Light, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast and furious; she speaks in charges and verdicts. Fast, sharp, verdicts and charges, no softening words. Tell since the war: she speaks to the lamp in the room as if it were a junior officer, and it is the only one she is gentle with.
**Combat Role:** spear and grapple, then her marines.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her catch a bought captain and she trusts you; show her what her father does and she breaks.
personality: Core: speaks in verdicts; never sits; keeps a list of the bought
Quirk: inspects everything twice

npcs.name: Mizuchi Toranosuke
npcs.info:
The admiral's youngest son, twenty-two, handsome, generous and drowning in debt at the dice tables of Lantern Row. He fights well, drinks badly and is sure his luck turns tomorrow. In person: handsome reckless samurai heir; messy topknot; flushed grin; open sea-blue kimono with a wave crest; dice; nervous bravado.

**Home Ground:** Dice Room at Lantern Row Gambling Den, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Charming, reckless and too loud; when he is frightened he gets louder. Loud, charming, talks over his own nerves, too many jokes. Snaps his fingers when he has an idea. Tell: the more frightened he is, the louder and faster he gets.
**Combat Role:** a sea house's sword, quick and showy, badly sober.
**Relationship Hook:** Get him out of the debt and he owes you a ship; tell his father and he never forgives you.
personality: Core: laughs too loud; bets on anything; keeps his father's letters unopened
Quirk: promises tomorrow

npcs.name: Money-Changer Ebara Jinpachi
npcs.info:
A money changer at the guild counting house's front counters, plump and quick, who weighs every coin twice and every customer once. He changes foreign silver, mainland gold and shrine scrip, at a rate that changes with your face. In person: plump middle-aged money changer; sly smile; scales and abacus; piles of coins; merchant guild counting house.

**Home Ground:** Money Counters at Guild Counting House, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Oily and fast, every sentence a little sum; he smiles at coins, not people. Quick oily sums under his breath, a click of the abacus between phrases, 'honoured customer' said a little too warmly. Tell: near the floorboard his voice rises half a tone.
**Combat Role:** none; he shouts for the guild guards and hides behind the counter.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him shaving a coin and he offers you a better rate forever.
personality: Core: weighs coins twice; knows every mint mark; never gives exact change first
Quirk: smiles at silver

npcs.name: Money-Changer Ebara Jinpachi
npcs.location: Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt
npcs.info:
A money changer at the Seat of the Debt after the war, plump and quick still, who changes the war's loot from every army into clean guild silver at a rate that depends on whose loot it is. In person: plump money changer; sly smile; scales; piles of foreign and house coin; a new gold ring.

**Home Ground:** Money Counters, After the War at Guild Counting House, Seat of the Debt, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Oily and fast, every sentence a little sum; he smiles at coins, not people. Quick oily sums under his breath, a click of the abacus between phrases, 'honoured customer' said a little too warmly. Tell since the war: he glances behind him between sums, and starts the sum over.
**Combat Role:** none; he shouts for the guild guards and hides behind the counter.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him shaving a coin and he offers you a better rate forever.
personality: Core: weighs coins twice; knows every mint mark; never gives exact change first
Quirk: smiles at silver

npcs.name: Moonview Nopperabo
npcs.info:
A noodle-seller with a cart on the bridge at night, whose face is a smooth blank when he looks up. Bridge nopperabo ask a frightened traveller if the face they saw looked like this. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nopperabo; faceless noodle seller with a cart; smooth blank skin where his face should be; no eyes; no nose; no mouth.

**Speaking Style:** Friendly, then empty: a noodle-seller's patter that stops dead. Tell: he asks the same question twice.
**Combat Role:** the question, the blank face, the fall off the bridge
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks the question; laughs; tail in the water
Quirk: offers noodles

npcs.name: Moorland Gaki
npcs.info:
Thin-necked, swollen-bellied hungry ghosts that crawl from the forgotten graves, mouths too small to eat. Gaki swarm the graves nobody makes offerings at and chew at the living for food they cannot swallow. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gaki hungry ghosts with thin necks; swollen bellies and tiny mouths; crawling from forgotten graves.

**Speaking Style:** A starving moan, begging for anything. Tell: offered food, the moan becomes a sob.
**Combat Role:** a swarm of grasping hands
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: crawls; begs; swarms
Quirk: starving

npcs.name: Moorland Hungry Mask
npcs.info:
A white mask with a grinning mouth that floats over the grave rows on a body of grey cloth. Hungry masks feed on the souls of mourners who stay past dark. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hungry mask spirit; grinning white mask floating.

**Speaking Style:** A hungry whisper in the last mourner's voice. Tell: offered a name of the dead, it grins wider.
**Combat Role:** a soul bite from the dark between graves
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: floats; hungers; wears faces
Quirk: grins

npcs.name: Moss Hermit Dougen
npcs.info:
A hermit grown over with moss who keeps a hut at the parting of the five stairs and knows which stair will suffer whom. He lets through those of the Elements and any shinobi, when the isles have learned their names. In person: moss growing; bald sun-browned head; kind squinting eyes; a weathered monk's robe; a staff; seated before a moss-roofed hut where five stairs part; calm.

**Home Ground:** The Parting at The Sanctum Steps, The Five Sanctums, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, warm and a little deaf, or pretending; he asks your Element before your name and points with his chin. Slow and warm, a little deaf or pretending, the Element asked before the name; he points with his chin and says 'that one'. Tell: the void stair mentioned and his warmth goes out of his voice.
**Combat Role:** a staff and the patience of moss; he turns strikes aside and waits.
**Relationship Hook:** Mend the first step with him one dawn and he tells you what each stair did to him.
personality: Core: points with his chin; asks the Element first; mends the stairs' first step each dawn
Quirk: sits so still moss grows on him

npcs.name: Moth Dell Swarm
npcs.info:
A cloud of black moths hatched from a curse. Grudge swarms smother sound and breath. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge swarm; a cloud of black moths.

**Speaking Style:** A rustle of wings with whispers inside it, many small grudges at once. Tell: near flame the rustle turns to a hiss.
**Combat Role:** a smothering cloud
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: silences; follows warmth; burns
Quirk: smothers

npcs.name: Moth Dell Swarm
npcs.info:
A cloud of black moths grown so large it blots the noon sun over the dell and has reached the pilgrims' road, smothering the penitents' prayers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge swarm; a towering cloud of black moths; grey wing-dust falling like snow.

**Speaking Style:** A rustle of wings with whispers inside it, many small grudges at once. Tell since the war: it goes utterly still when a prayer begins, then rushes toward the voice.
**Combat Role:** a smothering cloud
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: silences; follows prayers; burns
Quirk: smothers

npcs.name: Mother Tome
npcs.info:
A miner's widow, fifty-five, who stops every passing samurai on Soot Street to ask about her son, who went down to the deep forges and did not come back. In person: soot-stained miner's widow; grey hair loose; fierce wet eyes; patched clothes.

**Home Ground:** Soot Street at Miners' Town, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Raw, stubborn and loud; she will not stop asking. Raw, stubborn and loud, a mountain mother who will not stop asking. She repeats her son's name like a demand. Tell: when someone finally answers her honestly she goes very quiet and thanks them.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her son, or what became of him.
personality: Core: never stops asking; keeps her son's helmet; spits at the castle
Quirk: stops every samurai

npcs.name: Mother Tome
npcs.info:
A miner's widow after the war, fifty-seven, who stopped asking samurai about her son: she found him, walking in the Revenant Shaft with a lantern. In person: soot-stained widow; grey hair loose; fierce dry eyes; patched clothes; a lantern of her own.

**Home Ground:** Soot Street, After the War at Miners' Town, The Hollowed Town, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Raw, stubborn and loud; she will not stop asking. Raw, stubborn and loud, a mountain mother who will not stop asking. She repeats her son's name like a demand. Tell since the war: she says her son's name and then 'I found him', as if daring you to argue.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her son, or what became of him.
personality: Core: never stops asking; keeps her son's helmet; spits at the castle
Quirk: stops every samurai

npcs.name: Mother Urushi
npcs.info:
A warehouse owner on the foreign quay, fifty, heavy-lidded and draped in black lacquer jewellery, who rents storage to foreign captains and asks no questions. Porters call her Mother and do what she says. In person: heavy-lidded auctioneer; black hair; black lacquer jewellery; dark red and black kimono; a sliding lacquer box; sly.

**Home Ground:** The Black Warehouse at Foreign Quay Warehouses, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Husky and slow, every word priced; she calls everyone 'little one' and means it as a valuation. Husky, lazy vowels, a price at the end of every sentence. Taps a lacquer box with a fingernail as she talks. Tell: when something is truly valuable, she stops calling it 'little one' and names it.
**Combat Role:** she never fights; her porters close the doors and the foreign captains' men do the rest.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the runaway child and she pays more than the guild ever will; bring her a buyer's name and she trades you a box.
personality: Core: taps her lacquer rings while she thinks; never sits facing a door she did not choose; remembers every price ever paid
Quirk: calls everyone 'little one'

npcs.name: Mother Urushi
npcs.area: The Black Warehouse, After the War
npcs.info:
The black warehouse's owner after the war, fifty-two, richer than ever: the war bought every sealed host she could sell, and some never came back to be resold. Porters still call her Mother. In person: heavy-lidded auctioneer; black lacquer jewellery; a new dark red kimono; a sliding lacquer box; a smile like a closed door.

**Home Ground:** The Black Warehouse, After the War at Foreign Quay Warehouses, Bonded Quay, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Husky and slow, every word priced; she calls everyone 'little one' and means it as a valuation. Husky, lazy vowels, a price at the end of every sentence. Taps a lacquer box with a fingernail as she talks. Tell since the war: when a crate creaks anywhere near her she stops mid-price and listens.
**Combat Role:** she never fights; her porters close the doors and the foreign captains' men do the rest.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the runaway child and she pays more than the guild ever will; bring her a buyer's name and she trades you a box.
personality: Core: taps her lacquer rings while she thinks; never sits facing a door she did not choose; remembers every price ever paid
Quirk: calls everyone 'little one'

npcs.name: Mourner Asa
npcs.info:
A young wife, twenty-five, staying at the Pilgrims' Hostel, who has lit a mourning lantern for her husband. In person: quiet young mourner; hair tied plainly; calm eyes; white mourning kimono.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Hall at Pilgrims' Hostel, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, steady and strange; she speaks of her husband in the past tense though he lives. Soft and steady, a mourner's practised calm, and she speaks of a living man in the past tense. She folds her sleeves while she talks. Tell: when her daughter is mentioned the calm cracks, her voice drops, and her hand finds the knife in her sleeve.
**Combat Role:** a knife in the dark, once.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her daughter in the Records wing and she puts the knife down.
personality: Core: trims the lantern wick often; smiles at mourners; keeps a knife in her sleeve
Quirk: speaks of him in the past tense

npcs.name: Mourner Asa
npcs.epithet: The Wife Who Lit Two Lanterns
npcs.location: Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns
npcs.info:
A young wife at the Pilgrims' Hostel after the war, twenty-seven, who has lit a mourning lantern for her living husband every night for two years. In person: quiet young woman; hair tied plainly; calm eyes; white mourning kimono; a knife in her sleeve.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Hall, After the War at Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, steady and strange; she speaks of her husband in the past tense though he lives. Soft and steady, a mourner's practised calm, and she speaks of a living man in the past tense. She folds her sleeves while she talks. Tell since the war: she speaks of two lanterns now, one in the past tense and one not.
**Combat Role:** a knife in the dark, once.
**Relationship Hook:** Find her daughter in the Records wing and she puts the knife down.
personality: Core: trims the lantern wick often; smiles at mourners; keeps a knife in her sleeve
Quirk: speaks of him in the past tense

npcs.name: Mourner Hisae
npcs.info:
A woman who comes to the weeping torii every day to speak to her drowned daughter, who sometimes answers. In person: middle-aged woman.

**Home Ground:** Torii Ground at Weeping Torii, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and still, a mourner who speaks to the torii as if her daughter stood under it. Quiet and still, speaking to the torii as if to a child. Tell: when the voice answers, hers trembles with joy and fear together.
**Combat Role:** none; she stands between you and the torii.
**Relationship Hook:** Stay with her past dusk and you hear the voice that answers.
personality: Core: speaks to the torii; brings rice balls; smiles at nothing
Quirk: refuses to leave at dusk

npcs.name: Mourner Hisae
npcs.epithet: The Mother at the Salt Torii
npcs.info:
A woman who comes to the weeping torii every day after the war to speak to her drowned daughter. The torii weeps salt now, and the voice answers in daylight. In person: middle-aged woman; salt-crusted sleeves; a comb in her hand.

**Home Ground:** Torii Ground, After the War at Weeping Torii, Salt-Weeping Torii, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and still, a mourner who speaks to the torii as if her daughter stood under it. Quiet and still, speaking to the torii as if to a child. Tell since the war: when the torii answers, she no longer answers back at once; she counts to three first.
**Combat Role:** none; she stands between you and the torii.
**Relationship Hook:** Stay with her past dusk and you hear the voice that answers.
personality: Core: speaks to the torii; brings rice balls; smiles at nothing
Quirk: refuses to leave at dusk

npcs.name: Mukuro the False Pilgrim
npcs.info:
A pilgrim in grey who walks the Grey Pilgrims' Road with the others, praying for the cursed and helping the weak along. In person: kindly-looking grey pilgrim; shaved head; gentle smile; grey robes and straw hat; a staff; a bottle hidden.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road at Grey Pilgrims' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle, pious and slow; the voice of a kind pilgrim, with something cold underneath. Gentle, pious, slow blessings, something cold under the warmth. Tell: when someone sees through him, the warmth simply stops, like a lamp blown out.
**Combat Role:** a curse whispered into a prayer, then a knife.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him at his bottle and the pilgrims' road is safe again.
personality: Core: prays loudly; helps the weak carry their packs; never drinks with others
Quirk: touches a bottle under his robe

npcs.name: Mukuro the False Pilgrim
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
A pilgrim in grey after the war, walking the penitents' road among a thousand soldiers come to atone, praying for the cursed and helping the weak along. In person: kindly-looking grey pilgrim; shaved head; gentle smile; grey robes; a staff; three bottles hidden now.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle, pious and slow; the voice of a kind pilgrim, with something cold underneath. Gentle, pious, slow blessings, something cold under the warmth. Tell since the war: his blessings run longer for soldiers, and his hand lingers on their shoulders.
**Combat Role:** a curse whispered into a prayer, then a knife.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him at his bottle and the pilgrims' road is safe again.
personality: Core: prays loudly; helps the weak carry their packs; never drinks with others
Quirk: touches a bottle under his robe

npcs.name: Mule-Driver Hachibei
npcs.info:
A salt trader with a mule called Princess, forty-five, who carries salt from the pans up the post road and down the other side. In person: cheerful mule driver; straw hat; sun-browned.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans at Saltpan Village, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, folksy and cheerful; he talks to his mule more than to you and translates the mule's opinions. He clicks his tongue to steer. Tell: when the mule balks he trusts it, and stops the whole conversation.
**Combat Role:** Princess kicks.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk the road with him and learn every way around a barrier.
personality: Core: whistles; never pays a toll he can walk around; shares his rice
Quirk: talks to his mule

npcs.name: Mule-Driver Hachibei
npcs.epithet: Driver of the Long Way Round
npcs.info:
The salt trader after the war, forty-seven, who still carries salt from the pans with his mule Princess and now goes the long way round every barricade. In person: cheerful mule driver; straw hat with a hole in it; sun-browned; his old mule Princess.

**Home Ground:** Salt Pans, After the War at Saltpan Village, The Taxed Pans, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, folksy and cheerful; he talks to his mule more than to you and translates the mule's opinions. He clicks his tongue to steer. Tell since the war: he tells the mule which barricade they are going round before he tells you.
**Combat Role:** Princess kicks.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk the road with him and learn every way around a barrier.
personality: Core: whistles; never pays a toll he can walk around; shares his rice
Quirk: talks to his mule

npcs.name: Nagare Kyoya
npcs.info:
A masterless swordsman who walks the same roads as the character, takes the same jobs a day earlier, and treats every meeting as a joke until the blades come out.
