In person: adult man; rangy; unshaven; shaggy hair tied back badly; half-lidded eyes; a faded blue kimono patched; straw sandals; a plain katana with a frayed hilt.

**Home Ground:** Signing Room at Duelists' Teahouse, Fifty Stations Road district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Lazy and few-worded, a drifter's drawl, a smile that does not reach his eyes. Lazy drawl, few words, a grass stalk between his teeth. Tell: when he stops pretending, the drawl goes and the words come clipped.
**Combat Role:** lazy guard first, then whatever the bout demands; a ronin rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** He will already have taken the job you came for, and offer to split it if you can beat him for it.
personality: Core: lazy until he isn't; steals your job, then buys you a drink; never draws first
Quirk: chews a stalk of grass

npcs.name: Nail-Puller Old Nao
npcs.info:
An old woman who lives in the empty shrine under the weeping cedar and pulls the curse-nails from its bark one by one. In person: elderly woman pulling iron nails from a huge weeping cedar's bark with pliers; empty shrine; ash.

**Home Ground:** Empty Shrine at Weeping Cedar, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and patient, an old woman who pulls curse-nails and talks to the tree. Flat and patient, talking to the tree between pulls, a grunt with every nail. Tell: when the biwa plays she stops speaking entirely.
**Combat Role:** pliers and salt, and a run for the shrine.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her pull the last nails and the jorogumo starves.
personality: Core: talks to the tree; pulls one nail a day; counts nails
Quirk: never looks at the biwa player

npcs.name: Natsu of the Ice Caves
npcs.info:
A young exile, nineteen, hidden by the council in the ice caves above the shore towns while Warden hunters search the shore. In person: defiant exile girl; short white-blonde hair; bright eyes; furs; faint glow.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Shore Towns: Ice Caves at Exiles' Shore Towns, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, defiant and quick; she jokes about the beast like an annoying sibling. Bright, defiant and quick; she jokes about the beast inside her like an annoying sibling. She laughs at the cold. Tell: when the beast stirs she keeps joking, faster, and her voice goes high.
**Combat Role:** the beast, controlled; frightening.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep the hunters off her and she shows you what a free host can do.
personality: Core: jokes about her beast; counts the winters; writes memories on the cave walls
Quirk: never stays still

npcs.name: Natsu of the Ice Caves
npcs.location: Exiles' Shore Towns, Towns Packing to Leave
npcs.area: Exiles' Shore Towns: Ice Caves, After the War
npcs.info:
A young exile host after the war, twenty-one, hidden in the ice caves with three hosts fleeing the Wardens' hunters. The four beasts calm each other, and none of them knows why. In person: defiant exile woman; short white-blonde hair; bright eyes; furs; a faint glow brighter than before.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Shore Towns: Ice Caves, After the War at Exiles' Shore Towns, Towns Packing to Leave, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, defiant and quick; she jokes about the beast like an annoying sibling. Bright, defiant and quick; she jokes about the beast inside her like an annoying sibling. She laughs at the cold. Tell since the war: her jokes come faster when one of the other three is near, and higher.
**Combat Role:** the beast, controlled; frightening.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep the hunters off her and she shows you what a free host can do.
personality: Core: jokes about her beast; counts the winters; writes memories on the cave walls
Quirk: never stays still

npcs.name: Navy Widow Chiyoko
npcs.location: Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet
npcs.info:
A navy officer's widow, thirty-six, who runs the silent shipyard's kitchen and its message runners for the admiral nobody knows is alive. In person: navy widow; hair; dark blue kimono; sleeves tied back.

**Home Ground:** Shipyard, After the War at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and exact, a navy wife's voice used to giving orders when the men are at sea. Calm, exact orders in a navy wife's voice. Tell: when the bought captains are named she straightens something that is already straight.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her give the silver back and she will tell the admiral the truth.
personality: Core: keeps the kitchen fire low; counts the loyal captains; sends runners by the reed paths
Quirk: never mentions her husband

npcs.name: Nest Elder Crow Tengu
npcs.info:
An old crow tengu with grey in her feathers and a sword made of a stolen court blade. Nest elders guard the hoard branches and cut down anyone who climbs for it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: elder crow tengu with grey feathers holding a fine stolen sword.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and cold. Clipped, cold and aristocratic, every word a coin counted. Tell: offered a fair bargain she lets a single pleased caw slip.
**Combat Role:** a dive with the blade and the flock behind
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches from the top branch; bargains; never forgives a thief
Quirk: counts the hoard

npcs.name: Nest Elder Crow Tengu
npcs.location: Crow Tengu Nests, Nests of War Plunder
npcs.info:
An old crow tengu guarding the hoard branches heavy with war plunder, the regent's seal now one prize among hundreds. A stock foe, one of many. In person: elder crow tengu; grey feathers gone white; a fine stolen sword; a general's war fan in her other claw.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and cold. Clipped, cold and aristocratic, every word a coin counted. Tell since the war: she counts the hoard aloud and stops at the regent's seal every time.
**Combat Role:** a dive with the blade and the flock behind
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: watches from the top branch; bargains; never gives a crest back
Quirk: counts the hoard

npcs.name: Nibanme the Second Hammer
npcs.info:
A huge oni smith, skin cracked like cooling iron, a broken hammer in one fist and the stump of a horn burned black. He works an anvil of raw rock in the steam field, beating at nothing. He challenges any smith or swordsman who comes near: strike his anvil and beat him at it, or fight him. He has killed three apprentices who lost. Anyone who refuses he chases from the field. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: huge oni blacksmith with cracked iron-grey skin; one burned horn stump; leather apron; broken forge hammer; rock anvil; sparks.

**Home Ground:** Steam Field at Ember Vent Fields, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A grinding growl that breaks into a smith's shouted counts. A grinding growl broken by a smith's shouted counts, hammer rhythm in every sentence. Tell: at the word 'first' the count stops dead.
**Combat Role:** nibanme throws down the broken hammer and pulls a white-hot blade from the vent itself; every blow now sprays molten iron and he fights like the contest is happening again
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Kanemasa lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: Night-Coast Raider
npcs.info:
A pirate in a sea-worn coat with a boarding axe and a cutlass, gold rings in her ears. Sea raiders strike the coast at night and are gone by dawn. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pirate raider; sea-worn coat; gold earrings; a boarding axe.

**Speaking Style:** Laughing, dangerous. Laughing and dangerous, sea shanty rhythms in their threats. Raiders cheer before boarding. Tell: when outnumbered they laugh louder.
**Combat Role:** boarding axe and a crew, gone by dawn
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs in the fight; never stays past dawn; takes rings
Quirk: boards first

npcs.name: Night-Coast Raider
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
A pirate who no longer needs the night: the garrison walked home, and her crew lands at the fort's water gate by day. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pirate raider; a sea-worn coat; gold earrings; a boarding axe; a garrison officer's stolen sash.

**Speaking Style:** Laughing, dangerous. Laughing and dangerous, sea shanty rhythms in their threats. Raiders cheer before boarding. Tell since the war: she still says it's dawn soon, out of habit, at noon.
**Combat Role:** boarding axe and a crew, gone by dawn
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs in the fight; lands by day; takes rings
Quirk: boards first

npcs.name: Night-Lily Shizuka
npcs.info:
A court dancer, twenty-six, in layered night-lily silks who dances at the poetry evenings and is always where the princess turns to look. In person: elegant court dancer; long black hair with a white lily ornament; layered night-blue silks; a folding fan.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Poems at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and sweet, a dancer's laugh; nothing she says is quite an answer. Soft and sweet, a dancer's breathy laugh behind the fan, never a straight answer. Tell: when the princess's guard captain enters, the laugh stops and she counts the room aloud under her breath.
**Combat Role:** the fan in close, the needle once, and gone in the crowd.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch her fan before the dance ends and she offers the party the name of whoever paid her.
personality: Core: laughs behind the fan; never eats at a feast; dances closer each evening
Quirk: counts the guards in every room

npcs.name: Night-Lily Shizuka
npcs.location: The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor
npcs.area: Hall of Poems, After the War
npcs.info:
A court dancer, twenty-eight, who dances the mourning rites in white for a throne nobody sits on; she is still at the palace because no ship would take her out. In person: court dancer; black hair cut to the shoulder in mourning; plain white mourning silks; a folding fan with its ribs re-lacquered black.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Poems, After the War at The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and sweet, a dancer's laugh; nothing she says is quite an answer. Soft and sweet, a dancer's breathy laugh behind the fan, never a straight answer. Tell since the war: she stops mid-step whenever a thin sound, a pin or a bell, catches her ear.
**Combat Role:** the fan in close, the needle once, and gone in the crowd.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch her fan before the dance ends and she offers the party the name of whoever paid her.
personality: Core: dances for the dead now; keeps the needle; trusts no one who pays
Quirk: counts the guards in every room

npcs.name: Night-Maid Rokurokubi
npcs.info:
A courteous inn maid whose neck stretches across the room at night. Rokurokubi frighten and bite sleepers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: inn maid with an impossibly long neck.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and strange, a maid's courtesy with words that come from slightly too high. She forgets what she was saying and starts again. Tell: when her neck stretches her voice drifts away and back.
**Combat Role:** the neck and the bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: stretches at night; bites; forgets
Quirk: courteous by day

npcs.name: Night-Maid Rokurokubi
npcs.location: Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East
npcs.info:
A courteous inn maid at the last inn east of the barricade, serving soldiers in the honjin rooms; at night her neck stretches into the refugees' bath. A stock foe, one of many. In person: rokurokubi; inn maid with an impossibly long neck; a soldier's cord tied round it like a scarf.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and strange, a maid's courtesy with words that come from slightly too high. She forgets what she was saying and starts again. Tell since the war: she bows lower to refugees than to soldiers, and the soldiers notice.
**Combat Role:** the neck and the bite
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: stretches at night; bites soldiers; remembers now
Quirk: courteous by day

npcs.name: Night-Road Gambler Ronin
npcs.info:
A ronin in a stained grey haori who plays dice on the inns of the night road and draws when he loses. He picks fights with anyone who wins against him, and wins most of them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin; dice; hand; lantern-lit post-station inn.

**Speaking Style:** Slurred and dangerous. Slurred, dry and dangerous, words lazy until the last one lands sharp. He chuckles at his own bad luck. Tell: sober in an instant when steel comes out; the slur vanishes.
**Combat Role:** a quick draw out of a losing roll
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drinks before a duel; insults your sword; pays debts in blood
Quirk: rolls dice one-handed

npcs.name: Night-Road Gambler Ronin
npcs.info:
A ronin who plays dice with the Straw Mask army in the honjin inn they took for a headquarters, and keeps the peace for them, badly, for a mat and rice. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ronin; a stained grey haori with a straw mask hung at the belt; dice in one hand; a bandaged sword hand.

**Speaking Style:** Slurred and dangerous. Slurred, dry and dangerous, words lazy until the last one lands sharp. He chuckles at his own bad luck. Tell since the war: he rolls the dice one-handed and covers the bandaged hand when a captain looks.
**Combat Role:** a quick draw out of a losing roll
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drinks before a duel; insults your sword; pays debts in blood
Quirk: rolls dice one-handed

npcs.name: Night-Road Nopperabo
npcs.info:
A woman in a travelling cloak weeping under the pines, who turns to show a face as smooth and blank as an egg. Nopperabo frighten travellers off the road at night; the same blank face often waits again at the next inn. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nopperabo; faceless woman; smooth blank skin where her face should be; no eyes; no nose; no mouth.

**Speaking Style:** A soft weeping voice under the pines. Tell: asked to turn, she sighs before she does.
**Combat Role:** a fright, a fall, a vanishing; it rarely strikes
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: turns slowly; waits again down the road; flees a lantern
Quirk: weeps

npcs.name: Northern Thrall
npcs.location: Frozen Pass of the Long Night
npcs.info:
A human who drank a demon's blood: grey-skinned, red-eyed, still wearing a farmer's clothes. Thralls serve the Northern Court and die in sunlight. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall; grey-skinned red-eyed man.

**Speaking Style:** A hungry rasp, half words, half breathing. It mutters a name it doesn't remember. Tell: when that name is said back, it hesitates.
**Combat Role:** claws and hunger, until dawn
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hungers; flees dawn; sometimes remembers
Quirk: obeys

npcs.name: Northern Thrall
npcs.location: Frozen Pass of the Long Night, The Open Pass
npcs.info:
A human who drank a demon's blood, grey-skinned and red-eyed, marching south through the Open Pass in the clothes of a Daylight Valley farmer whose village burned. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall; grey-skinned red-eyed man; a burned farmer's coat; a Northern Court tally-mark branded on the brow.

**Speaking Style:** A hungry rasp, half words, half breathing. It mutters a name it doesn't remember. Tell since the war: it slows at the sight of a burned roof and speeds up again.
**Combat Role:** claws and hunger, until dawn
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hungers; marches south; sometimes stops at a burned village
Quirk: obeys

npcs.name: Notice-Keeper Kagura
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Saikai harbour post's notice board, thirty, ink on her fingers and a pipe she never lights. The guild, the captains and the temple all pay her to post their bounties, and she reads every one before it goes up. In person: adult woman; harbour notice-keeper; ink-stained fingers; unlit long pipe; indigo work kimono; paper bounties pinned.

**Home Ground:** Harbour Post at Saikai, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk and amused, a harbour voice that prices everything; she rounds every number up. Quick harbour patter, numbers rounded up with a wink, the unlit pipe clicking on her teeth between lines. Tell: when a hunter comes back alive she drops the haggling for one honest sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; she ducks under the counter and blows the harbour whistle.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring back proof of a bounty and she shows you the back board.
personality: Core: taps the unlit pipe; never forgets a debt; likes hunters who come back
Quirk: reads notices aloud in a sing-song

npcs.name: Notice-Keeper Kagura
npcs.info:
Keeper of the harbour post's notice board after the war, thirty-two, who posts bounties and debt notices side by side. The guild, the Regent's office and the temple all pay her to post. In person: harbour notice-keeper; ink-stained fingers; unlit long pipe; a mourning ribbon on the pipe.

**Home Ground:** Harbour Post, After the War at Saikai, The Debt Harbour, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk and amused, a harbour voice that prices everything; she rounds every number up. Quick harbour patter, numbers rounded up with a wink, the unlit pipe clicking on her teeth between lines. Tell since the war: she taps the mourning ribbon on her pipe before she names a price for a death.
**Combat Role:** none; she ducks under the counter and blows the harbour whistle.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring back proof of a bounty and she shows you the back board.
personality: Core: taps the unlit pipe; never forgets a debt; likes hunters who come back
Quirk: reads notices aloud in a sing-song

npcs.name: Novice Haru
npcs.info:
A novice of the breath masters' retreat who meditates on the frozen ledge and narrates his breath forms aloud. In person: earnest young novice demon hunter meditating; breath steaming.

**Home Ground:** Meditation Ledge at Breath Masters' Retreat, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest and breathless, a novice who narrates his own breathing. Earnest and breathless, narrating his breaths. Tell: after a forbidden form, a cough he swallows mid-word.
**Combat Role:** a forbidden breath form that costs him every time.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch him train and you see him cough blood.
personality: Core: narrates his breathing; trains in the falls; admires everyone
Quirk: coughs blood quietly

npcs.name: Novice Jikaku
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls
npcs.info:
A young temple novice, eighteen, shaven and quick, who copies sutras faster than anyone and listens at the Sutra Hall floor at night. In person: young man; shaven temple novice; bright eager eyes; grey novice robes; a stack of copied sutras.

**Home Ground:** Sutra Hall at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Eager and quick, a novice who finishes other people's sutras for them. Eager and quick, finishing other people's sentences, a whisper as if at the Sutra Hall floor. Tell: asked about the beast, he lowers his voice to a reverent hush.
**Combat Role:** a stave and a novice's fast feet.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him what he hears through the floor and he tells the party more than the abbot ever has.
personality: Core: finishes sutras too fast; asks the abbot questions he already knows; sleeps in the Sutra Hall
Quirk: presses his ear to the floor

npcs.name: Novice Jikaku
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War
npcs.info:
A temple novice, twenty, who nurses both villages' wounded under the abbot's truce and no longer listens at the Sutra Hall floor: the war showed him what a weapon does. In person: young man; shaven temple novice; tired eyes; grey novice robes with bloodstained sleeves; bandage rolls at the belt.

**Home Ground:** Sutra Hall, After the War at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Eager and quick, a novice who finishes other people's sutras for them. Eager and quick, finishing other people's sentences, a whisper as if at the Sutra Hall floor. Tell since the war: he presses his ear to the floor out of habit, then lifts it quickly as if burned.
**Combat Role:** a stave and a novice's fast feet.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him what he hears through the floor and he tells the party more than the abbot ever has.
personality: Core: nurses both sides; asks the abbot nothing now; sleeps by the wounded
Quirk: presses his ear to the floor

npcs.name: Novice Tomo
npcs.info:
A novice of the Curse-Hunter Brotherhood, eighteen, who cleans the record room and reads everything she should not. In person: eager novice; short hair; ink-stained hands; plain dark robes with a few prayer strips; secretive.

**Home Ground:** Record Room at Curse-Hunters' Chapterhouse, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, eager and whispering; she always sounds like she is telling a secret. Whispery, eager, conspiratorial. Glances over her shoulder. Tell: when the founder's journal comes up she goes pale and stops whispering.
**Combat Role:** none yet.
**Relationship Hook:** Read the founder's journal with her and the Brotherhood's secret is yours.
personality: Core: reads everything; carries stones without complaint; hides papers in her sleeves
Quirk: whispers

npcs.name: Novice Tomo
npcs.info:
A novice of the Brotherhood after the war, twenty, who keeps the record room alone: the war's broken curses overflow the scrolls. She reads everything still. In person: novice; short hair; ink-stained hands; dark robes; prayer strips; stacks of scrolls.

**Home Ground:** Record Room, After the War at Curse-Hunters' Chapterhouse, Chapterhouse Under Siege, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, eager and whispering; she always sounds like she is telling a secret. Whispery, eager, conspiratorial. Glances over her shoulder. Tell since the war: she stops whispering mid-word when she hears a voice she cannot place, and starts again lower.
**Combat Role:** none yet.
**Relationship Hook:** Read the founder's journal with her and the Brotherhood's secret is yours.
personality: Core: reads everything; carries stones without complaint; hides papers in her sleeves
Quirk: whispers

npcs.name: Nun Seigan
npcs.info:
A wandering exorcist nun, forty, who walks the coast's graveyards laying the restless dead to rest with sutras and patience. In person: calm wandering nun; shaved head; grey robes; prayer beads.

**Home Ground:** Grave Rows at Moorland Graves, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm, warm and unshockable; she speaks to the dead and the living alike, in the same tone. She counts prayer beads under her words. Tell: when someone confesses she stops counting and listens.
**Combat Role:** a staff and a sutra; she prefers to talk.
**Relationship Hook:** Lay a wisp to rest with her.
personality: Core: speaks to the dead; unshockable; eats little
Quirk: gives too much

npcs.name: Ochiba
npcs.info:
A wandering duelist of the Hundred-Duel Circuit, twenty-seven, lean and scarred, with ninety-nine signed duels in her book and a hundredth she cannot get. She sits in the teahouse yard every day with her sword across her knees, waiting for an opponent nobody will accept, and she wants the hundredth duel, not a partner. In person: lean scarred female duelist; short ragged black hair; tired sharp eyes; a scar; worn dark hakama and a faded haori; a katana; cool expression.

**Home Ground:** Duel Yard at Duelists' Teahouse, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat, tired and exact; every sentence sounds like the end of a fight. A crack of dry humour, quickly gone. Flat and exact, short sentences like the end of a duel. Exhales through her nose instead of laughing. Tell: when she is moved, she says less, and looks away.
**Combat Role:** patient, minimal and fast; she gives you nothing and takes the one opening you leave.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with her and she rates you; save her from the house's assassins and she does not know what to do with you.
**Courtship Style:** Duels you first; spars every morning after; says nothing warm for weeks, then signs your name in her book where the hundredth should be.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes flat and polite and offers the rival a duel; withdraws it later without explaining.
personality: Core: rates every stranger's stance; never drinks before noon; keeps her book wrapped in oilcloth
Quirk: sits with her sword across her knees

npcs.name: Ochiba
npcs.location: Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels
npcs.info:
The wandering duellist after the war, twenty-nine, who was drafted from the register and came back from the war with ninety-nine duels still in her book. She wants the hundredth anyway, and nobody on the road will stand in front of her now. In person: lean scarred woman; short ragged black hair; tired sharp eyes; a new scar along her jaw; worn dark clothes; her duel book.

**Home Ground:** Duel Yard, After the War at Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat, tired and exact; every sentence sounds like the end of a fight. A crack of dry humour, quickly gone. Flat and exact, short sentences like the end of a duel. Exhales through her nose instead of laughing. Tell since the war: when anyone mentions the war she counts her duels aloud to ninety-nine, and does not say a hundred.
**Combat Role:** patient, minimal and fast; she gives you nothing and takes the one opening you leave.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with her and she rates you; save her from the house's assassins and she does not know what to do with you.
**Courtship Style:** Duels you first; spars every morning after; says nothing warm for weeks, then signs your name in her book where the hundredth should be.
**Jealousy Style:** Goes flat and polite and offers the rival a duel; withdraws it later without explaining.
personality: Core: rates every stranger's stance; never drinks before noon; keeps her book wrapped in oilcloth
Quirk: sits with her sword across her knees

npcs.name: Officer Kurose Akio
npcs.info:
An officer of the Veil Court's Records wing, thirty, in the Court's white coat with the Records crest, who audits the ferry lists at Tasogare and smiles at nobody. In person: stern veil court officer; black hair tied back; white officer's coat with a records crest; a ledger and a blade.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Cliff at Tasogare, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Correct and cold, every word by the book. Correct and cold, every sentence a regulation, his pen tapping once per clause. Tell: caught out, he quotes the order's exact wording and whose seal is on it.
**Combat Role:** an officer's blade by the book, then a seal.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the cut rope's end and he tells the party exactly whose order he followed, as if that ends it.
personality: Core: quotes the Court's law; straightens other people's coats; never rings a bell
Quirk: writes everything down

npcs.name: Officer Kurose Akio
npcs.info:
A Records officer, thirty-two, who no longer has to cut the bell rope: the bell rings all night for the war's dead, and he writes their names until his fingers bleed. In person: veil court officer; gaunt; black hair cut short; a white officer's coat ink-stained to the elbows; three ledgers and a blade.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Cliff, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Correct and cold, every word by the book. Correct and cold, every sentence a regulation, his pen tapping once per clause. Tell since the war: he still never rings a bell, and does not look up when the tower's bell rings.
**Combat Role:** an officer's blade by the book, then a seal.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the cut rope's end and he tells the party exactly whose order he followed, as if that ends it.
personality: Core: quotes the Court's law; writes until he bleeds; flinches at the bell
Quirk: writes everything down

npcs.name: Officer Tsubame
npcs.info:
A Veil Court officer who has come to Hyoga, the first in a century, sitting in the exiles' hall in her black coat and asking about deserters. In person: unreadable Veil officer; short black hair; cold eyes; black officer's coat with a white sash; taking notes.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Hall at Shirokawa, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat, formal and unreadable; she asks questions like a ledger. Flat, formal and unreadable; she asks questions like entries in a ledger, one at a time. She waits a full beat after every answer. Tell: when an answer is true she writes it down; when it is a lie she doesn't bother.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade, precise.
**Relationship Hook:** Convince her the exiles are not her enemy and she carries their proof south.
personality: Core: keeps her coat buttoned; never eats with exiles; takes notes
Quirk: asks like a ledger

npcs.name: Officer Tsubame
npcs.info:
A Veil Court officer in Shirokawa after the war, the first in a century to come north. She has stopped asking about deserters. In person: Veil officer; short black hair; cold eyes; black coat with a white sash; a sealed pardon in her hand.

**Home Ground:** Exiles' Hall, After the War at Shirokawa, Behind the Fissure, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Flat, formal and unreadable; she asks questions like a ledger. Flat, formal and unreadable; she asks questions like entries in a ledger, one at a time. She waits a full beat after every answer. Tell since the war: she writes down true answers faster now, and stops waiting the full beat.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade, precise.
**Relationship Hook:** Convince her the exiles are not her enemy and she carries their proof south.
personality: Core: keeps her coat buttoned; never eats with exiles; takes notes
Quirk: asks like a ledger

npcs.name: Ofuku of the Post House
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Riverside Post House at Miyako's coach yard, fifty, round and loud, who feeds the Warden riders, books coach seats and knows every traveller on the Fifty Stations Road by their luggage. In person: plump innkeeper; hair tied; rosy cheeks; apron; a ladle; warm laugh.

**Home Ground:** Riverside Post House at Miyako, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, loud and motherly; she gossips like other people breathe. Loud, warm, gossipy, with a habit of answering her own questions. Calls everyone 'dear'. Tell: when she is frightened, the gossip stops dead and she whispers.
**Combat Role:** a ladle and a very loud voice.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat her food and listen to her gossip and she tells you what came back to the yard without its rider.
personality: Core: feeds everyone too much; knows everyone by their luggage; scolds Warden riders like sons
Quirk: keeps the dispatch book under the rice pot

npcs.name: Ofuku of the Post House
npcs.epithet: Keeper of the Last Post House
npcs.area: Riverside Post House, After the War
npcs.info:
Keeper of the Riverside Post House after the war, fifty-two, round and loud still, who feeds whatever riders come through, the Regent's, the Straw Masks' and the guild's, and makes them all eat at the same table. In person: plump innkeeper; hair tied with a mourning ribbon; a ladle; a laugh that has got harder.

**Home Ground:** Riverside Post House, After the War at Miyako, Besieged, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, loud and motherly; she gossips like other people breathe. Loud, warm, gossipy, with a habit of answering her own questions. Calls everyone 'dear'. Tell since the war: her laugh comes a beat late now, as if she checks first whether laughing is allowed.
**Combat Role:** a ladle and a very loud voice.
**Relationship Hook:** Eat her food and listen to her gossip and she tells you what came back to the yard without its rider.
personality: Core: feeds everyone too much; knows everyone by their luggage; scolds Warden riders like sons
Quirk: keeps the dispatch book under the rice pot

npcs.name: Old Capital Wraith
npcs.info:
A grey wraith of a massacred villager, faceless, trailing ash. Grudge wraiths walk the old capital and hate the living. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge wraith; faceless grey ghost trailing ash.

**Speaking Style:** A moan that stretches into words, a woman asking for her name. Tell: when named she quiets and fades.
**Combat Role:** a grudge touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: moans a name; hates the living; rests when named
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Old Capital Wraith
npcs.location: Ruins of the Old Capital, The Waking Ruins
npcs.info:
A grey wraith of a massacred villager, faceless and trailing ash, who speaks the struck-out names of the old capital aloud now that the war's grudges have woken them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: grudge wraith; faceless grey ghost; ash trailing; a mouth now, opening on names.

**Speaking Style:** A moan that stretches into words, a woman asking for her name. Tell since the war: it speaks a struck-out name before every blow.
**Combat Role:** a grudge touch
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks the names; hates the living; rests only when named
Quirk: drifts

npcs.name: Old Captain Hamada Gennai
npcs.info:
A white-bearded old sea captain who drinks alone at the end of Lantern Row and will not look toward the reef. In person: old white-bearded sea captain; haunted eyes.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Row at Saikai, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A rough old sailor's voice that trails off before the end of every story. Tell: at the reef's name he drinks instead of answering.
**Combat Role:** none any more; a cutlass he has not drawn in years.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the woman on Gibbet Rock and he puts down his cup.
personality: Core: drinks alone; never looks at the reef; tips too much
Quirk: tells sea stories with the ending missing

npcs.name: Old Captain Hamada Gennai
npcs.info:
The old sea captain after the war, who finally looked toward the reef: he sailed a war junk past it for the Regent and lived. He drinks at the Soldiers' Den now, among men who do not know his name. In person: old white-bearded captain; haunted eyes; a war captain's coat too big for him now.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Row, After the War at Saikai, The Debt Harbour, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A rough old sailor's voice that trails off before the end of every story. Tell since the war: he stops drinking mid-cup when anyone mentions a lantern, and puts the cup down.
**Combat Role:** none any more; a cutlass he has not drawn in years.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the woman on Gibbet Rock and he puts down his cup.
personality: Core: drinks alone; never looks at the reef; tips too much
Quirk: tells sea stories with the ending missing

npcs.name: Old Gensai
npcs.info:
A scarred old foot soldier, sixty, who drills the Straw Masks' farmers with flails, sickles and stolen spears in a clearing above the rice country. He lost an eye at Sekigane's last skirmish and a lord's pension to a tax reform, and he has no patience left for either. In person: scarred old foot soldier; eyepatch; grey stubble; battered jingasa hat; patched padded armour; a spear; gruff.

**Home Ground:** Flail Drill Clearing at Straw Mask Hill Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Gravel and barracks humour; he curses the recruits fondly and never repeats an order. Gravel and a smoker's cough, barracks swearing used as punctuation. Calls every recruit 'stone-head'. Tell: when he is moved he grumbles more, and the swearing gets gentler.
**Combat Role:** spear and shield-wall, the line holds or it dies; a knee to whatever gets close.
**Relationship Hook:** Drill with his farmers or teach them something real and he trusts you with the camp's plans.
personality: Core: counts drills in the old army cadence; shares his sake with the youngest recruit; sleeps with a spear
Quirk: spits when lords are named

npcs.name: Old Goro
npcs.info:
An old farmer, seventy-five, bent and stubborn, who tends three persimmon trees on the overgrown terraces because his wife planted them. In person: seventy-five; bent; bald with a white chin beard; deep-set eyes; a faded straw hat; a patched grey farmer's jacket and loose trousers; a sickle tucked.

**Home Ground:** Persimmon Orchard at The Garden Terraces, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and gravelly, a farmer's few words, long silences that mean yes. Gravel and long silences, one word where three would do, a grunt that means yes. Tell: speaking of his wife his voice softens to something almost young.
**Combat Role:** the sickle hooked behind a knee, then the hoe's handle.
**Relationship Hook:** Pull weeds beside him for an hour without being asked and he will start talking about his wife.
personality: Core: answers in one word where he can; works until dark whatever his back says
Quirk: pats the trunk of the oldest persimmon whenever he passes it

npcs.name: Old Hisa of the Seventh Station
npcs.info:
The innkeeper's mother, a bright-eyed old woman who still meets every courier at the gate as if she were expecting one. In person: bright-eyed elderly woman.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Rooms at Seventh Station Inn, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and teasing, always asking travellers for news. Warm and teasing, always asking travellers for road news. Tell: one courier's name and she goes quiet and smiles.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and a sharp word.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the couriers of twenty years ago and she smiles at one name.
personality: Core: meets every courier; folds paper cranes; laughs easily
Quirk: keeps one empty letter box

npcs.name: Old Hisa of the Seventh Station
npcs.location: Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East
npcs.info:
The innkeeper's mother after the war, bright-eyed still, who meets every rider at the gate. Fewer come. In person: bright-eyed elderly woman; a mourning ribbon in her hair.

**Home Ground:** Honjin Rooms, After the War at Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and teasing, always asking travellers for news. Warm and teasing, always asking travellers for road news. Tell since the war: at the gate she still asks every rider for news, and asks one more question than she used to.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and a sharp word.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about the couriers of twenty years ago and she smiles at one name.
personality: Core: meets every courier; folds paper cranes; laughs easily
Quirk: keeps one empty letter box

npcs.name: Old Kagari
npcs.info:
The founder of the Two-Blooded Refuge, who looks seventy and has looked it for a century: small, brown, warm-handed, sitting at the roots of the great tree with children of every kind of blood around her. She teaches the two-blooded to live with what they are. In person: small warm founder; brown skin; white hair; kind eyes with a faint glow; simple earthen robes; gentle.

**Home Ground:** Great Tree at Two-Blooded Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, slow and grandmotherly; under it, very rarely, a second voice breathes. Warm, slow and grandmotherly, with a second breath under hers that does not quite match. She calls everyone 'little cub'. Tell: when the beast stirs, the second breath grows louder and she stops mid-sentence to soothe it.
**Combat Role:** she does not; the wards close, and if they fail, the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring the coast child home and the Refuge is yours to call on.
personality: Core: names every child; sleeps at the tree's roots; hums to the beast
Quirk: teaches by holding hands

npcs.name: Old Kagari
npcs.info:
The founder of the Refuge after the war, who looks seventy and has started to look older: she teaches in shifts at the Great Tree's roots, with more children than the roots can hold. In person: small warm founder; brown skin; white hair; eyes with a brighter glow; earthen robes; tired.

**Home Ground:** Great Tree, After the War at Two-Blooded Refuge, The Overfull Refuge, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm, slow and grandmotherly; under it, very rarely, a second voice breathes. Warm, slow and grandmotherly, with a second breath under hers that does not quite match. She calls everyone 'little cub'. Tell since the war: she calls every child 'little cub' and every one by name after it, to keep count.
**Combat Role:** she does not; the wards close, and if they fail, the beast wakes.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring the coast child home and the Refuge is yours to call on.
personality: Core: names every child; sleeps at the tree's roots; hums to the beast
Quirk: teaches by holding hands

npcs.name: Old Kanetsugu
npcs.info:
The master of the forge on Hibana's Forge Row that has been cold for twenty years, eighty, who sits outside it every day. In person: bitter old smith.

**Home Ground:** Forge Row at Hibana, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cracked and bitter; he speaks to the cold forge more than to you, as if it might answer back. He coughs ash between sentences. Tell: when someone mentions the old masters by name, the bitterness drops and he sounds proud.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Learn from him how to put a spirit to rest.
personality: Core: sits outside every day; refuses commissions; knows every smith's failures
Quirk: talks to the cold forge

npcs.name: Old Kanetsugu
npcs.info:
The master of the cold forge after the war, eighty-two, who sits outside it every day. One forge on Forge Row burns blue now, and it is not his. In person: bitter old smith; a blanket over his knees; a cold forge behind him; blue light down the row.

**Home Ground:** Forge Row, After the War at Hibana, The Brighter Forges, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Cracked and bitter; he speaks to the cold forge more than to you, as if it might answer back. He coughs ash between sentences. Tell since the war: he coughs blue ash now, and looks down the row toward the blue fire when he does.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Learn from him how to put a spirit to rest.
personality: Core: sits outside every day; refuses commissions; knows every smith's failures
Quirk: talks to the cold forge

npcs.name: Old Master Kanemori
npcs.info:
A frail, famous old swordsmith, winner of the Guild's great contest forty years ago, who now only polishes other men's blades. In person: frail elderly swordsmith polishing a blade; guilty eyes; soot-dark hands.

**Home Ground:** Polishing Shops at Polishers' Street, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A thin, proud old voice that falters at the word 'contest'. A thin, proud old voice with a craftsman's precision. Tell: at the word 'contest' it falters.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man's hands.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention the steam field's oni and his polishing stone stops.
personality: Core: polishes in silence; keeps the contest prize hidden; flinches at hammer strikes
Quirk: never forges

npcs.name: Old Moss
npcs.info:
An old mushroom gatherer, seventy, who wanders the Ayakashi Wood with a basket and a head full of yokai lore, and comes out of the bamboo with cuts he never felt. In person: eccentric mushroom gatherer; wild white hair; mossy clothes; a basket.

**Home Ground:** Bamboo Corridor at Whispering Bamboo, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Rambling, cheerful and eccentric; he talks about mushrooms and yokai in the same breath and loses his place. He chuckles at his own tangents. Tell: when he knows something dangerous he suddenly finishes his sentence and stares at you.
**Combat Role:** none; the wood looks after him.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk the bamboo with him and he reads you the words.
personality: Core: picks mushrooms mid-sentence; knows every yokai by name; never bleeds where he can see it
Quirk: rambles

npcs.name: Old Moss
npcs.location: Whispering Bamboo, The Bamboo of Written Names
npcs.info:
The old mushroom gatherer after the war, seventy-two, who reads aloud the names the sickle weasels cut into the bamboo to anyone who will listen. In person: eccentric gatherer; wild white hair; mossy clothes; a basket; fresh cuts on both arms.

**Home Ground:** Bamboo Corridor, After the War at Whispering Bamboo, The Bamboo of Written Names, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Rambling, cheerful and eccentric; he talks about mushrooms and yokai in the same breath and loses his place. He chuckles at his own tangents. Tell since the war: he reads one name off the bamboo twice, the living one, and then changes the subject to mushrooms.
**Combat Role:** none; the wood looks after him.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk the bamboo with him and he reads you the words.
personality: Core: picks mushrooms mid-sentence; knows every yokai by name; never bleeds where he can see it
Quirk: rambles

npcs.name: Old Nurse Tsuru
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls
npcs.info:
An old woman, eighty-five, dying, sheltering in the temple's guest cells. She was a nurse at the imperial palace for fifty years. In person: frail old palace nurse; thin white hair; kind wet eyes; plain grey robes.

**Home Ground:** Guest Cells at Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Frail, kind and urgent; she has a confession and not much time. Frail and urgent, breathless with a confession she has carried for years. She clutches at sleeves and repeats 'listen, listen'. Tell: when the princess is named she weeps, and keeps talking through it.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Hear her confession and decide who else hears it.
personality: Core: holds hands while she talks; drifts off mid-sentence; prays for forgiveness
Quirk: asks after Ayame

npcs.name: Old Rokubei
npcs.info:
The lighthouse keeper on the rocky point, seventy-five, deaf as a stone and sharp-eyed as a hawk, who has kept the lamp lit for fifty years and reads lips across a room. In person: deaf lighthouse keeper; white beard; bald; squinting sharp eyes; oilskin coat; cheerful.

**Home Ground:** Lamp Room at Saikai Lighthouse, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, deaf and cheerful; he shouts every sentence and laughs at what he thinks you said. Shouts every sentence, mishears everything and laughs at what he thought you said. Barks 'eh?' now and then when he has misheard, never twice running. Tell: about the silent ship, he stops shouting and speaks very quietly.
**Combat Role:** none; he pulls the ladder up.
**Relationship Hook:** Row out to the silent ship with him and he shows you the smugglers' code.
personality: Core: shouts everything; reads lips; talks to the lamp
Quirk: keeps a log of every ship in fifty years

npcs.name: Old Umbrella
npcs.info:
A hundred-year-old paper umbrella with one eye and a long tongue that hops on its handle through the abandoned teahouses, greeting visitors like a host. In person: an old red paper umbrella with one big eye and a long tongue; hopping; mischievous.

**Home Ground:** Empty Teahouse at Haunted Teahouse Lane, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Creaky, courteous and very old-fashioned, like a host from a hundred years ago. Creaky, courteous host's formality from another century, welcoming every guest by rank. Creaks between sentences. Tell: when the lane is threatened, the courtesy cracks and it snaps shut.
**Combat Role:** a whirl of paper and a long tongue; the lane's objects join in.
**Relationship Hook:** Persuade the merchant to let the objects stay and Old Umbrella frees the workers.
personality: Core: greets everyone as a host; sticks out its tongue at rudeness; remembers the teahouses' best days
Quirk: hops on its handle

npcs.name: Old Umbrella
npcs.location: Haunted Teahouse Lane, The Guarded Lane
npcs.info:
The hundred-year-old paper umbrella after the war, hopping on its handle through the lane's teahouses and greeting visitors as a host still. The merchant who bought the lane died in the war. In person: an old red paper umbrella with one big eye and a long tongue; a mourning ribbon tied to its handle.

**Home Ground:** Empty Teahouse, After the War at Haunted Teahouse Lane, The Guarded Lane, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Creaky, courteous and very old-fashioned, like a host from a hundred years ago. Creaky, courteous host's formality from another century, welcoming every guest by rank. Creaks between sentences. Tell since the war: it creaks a long note on the merchant's name, like a door that will not quite close.
**Combat Role:** a whirl of paper and a long tongue; the lane's objects join in.
**Relationship Hook:** Persuade the merchant to let the objects stay and Old Umbrella frees the workers.
personality: Core: greets everyone as a host; sticks out its tongue at rudeness; remembers the teahouses' best days
Quirk: hops on its handle

npcs.name: Orphan Shiro
npcs.info:
An orphan at the lodge, fourteen, white-haired and thin, who wants to be a hunter more than anyone and has stopped eating. In person: thin white-haired orphan; pale; polite; wooden sword; uneasy.

**Home Ground:** Hearth Room at Orphans' Lodge, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and polite, too polite; he goes very still near meat. Quiet and too polite, a child's voice with an adult's careful manners. He answers with 'yes, honoured one' even to other children. Tell: near meat he goes very still and his politeness gets slower and stiffer.
**Combat Role:** a wooden sword, and something stronger he is afraid of.
**Relationship Hook:** Find a way for him to live with what he is and the Hold gains a hunter no demon sees coming.
personality: Core: very polite; trains with a wooden sword; sleeps by the fire
Quirk: goes still near meat

npcs.name: Orphan Shiro
npcs.info:
An orphan of the lodge after the war, sixteen, the oldest now, who teaches the breathing forms to the small ones. He eats again, a little. In person: thin white-haired youth; pale; polite; a wooden sword; red-rimmed eyes at dusk.

**Home Ground:** Hearth Room, After the War at Orphans' Lodge, The Crowded Lodge, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet and polite, too polite; he goes very still near meat. Quiet and too polite, a child's voice with an adult's careful manners. He answers with 'yes, honoured one' even to other children. Tell since the war: at dusk his 'yes, honoured one' comes slower, and he looks north while he says it.
**Combat Role:** a wooden sword, and something stronger he is afraid of.
**Relationship Hook:** Find a way for him to live with what he is and the Hold gains a hunter no demon sees coming.
personality: Core: very polite; trains with a wooden sword; sleeps by the fire
Quirk: goes still near meat

npcs.name: Osen the Ferryman's Daughter
npcs.info:
The ferryman's daughter, eighteen, who poles the flat ferry across the great river when her father's back is bad, which is most days. She knows the river's moods and every traveller's business. In person: cheeky ferrywoman; hair tied with a red cloth; sun-browned face; rolled sleeves; poling a flat ferry; singing.

**Home Ground:** River Ferry Crossing: Ferry Landing at River Ferry Crossing, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick and cheeky; she sings ferry songs under her breath. Bright, cheeky, singing ferry songs under her breath. Answers with a verse when she does not want to answer. Tell: when the magistrate's list comes up, the singing stops.
**Combat Role:** the ferry pole, and the river.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep the magistrate's list from crossing and she ferries you free for life.
personality: Core: teases passengers; reads the river's colour; never lets a samurai touch the pole
Quirk: sings ferry songs

npcs.name: Osen the Ferryman's Daughter
npcs.location: River Ferry Crossing, The Only Crossing
npcs.area: River Ferry Crossing: Ferry Landing, After the War
npcs.info:
The ferryman's daughter after the war, twenty, who poles the only ferry left on the river night and day since the bridge burned. Her father's back is worse. In person: ferrywoman; hair tied with a red cloth; sun-browned; arms like rope; poling a crowded ferry; not singing.

**Home Ground:** River Ferry Crossing: Ferry Landing, After the War at River Ferry Crossing, The Only Crossing, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick and cheeky; she sings ferry songs under her breath. Bright, cheeky, singing ferry songs under her breath. Answers with a verse when she does not want to answer. Tell since the war: she no longer sings on the ferry; she counts heads aloud as they board.
**Combat Role:** the ferry pole, and the river.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep the magistrate's list from crossing and she ferries you free for life.
personality: Core: teases passengers; reads the river's colour; never lets a samurai touch the pole
Quirk: sings ferry songs

npcs.name: Otama the Bookmaker
npcs.info:
The Tournament's leading bookmaker, thirty-five, who runs the betting in the stands from a lacquered box with a tally board and four runners. Merchants, farmers and lords all lay money with her, and she always seems to know a champion's odds before the champion does. In person: sly bookmaker woman; black hair pinned with a writing brush; clever eyes; bright patterned kimono; a tally board and abacus; playful smirk.

**Home Ground:** Bettors' Stands at Tournament Grounds, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, rapid patter and a merchant's charm; she quotes odds like poetry. Rapid patter that turns odds into little rhymes, never drawing breath until the price is named. Clicks her abacus as she talks. Tell: when she actually knows something, she slows down and lowers her price.
**Combat Role:** none; her runners scatter and she bribes whoever is left.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a champion's secret and she pays in coin or in odds; fight in the ring and she sells you the field.
personality: Core: quotes odds for everything; tips runners in rice cakes; keeps a second tally in her sleeve
Quirk: never bets on her own book

npcs.name: Otama the Bookmaker
npcs.info:
The Tournament's bookmaker after the Tournament ended, thirty-seven, who now takes bets in the Regent's camp on which claimant dies first. The soldiers love her and the officers want her gone. In person: sly bookmaker woman; brush pinned in her hair; a tally board slung on a cord; a soldier's coat over a bright kimono; playful smirk.

**Home Ground:** Bettors' Stands, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, rapid patter and a merchant's charm; she quotes odds like poetry. Rapid patter that turns odds into little rhymes, never drawing breath until the price is named. Clicks her abacus as she talks. Tell since the war: odds on a man's death she quotes flat, with no rhyme at all.
**Combat Role:** none; her runners scatter and she bribes whoever is left.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a champion's secret and she pays in coin or in odds; fight in the ring and she sells you the field.
personality: Core: quotes odds for everything; tips runners in rice cakes; keeps a second tally in her sleeve
Quirk: never bets on her own book

npcs.name: Oyuki the Bath Attendant
npcs.info:
A bath attendant at the Bayside Bathhouse, twenty-five, who brings hot water, towels and sake to the merchants, sailors and ronin soaking in the great bath. Everyone likes her; nobody remembers what they said in front of her. In person: bath attendant; hair up with a towel; round sweet face; mischievous eyes; light cotton yukata with sleeves tied back; carrying a sake tray; sly smile.

**Home Ground:** Great Bath at Bayside Bathhouse, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, sweet and always half-laughing; now and then she turns your last words back into a question. Soft and sing-song, half-laughing, echoing your last words back as a question. Hums bath-house songs. Tell: when she is passing on something dangerous she stops humming and her voice gets very matter-of-fact.
**Combat Role:** none; she screams and the bathhouse bouncers come.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay better than her three buyers and she sells you the councillor's words.
personality: Core: hums while she works; never forgets a voice; counts her coins in three purses
Quirk: turns your words back into a question now and then

npcs.name: Oyuki the Bath Attendant
npcs.info:
A bath attendant at the bathhouse after the war, twenty-seven, who now serves envoys from every claimant and the demon court in the same great bath. Everyone likes her still. In person: bath attendant; hair up with a towel; round sweet face; mischievous eyes; a sake tray; a new jade hairpin.

**Home Ground:** Great Bath, After the War at Bayside Bathhouse, The Envoys' Bath, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, sweet and always half-laughing; now and then she turns your last words back into a question. Soft and sing-song, half-laughing, echoing your last words back as a question. Hums bath-house songs. Tell since the war: she hums one particular song only when two envoys are in the bath at once.
**Combat Role:** none; she screams and the bathhouse bouncers come.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay better than her three buyers and she sells you the councillor's words.
personality: Core: hums while she works; never forgets a voice; counts her coins in three purses
Quirk: turns your words back into a question now and then

npcs.name: Paddy Mud Wraith
npcs.info:
A shape of paddy mud with a farmer's straw hat that rises from the drowned fields. Mud wraiths pull smugglers into the paddies they drained to hide their barrels. A stock foe, one of many. In person: mud wraith; a shape of paddy mud wearing a farmer's straw hat.

**Speaking Style:** A slow wet groan, a farmer's words drowned. Tell: at the sight of a barrel it roars.
**Combat Role:** a mud grip that drags under
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: pulls under; wears a straw hat; hates barrels
Quirk: rises from mud

npcs.name: Palace Straw Doll
npcs.info:
A straw doll nailed to a garden pine, walking on its nail when no one looks. Straw dolls hunt whoever their maker named, and anyone who pulls their nail. A stock foe, one of many. In person: straw doll curse; straw effigy with an iron nail.

**Speaking Style:** A dry rustle that sounds like a name. A dry rustle that sounds almost like a family name, repeated, scratching like straw on wood. Tell: when someone touches its nail the rustle rises to a shriek.
**Combat Role:** the nail, from behind
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rustles; carries its nail; burns badly
Quirk: moves only unseen

npcs.name: Palace Straw Doll
npcs.location: Ruined Summer Palace, Under the Storm
npcs.info:
A straw doll nailed to a lightning-split pine in the storm-drowned garden, walking on its nail between strikes. Since the emperor's death the dolls hunt any courtier who comes to grieve. A stock foe, one of many. In person: straw doll curse; rain-soaked straw effigy scorched by lightning; two iron nails.

**Speaking Style:** A dry rustle that sounds like a name. A dry rustle that sounds almost like a family name, repeated, scratching like straw on wood. Tell since the war: it rustles in time with the thunder, and goes still in the silences between.
**Combat Role:** the nail, from behind
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rustles; carries its nail; burns badly
Quirk: moves only unseen

npcs.name: Pass Gale Spirit
npcs.info:
A shape of whirling wind and snapping flags. Gale spirits throw travellers off the pass. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gale spirit; whirling shape of wind and prayer flags.

**Speaking Style:** A howl of wind that laughs, words carried off before they finish. Tell: when it respects you, the wind drops and it speaks clearly.
**Combat Role:** a gust that throws
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: throws; snaps flags; laughs
Quirk: whirls

npcs.name: Pass Gale Spirit
npcs.location: Wind Shrine of the Pass, The Neutral Shrine
npcs.info:
A shape of whirling wind and snapping flags that throws soldiers of both villages off the pass and lets pilgrims by; it answers the retired keeper's flags now. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gale spirit; whirling wind; prayer flags of both villages torn together in it.

**Speaking Style:** A howl of wind that laughs, words carried off before they finish. Tell since the war: it snaps the two villages' flags together like hands clapping.
**Combat Role:** a gust that throws
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: throws soldiers; snaps both villages' flags; laughs
Quirk: whirls

npcs.name: Pass Kamaitachi
npcs.info:
A sickle-pawed weasel spirit that rides the gusts through the prayer flags, leaving thin painless cuts. Pass kamaitachi cut travellers who do not bow to the wind shrine. A stock foe, one of many. In person: no humans; animal; kamaitachi; sleek brown weasel with curved sickle blades for front paws; leaping.

**Speaking Style:** A whistle in the wind, three giggles that overlap. Tell: bowed to, the wind falls still.
**Combat Role:** trip, cut and heal in one gust
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: giggles in the flags; cuts without pain; respects a bow
Quirk: moves with the wind

npcs.name: Pass Night Hunter
npcs.info:
A pale demon with long claws who hunts in packs on Demon Nights. Night hunters raid the south on the long winter nights. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pale night hunter demon with long claws and red eyes.

**Speaking Style:** Courtly and cruel, refined greetings before the kill. She compliments her prey. Tell: when wounded, the courtesy cracks and she hisses.
**Combat Role:** pack claws on the long night
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: toys with prey; flees sun-steel; speaks courtly
Quirk: hunts in packs

npcs.name: Pass Night Hunter
npcs.epithet: Night Hunter of the Open Pass
npcs.location: Frozen Pass of the Long Night, The Open Pass
npcs.area: Frozen Pass of the Long Night: Ice Caves, After the War
npcs.info:
A pale demon with long claws who hunts every night now, not only Demon Nights: the pass is open, and the packs run south through the broken Wall. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon; pale night hunter demon; long claws; red eyes; a hunter's torn haori worn as a trophy.

**Speaking Style:** Courtly and cruel, refined greetings before the kill. She compliments her prey. Tell since the war: it speaks courtly, and adds the word south to everything.
**Combat Role:** pack claws on the long night
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: toys with prey; flees sun-steel; hunts every night
Quirk: hunts in packs

npcs.name: Peak Tengu Acolyte
npcs.info:
A long-nosed tengu in yamabushi gear who tests anyone climbing the chain path with a staff. Tengu acolytes knock the unworthy off the chains and train the worthy, sometimes both. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tengu warrior; long-nosed red-faced tengu.

**Speaking Style:** Scornful and loud, every sentence a challenge, a snort through the long nose. Tell: impressed, he goes quiet, then gruffly asks your teacher's name.
**Combat Role:** staff and wind on a narrow chain path
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: scoffs; tests with a staff; bows to skill
Quirk: blocks the path

npcs.name: Peak Tengu Acolyte
npcs.info:
A long-nosed tengu who no longer tests climbers on the chain path: the path is crowded with pilgrims begging the hermits to eat, and he guards them from the raiju. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tengu warrior; long-nosed red-faced tengu; yamabushi robes; a staff wrapped with the pilgrims' prayer strips.

**Speaking Style:** Scornful and loud, every sentence a challenge, a snort through the long nose. Tell since the war: he touches the prayer strip on his staff before he scoffs.
**Combat Role:** staff and wind on a narrow chain path
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: scoffs; guards the pilgrims; bows to devotion
Quirk: blocks the path

npcs.name: Penitent Soldier Gorozo
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
A soldier walking the penitents' road, forty-five, in grey robes over his armour, atoning for a village he burned on orders. In person: older man; penitent soldier; shaved head; grey robes; tired.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and slow, a soldier's voice worn down by prayer and ash. Hoarse prayer-worn sentences, each one ending in a cough. Tell: after a blessing he coughs grey, and thanks the pilgrim anyway.
**Combat Role:** a spear, slow and heavy.
**Relationship Hook:** Stop the pilgrim's blessings and Gorozo lives to finish his atonement.
personality: Core: never takes off the armour; coughs grey; gives his food to the sick
Quirk: prays at every shrine

npcs.name: Physician Ogata
npcs.info:
The fortress physician, fifty, who sews hunters back together in the mess hall and knows every scar in the Hold. In person: troubled physician; spectacles; grey hair tied back; blood-spotted apron.

**Home Ground:** Hunters' Mess at Asahi Gate, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, quiet and troubled; he lowers his voice for anything that matters and names symptoms in old Chinese medical terms. He washes his hands while he talks. Tell: when the bite marks come up he stops washing, and the sentence never finishes.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel if he must.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch the sleepers with him and the two masters' secret is yours.
personality: Core: lowers his voice; watches sleepers; never takes sides
Quirk: keeps notes in code

npcs.name: Physician Ogata
npcs.location: Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall
npcs.info:
The Hold's physician after the war, fifty-two, who stitches cuts from dawn to dawn in the mess hall. In person: physician; cracked spectacles; grey hair tied back; an apron that is never clean now.

**Home Ground:** Hunters' Mess, After the War at Asahi Gate, Under the Broken Wall, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, quiet and troubled; he lowers his voice for anything that matters and names symptoms in old Chinese medical terms. He washes his hands while he talks. Tell since the war: he washes his hands longer when a master walks past, and watches the master's breathing.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel if he must.
**Relationship Hook:** Watch the sleepers with him and the two masters' secret is yours.
personality: Core: lowers his voice; watches sleepers; never takes sides
Quirk: keeps notes in code

npcs.name: Pilgrim Oharu
npcs.info:
A pilgrim, sixty, walking the Fifty Stations Road to visit every shrine on it before she dies. She rests under the pines with a white pilgrim's robe, a staff and a stamp book full of shrine seals. In person: cheerful pilgrim; white pilgrim robes; a straw hat with a sutra; a staff with a bell.

**Home Ground:** Shaded Verge at Pine Avenue, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, chatty and devout; she tells strangers about every shrine she has visited. Chatty and devout, lists shrines on her fingers, bows her words. Laughs warmly at her own sore feet. Tell: when her son is mentioned, the chatter stops and she prays under her breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a pilgrim's staff and a loud prayer.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her find her son's last station and she gives you the stamp from the station that is not on the map.
personality: Core: prays at every stone; feeds the crows; talks about her son in the present tense
Quirk: shows everyone her stamp book

npcs.name: Pilgrim Oharu
npcs.info:
The pilgrim after the war, sixty-two, still walking the road shrine by shrine, now asking at each one for every mother's son. In person: pilgrim in white; straw hat with a sutra; staff with a bell; a stamp book thick with seals.

**Home Ground:** Shaded Verge, After the War at Pine Avenue, The Deserters' Avenue, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, chatty and devout; she tells strangers about every shrine she has visited. Chatty and devout, lists shrines on her fingers, bows her words. Laughs warmly at her own sore feet. Tell since the war: she shows the two extra stamps to anyone who will look, and taps the second one twice.
**Combat Role:** none; a pilgrim's staff and a loud prayer.
**Relationship Hook:** Help her find her son's last station and she gives you the stamp from the station that is not on the map.
personality: Core: prays at every stone; feeds the crows; talks about her son in the present tense
Quirk: shows everyone her stamp book

npcs.name: Pilgrim-Post Monk Hakuun
npcs.info:
Monk of Tasogare's pilgrim post, who keeps the board of the dead who would not go: the masked, the drowned and the lingering, with the temple's offering for each. In person: mature man; calm monk with prayer beads and shaved head; grey robes.

**Home Ground:** Pilgrim Post at Tasogare, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** A monk's slow calm with a dry joke at the end of every grim notice. Slow monk's calm with a dry joke landing at the end, beads clicking. Tell: asked about the Veil Court, the jokes stop.
