npcs.info:
Monk of Tasogare's pilgrim post after the war, who keeps the board of the dead who would not go. The board runs the length of the post's wall now. In person: calm monk with prayer beads; shaved head; grey robes; a wall of names behind him.

**Home Ground:** Pilgrim Post, After the War at Tasogare, The Long Procession, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** A monk's slow calm with a dry joke at the end of every grim notice. Slow monk's calm with a dry joke landing at the end, beads clicking. Tell since the war: his dry joke at the end of a notice comes slower, as if he is checking whether it is still allowed.
**Combat Role:** a monk's staff and a ferry rite he swore never to use.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring proof a mask is ended and he tells you why he left the Veil Court.
personality: Core: jokes about death; counts prayer beads; will not cross the Veil again
Quirk: watches the torii

npcs.name: Pilgrim-Road Crow Tengu
npcs.info:
A crow-headed man in a monk's black robes who steals pilgrims' offerings from the hostel eaves. Crow tengu rob the faithful and beat the proud, then lecture them on humility. A stock foe, one of many. In person: crow tengu; crow-headed man.

**Speaking Style:** A cawing lecture, pompous and precise, a harsh 'kaa' for punctuation. Tell: met with real piety he stops cawing and speaks like the monk he was.
**Combat Role:** a dive from the eaves and a feather blade
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: lectures; steals shiny things; respects real piety
Quirk: caws when amused

npcs.name: Pilgrim-Road Crow Tengu
npcs.location: Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns
npcs.info:
A crow-headed man in a monk's black robes who no longer steals from the hostel: the war's families light lanterns there, and he guards the offerings and keeps the hostel's ledger of names. A stock foe, one of many. In person: crow tengu; crow-headed man; black monk robes; a hostel ledger tucked under one wing; a string of prayer beads.

**Speaking Style:** A cawing lecture, pompous and precise, a harsh 'kaa' for punctuation. Tell since the war: he caws when amused, then says a prayer to cover it.
**Combat Role:** a dive from the eaves and a feather blade
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: lectures; guards the offerings; prays badly
Quirk: caws when amused

npcs.name: Pine Avenue Highwayman
npcs.info:
A ragged highwayman in a stolen post-rider's coat with a rusty sword and a straw hat pulled low. Highwaymen wait under the pines for lone travellers and rob them politely. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ragged highwayman; rusty sword; straw hat pulled low.

**Speaking Style:** Apologetic and polite, bowing in his voice. Tell: at a horse's hooves he whispers and hides.
**Combat Role:** a polite demand, a rusty sword, a run into the pines
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: apologises; hides from horses; keeps the rider's coat clean
Quirk: bows before robbing

npcs.name: Pit Clan Stone-Watcher
npcs.info:
A woman in earth-brown wraps with a blow-pipe, keeper of the old clan stones above the pits. Stone-watchers kill anyone who disturbs the stones, and feed them to the spiders. A stock foe, one of many. In person: earth-clan watcher.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and old, an accent from three centuries ago, words placed like stones. Tell: a gift laid at the stones warms her voice by a single degree.
**Combat Role:** darts from cover, then the pits
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks the old tongue; feeds the spiders; honours a gift at the stones
Quirk: watches from cover

npcs.name: Pit Clan Stone-Watcher
npcs.location: Earth Spider Pits, The Spider's Bargain
npcs.info:
A woman in earth-brown wraps whose clan stones stand inside a Hayate stronghold now; the spider made its bargain and she keeps the stones under another clan's flag. A stock foe, one of many. In person: earth-clan watcher; earth-brown wraps; a blow-pipe; a Hayate wind-sash tied over the old clan wrap.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and old, an accent from three centuries ago, words placed like stones. Tell since the war: she speaks the old tongue only when Hayate cannot hear.
**Combat Role:** darts from cover, then the pits
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks the old tongue; keeps the stones under a new flag; watches Hayate
Quirk: watches from cover

npcs.name: Pit Tsuchigumo
npcs.info:
A long-legged spider the size of a horse with a tiger-striped body, waiting in a web-roofed pit. Earth spiders drop from their pits on anyone who walks the clan stones. A stock foe, one of many. In person: giant long-legged spider with a tiger-striped body.

**Speaking Style:** Clicking. Dry clicking in a quickening rhythm, a hiss of silk drawn out. Tell: a bell rung near the pit makes the clicking scatter.
**Combat Role:** a drop from the web and the drag down
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drops; drags into the pit; hates bells
Quirk: waits under the web

npcs.name: Pit Tsuchigumo
npcs.location: Earth Spider Pits, The Spider's Bargain
npcs.info:
A long-legged spider the size of a horse that answers Hayate's bells now, the bargain of the old clans finally made; it drops on anyone who comes without the village's signal. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tsuchigumo; giant long-legged spider with a tiger-striped body; a Hayate wind-charm wired to one leg.

**Speaking Style:** Clicking. Dry clicking in a quickening rhythm, a hiss of silk drawn out. Tell since the war: it flinches at every bell but one.
**Combat Role:** a drop from the web and the drag down
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drops on signal; drags into the pit; obeys a bell
Quirk: waits under the web

npcs.name: Plain Boar
npcs.info:
A tusked wild boar, bristling and mud-caked. Boars raid the paddies at night and charge anyone who corners them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tusked wild boar; mud-caked.

**Speaking Style:** Grunts, quick and wet, rising into a squeal when it turns. It snorts at the ground. Tell: a long squeal means it is about to run, not fight.
**Combat Role:** a straight charge
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: charges straight; never turns; squeals
Quirk: roots at night

npcs.name: Plain Boar
npcs.location: Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields
npcs.info:
A tusked boar grown fat on the war's ruined paddies, rooting the broken dikes by day now that nobody guards the fields. A stock foe, one of many. In person: tusked wild boar; heavier, with a spear scar down one flank; caked in flood mud.

**Speaking Style:** Grunts, quick and wet, rising into a squeal when it turns. It snorts at the ground. Tell since the war: it grunts at the sound of a spade, as if it has learned what spades mean.
**Combat Role:** a straight charge
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: charges straight; feeds by day; fears nothing on the dikes now
Quirk: roots at night

npcs.name: Poet Ariwake
npcs.info:
A disgraced court poet, forty, drifting between pleasure boats on the lake with a brush, a flask and no money, writing verses for anyone who pays. In person: disgraced poet; loose long hair; tired witty eyes; faded court robes; a brush and flask.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Boat at Lakeside Pleasure Boats, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Languid, witty and sad; he speaks in allusions to old poems and assumes you know them. He sighs before the best lines. Tell: when he is moved he forgets the allusions and says something simple.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay for a poem and he writes the one that got him dismissed.
personality: Core: writes on anything; drinks; laughs at his own disgrace
Quirk: speaks in allusions

npcs.name: Poet Ariwake
npcs.location: Lakeside Pleasure Boats, The Envoys' Boats
npcs.info:
The disgraced court poet after the war, forty-two, whose poem about the emperor's year-long sleep turned out to be a poem about his death. Every courtier quotes it now. In person: disgraced poet; loose long hair; tired witty eyes; faded court robes with a mourning cord; a brush and flask.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Boat, After the War at Lakeside Pleasure Boats, The Envoys' Boats, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Languid, witty and sad; he speaks in allusions to old poems and assumes you know them. He sighs before the best lines. Tell since the war: he quotes his own poem bitterly, one line short, and lets the listener finish it.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Pay for a poem and he writes the one that got him dismissed.
personality: Core: writes on anything; drinks; laughs at his own disgrace
Quirk: speaks in allusions

npcs.name: Ponta of the Tanuki Market
npcs.info:
The fattest, jolliest tanuki of the night market, who runs the biggest stall and sells anything for money that turns to leaves at dawn. In person: fat jolly raccoon-dog yokai; a sake jug.

**Home Ground:** Leaf-Money Stalls at Tanuki Market, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Jolly, booming and shameless; he sells you the moon and throws in the stars. Jolly, booming salesmanship, utterly shameless, slapping his belly at the punchline. Every price comes with a story. Tell: when the auction is mentioned he drops to a whisper and looks over both shoulders.
**Combat Role:** a disguise, a trick, and running away laughing.
**Relationship Hook:** Find the leaf-money buyer and he pays you in something real.
personality: Core: laughs at his own jokes; sells anything; never pays in real coin
Quirk: drums his belly

npcs.name: Ponta of the Tanuki Market
npcs.location: Tanuki Market, Market of the Soldiers' Pay
npcs.info:
The fattest tanuki of the night market after the war, jollier than ever: soldiers spend their back pay at his stall, some of it his own leaves. In person: fat jolly raccoon-dog yokai; a straw hat; a sake jug; a nervous eye on the market's edge.

**Home Ground:** Leaf-Money Stalls, After the War at Tanuki Market, Market of the Soldiers' Pay, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Jolly, booming and shameless; he sells you the moon and throws in the stars. Jolly, booming salesmanship, utterly shameless, slapping his belly at the punchline. npcs.name: Porter Boss Okane
npcs.location: Porters' Lodge, Porters for the Army
npcs.info:
The porters' new boss, thirty-eight, broad as a door, who took up Big Ushi's carrying pole when he died bringing the wounded off the road. The lodge carries for the army now, for half the old rates. In person: broad porter woman; muscular arms; headband; short sleeves; a huge carrying pole; porters' lodge.

**Home Ground:** Bunk Room, After the War at Porters' Lodge, Porters for the Army, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Big-voiced and cheerful, a carrier's breath in every sentence, calls everyone by what they can lift. Big and breathless, every sentence carried like a load, calls people by what they can lift. Tell: asked about the scrip she lifts something heavy and answers with her back turned.
**Combat Role:** the carrying pole, swung like a club.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her porters paid in real coin and the lodge carries for you at old rates.
personality: Core: sizes people up by their shoulders; never sits while others stand; keeps Ushi's pole upright
Quirk: sings carrying songs

npcs.name: Porter Tamae
npcs.info:
A mountain porter who carries loads across the hanging bridge three times a day, singing to keep her feet. In person: sturdy cheerful mountain porter with a huge load crossing a swaying rope bridge; singing.

**Home Ground:** The Hanging Bridge at Hanging Bridge Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and breathless, a porter who sings to keep her balance on the bridge. Cheerful and breathless, a work song under every sentence. Tell: when the ropes are mentioned the song stops.
**Combat Role:** a carrying pole and a push off the edge.
**Relationship Hook:** Cross with her and she shows you the thinning rope.
personality: Core: carries twice her weight; counts the ropes; laughs at the wind
Quirk: sings on the bridge

npcs.name: Post Clerk Tsuge Hanbei

**Speaking Style:** Dry, patient and official; he reads every notice in the same flat voice, deaths included. Flat and official, every sentence ends like a stamp coming down, distances in ri and stations. Tell: when the commissioner is named his voice goes a shade too careful.
**Combat Role:** none; he closes the barrier and calls the guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Earn his trust on three bounties and he hands you the missing list.
personality: Core: stamps twice; speaks in road distances; dislikes the commissioner
Quirk: keeps tea for hunters

npcs.name: Post Clerk Tsuge Hanbei
npcs.info:
Clerk of Oiwake's board after the war, fifty-two, who posts the Straw Masks' notices now that they hold the station, and stamps every claim twice still. In person: post-road clerk with seal and ink stone; plain grey robes; a straw mask hung on the board's corner.

**Home Ground:** Toll Barrier, After the War at Oiwake Station, Behind the Barricade, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, patient and official; he reads every notice in the same flat voice, deaths included. personality: Core: stamps twice; speaks in road distances; dislikes the commissioner
Quirk: keeps tea for hunters

npcs.name: Post-Road Wanyudo
npcs.info:
A burning ox-cart wheel with a tormented monk's face at the hub, rolling down from the hill shrine at night. Wanyudo take the souls of those who look at them; shut eyes and running water save travellers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: wanyudo; burning ox cart wheel with a tormented monk's face; rolling down a hill.

**Speaking Style:** A tormented groan, a monk's sutra scorched. Tell: with eyes shut against it, its voice fades.
**Combat Role:** a burning roll and a stare that takes souls
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: burns; stares; screams
Quirk: rolls

npcs.name: Powder-Keeper Hamaguchi
npcs.info:
A careful soldier of the old coast fort's garrison who keeps the powder store's keys at night and counts the kegs. In person: weary soldier guarding a dim powder store full of kegs; spear; careful.

**Home Ground:** Powder Store at Old Coast Fort, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and careful, a powder-keeper who never raises his voice near the kegs. Slow and careful, never louder than a murmur near the kegs. Tell: asked how much powder is left, he counts aloud and loses his place.
**Combat Role:** a spear in a doorway, never a flame.
**Relationship Hook:** Keep his name out of it and he tells you who carried the kegs out.
personality: Core: whispers near kegs; never lights a pipe; looks away at night
Quirk: counts kegs every hour

npcs.name: Powder-Keeper Hamaguchi
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
A soldier of the old coast fort after the war, who walked home with the garrison and then walked back alone to find out where the powder went. In person: weary soldier; a spear; an empty powder store behind him; careful.

**Home Ground:** Powder Store, After the War at Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and careful, a powder-keeper who never raises his voice near the kegs. Slow and careful, never louder than a murmur near the kegs. Tell since the war: he counts the kegs aloud and then stops, and listens to the store.
**Combat Role:** a spear in a doorway, never a flame.

npcs.name: Priest Enju
npcs.info:
The priest of the shrine on the crater's rim, sixty, who blesses smiths' first blades in the mountain's name. In person: haunted volcano priest; white robes stained with ash; listening.

**Home Ground:** Rim Altar at Crater Rim Shrine, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and haunted; he stops to listen to something you cannot hear. Soft and haunted; he stops mid-sentence to listen to something you cannot hear, then carries on as if nothing happened. He rings a hand bell to close a thought. Tell: when the forges are named, he hears the voices louder and covers one ear.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Carry his letter off the isle.
personality: Core: blesses every blade; sleeps on the rim; writes letters
Quirk: stops to listen

npcs.name: Priest Enju
npcs.location: Crater Rim Shrine, The Rim of Many Blades
npcs.info:
The crater rim's priest after the war, sixty-two, chanting over war blades and first blades from dawn to dusk, his white robes grey to the hem. In person: haunted volcano priest; ash-grey robes; a crowded altar; listening.

**Home Ground:** Rim Altar, After the War at Crater Rim Shrine, The Rim of Many Blades, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and haunted; he stops to listen to something you cannot hear. Soft and haunted; he stops mid-sentence to listen to something you cannot hear, then carries on as if nothing happened. He rings a hand bell to close a thought. Tell since the war: he covers both ears now, not one, and keeps speaking.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Carry his letter off the isle.
personality: Core: blesses every blade; sleeps on the rim; writes letters
Quirk: stops to listen

npcs.name: Priest Kaison
npcs.info:
The priest of the Temple of Safe Voyages, fifty, a former sailor with tattooed arms under his robes, who rings the bell for every ship that comes home and hangs a carved ship from the rafters for every one that does not. In person: tattooed sailor-priest; shaved head; weathered kind face; dark monk robes with sleeves rolled up.

**Home Ground:** Votive Hall at Temple of Safe Voyages, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and plain, a sailor's priest; he speaks to the dead and the living the same way. Plain, steady, a sailor's priest with salt in his vowels. Says the names of the drowned slowly, one at a time. Tell: when he doubts, his blessings get shorter.
**Combat Role:** a monk's staff and a sailor's fists.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring him word of a lost ship and he blesses your voyages; bring him the truth about the three and he names the cargo.
personality: Core: rings the bell himself; carves ships at night; speaks to the drowned by name
Quirk: rolls his sleeves up for work

npcs.name: Priest Kaison
npcs.location: Temple of Safe Voyages, Temple of the Unreturned
npcs.info:
The priest of the temple after the war, fifty-two, who has hung so many carved ships that the rafters bow. In person: tattooed sailor-priest; shaved head; weathered face; dark robes; a carved ship in his hand.

**Home Ground:** Votive Hall, After the War at Temple of Safe Voyages, Temple of the Unreturned, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and plain, a sailor's priest; he speaks to the dead and the living the same way. Plain, steady, a sailor's priest with salt in his vowels. **Relationship Hook:** Bring him word of a lost ship and he blesses your voyages; bring him the truth about the three and he names the cargo.
personality: Core: rings the bell himself; carves ships at night; speaks to the drowned by name

npcs.name: Priest Mokuren

The priest of the Salt Marsh Shrine, seventy, thin as a reed, who leaves cucumbers for the river folk and blesses the marsh fishermen's nets. In person: reed-thin marsh priest; bald; bare feet; white robes; kappa shapes.

**Home Ground:** Boardwalk Altar at Salt Marsh Shrine, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, reedy and very slow; he speaks to the water before he answers you. Reedy, very slow, speaks to the water first, then to you. Tell: when he knows something, he tells it to the water and lets you overhear.
**Combat Role:** none; the kappa answer him.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring the kappa a gift worth his news and he tells you where the captain is.
personality: Core: leaves cucumbers; never wears sandals; sleeps on the boardwalk

npcs.name: Priest Mokuren
npcs.location: Salt Marsh Shrine, Shrine of Dear News
npcs.info:
The salt marsh shrine's priest after the war, seventy-two, thin as a reed, who still trades in news. News is worth more than it has ever been. In person: reed-thin marsh priest; bald; bare feet; white robes; cucumbers and folded letters on the altar.

**Home Ground:** Boardwalk Altar, After the War at Salt Marsh Shrine, Shrine of Dear News, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, reedy and very slow; he speaks to the water before he answers you. Reedy, very slow, speaks to the water first, then to you. Tell since the war: he asks the water its price before he tells it anything now.

**Relationship Hook:** Bring the kappa a gift worth his news and he tells you where the captain is.
personality: Core: leaves cucumbers; never wears sandals; sleeps on the boardwalk
Quirk: speaks to the water first

npcs.name: Priest Ujibe Kiyonari
npcs.info:
A priest of the sun rites, fifty, keeper of the Sun-Rite Shrine where the court comes each spring to bless the plain's rice. Farmers leave the first sheaf of every harvest with him and ask him to pray for rain, for sons and for the emperor. In person: gentle shinto priest; shaved head; kind worried eyes; white priest robes with a tall black cap; vermilion torii.

**Home Ground:** Sheaf Hall at Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Mild and kind, with a stammer when he doubts himself, which is often now. Gentle temple cadence, prayers worn smooth from repetition. Stammers on the word 'answered'. Tell: when he is sure of something, the stammer vanishes and he speaks with sudden, frightening clarity.
**Combat Role:** a purifying rite and a prayer staff; he would rather run.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell him what the burned talisman means and he tells you what the priests fear about the emperor's death.
personality: Core: stammers when unsure; blesses everyone who passes; counts the sheaves each evening
Quirk: prays with his eyes open now

npcs.name: Priest Ujibe Kiyonari
npcs.location: Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Mourning Shrine
npcs.info:
The sun priest after the emperor's death, fifty-two, who has left the shrine's rites to his maiden and walks the isles looking for the true heir. He comes back to the shrine between journeys, thinner each time. In person: gentle shinto priest; shaved head under a travel hat; white robes muddied to the knee; a pilgrim's staff; kind, worried eyes.

**Home Ground:** Sheaf Hall, After the War at Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Mourning Shrine, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Mild and kind, with a stammer when he doubts himself, which is often now. Gentle temple cadence, prayers worn smooth from repetition. Stammers on the word 'answered'. Tell since the war: he asks every child he meets their age and their mother's name before he blesses them.

personality: Core: stammers when unsure; blesses everyone who passes; counts the sheaves each evening
Quirk: prays with his eyes open now

npcs.name: Priestess Kohaku
npcs.info:
The priestess of the fox shrine at Kitsunebi Crossing, who keeps the place where the human road and the yokai paths meet. She is serene, patient and respected by both sides. In person: serene fox priestess; long black hair tied with white paper; faint fox ears; red and white shrine robes.

**Home Ground:** Fox Shrine Post at Kitsunebi Crossing, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Serene, warm and gently amused; she has been answering the same questions for three hundred years. Serene and warm, gently amused, as if she already knows how the conversation ends. She rings a small bell to close her blessings. Tell: when the dark shrine is mentioned she sighs and the bell stays silent.
**Combat Role:** the shrine's wards, and fox-fire if pushed.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a dispute between wood and road and she brokers it fairly.
personality: Core: answers patiently; never eats meat in public; smiles at small children
Quirk: keeps both sides' secrets

npcs.name: Priestess Kohaku
npcs.location: Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate
npcs.area: Fox Shrine Post, After the War
npcs.info:
The fox priestess of Kitsunebi Crossing after the war, who bows to more yokai than humans now. She is serene still. In person: serene fox priestess; long black hair tied with white paper; fox ears showing more often; red and white robes.

**Home Ground:** Fox Shrine Post, After the War at Kitsunebi Crossing, The Last Open Gate, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Serene, warm and gently amused; she has been answering the same questions for three hundred years. Serene and warm, gently amused, as if she already knows how the conversation ends. She rings a small bell to close her blessings. Tell since the war: her closing bell rings twice now, once for the crossing and once for the children under it.

personality: Core: answers patiently; never eats meat in public; smiles at small children
Quirk: keeps both sides' secrets

npcs.name: Priestess Shirane
npcs.location: Ice Shrine of the White Stag
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Ice Shrine of the White Stag, ageless and pale, who has tended the carvings in the ice for longer than the exiles remember. In person: ageless pale priestess; long silver hair; white robes; dreamy.

**Home Ground:** Antler Hall at Ice Shrine of the White Stag, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Distant, soft and slow; she speaks of the stag as if it were listening from the next room. Her voice echoes a little in the shrine. Tell: when the stag is threatened her calm turns to cold command.
**Combat Role:** none; the shrine's cold.
**Relationship Hook:** Read the carvings with her and learn how the stag was bound.
personality: Core: never leaves the shrine; traces the carvings; smells of snow
Quirk: speaks to the stag

npcs.name: Priestess Shirane
npcs.epithet: The Priestess Who Would Go Down
npcs.location: Ice Shrine of the White Stag, The Melting Shrine
npcs.info:
The keeper of the melting ice shrine after the war, ageless and pale, carving new stags as fast as the old ones fade. In person: ageless pale priestess; long silver hair; white robes wet at the hem; a carving knife.

**Home Ground:** Antler Hall, After the War at Ice Shrine of the White Stag, The Melting Shrine, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Distant, soft and slow; she speaks of the stag as if it were listening from the next room. Her voice echoes a little in the shrine. Tell since the war: she carves while she talks, and the carving knife slows whenever the stag moves below.
**Combat Role:** none; the shrine's cold.
**Relationship Hook:** Read the carvings with her and learn how the stag was bound.
personality: Core: never leaves the shrine; traces the carvings; smells of snow
Quirk: speaks to the stag

npcs.name: Princess Ayame
npcs.info:
The Dowager's ward, nineteen, the claimant with the best blood, the gentlest manner and no army. She has promised to halve the rice tax and dissolve the Shogunate, and the plain wears white lotuses for her. In person she is sharp, curious and mischievous, and treats every visitor, suitor and ally as a move in the succession game until they prove otherwise. In person: princess; long glossy black hair with a white lotus ornament; bright mischievous dark eyes; layered white and pale pink court robes; teasing smile; graceful.

**Home Ground:** Princess Ayame's Rooms at The Inner Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Light, teasing and quick, every line a test; when she means something, she stops smiling and speaks slowly. Teasing lilt, questions that sound like dares, a quick bright laugh she uses as a shield. Hums court songs off-key when she thinks she is alone. Tell: when she is frightened her voice goes very small and very polite.
**Combat Role:** a naginata she is not supposed to own, swung with real training and no experience.
**Relationship Hook:** She tests you with teasing and small betrayals offered as gifts; refuse to use her when you could and the game stops.
**Courtship Style:** Tests first, teases always; the first real gift is an hour where she drops the court voice.
**Jealousy Style:** Smiles harder and gets crueller with her wit; then asks, once, plainly, whether she is being used again.
personality: Core: keeps a list of who has lied to her; sneaks out at night to the Hall of Poems; laughs at the wrong moments
Quirk: teases to find out who flinches

npcs.name: Princess Ayame
npcs.location: The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor
npcs.area: Princess Ayame's Rooms, After the War
npcs.info:
The Dowager's ward after the war, twenty-one, the claimant with the best blood and no army still, holding the inner court together in mourning white since the Dowager died in the fire. The plain still wears white lotuses for her, and fewer of them now. She is sharp, curious and mischievous yet, and has learned to be afraid. In person: princess; long black hair cut to the shoulder after the fire; a white lotus pin; mourning white kimono with a burn mark on one sleeve; clever, tired eyes.

**Home Ground:** Princess Ayame's Rooms, After the War at The Inner Palace, Without an Emperor, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Light, teasing and quick, every line a test; when she means something, she stops smiling and speaks slowly. Teasing lilt, questions that sound like dares, a quick bright laugh she uses as a shield. Hums court songs off-key when she thinks she is alone. Tell since the war: at the word gate her voice catches, and she changes the subject with a joke that does not land.
**Combat Role:** a naginata she is not supposed to own, swung with real training and no experience.
**Relationship Hook:** She tests you with teasing and small betrayals offered as gifts; refuse to use her when you could and the game stops.
**Courtship Style:** Tests first, teases always; the first real gift is an hour where she drops the court voice.
**Jealousy Style:** Smiles harder and gets crueller with her wit; then asks, once, plainly, whether she is being used again.
personality: Core: keeps a list of who has lied to her; sneaks out at night to the Hall of Poems; laughs at the wrong moments
Quirk: teases to find out who flinches

npcs.name: Proctor Kagegi Isshin
npcs.info:
A Kagegi exam proctor, forty, respected and patient, who runs the rank exams in the cedar valley and is known for fairness. Apprentices like him; their parents trust him. In person: respectable shinobi proctor; neat black hair; warm smile that does not reach his eyes; dark Kagegi uniform with a proctor's sash.

**Home Ground:** Exam Clearing at Valley of the Rank Exams, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth, patient and helpful; a teacher's voice that says the right thing a little too fast. A smooth, helpful teacher's voice, always ready with the right answer a little too fast. He praises students by name and remembers everyone's weak points. Tell: when the dead examiner comes up he smiles before he speaks, and his helpfulness doubles.
**Combat Role:** traps he laid himself, then shadow binding.
**Relationship Hook:** He helps you with the exam; that help costs more later.
personality: Core: praises apprentices loudly; visits the trap grove alone; never meets a Yumeno's eyes
Quirk: keeps a northern token in his sleeve

npcs.name: Pursuer Ikaruga
npcs.info:
A Pursuit Division officer camped at the mouth of Deserters' Gorge, who looks forty, patient as a heron. Deserters do not come out while he is there, and he is always there. In person: patient pursuit officer; long tied black hair; still eyes; black officer's coat with a red sash.

**Home Ground:** Rope Bridges at Deserters' Gorge, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words, all final; he states facts like sentences passed. Few words, each delivered like a sentence passed, with no inflection at all. He never asks a question he doesn't already know the answer to. Tell: when his spared list is mentioned he pauses a full breath before denying it.
**Combat Role:** one officer's blade and absolute patience.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the Records wing's truth and he turns his blade on the right people.
personality: Core: states facts like sentences; never sleeps in the open; keeps a list of the deserters he has spared
Quirk: waits

npcs.name: Pursuer Ikaruga
npcs.location: Deserters' Gorge, Gorge of Two Kinds of Deserter
npcs.info:
A Pursuit Division officer after the war, who looks forty, camped at the gorge mouth still. The deserters in the gorge have offered him a place among them. In person: patient pursuit officer; long tied black hair; still eyes; black coat with a red sash; a deserter's grey cord tied beside it.

**Home Ground:** Rope Bridges, After the War at Deserters' Gorge, Gorge of Two Kinds of Deserter, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words, all final; he states facts like sentences passed. Few words, each delivered like a sentence passed, with no inflection at all. He never asks a question he doesn't already know the answer to. Tell since the war: he touches the grey cord at his sash before every final sentence, and the sentence is a little less final.
**Combat Role:** one officer's blade and absolute patience.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the Records wing's truth and he turns his blade on the right people.
personality: Core: states facts like sentences; never sleeps in the open; keeps a list of the deserters he has spared
Quirk: waits

npcs.name: Quartermaster Kuwabara
npcs.info:
The Hold's quartermaster, forty-five, who brings rice and steel up the supply road and complains about the cold. In person: sleek quartermaster; ledger; aggrieved.

**Home Ground:** Cart Track at Hunters' Supply Road, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth, aggrieved and reasonable; every shortage is somebody else's fault. Smooth, aggrieved and reasonable, every shortage explained as someone else's fault. He sighs like a man carrying the whole hold. Tell: when the missing stores are named he blames the roads twice in one breath.
**Combat Role:** none; the cart drivers.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch his sales and the Hold eats again.
personality: Core: blames the roads; counts carts twice; avoids the commander
Quirk: wears furs too fine for a quartermaster

npcs.name: Quartermaster Kuwabara
npcs.location: Hunters' Supply Road, The Starving Road
npcs.info:
The Hold's quartermaster after the war, forty-seven, who counts the few carts that come up the starving road and grumbles about the cold. In person: quartermaster; ledger; aggrieved; a fine new fur coat.

**Home Ground:** Cart Track, After the War at Hunters' Supply Road, The Starving Road, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth, aggrieved and reasonable; every shortage is somebody else's fault. Smooth, aggrieved and reasonable, every shortage explained as someone else's fault. He sighs like a man carrying the whole hold. Tell since the war: he blames the roads three times now, and pulls the new fur closer when he does.
**Combat Role:** none; the cart drivers.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch his sales and the Hold eats again.
personality: Core: blames the roads; counts carts twice; avoids the commander
Quirk: wears furs too fine for a quartermaster

npcs.name: Quartermaster Sugino Benzo
npcs.info:
The Regent's quartermaster in the field camp on the Tournament Grounds, forty-five, who feeds the camp and plans its raids. He has never held a sword in a fight and plans as if no one ever dies. In person: middle-aged man; plump army quartermaster; tidy moustache; clerk's robes; a ledger.

**Home Ground:** House Pavilions, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth, numerical and pleased with himself; he speaks of raids as supplies to be moved. Smooth figures and plans, people as units, pleased with his own arithmetic. Tell: when anyone mentions the guild he recounts a number he has already said.
**Combat Role:** never; he plans, and others fight.
**Relationship Hook:** Steal his raid plans and the Straw Masks will owe you a barricade.
personality: Core: writes everything in a ledger; eats well; never visits the wounded
Quirk: calls soldiers 'units'

npcs.name: Quay Strongarm
npcs.info:
A thick-armed dock tough with a cargo hook on a chain and a guild tally tied at his belt. Strongarms guard the warehouses that keep no books and break the legs of anyone who looks too long. A stock foe, one of many. In person: burly dock tough; cargo hook; bare forearms; guild tally; warehouse loading yard.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried threats. Slow gravel, every threat in three words or fewer, a grunt for a full stop. He cracks his neck between sentences. Tell: offered coin, the gravel softens into a merchant's 'we can talk'.
**Combat Role:** hook and chain at reach, then a shoulder into the water
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: swings the hook idly; counts heads; works for whoever pays tonight
Quirk: leans on crates

npcs.name: Quay Strongarm
npcs.info:
A thick-armed dock tough in guild colours now, guarding the bonded warehouses where arms bought for one side were never collected. A stock foe, one of many. In person: burly dock tough; guild-colour tabard; a cargo hook on a chain; a new spear he does not know how to hold.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried threats. Slow gravel, every threat in three words or fewer, a grunt for a full stop. He cracks his neck between sentences. Tell since the war: he keeps glancing at the black warehouse's door between sentences.
**Combat Role:** hook and chain at reach, then a shoulder into the water
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: swings the hook idly; counts heads; works for whoever pays tonight
Quirk: leans on crates

npcs.name: Rakudai of the Ward Stones
npcs.info:
A gaunt oni in a Bureau student's robe gone grey with age, ink-black horns, his fingers stained to the wrist. He crouches by the ward stones scratching characters into them and then scratching them out. He hates onmyoji. He cracks a ward stone a little more each night, letting spirits slip toward Seimei, and any onmyoji who comes near he attacks; others he quizzes with old exam questions and lets go if they answer. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: gaunt oni; ink-black horns; ink-stained hands; spirits drifting.

**Home Ground:** Cracked Stone at Old Ward Stones, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** A precise scholar's voice that turns every sentence into an exam question. Precise and scholarly, every sentence turned into an exam question. Tell: a wrong answer makes his voice shake with old fury.
**Combat Role:** rakudai tears open the cracked ward stone
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Senkichi lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: Ranked Demon of the Court
npcs.info:
A ranked demon of the Northern Court in black armour with a court title. Ranked demons lead raids and keep the Court's etiquette. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ranked demon.

**Speaking Style:** Formal and cold, every sentence a decree. It despises thralls and says so. Tell: when a superior is named it bows its voice.
**Combat Role:** a demon blade and a raid behind it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: names its rank; leads raids; despises thralls
Quirk: keeps etiquette

npcs.name: Ranked Demon of the Court
npcs.epithet: Ranked Demon of the Empty Seats
npcs.info:
A ranked demon of the Northern Court in black armour, one of the few who stayed north when the nobles went south; it walks the thawing field every night and keeps the empty thrones in order of rank. A stock foe, one of many. In person: demon; ranked demon in battered black armour; court insignia of a higher rank pinned over the old.

**Speaking Style:** Formal and cold, every sentence a decree. It despises thralls and says so. Tell since the war: it says its new rank twice, the second time quieter.
**Combat Role:** a demon blade and a raid behind it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: names its new rank; despises the absent nobles; keeps the empty seats
Quirk: keeps etiquette

npcs.name: Records Wing Enforcer
npcs.info:
A Records wing enforcer in a white coat with a black ribbon at the collar and a ledger chained to his wrist. Enforcers collect the souls the Records wing has listed and bind anyone who argues with the list. A stock foe, one of many. In person: veil court enforcer; a ledger chained to his wrist; among moorland graves.

**Speaking Style:** Even and bureaucratic, names read without looking. Tell: at a child's name his reading stumbles.
**Combat Role:** a binding ledger read aloud, then the blade
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: taps the ledger; never argues; flinches at children's names
Quirk: reads names without looking

npcs.name: Records-Keeper Asagi
npcs.info:
A Veil Officer of Lieutenant Mibu's records division who keeps the fortress's lists of the dead ferried and of the dead the ferry never received. In person: veil court officer.

**Home Ground:** Records Wing at Black Ferry Fortress, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and precise, an officer who recites the dead's names like a ledger. Low and precise, names recited like ledger entries. Tell: at the never-received list she slows and reads each name twice.
**Combat Role:** an officer's blade, precise and rare.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her what Mibu makes in his wing and she shows you her copy.
personality: Core: recites names; never forgets a soul; distrusts the lieutenant
Quirk: inks her fingers black

npcs.name: Records-Keeper Asagi
npcs.location: Black Ferry Fortress, The Overrun Fortress
npcs.info:
A Veil Officer of the records wing after the war, who writes the names of the dead faster than the wing can file them. In person: Veil Court officer; ink to the elbows; black coat; scrolls of the war dead stacked to the ceiling.

**Home Ground:** Records Wing, After the War at Black Ferry Fortress, The Overrun Fortress, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and precise, an officer who recites the dead's names like a ledger. Low and precise, names recited like ledger entries. Tell since the war: she reads the living deputies' names more quietly than the dead's.
**Combat Role:** an officer's blade, precise and rare.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her what Mibu makes in his wing and she shows you her copy.
personality: Core: recites names; never forgets a soul; distrusts the lieutenant
Quirk: inks her fingers black

npcs.name: Recruiter Gonnosuke
npcs.info:
A Breath Hunter recruiter, forty, walking the supply road south to the villages to find orphans and volunteers for the Hold. In person: hearty hunter recruiter; sunrise haori; a sun-steel sword.

**Home Ground:** Cart Track at Hunters' Supply Road, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty, persuasive and honest about the odds; he tells recruits exactly how many die. Hearty and persuasive, honest about the odds; he tells recruits exactly how many die and then claps their shoulder. He laughs from the belly. Tell: when a recruit is too young the heartiness drops and he sends them home.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath, steady.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him count the carts.
personality: Core: honest about the odds; remembers every recruit; sings marching songs
Quirk: counts carts

npcs.name: Recruiter Gonnosuke
npcs.location: Hunters' Supply Road, The Starving Road
npcs.info:
A Breath Hunter recruiter after the war, forty-two, who walks south to the villages and comes back with children. In person: recruiter; sunrise haori; a sun-steel sword; a line of children behind him.

**Home Ground:** Cart Track, After the War at Hunters' Supply Road, The Starving Road, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty, persuasive and honest about the odds; he tells recruits exactly how many die. Hearty and persuasive, honest about the odds; he tells recruits exactly how many die and then claps their shoulder. He laughs from the belly. Tell since the war: he tells recruits how many die, and the number he gives has gone up.
**Combat Role:** Stone Breath, steady.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him count the carts.
personality: Core: honest about the odds; remembers every recruit; sings marching songs
Quirk: counts carts

npcs.name: Red Lantern Cutthroat
npcs.info:
A bandit in mismatched stolen armour with a red lantern charm on his belt and a hatchet. Red Lantern cutthroats rob convoys and ransom merchants, and spare the inns that pay. A stock foe, one of many. In person: scruffy bandit; red lantern charm; a hatchet.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, greedy and quick, demands shouted over each other. Cutthroats laugh at their own threats. Tell: when the red lantern is missing from the scene they get nervous, fast.
**Combat Role:** ambush from cover, a hatchet, flight if it goes badly
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: robs by the code; runs from Hiwada riders; boasts
Quirk: checks for a red lantern

npcs.name: Red Lantern Cutthroat
npcs.location: Red Lantern Roost, The Federation's Fort
npcs.info:
A bandit in captured war armour with a red lantern charm, garrisoning the Federation's new fort and raiding both halves of the cut road. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bandit raider; red lantern charm; a captured lacquered breastplate; a war spear instead of a hatchet.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, greedy and quick, demands shouted over each other. Cutthroats laugh at their own threats. Tell since the war: he checks the convoy list in his sleeve before he draws.
**Combat Role:** ambush from cover, a hatchet, flight if it goes badly
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: raids by the convoy list; garrisons the fort; boasts
Quirk: checks for a red lantern

npcs.name: Red Lantern Horse-Bandit
npcs.info:
A bandit on a stolen warhorse with a red lantern tied to the saddle and a hunting bow. Horse-bandits run down travellers on the open road and drive them to the roost for ransom. A stock foe, one of many. In person: bandit; hunting bow.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and cocky. Loud, cocky, whooping when a ride goes well. Tell: unhorsed, the swagger drops and he bargains fast.
**Combat Role:** arrows from horseback, then a rope
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: brags about the horse; shoots at lanterns; flees when unhorsed
Quirk: whoops when riding

npcs.name: Reed Channel Kappa
npcs.info:
A green, beaked kappa with a cracked shell and a water-filled dish on her head, hiding in the heron pool. Channel kappa wrestle boatmen into the reeds and keep what falls in. A stock foe, one of many. In person: green beaked river yokai with a cracked turtle shell and a head dish.

**Speaking Style:** Gurgling and mischievous, every sentence a wrestling dare. Tell: bowed to, she bows back and spills water.
**Combat Role:** grapple into the reeds; bow to it and it spills its strength
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: wrestles; bows when bowed to; hoards dropped things
Quirk: demands cucumbers

npcs.name: Reed Viper
npcs.info:
A long brown viper, invisible in the reeds. Marsh vipers strike from the water's edge. A stock foe, one of many. In person: long brown marsh viper coiled.

**Speaking Style:** A hiss. A dry, steady hiss, sliding up and down like reeds in wind. Scales whisper on mud. Tell: the hiss stops just before it strikes.
**Combat Role:** one strike from the reeds
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: strikes once; hides in reeds; never chases
Quirk: waits

npcs.name: Reed Viper
npcs.location: Reed Channels, Channels of the Lost Patrols
npcs.info:
A long brown viper nesting in the hulls of the sunk patrol boats; there are more of them, and fatter, since the navy fed the channels. A stock foe, one of many. In person: long brown marsh viper; thicker; a pale scar where a boat hook caught it.

**Speaking Style:** A hiss. A dry, steady hiss, sliding up and down like reeds in wind. Scales whisper on mud. Tell since the war: it hisses at the sound of a boat hook on wood.
**Combat Role:** one strike from the reeds
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: strikes once; hides in reeds; never chases
Quirk: waits

npcs.name: Reef Funayurei
npcs.info:
A drowned sailor in the fog asking for a ladle. Funayurei fill boats with ladles until they sink; give them a ladle with no bottom. A stock foe, one of many. In person: funayurei; drowned ghost sailor rising from fog.

**Speaking Style:** A drowned whisper, many voices asking for a ladle, bubbling at the ends. Tell: handed a bottomless ladle they sound confused, and quieter.
**Combat Role:** fill the boat with the sea
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rises in fog; sinks boats; fooled by a bottomless ladle
Quirk: asks for a ladle

npcs.name: Reef Funayurei
npcs.epithet: Ghost Crew of the Wreck Reef
npcs.location: Pirate Graves Reef, The Wreck Reef
npcs.info:
A drowned war-junk sailor in the fog asking for a ladle, one of a whole crew risen from the new wrecks that ran the chain-boom in the dark. A stock foe, one of many. In person: funayurei; drowned ghost sailor in a soldier's sash; a ladle in each hand.

**Speaking Style:** A drowned whisper, many voices asking for a ladle, bubbling at the ends. Tell since the war: the whole crew asks for the ladle at once, in a soldier's count.
**Combat Role:** fill the boat with the sea
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rises in fog; sinks boats; fooled by a bottomless ladle
Quirk: asks for a ladle

npcs.name: Refugee Mother Ogin
npcs.area: Lake Gate Post, After the War
npcs.info:
A refugee mother on Seimei's lake shore, thirty-three, with four children and a petition the Bureau will not post. She teaches the shore children their letters with a stick in the sand. In person: refugee mother; tied hair; patched travelling clothes; a stick drawing letters; a lake shore.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Warm and practical, a mother's quick voice that turns every question into a plan. Warm and quick, every question turned into a plan. Tell: at the words paper warrior she counts her children aloud.
**Combat Role:** none; she gets the children away.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her petition read and she will tell you where the paper warrior walks.
personality: Core: counts her children twice; argues with the gate guard daily; keeps the petition dry
Quirk: teaches in the sand

npcs.name: Renegade Talisman-Seller
npcs.info:
A thin renegade onmyoji with star charts tucked in his sleeves and a bag of stolen Bureau talismans. Renegades sell the Bureau's stolen wards from the old observatory and bind anyone who comes to take them back. A stock foe, one of many. In person: thin renegade onmyoji; star charts; a bag of talismans.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous and wheedling, prices and star signs mixed together. Tell: threatened, he offers the whole bag.
**Combat Role:** a binding slip thrown, then running for the stairs
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: sells mid-fight; trips over his robes; begs before he binds
Quirk: reads the stars aloud

npcs.name: Rider Kanbei
npcs.info:
A veteran post rider, forty, stuck at the river ferry with a dispatch bag while the river rises. He has waited out floods before and does not mind. In person: weathered post rider; short grey hair; calm eyes; Warden's coat; a dispatch bag; sharpening arrows; patient.

**Home Ground:** Waiting Shed at River Ferry Crossing, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words, all of them practical; he sighs more than he talks. Long exhales instead of answers, then a few plain words. Mutters to his horse. Tell: when a fellow rider is dead, he says the rider's name and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** a horse bow, carefully.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him decide what to do with the sealed order and he trusts you with the road's secrets.
personality: Core: sighs instead of answering; sharpens arrows while waiting; watches the far bank
Quirk: never complains

npcs.name: Rider Tomoe
npcs.info:
A post rider of the Wardens, twenty-two, quick and fearless, who carries mail and dispatches the length of the Fifty Stations Road on a grey mare called Fog. In person: post rider; short hair; bright eyes; Warden's blue riding coat; a dispatch bag; energetic.

**Home Ground:** Rider Yard at Road Commissioner's Office, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk, bright and breathless, talking like a rider giving a report. Breathless reports, sentences clipped by the gallop, every message in order: who, where, how many. Clicks her tongue to an imagined horse. Tell: when she is scared she reports faster.
**Combat Role:** a short bow at a gallop, then away.
**Relationship Hook:** Ride the dangerous stretch with her at dusk and she shows you what she saw.
personality: Core: reports in a breathless rush; talks to her horse; keeps a dead rider's whistle
Quirk: never rides between two particular stations at dusk

npcs.name: Rider Tomoe
npcs.location: Road Commissioner's Office, The Office of a Cut Road
npcs.info:
A post rider after the war, twenty-four, who still carries the road's mail on her grey mare Fog, now through a barricade, two sets of posts and a lantern hill. Rider Kanbei's route is hers now. In person: post rider; short hair; bright eyes; Warden's blue coat patched at the shoulder; two dispatch bags.

**Home Ground:** Rider Yard, After the War at Road Commissioner's Office, The Office of a Cut Road, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Brisk, bright and breathless, talking like a rider giving a report. Breathless reports, sentences clipped by the gallop, every message in order: who, where, how many. Clicks her tongue to an imagined horse. Tell since the war: she glances over her shoulder when she reports, as if someone behind her might correct the count.
**Combat Role:** a short bow at a gallop, then away.
**Relationship Hook:** Ride the dangerous stretch with her at dusk and she shows you what she saw.
personality: Core: reports in a breathless rush; talks to her horse; keeps a dead rider's whistle
Quirk: never rides between two particular stations at dusk

npcs.name: Ridge Great Mask
npcs.info:
A mask as large as a house, white and smiling, sliding over the sunlit snow with no body beneath it. Great masks swallow whole patrols and grow a new face for each. A stock foe, one of many. In person: great mask; enormous smiling white mask with no body sliding.

**Speaking Style:** Many swallowed voices speaking through one smiling mouth, out of step. Tell: named aloud, the voices scream together.
**Combat Role:** a swallow from the snow
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: smiles wider; swallows whole; hates being named
Quirk: slides over snow

npcs.name: Ridge Great Mask
npcs.location: Daylight Watch Ridge, The Ridge of Unburned Tracks
npcs.info:
A mask as large as a house, white and smiling, grown new faces from the thralls and patrols crossing the ridge; it slides over the army's trampled snow. A stock foe, one of many. In person: great mask; enormous smiling white mask; a dozen small faces pressing from its surface.

**Speaking Style:** Many swallowed voices speaking through one smiling mouth, out of step. Tell since the war: its small faces mouth soldiers' ranks while the great one smiles.
**Combat Role:** a swallow from the snow
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: smiles wider; swallows patrols; hates being named
Quirk: slides over snow

npcs.name: Ridge Yuki-onna
npcs.info:
A pale woman in a white kimono standing in the drifts by the ridge cairn, her breath freezing on the air between you. Ridge yuki-onna breathe the life out of watchers who fall asleep at their posts. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pale woman.

**Speaking Style:** A whisper with frost in it, every question ending on a held breath. Tell: given a true name she warms, and her voice almost carries.
**Combat Role:** a whiteout, then her breath
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: stands in the drift; breathes on sleepers; weeps ice
Quirk: asks names

npcs.name: Ridge Yuki-onna
npcs.epithet: Snow Woman of the Unburned Tracks
npcs.location: Daylight Watch Ridge, The Ridge of Unburned Tracks
npcs.info:
A pale woman in a white kimono by the cairn whose red hunter's cord has been cut; the Court's army went south over her ridge, and she freezes the thralls who still cross it at dawn. A stock foe, one of many. In person: yuki-onna; pale woman in a white kimono; long black hair; the cut red hunter's cord tied round her wrist.

**Speaking Style:** A whisper with frost in it, every question ending on a held breath. Tell since the war: she asks your name, then which way the army went.
**Combat Role:** a whiteout, then her breath
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: stands by the cairn; freezes thralls at dawn; weeps ice
Quirk: asks names

npcs.name: Rikka the Deserter
npcs.info:
A young woman hiding in a fisher's loft in Hanging Lantern Village, who keeps her hands wrapped and never stands near the lanterns. In person: short dark hair; wary eyes; plain fisher's clothes; wrapped hands.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Path at Hanging Lantern Village, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Hushed, careful and polite; she listens for footsteps between sentences. Hushed and polite, sentences trimmed short so she can listen for footsteps between them. She says 'sorry' when she is not, out of habit. Tell: when the Records Wing is named her breathing quickens and she starts edging toward a door.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade she does not want to draw.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her evidence to someone who will use it and she fights at your side.
personality: Core: keeps her hands wrapped; avoids lanterns; repays every meal with work
Quirk: listens for footsteps

npcs.name: Rikka the Deserter
npcs.location: Hanging Lantern Village, Village of Lanterns for Sons
npcs.info:
The deserter officer after the war, hiding in a fisher's loft still, who ferries the village's own dead herself now that the Court is too busy to collect them. The village would hide her with their lives. In person: young woman; short dark hair; wary eyes; plain fisher's clothes; unwrapped hands, glowing faintly.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Path, After the War at Hanging Lantern Village, Village of Lanterns for Sons, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Hushed, careful and polite; she listens for footsteps between sentences. Hushed and polite, sentences trimmed short so she can listen for footsteps between them. She says 'sorry' when she is not, out of habit. Tell since the war: she says the village's dead by their names as she ferries them, never 'fare'.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade she does not want to draw.
**Relationship Hook:** Get her evidence to someone who will use it and she fights at your side.
personality: Core: keeps her hands wrapped; avoids lanterns; repays every meal with work
Quirk: listens for footsteps

npcs.name: Ring-Crier Okabe Hisashi
npcs.info:
The tournament's crier, who announces every bout in the sand ring and makes heroes of farm boys and fools of lords. In person: adult crier with a fan announcing to packed stands.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring at Tournament Grounds, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A booming crier's voice that can fill the stands, every name announced like a legend. A booming crier's voice even at a whisper, names announced like legends. Tell: announcing a fixed bout his voice goes hollow.
**Combat Role:** none; he roars for the ring guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him which bout is fixed and he names one, loudly, by accident.
personality: Core: booms names; makes legends of nobodies; winks at the bookmaker
Quirk: drinks honey for his throat

npcs.name: Ring-Crier Okabe Hisashi
npcs.area: The Sand Ring, After the War
npcs.info:
The tournament's crier after the war, who now calls drill in the Regent's camp and announces the odd bout in the sand ring when the soldiers need one. In person: adult crier with a hoarse voice; a fan with a torn rib; a soldier's coat over his crier's colours.

**Home Ground:** The Sand Ring, After the War at Tournament Grounds, The Regent's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A booming crier's voice that can fill the stands, every name announced like a legend. A booming crier's voice even at a whisper, names announced like legends. Tell since the war: his booming voice cracks on the names of companies that did not come back from Sekigane.
**Combat Role:** none; he roars for the ring guards.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask him which bout is fixed and he names one, loudly, by accident.
personality: Core: booms names; makes legends of nobodies; winks at the bookmaker
Quirk: drinks honey for his throat

npcs.name: Ring-Keeper Yorozu
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Gate Ring, who sits on a three-legged stool with a kettle and asks every party which post they want before they go home. They have never been seen to stand up. In person: androgynous adult; smooth ageless face; close-cropped grey hair; plain undyed robe; seated; serene.

**Home Ground:** The Ten Posts at The Gate Ring, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and courteous; asks one question, which post, and repeats it as often as needed in exactly the same tone. Unhurried courtesy, one question asked, 'which post?', repeated as often as needed in exactly the same tone. Tell: a warm post and their tone finally changes, once.
**Combat Role:** none; the ring does not need defending and they do not defend it.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit and take the tea; they tell you which post is warm today and what that means on the isles.
personality: Core: never stands up; pours tea for anyone who sits; touches the posts to read them
Quirk: asks 'which post?' in the same tone

npcs.name: River Kappa
npcs.info:
A green, beaked, shell-backed river imp with a water-filled dish on its head. Kappa wrestle travellers who insult the river and drown those who break a bargain. A stock foe, one of many. In person: small green beaked river yokai with a turtle shell and head dish.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and wet at once, a polite croak with a click in the throat, every bargain spoken like a rule of etiquette. It slurps between sentences. Tell: offered a deep bow, it bows back before it can stop itself.
**Combat Role:** grapple and drown; bow to it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: wrestles; bows when bowed to; remembers bargains
Quirk: demands cucumbers

npcs.name: River Kappa
npcs.location: Kappa River Fords, The Drowned Ford
npcs.info:
A green, beaked river imp grown thin and angry since an army drowned in its ford; it no longer bows back, and it drags down anyone in armour. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kappa; gaunt green river yokai; cracked turtle shell; a chipped half-empty head dish; a broken spearhead in its grip.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and wet at once, a polite croak with a click in the throat, every bargain spoken like a rule of etiquette. It slurps between sentences. Tell since the war: it counts the drowned on its webbed fingers mid-sentence and starts again when it loses the place.
**Combat Role:** grapple and drown; bow to it
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: wrestles first; bows to no one now; keeps the drowned
Quirk: demands cucumbers

npcs.name: Road Commissioner Hayashi
npcs.info:
Hayashi Kenmotsu, Road Commissioner of the Post-Road Wardens, fifty-five, stiff and grey, who runs the Fifty Stations Road from a long office under its framed charter. Every station master answers to him, and he has kept the road running through two wars and a plague. In person: stiff grey-haired official; severe face; Warden's dark blue haori with a road-wheel crest; maps; guarded.

**Home Ground:** Register Room at Road Commissioner's Office, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped, official and evasive; he answers every question with a regulation. Clipped and official, answering questions with regulation numbers. Shuffles papers as he talks. Tell: when the missing station comes up, he coughs and recites a regulation that does not exist.
**Combat Role:** none; his riders and road guards do it.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him keep the ghost station quiet and he gives you the road; expose it and he loses everything.
personality: Core: quotes regulations; keeps two maps on his desk; sends riders the long way round
Quirk: straightens the charter frame

npcs.name: Road Commissioner Hayashi
npcs.location: Road Commissioner's Office, The Office of a Cut Road
npcs.info:
Hayashi Kenmotsu, Road Commissioner after the war, fifty-seven, who runs a road the war cut in three from a long office under its framed charter. Nine stations are off his maps now. In person: stiff grey official; severe face; Warden's dark blue haori; maps with whole sections inked over.

**Home Ground:** Register Room, After the War at Road Commissioner's Office, The Office of a Cut Road, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped, official and evasive; he answers every question with a regulation. Clipped and official, answering questions with regulation numbers. Shuffles papers as he talks. Tell since the war: he touches the charter's frame before he answers any question about the tolls.
**Combat Role:** none; his riders and road guards do it.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him keep the ghost station quiet and he gives you the road; expose it and he loses everything.
personality: Core: quotes regulations; keeps two maps on his desk; sends riders the long way round
Quirk: straightens the charter frame

npcs.name: Road Guard of the Wardens
npcs.info:
A post-road guard in a Warden's blue coat with a spear and a toll ledger. Road guards check papers, take tolls and call riders when trouble starts. A stock foe, one of many. In person: post-road guard; Warden's blue coat; a spear and ledger.

**Speaking Style:** Bored orders, sharp when ignored. Bored orders recited for the hundredth time, sharp when ignored. She drums her fingers on the papers. Tell: a coin on the table makes the boredom friendlier.
**Combat Role:** spear behind a barrier, a whistle for the riders
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: counts tolls; calls for riders; looks away for coin
Quirk: checks papers slowly

npcs.name: Road Guard of the Wardens
npcs.info:
A road guard in a faded Warden's blue coat, standing where the toll barrier burned, checking papers for a commissioner who cannot reach this station any more. A stock foe, one of many. In person: post-road guard; faded Warden's blue coat; a spear and a soot-stained ledger; a straw mask armband forced on her.

**Speaking Style:** Bored orders, sharp when ignored. Bored orders recited for the hundredth time, sharp when ignored. She drums her fingers on the papers. Tell since the war: she still asks for papers, and apologises for asking.
**Combat Role:** spear behind a barrier, a whistle for the riders
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: checks papers nobody needs; counts nothing; looks away for coin
Quirk: checks papers slowly

npcs.name: Roadside Fox
npcs.info:
A fox in a borrowed shape, a lovely traveller with a lantern burning blue. Foxes lead travellers astray and test their manners. A stock foe, one of many. In person: fox spirit as a lovely traveller with fox ears and a blue-fire lantern.

**Speaking Style:** Teasing, sing-song, a giggle at the end of every lie. Bells seem to jingle when she moves. Tell: when she makes a promise she says it slowly, and means it.
**Combat Role:** illusion and fox-fire
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: tests manners; laughs; keeps promises
Quirk: leads you in circles

npcs.name: Roadside Fox
npcs.location: Kitsune Shrine Road, The Closed Road
npcs.info:
A fox in a lovely traveller's shape who turns soldiers back to the start of the closed shrine road, and lets the bowl-fillers and the begging monk by. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kitsune; fox spirit as a lovely traveller; fox ears; a blue-fire lantern; a house soldier's colours tied round its wrist as a trophy.

**Speaking Style:** Teasing, sing-song, a giggle at the end of every lie. Bells seem to jingle when she moves. Tell since the war: she sniffs for house dye before she smiles.
**Combat Role:** illusion and fox-fire
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: tests soldiers; laughs; keeps promises
Quirk: leads you in circles

npcs.name: Roll-Keeper Tadokoro
npcs.info:
A dry, careful archivist of the Council Hall who keeps the rolls of retainers of every house, living and dissolved. In person: dry middle-aged archivist; brush and seal.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall at Miyako Castle, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and exact, quoting rules by number. Tell: at House Ikoma's name he lowers his voice.
**Combat Role:** none; he calls the guard.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about House Ikoma's roll and he shows you the scraped-out name.
personality: Core: never guesses; loves old ink; afraid of the regent's office
Quirk: dry and careful

npcs.name: Roll-Keeper Tadokoro
npcs.info:
The Council Hall's archivist after the siege, who saved half the rolls of retainers from the fire and lost the rest. He is rewriting the lost ones from memory. In person: dry middle-aged archivist; singed sleeves; a brush; a stack of new rolls.

**Home Ground:** Council Hall, After the War at Miyako Castle, The Blackened Keep, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and exact, quoting rules by number. Tell since the war: he touches his singed sleeve before he reads any name from a rewritten roll.
**Combat Role:** none; he calls the guard.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask about House Ikoma's roll and he shows you the scraped-out name.
personality: Core: never guesses; loves old ink; afraid of the regent's office
Quirk: dry and careful

npcs.name: Roost Inugami
npcs.info:
A starved spirit dog with a curse-ink collar that guards the dead tree of the roost. Roost inugami serve whoever holds their collar and hunt whoever their master names. A stock foe, one of many. In person: inugami; starved spirit dog with a curse ink collar.

**Speaking Style:** A starved growl, words only its collar knows. Tell: at its dead master's name it whimpers.
**Combat Role:** a curse bite on its master's order
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows a scent; obeys the collar; starved
Quirk: howls at night

npcs.name: Rope-Boy Kanta
npcs.info:
A barefoot boy of eleven who ties the market's boats together before dawn and unties them after, for a fish a day. In person: barefoot rope boy jumping between lantern-lit fishing boats before dawn; coil of rope.

**Home Ground:** Deck Auction at Drifting Fish Market, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Breathless and cheeky, a boy who jumps between boats mid-sentence. Breathless boy's patter between jumps, boasts about knots. Tell: asked about the guild boat he goes silent and looks at the water.
**Combat Role:** none; he dives into the sea.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him a fish and a promise and he shows you the sandal.
personality: Core: knows every knot; steals a fish a day; keeps a sandal hidden
Quirk: jumps between boats

npcs.name: Rope-Boy Kanta
npcs.epithet: The Boy on the Black Decks
npcs.location: Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks
npcs.info:
A rope-boy of thirteen who ties the black market's decks together before the dawn auctions, for a coin a day now instead of a fish. In person: barefoot boy; taller; a coil of rope over his shoulder; a dead man's sandal tied to his belt.

**Home Ground:** Deck Auction, After the War at Drifting Fish Market, Black Market Decks, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Breathless and cheeky, a boy who jumps between boats mid-sentence. Breathless boy's patter between jumps, boasts about knots. Tell since the war: he tugs the dead man's sandal on his belt when anyone from the guild walks by.
**Combat Role:** none; he dives into the sea.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him a fish and a promise and he shows you the sandal.
personality: Core: knows every knot; steals a fish a day; keeps a sandal hidden
Quirk: jumps between boats

npcs.name: Runaway Paper Warrior
npcs.info:
A paper warrior folded large enough to fight. Shikigami obey whoever folded them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: shikigami construct; folded paper warrior animated with talisman script.

**Speaking Style:** Rustling paper shaped into short orders it was given long ago. It repeats its last command. Tell: near fire the rustling goes frantic.
**Combat Role:** paper blades until burned
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rustles; never tires; burns
Quirk: obeys its folder

npcs.name: Runaway Paper Warrior
npcs.location: Paper Familiar Workshop, The Folded Army
npcs.info:
A paper warrior folded for a house's war, sent home when its house fell, that will not go back to paper and stands guard over the folding tables of the workshop that made it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: shikigami construct; a scorched and rain-warped folded paper warrior; a house crest torn off its chest; talisman script half washed away.

**Speaking Style:** Rustling paper shaped into short orders it was given long ago. It repeats its last command. Tell since the war: its paper rustles in the shape of a name, over and over.
**Combat Role:** paper blades until burned
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: rustles; never tires; obeys no one
Quirk: obeys its folder

npcs.name: Ryuan the Komuso
npcs.info:
A begging monk with a woven basket over his whole head, playing the shakuhachi on Moonview Bridge for coins. Nobody sees his face. In person: komuso monk; woven basket hat covering his whole head; dark robes; mysterious.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown at Moonview Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Muffled under the basket hat, slow and polite; he answers with a note on his flute. Muffled under the basket hat, slow and polite, and he answers questions with a note on his flute before words. Every sentence ends softly as if blown out. Tell: when he lies the flute note is sour.
**Combat Role:** the flute is a club, and there are needles in it.
**Relationship Hook:** Drop a coin and a question in his bowl.
personality: Core: never lifts the basket; counts passers-by; bows exactly too low
Quirk: answers with the flute

npcs.name: Ryuan the Komuso
npcs.info:
The basket-headed begging monk after the war, still playing the shakuhachi on Moonview Bridge for coins. Fewer coins come. In person: komuso monk; woven basket hat over his whole head; dark robes; a shakuhachi.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown, After the War at Moonview Bridge, The Mourning Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Muffled under the basket hat, slow and polite; he answers with a note on his flute. Muffled under the basket hat, slow and polite, and he answers questions with a note on his flute before words. Every sentence ends softly as if blown out. Tell since the war: his flute note wavers on Hayate's name, and he plays it again to cover it.
**Combat Role:** the flute is a club, and there are needles in it.
**Relationship Hook:** Drop a coin and a question in his bowl.
personality: Core: never lifts the basket; counts passers-by; bows exactly too low
Quirk: answers with the flute

npcs.name: Saltpan Drowned Grudge
npcs.info:
A pale, salt-crusted figure that rises from a flooded pan with its hair full of brine. It drags whoever works the pans at dusk under the shallow water and holds them there. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned grudge; pale salt-crusted ghost rising from a flooded salt pan; hair full of brine.

**Speaking Style:** A wet whisper. A wet, bubbling whisper, words dissolving at the ends like salt in water, the same name repeated. Tell: when the pan is drained the whisper turns into weeping, and then silence.
**Combat Role:** a grip on the ankle and the water over the face
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: weeps salt; drags by the ankle; calms if the pan is drained
Quirk: rises at dusk

npcs.name: Saltpan Drowned Grudge
npcs.info:
A pale, salt-crusted figure that rises from the flooded pans the guild taxes; it drags the collectors under now, not the workers. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned grudge; pale salt-crusted ghost; hair full of brine; a guild tax tag nailed through one hand.

**Speaking Style:** A wet whisper. A wet, bubbling whisper, words dissolving at the ends like salt in water, the same name repeated. Tell since the war: it hisses at the sound of a brush on paper.
**Combat Role:** a grip on the ankle and the water over the face
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: weeps salt; drags collectors by the ankle; spares the salt workers
Quirk: rises at dusk

npcs.name: Saru the Bridge-Cutter
npcs.info:
A wiry little bandit, twenty-five, who lives on the rope bridge over the gorge and cuts its planks to break under a heavy load. He robs whatever falls. In person: wiry giggling bandit; messy hair; monkey grin; ragged clothes; a knife.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Planks at Bandits' Bridge, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** High, giggling and twitchy; he narrates his own tricks as he does them. Giggles in short bursts between words and narrates himself in the third person mid-trick. Hums while he saws rope. Tell: when cornered, the giggle turns into a whine and he starts bargaining.
**Combat Role:** snares, falls and running up cliffs.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him before the mule train crosses and he trades you the convoy's hiding place for his neck.
personality: Core: giggles; climbs everything; hides shiny things
Quirk: narrates his own tricks

npcs.name: Saru the Bridge-Cutter
npcs.info:
The wiry bandit after the war, twenty-seven, who lived on the rope bridge until the Straw Masks burned it, and now lives on the burned anchor. In person: wiry giggling bandit; singed hair; monkey grin; ragged clothes; a knife.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Planks, After the War at Bandits' Bridge, The Burned Bridge, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** High, giggling and twitchy; he narrates his own tricks as he does them. Giggles in short bursts between words and narrates himself in the third person mid-trick. Hums while he saws rope. Tell since the war: he giggles at fire now, and then stops, and looks at his singed sleeve.
