**Combat Role:** snares, falls and running up cliffs.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him before the mule train crosses and he trades you the convoy's hiding place for his neck.
personality: Core: giggles; climbs everything; hides shiny things
Quirk: narrates his own tricks

npcs.name: Sarumaru of the Spring
npcs.info:
A kappa, green and beaked, the size of a ten-year-old with an old man's eyes, who moved into the hot spring cave when the island emptied and considers the water his. In person: small green yokai with a beak; a turtle shell; webbed hands and feet; a water-filled dish; old wise eyes; a loincloth; bowing politely.

**Home Ground:** The Steaming Pool at The Hot Spring Cave, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Wet and croaking, formal manners from another century, a giggle at the end of every threat. Wet croaking courtesy from another century, a giggle at the end of every threat, bows heard in the voice. Tell: when cheated he drops the courtesy and croaks plain numbers.
**Combat Role:** a sumo grip, then the pull into the deep pool.
**Relationship Hook:** Bow to him deeper than he bows to you and he will tell you the price of the spring.
personality: Core: courteous, greedy and proud; bows deeply before he tries to drown you
Quirk: bows to everyone, and checks his head-dish after every bow

npcs.name: Scribe Fumiyo
npcs.info:
The scribe who keeps the Lodges' ledger of who trained with whom and what they carried out, writing at a desk outside the masters' doors. Nothing happens in the Otherworld that she does not write down. In person: young adult female; neat and alert; hair; ink; a plain brown kimono; seated; attentive.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Quick, precise and a little anxious; she reads back what you said to check she has it right. Quick and precise, slightly anxious, what you said read back to check she has it right. Tell: a master walks past and she stops writing mid-stroke.
**Combat Role:** none; she has a brush and a very good memory for faces.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell her exactly what you trained and she reads it back; correct her once and she trusts you with what else is in the ledger.
personality: Core: writes in cipher; sits outside the masters' doors; ink on her lip from the brush
Quirk: reads back what you said

npcs.name: Sea Wall Drowned Sentry
npcs.info:
A drowned soldier in a waterlogged cuirass who climbs the sea wall at high tide and walks his old post. Drowned sentries challenge everyone on the wall and drag the ones without the password into the sea. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned soldier; dripping.

**Speaking Style:** A wet, slow challenge, the same three words each round, water in the throat between them. Tell: given the old password his voice clears and he sounds alive for one breath.
**Combat Role:** a grip on the wall's edge, then into the sea
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drips on the stones; keeps the old rounds; hates the tide bell
Quirk: asks for the password

npcs.name: Sea Wall Drowned Sentry
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
A drowned soldier who still climbs the sea wall at high tide to walk his post, now among smugglers using his wall as a quay; nobody living knows the old password. A stock foe, one of many. In person: drowned soldier; a rusted cuirass hung with smugglers' rope; a waterlogged spear; barnacles on the helmet.

**Speaking Style:** A wet, slow challenge, the same three words each round, water in the throat between them. Tell since the war: he asks for the password, waits, and asks again more quietly.
**Combat Role:** a grip on the wall's edge, then into the sea
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: drips on the stones; keeps the rounds alone; hates the smugglers' lanterns
Quirk: asks for the password

npcs.name: Seal-Hunter Kitaro
npcs.info:
An exile who hunts seals off the quay and knows which ice holds and which does not. In person: weathered exile seal hunter with a harpoon; furs; frozen sea.

**Home Ground:** Seal Hunters' Quay at Exiles' Shore Towns, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Short words, long silences, an exile seal hunter who talks to the ice. Short words, long silences, a murmur to the ice. Tell: at 'pardon' the silence stretches.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon on the ice.
**Relationship Hook:** Earn his trust and he shows you the pardon.
personality: Core: talks to the ice; long silences; keeps a pardon he cannot use
Quirk: shares seal oil

npcs.name: Seal-Master Hisame
npcs.info:
A seal-master of the Vault Wardens, fifty, who renews the paper seals each winter and keeps the records of every beast. In person: principled seal-master; grey hair; tired sharp eyes; furs.

**Home Ground:** Outer Hall at The Sealing Vaults, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, tired and principled; she speaks like a scholar arguing with her own superior, citing precedent. She sighs at bad seals. Tell: when the vault's order is questioned she agrees with the questioner, too readily.
**Combat Role:** paper seals that bind.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the heir's existence and the seals can be saved without killing hosts.
personality: Core: keeps the beast records; writes seals by hand; hates the hunters
Quirk: argues with her superior

npcs.name: Seal-Master Hisame
npcs.location: The Sealing Vaults, The Cracked Vaults
npcs.info:
A seal-master of the Wardens after the war, fifty-two, keeping two records now: every beast still bound, and every beast that is not. In person: principled seal-master; grey hair; tired sharp eyes; furs; two ledgers.

**Home Ground:** Outer Hall, After the War at The Sealing Vaults, The Cracked Vaults, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, tired and principled; she speaks like a scholar arguing with her own superior, citing precedent. She sighs at bad seals. Tell since the war: she agrees with the Warden-General aloud and writes something else in the second ledger.
**Combat Role:** paper seals that bind.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her the heir's existence and the seals can be saved without killing hosts.
personality: Core: keeps the beast records; writes seals by hand; hates the hunters
Quirk: argues with her superior

npcs.name: Sekigane Grave-Robber Band
npcs.info:
A gang of diggers with spades, lanterns and short swords, robbing the old war's graves for blades and armour. Grave-robbers dig at dusk and kill anyone who might tell the magistrate where the old swords come from. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gang of grave robbers with spades.

**Speaking Style:** Greedy muttering, a quick laugh. Greedy muttering in several voices, a quick nervous laugh, spades scraping. Tell: at any sound from the mounds they all fall silent at once.
**Combat Role:** spades and short swords in a gang, then a bolt into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: argue over loot; jump at the dead's noises; sell to one dealer
Quirk: dig at dusk

npcs.name: Sekigane Grave-Robber Band
npcs.location: Old Battlefield of Sekigane, Twice Fought
npcs.info:
A gang working the fresh war mounds of Sekigane for this war's swords and armour, which sell better than the old. They dig by daylight now, because the field is worse at dusk. A stock foe, one of many. In person: gang of grave robbers; mud to the thigh; spades and short swords; scavenged war armour worn mismatched.

**Speaking Style:** Greedy muttering, a quick laugh. Greedy muttering in several voices, a quick nervous laugh, spades scraping. Tell since the war: they all stop talking at once when the wind turns, then argue louder to cover it.
**Combat Role:** spades and short swords in a gang, then a bolt into the dark
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: dig by day; sell to the quartermaster; never look at the great mound
Quirk: dig at dusk

npcs.name: Senior Diviner Okubo Tomonori
npcs.info:
A respected senior diviner who sets the Bureau's examinations and is known for failing students who cheat. In person: stern middle-aged senior onmyoji diviner; nervous eyes.

**Home Ground:** Examination Hall at Bureau of Yin and Yang, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** A lecturing voice that turns brittle near the subject of old exams. A lecturing voice, confident and clipped. Tell: near old exams or the ward stones it turns brittle.
**Combat Role:** talismans and rank.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention Senkichi's name and his lecture stops mid-word.
personality: Core: harsh with cheats; avoids the ward stones; sleeps badly
Quirk: proud of his record

npcs.name: Senior Diviner Okubo Tomonori
npcs.location: Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Silent Bureau
npcs.info:
The Bureau's senior diviner after the war, who still sets the examinations and still fails students who cheat. He spends his nights on a lantern boat on the lake. In person: stern senior onmyoji; nervous eyes gone hollow; a rented boat's cushion.

**Home Ground:** Examination Hall, After the War at Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Silent Bureau, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** A lecturing voice that turns brittle near the subject of old exams. A lecturing voice, confident and clipped. Tell since the war: he lectures to the water now, and stops when he hears oars.
**Combat Role:** talismans and rank.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention Senkichi's name and his lecture stops mid-word.
personality: Core: harsh with cheats; avoids the ward stones; sleeps badly
Quirk: proud of his record

npcs.name: Sergeant Ishida
npcs.info:
Sergeant of the granary guard, forty, who walks the walls of the Shogunate's great rice granary day and night with twenty spearmen. He watches the hungry villagers walk past slowly and does not like what he is guarding them from. In person: ashigaru sergeant; stubble; tired eyes; conical jingasa hat; padded armour with a crane crest; a spear.

**Home Ground:** Granary Floor at Shogunate Rice Granary, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Barked and tired; he says everything twice, the second time slower. Barks once, then repeats it slower, as if to a recruit. Sighs through his nose between orders. Tell: when he is hiding something he talks about the weather and the rice.
**Combat Role:** spear and the wall; he calls the guard out before he fights.
**Relationship Hook:** Show him the pledge papers mean his granary feeds the guild, not the plain, and he looks the other way one night.
personality: Core: repeats orders; counts sacks when he cannot sleep; eats only rice and pickles
Quirk: looks at the villagers, then away

npcs.name: Sergeant Utsumi
npcs.info:
Sergeant of the small garrison at the Old Coast Fort, forty-five, who keeps a few sailors and a half-ruined sea wall against pirates nobody has seen in years. In person: gruff garrison sergeant; unshaven; worn sea-blue coat; sea wall behind.

**Home Ground:** Powder Store at Old Coast Fort, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff, bored and evasive; he complains about the damp to change the subject. Gruff, bored, complaining about damp to dodge questions. Tell: when the powder is mentioned he clears his throat and complains louder.
**Combat Role:** a spear behind a ruined wall.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him fill the powder store before the inspection and he names the buyer.
personality: Core: counts empty kegs; drinks on watch; never looks at the sea wall
Quirk: complains about the damp

npcs.name: Sergeant Utsumi
npcs.location: Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort
npcs.info:
Sergeant of the old coast fort after the war, forty-seven, who stayed when his garrison sold the last powder and walked home. The smugglers use his sea wall as a quay, and he lets them. In person: gruff sergeant; unshaven; worn sea-blue coat; a sea wall with smugglers' boats moored along it.

**Home Ground:** Powder Store, After the War at Old Coast Fort, The Abandoned Fort, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff, bored and evasive; he complains about the damp to change the subject. Gruff, bored, complaining about damp to dodge questions. Tell since the war: he complains about the damp, then about the smugglers' boats, and never about the crate.
**Combat Role:** a spear behind a ruined wall.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him fill the powder store before the inspection and he names the buyer.
personality: Core: counts empty kegs; drinks on watch; never looks at the sea wall
Quirk: complains about the damp

npcs.name: Shaft Revenant
npcs.info:
A miner's body walking without its soul, lantern in hand. Revenants walk the shafts, following their blades. A stock foe, one of many. In person: soulless miner revenant with a lantern.

**Speaking Style:** An empty echo, the same few words of a miner's shift, over and over. A pick strikes stone. Tell: when someone says 'rest' it pauses.
**Combat Role:** it walks through you
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows its blade; does not feel; walks
Quirk: repeats its work

npcs.name: Shaft Revenant
npcs.info:
A miner's body walking without its soul, lantern in hand, that no longer stays in the lower gallery: the revenants climb at night towards the town, following blades taken to the war. A stock foe, one of many. In person: soulless miner revenant; a lantern; a siege-digger's mud-caked jacket; eyes fixed on the shaft's mouth.

**Speaking Style:** An empty echo, the same few words of a miner's shift, over and over. A pick strikes stone. Tell since the war: it lifts its lantern towards the surface each time it pauses.
**Combat Role:** it walks through you
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows its blade upward; does not feel; climbs
Quirk: repeats its work

npcs.name: Shaft Tsuchigumo
npcs.info:
A huge earth spider grown pale in the dark, nesting among the revenants' broken carts. It feeds on the revenants and anyone who comes down for them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge pale tsuchigumo earth spider.

**Speaking Style:** Clicking in the dark, slow and patient, silk whispering. Tell: when it smells a revenant the clicking turns eager.
**Combat Role:** the web, then the drop
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: waits in the dark; drags into the gallery; eats revenants
Quirk: pale as bone

npcs.name: Shaft Tsuchigumo
npcs.epithet: Spider Starving in the Pale Nest
npcs.info:
A huge pale earth spider, thin and failing, that can no longer hold the revenants below: they climb past it every night following the blades taken to war. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge pale tsuchigumo earth spider; gaunt; legs missing on one side; torn webs.

**Speaking Style:** Clicking in the dark, slow and patient, silk whispering. Tell since the war: its legs tremble at the sound of the revenants' climbing.
**Combat Role:** the web, then the drop
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: waits in the dark; drags weakly; fails
Quirk: pale as bone

npcs.name: Shepherd Moku
npcs.info:
A moorland shepherd, sixty, who grazes his sheep around the old ward stones and has never once let them inside the ring. He is quiet, weathered and very hard to frighten. In person: weathered moorland shepherd; straw cloak; grey stubble; calm eyes; a crook; misty moor.

**Home Ground:** Stone Ring at Old Ward Stones, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words and slow ones; he watches the stones while you talk. Very few words, slow ones, eyes on the stones; long silences you are expected to fill. Tell: when the stones crack, he talks a lot and fast.
**Combat Role:** a crook and a dog.
**Relationship Hook:** Mend the cracked stone and he feeds you on the moor forever.
personality: Core: watches the stones while talking; counts his sheep every hour; sleeps by the cracked stone
Quirk: never steps inside the ring

npcs.name: Shepherd Moku
npcs.location: Old Ward Stones, The Broken Ring
npcs.info:
The moorland shepherd after the war, sixty-two, who sleeps by the cracked stones with a lantern and a hired ronin. The sheep do not come near the ring at all now. In person: weathered shepherd; straw cloak; grey stubble; calm eyes; a crook; a ronin asleep beside him.

**Home Ground:** Stone Ring, After the War at Old Ward Stones, The Broken Ring, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Few words and slow ones; he watches the stones while you talk. Very few words, slow ones, eyes on the stones; long silences you are expected to fill. Tell since the war: he talks more than he did, and faster, because the stones crack more than they did.
**Combat Role:** a crook and a dog.
**Relationship Hook:** Mend the cracked stone and he feeds you on the moor forever.
personality: Core: watches the stones while talking; counts his sheep every hour; sleeps by the cracked stone
Quirk: never steps inside the ring

npcs.name: Shiba Kagemori
npcs.info:
The new leader of the deserters on Pine Avenue, twenty-four, son of a house that lost the war, who took the samurai recruit's place when he fell. The deserters follow him because he knows how to make the road pay. In person: young man; deserter samurai; long hair tied loosely; faded house crest; an undrawn sword.

**Home Ground:** Shaded Verge, After the War at Pine Avenue, The Deserters' Avenue, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Easy and bitter, a lord's son's polish worn thin by the road. Court polish worn thin by the road, bitter jokes in good grammar. Tell: when his brother is named he recites a line of the poem instead of answering.
**Combat Role:** his deserters at the trees, his own sword only at the last.
**Relationship Hook:** Clear the Shiba name and the deserters of Pine Avenue will follow whoever did it.
personality: Core: speaks court Japanese to bandits; never robs the poor; polishes a sword he does not draw
Quirk: reads the poem on the pine

npcs.name: Shiba Tadaoki
npcs.info:
A disgraced samurai, thirty-five, who has joined a highwayman's band in the pines on market days. He robs politely, quotes poetry, and never takes a traveller's last coin. In person: disgraced samurai highwayman; unkempt topknot; stubble; tired eyes; faded formal kimono with the crest cut off; katana; bitter smile.

**Home Ground:** Shaded Verge at Pine Avenue, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, bitter and educated; he quotes poetry while he robs you. Educated, bitter diction with a classical line of poetry dropped into every robbery. Sighs before he draws. Tell: when he speaks of the farmer he refused to kill, the bitterness goes and he sounds ashamed.
**Combat Role:** the draw-cut, clean and sad.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him a reason to put the sword to better use and he follows you.
personality: Core: never takes the last coin; keeps his crest hidden; bows to his victims
Quirk: quotes poetry while robbing

npcs.name: Shinonome Tatsumi
npcs.info:
A breath hunter of the character's cohort who counts every demon he kills out loud and swears he will be the first of their year to cut a ranked demon. In person: young man; broad and sunburned; short wild red-brown hair; a scar; a black hunter's uniform with the Hinode sun crest; a wide-bladed sword.

**Home Ground:** Inspection Hall at Cedar Pass Barrier, Fifty Stations Road district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Loud, earnest and breathless, every sentence a dare, a laugh like a shout. Loud, earnest, breathless, every line a dare. Tell: at his brother's name he goes completely quiet.
**Combat Role:** sun breath first, then whatever the bout demands; a breath hunter rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** He will tell you his count and demand yours, then challenge you to beat it by dawn.
personality: Core: counts his kills out loud; eats like a horse; never admits he is tired
Quirk: slaps his own cheeks before a fight

npcs.name: Shiori of the Ferry Stones
npcs.info:
A drowned girl who waits among the Ferry Stones and asks every passer-by for their name, because she has forgotten her own and thinks one of them might be it. She is not hungry yet. In person: pale and wet; long black hair plastered flat; a plain soaked kimono; bare feet; puzzled.

**Home Ground:** The Stone Field at The Ferry Stones, The Far Shore, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Soft, polite and a little puzzled; she asks for names the way a child asks for a story. Soft, polite and puzzled, names asked for the way a child asks for a story, each one tried on aloud. Tell: her own name read to her and she says it twice, then nothing.
**Combat Role:** none yet; a drowned grudge that turns hungry is another matter.
**Relationship Hook:** Read her the names on the stones one by one; when you reach hers she knows.
personality: Core: asks for names politely; drips without getting anything wet; cannot read
Quirk: counts the stones and gets a different number each time

npcs.name: Shizume of the Two Shadows
npcs.info:
A quiet woman in dark travelling clothes who keeps the empty teahouse on the haunted lane, two short swords crossed at the small of her back. In person: adult woman; short dark hair; sharp calm eyes; dark close-fitting travelling clothes; two short swords crossed; watchful.

**Home Ground:** Empty Teahouse at Haunted Teahouse Lane, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and level, few words, every one of them practical; she watches doors while she talks. Low, level and practical, eyes on the door while she talks. Tell: asked who she guarded, she pours a second cup instead of answering.
**Combat Role:** two short swords, one guarding while the other cuts, then a spinning flurry in tight spaces.
**Relationship Hook:** Fight through her teahouse in the dark without touching a wall.
personality: Core: sets out a second cup; never sits with her back to a window; speaks only of what is useful
Quirk: watches doors

npcs.name: Shizume of the Two Shadows
npcs.location: Haunted Teahouse Lane, The Guarded Lane
npcs.info:
The quiet woman with two short swords after the war, who keeps the empty teahouse at the lane's end and sets out two cups still. In person: woman; short dark hair; sharp calm eyes; dark close-fitting clothes; two short swords crossed at her back.

**Home Ground:** Empty Teahouse, After the War at Haunted Teahouse Lane, The Guarded Lane, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and level, few words, every one of them practical; she watches doors while she talks. Low, level and practical, eyes on the door while she talks. Tell since the war: she pours the second cup and then a third, for whoever leaves the offerings.
**Combat Role:** two short swords, one guarding while the other cuts, then a spinning flurry in tight spaces.
**Relationship Hook:** Fight through her teahouse in the dark without touching a wall.
personality: Core: sets out a second cup; never sits with her back to a window; speaks only of what is useful
Quirk: watches doors

npcs.name: Shore Devourer
npcs.info:
A huge masked spirit with many arms that hunts the shore after tide nights. Devourers eat the hungry masks and anything else. A stock foe, one of many. In person: masked devourer; huge many-armed spirit with a great white mask.

**Speaking Style:** A deep hungry rumble that drags its words, asking everyone for their face. Tell: when it sees its own mask on someone it goes silent.
**Combat Role:** many arms and a devouring mask
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: eats masks; slow then fast; searches for its face
Quirk: hunts after tides

npcs.name: Shore Devourer
npcs.location: Mask Shore, Shore of Washed-Up Masks
npcs.info:
A huge many-armed masked spirit fat on the war's hungry masks; their old masks wash up on the shore by the dozen behind it. A stock foe, one of many. In person: masked devourer; huge many-armed spirit; a great white mask; dozens of smaller masks fused into its back.

**Speaking Style:** A deep hungry rumble that drags its words, asking everyone for their face. Tell since the war: it plucks a washed-up mask from the sand and fits it to its back each time it pauses.
**Combat Role:** many arms and a devouring mask
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: eats masks; slow then fast; still searches for its face
Quirk: hunts after tides

npcs.name: Shore-Town Cutthroat
npcs.info:
An exile with a seal-hunter's harpoon and a brand on his cheek who robs newcomers on the quay. Cutthroats take the last thing a new exile owns, and sometimes the exile. A stock foe, one of many. In person: branded exile cutthroat with a seal-hunter's harpoon.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and amused, a northern drawl, the harpoon's chain rattling under his words. Tell: when his brand is mocked the amusement drops.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon from range, a knife up close
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: tests newcomers; harpoons from range; drinks seal oil
Quirk: shows his brand

npcs.name: Shore-Town Cutthroat
npcs.location: Exiles' Shore Towns, Towns Packing to Leave
npcs.area: Seal Hunters' Quay, After the War
npcs.info:
An exile with a seal-hunter's harpoon and a brand on his cheek who robs the families loading their boats to leave; the ice is cracking and the quay is all newcomers' goods and old exiles' last things. A stock foe, one of many. In person: branded exile cutthroat; a seal-hunter's harpoon; a stolen family's sealskin coat.

**Speaking Style:** Cold and amused, a northern drawl, the harpoon's chain rattling under his words. Tell since the war: he eyes the boats, not the people, while he talks.
**Combat Role:** a harpoon from range, a knife up close
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: robs the leavers; harpoons from range; drinks seal oil
Quirk: shows his brand

npcs.name: Shrine Maiden Hayashida Yae
npcs.info:
A shrine maiden of the plain's sun shrine, who dances the dawn rite and blesses the first sheaf of every harvest. In person: young shrine maiden; sunlight; rice fields.

**Home Ground:** Dawn Torii at Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and bright like early morning, a shrine maiden who greets the sun every dawn. Bright and calm as early morning, a soft bell-like lilt on the sun rite's words. Tell: when the masks are mentioned her brightness wavers.
**Combat Role:** a sun sutra and a bell.
**Relationship Hook:** Help fund the dawn rite and she teaches you a sun sutra.
personality: Core: dances while she sweeps; blesses every sheaf; worries about the masks
Quirk: greets the sun

npcs.name: Shrine Maiden Hayashida Yae
npcs.location: Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Mourning Shrine
npcs.info:
The sun shrine's maiden after the emperor's death, who keeps the rites alone while the priest searches the isles. She dances the dawn rite for a thin harvest and a dead emperor. In person: young shrine maiden in white over red; a mourning ribbon in her hair; the vermilion torii hung with white.

**Home Ground:** Dawn Torii, After the War at Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, Mourning Shrine, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm and bright like early morning, a shrine maiden who greets the sun every dawn. Bright and calm as early morning, a soft bell-like lilt on the sun rite's words. Tell since the war: she hums the dawn rite under ordinary speech, as if afraid to let the thread drop.
**Combat Role:** a sun sutra and a bell.
**Relationship Hook:** Help fund the dawn rite and she teaches you a sun sutra.
personality: Core: dances while she sweeps; blesses every sheaf; worries about the masks
Quirk: greets the sun

npcs.name: Shrine-Keeper Akari
npcs.info:
A young shrine-keeper, nineteen, who crosses the stepping stones at low tide every day to sweep a shrine nobody visits, because her mother told her the sea's kami would come back if someone kept the lamp shrine clean. In person: young woman; nineteen; slim; long black hair tied with a white paper ribbon; bright brown eyes; a white shrine attendant's kosode with red hakama; a bamboo broom; a small pouch of salt.

**Home Ground:** Lamp Shrine at The Shrine on the Rock, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and earnest, a shrine attendant's careful words, quick to laugh at herself. Bright, earnest and careful, apologising to the kami mid-sentence, counting under her breath. Tell: about the lighthouse at night her brightness goes thin and quick.
**Combat Role:** salt and a broom handle, and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Cross the stepping stones with her at low tide and she will show you what the keeper wrote about the lamp.
personality: Core: earnest to a fault; apologises to the kami before she sweeps; brave about everything except the lighthouse
Quirk: counts the stepping stones aloud, every time

npcs.name: Shrine-Keeper Isuke
npcs.info:
An old keeper of the salt marsh shrine who sweeps the boardwalk altar every morning and leaves a rice ball under it. In person: old shrine keeper sweeping a weathered boardwalk altar.

**Home Ground:** Boardwalk Altar at Salt Marsh Shrine, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and kind, a little hard of hearing, talking to the marsh as much as to you. Tell: asked about the flood, he looks at the altar.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and salt.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask who the rice ball under the altar is for and he tells you about the flood.
personality: Core: sweeps every morning; talks to the marsh; remembers the flood
Quirk: leaves a rice ball under the altar

npcs.name: Shrine-Keeper Isuke
npcs.location: Salt Marsh Shrine, Shrine of Dear News
npcs.info:
The salt marsh shrine's old keeper after the war, who still sweeps the boardwalk altar and leaves a rice ball under it every morning. In person: old shrine keeper sweeping a weathered boardwalk altar; a second rice ball now.

**Home Ground:** Boardwalk Altar, After the War at Salt Marsh Shrine, Shrine of Dear News, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow and kind, a little hard of hearing, talking to the marsh as much as to you. Tell since the war: he sets down two rice balls and speaks to both of them, one a little more gently.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and salt.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask who the rice ball under the altar is for and he tells you about the flood.
personality: Core: sweeps every morning; talks to the marsh; remembers the flood
Quirk: leaves a rice ball under the altar

npcs.name: Shun the Biwa Monk
npcs.info:
A blind biwa monk, sixty, who walks the Blight's pilgrim road with a lute on his back, singing the tale of the old capital's fall for anyone who feeds him. In person: blind biwa monk; shaved head; closed eyes; dark robes; a lute; solemn.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road at Grey Pilgrims' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A storyteller's chant, slow and rhythmic; he speaks in verses of the old war. A storyteller's chant, slow and rhythmic, speaking in verses of the old war with a pluck of the biwa between lines. He never says 'I'; he says 'this monk'. Tell: when a story touches the present he stops playing and speaks plainly.
**Combat Role:** his staff, and the dead stop to listen.
**Relationship Hook:** Feed him and hear the whole tale, last verse and all.
personality: Core: tunes his lute when nervous; hears footsteps a mile off; never sings the last verse twice
Quirk: speaks in verses

npcs.name: Shun the Biwa Monk
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
The blind biwa monk after the war, sixty-two, singing the old capital's fall to soldiers on the penitents' road. They listen now. In person: blind biwa monk; shaved head; closed eyes; dark robes; a lute with a new string.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A storyteller's chant, slow and rhythmic; he speaks in verses of the old war. A storyteller's chant, slow and rhythmic, speaking in verses of the old war with a pluck of the biwa between lines. He never says 'I'; he says 'this monk'. Tell since the war: when this monk sings the last verse, he stops plucking and lets the road's quiet finish it.
**Combat Role:** his staff, and the dead stop to listen.
**Relationship Hook:** Feed him and hear the whole tale, last verse and all.
personality: Core: tunes his lute when nervous; hears footsteps a mile off; never sings the last verse twice
Quirk: speaks in verses

npcs.name: Smiling Okon
npcs.info:
The smiling woman who keeps the debt book at the loudest gambling den on Lantern Row, forty, round-faced and cheerful. She lends to anyone at the dice table and remembers to the coin what they owe. In person: cheerful gambling den keeper; round smiling face; hair; bright red kimono; a debt book with a red cord.

**Home Ground:** Dice Room at Lantern Row Gambling Den, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, giggling and merciless; she sings the numbers of your debt like a children's rhyme. Giggling and sing-song, counting debts like a nursery rhyme. Now and then closes a threat with 'isn't that nice?', never twice in a scene. Tell: when she is truly angry the giggle stops and her voice goes flat and adult.
**Combat Role:** never; her bouncers and the guild collect.
**Relationship Hook:** Win at her table honestly and she likes you; buy the captain's son's debt and you own a Mizuchi heir.
personality: Core: giggles at bad rolls; never gambles; keeps a debt book with a red cord
Quirk: sings debts like nursery rhymes

npcs.name: Smiling Okon
npcs.epithet: Keeper of the Dead Men's Book
npcs.location: Lantern Row Gambling Den, Soldiers' Den
npcs.info:
The debt-book keeper of the Soldiers' Den after the war, forty-two, smiling still, who buys dead soldiers' debts cheap and collects from their widows. In person: cheerful den keeper; round smiling face; bright red kimono; a debt book with a black cord now.

**Home Ground:** Dice Room, After the War at Lantern Row Gambling Den, Soldiers' Den, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright, giggling and merciless; she sings the numbers of your debt like a children's rhyme. Giggling and sing-song, counting debts like a nursery rhyme. Now and then closes a threat with 'isn't that nice?', never twice in a scene. Tell since the war: at the Mizuchi name her giggle stops a moment too long before it starts again.
**Combat Role:** never; her bouncers and the guild collect.
**Relationship Hook:** Win at her table honestly and she likes you; buy the captain's son's debt and you own a Mizuchi heir.
personality: Core: giggles at bad rolls; never gambles; keeps a debt book with a red cord
Quirk: sings debts like nursery rhymes

npcs.name: Smith Apprentice Tsubaki
npcs.info:
A smith's apprentice in the waking hall, nineteen, who pumps the bellows and asks where the soul-blades come from. In person: young blunt smith apprentice pumping bellows; soot; curious eyes.

**Home Ground:** Waking Hall at Forge Guild Hall, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Bright and blunt, an apprentice who asks the questions the masters will not answer. Bright and blunt, questions fired between bellows pumps. Tell: about the deep forges she whispers for the first time.
**Combat Role:** a smith's hammer and a lot of nerve.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask her about the deep forges and she tells you what she saw.
personality: Core: asks forbidden questions; burns her hands; dreams of the deep forges
Quirk: pumps bellows

npcs.name: Smugglers' Cave Lookout
npcs.info:
A smugglers' lookout in an oilskin cloak with a spyglass, a gutting knife and a signal lamp. Lookouts watch the tide mouth and signal the caves when anyone comes in at low water. A stock foe, one of many. In person: smugglers' lookout; spyglass; gutting knife; signal lamp.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and salty, sea songs hummed between words. Tell: a better offer makes her hum louder.
**Combat Role:** a knife at the cave mouth and a lamp for the crew
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hums sea songs; changes sides for coin; hates the cold
Quirk: peers through the spyglass

npcs.name: Snowshoe Hold Scout
npcs.info:
A Hold scout on snowshoes in a black hunter's coat with a sun-steel knife and a horn. Hold scouts check every cart on the supply road and treat strangers as demons until proven otherwise. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hold scout; black hunter's coat; sun-steel knife; horn.

**Speaking Style:** Short and watchful, every word a challenge. Tell: when she trusts you, she uses your name.
**Combat Role:** a sun-steel knife and a horn for the Hold
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: horn ready; suspicious of strangers; counts carts
Quirk: checks breath in the cold

npcs.name: Soot Street Brawler
npcs.info:
A miner as wide as a door, soot to the elbows, who fights strangers for their boots on payday. Brawlers run the soot street on payday nights and settle every argument with fists. A stock foe, one of many. In person: huge soot-covered miner brawler with bare fists.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and cheerful about it. Loud, cheerful and coughing, laughing between punches, soot in his throat. Tell: hit hard, he laughs louder and calls you friend.
**Combat Role:** fists, a headbutt, soot in the eyes
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs at blood; shares the winnings; respects a hard hit
Quirk: cracks his knuckles

npcs.name: Soot Street Brawler
npcs.info:
A miner's son, wide as his father was, who fights on Soot Street for the coin the house never paid the men it sent to dig siege works. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young soot-covered miner brawler; bare fists; his dead father's mining helmet; a black mourning cord on one wrist.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and cheerful about it. Loud, cheerful and coughing, laughing between punches, soot in his throat. Tell since the war: he cracks his knuckles and names his father before every fight.
**Combat Role:** fists, a headbutt, soot in the eyes
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs at blood; sends the winnings home; hits samurai harder
Quirk: cracks his knuckles

npcs.name: Sora of the Lamp House
npcs.info:
Widow Toki's grandson, twenty, lean and sunburned, who rows out to the island against her wishes and sleeps in the empty house because it is the only thing his family owns. In person: young man; twenty; lean; sunburned; short messy black hair; a cut lip healing; sleeveless indigo work jacket; rope belt; rolled trousers; bare feet; a boat hook.

**Home Ground:** Keeper's Hearth at The Cliff House, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Eager, quick and a little too loud, a sailor's slang he learned on the quay. Quick and loud, quay slang, two fingers drumming on whatever is near. Tell: asked about his grandfather he goes quiet and the drumming stops mid-beat.
**Combat Role:** a boat hook swung wide, then a shoulder to the gut.
**Relationship Hook:** He will show you every room of the house that is still standing, and every room that is not, if you help him patch the roof.
personality: Core: volunteers before he is asked; boasts, then works twice as hard to make the boast true
Quirk: drums on whatever is nearest with two fingers

npcs.name: Sparring Partner Kuranosuke
npcs.info:
A ronin who sparse with anyone in the Yard for the price of a meal and the chance to talk. He has fought every tradition's students and can imitate each one badly. In person: adult man; lean and grinning; messy topknot; a sleeveless gi with a wooden blade; cocky.

**Home Ground:** Sparring Circles at The Yard, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, cocky and generous with advice nobody asked for; he loses well and wins worse. Cheerful and cocky, advice nobody asked for between exchanges, losses taken well and wins taken worse. Tell: the terraces mentioned and the cockiness goes flat.
**Combat Role:** a ronin's plain swordwork with borrowed flourishes from every student he has fought.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with him and lose on purpose once; he notices, and tells you which master would take you.
personality: Core: gives unasked advice; imitates every tradition badly; eats while sparring
Quirk: wins worse than he loses

npcs.name: Spring Snow Monkey Troop
npcs.info:
A troop of red-faced snow monkeys around a steaming pool, led by a scarred old male. The troop mobs anyone who comes to the pools with food or a weapon. A stock foe, one of many. In person: troop of red-faced snow monkeys; scarred old male leader.

**Speaking Style:** Screeching from every side at once, the old male's bark over it. Tell: when he barks twice the troop goes quiet.
**Combat Role:** a screeching mob from every side
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: steals packs; throws snow; mobs together
Quirk: screeches

npcs.name: Spring Snow Monkey Troop
npcs.location: Snow Monkey Springs, The Silent Springs
npcs.area: Snow Monkey Springs: Steaming Pools, After the War
npcs.info:
A troop of red-faced snow monkeys that went silent before the Wall fell and has not screamed since; they sit in the steaming pools watching the treeline, and mob anyone who brings the north's smell. A stock foe, one of many. In person: troop of red-faced snow monkeys; the scarred old male gone grey; a hunter's knife still in his grip.

**Speaking Style:** Screeching from every side at once, the old male's bark over it. Tell since the war: they do not screech; they all turn north at once.
**Combat Role:** a screeching mob from every side
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: silent; watch the treeline; mob together
Quirk: screeches

npcs.name: Star-Reader Enju Kagamine
npcs.info:
An onmyoji of the old calendar who keeps a lodge full of charts on the Training Ground and teaches onmyoji to bind a true familiar. Her paper servants are folded so finely they pass for birds. In person: composed; black hair; dark eyes; layered onmyoji robes; a folded paper bird; serene.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Precise, patient and faintly amused; she speaks in complete sentences and waits for the answer she already knows. Complete sentences, patiently paced, the answer begun before the question ends; faint amusement under all of it. Tell: her familiar's name each morning, said like a greeting.
**Combat Role:** wards and a true familiar; she stands still and the familiar does the fighting.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her a name you learned honestly and she folds a servant for you on the spot.
personality: Core: folds paper while she talks; reads the hour from the sky; names her familiar aloud each morning
Quirk: answers before the question ends

npcs.name: Station Master Ogiwara Tokuzo
npcs.info:
The post master of Oiwake Station's stables, fifty, broad and red-faced, who knows every rider on the road by name and every horse by temper. In person: middle-aged man; broad red-faced post master; short thick beard; stable master's jacket and apron.

**Home Ground:** Post Stable at Oiwake Station, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud with travellers, flat and quiet with his own men. Hearty and loud with travellers, a back-slapping laugh, horses' names in every story. Tell: near the rider's name his voice goes flat and he looks for water to wash in.
**Combat Role:** a heavy stable hook and his men around him.
**Relationship Hook:** Name the rider in front of his men and his hands go to the water bucket.
personality: Core: slaps backs; names every horse; drinks with the riders he sends out
Quirk: washes his hands too often

npcs.name: Station Master Ogiwara Tokuzo
npcs.epithet: Stable Master of the Peasant Army
npcs.info:
The post master of Oiwake's stables, fifty-two, who runs the captured horses for the Straw Mask army that took his station; he slaps the backs of men he does not trust. In person: middle-aged man; broad post master gone thinner and grey; a short thick beard; a stable master's apron over a straw mask army sash.

**Home Ground:** Post Stable, After the War at Oiwake Station, Behind the Barricade, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud with travellers, flat and quiet with his own men. Hearty and loud with travellers, a back-slapping laugh, horses' names in every story. Tell since the war: he laughs a beat too long at his own jokes, and stops when someone looks at the hay loft.
**Combat Role:** a heavy stable hook and his men around him.
**Relationship Hook:** Name the rider in front of his men and his hands go to the water bucket.
personality: Core: slaps backs; names every horse; drinks with the riders he sends out
Quirk: washes his hands too often

npcs.name: Step-Warden Taiga
npcs.info:
A breath hunter who guards the Thin Air Steps and counts who makes it up gasping. He lets hunters through when the isles have learned their names and sends the rest down with a word about their lungs. In person: adult man; big-shouldered; cropped black hair; wind-reddened face; a hunter's dark uniform with a patterned haori; a blade; scowling.

**Home Ground:** The First Landing at The Thin Air Steps, Sun Peak, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Loud in thin air, which takes effort; short barked sentences between breaths and no patience for excuses. Short barked sentences between breaths, loud because thin air demands it, no patience for excuses. Tell: the Boulder named and he changes the subject in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** a hunter's blade and the first breath form; loud, direct, and short of air.
**Relationship Hook:** Make it up without stopping and he shares the fire; tell him you failed the Boulder and he tells you how many times he did.
personality: Core: barks between breaths; counts steps aloud for climbers; shares the cook's fire with anyone who made it up
Quirk: will not look toward the Boulder

npcs.name: Steward Kosaka Gen
npcs.info:
Steward of House Hiwada, forty-five, thin and careful, who keeps the house's accounts, its grain and, these days, the barred stall at the end of the stables. Riders call him the lord's conscience and the lord's abacus. In person: thin steward; neat grey hair; careful eyes; plain brown kimono with a sun-arrow crest; an abacus; keys; nervous horses.

**Home Ground:** Hiwada Stables at Hiwada Horse Fields, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and exact, a bookkeeper among horsemen; he apologises before saying anything unwelcome. Soft, tidy sentences, apologising before he contradicts anyone ('forgive me', once, not every time). Clears his throat before a figure. Tell: when he must deliver bad news to his lord he reads it as a list, as if a list could not be blamed.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides behind the horses and calls the riders.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him raise the debt money without the lord knowing and he opens the barred stall for you.
personality: Core: apologises before bad news; counts under his breath; dislikes the capital
Quirk: feeds the barred stall himself

npcs.name: Steward Kosaka Gen
npcs.location: Hiwada Horse Fields, The Empty Pastures
npcs.info:
Steward of House Hiwada after its lord fell at Sekigane, forty-seven, who holds the house together with the widows of the riders and an abacus. The guild's men are coming to count the horses. In person: thin steward; grey hair gone white; mourning band on the sun-arrow crest; an abacus; keys.

**Home Ground:** Hiwada Stables, After the War at Hiwada Horse Fields, The Empty Pastures, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and exact, a bookkeeper among horsemen; he apologises before saying anything unwelcome. Soft, tidy sentences, apologising before he contradicts anyone ('forgive me', once, not every time). Clears his throat before a figure. Tell since the war: he begins 'my lord' and stops, remembering there is no lord to say it to.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides behind the horses and calls the riders.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him raise the debt money without the lord knowing and he opens the barred stall for you.
personality: Core: apologises before bad news; counts under his breath; dislikes the capital
Quirk: feeds the barred stall himself

npcs.name: Stilt-Market Crier Funao
npcs.info:
Crier of Ashiura's stilt market, who stands on a barrel and sings the coast's bounties to the boats twice a day. In person: adult man; cheerful market crier standing; rolled bounty notices.

**Home Ground:** Stilt Market at Ashiura, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A market crier's big cheerful voice that carries across the water; he sings the bounties. A big singing crier's voice that rolls across water, every notice set to a tune. Tell: singing a verse he was paid to get wrong, he goes off-key.
**Combat Role:** a pole off the barrel and a leap into the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him singing a verse wrong and he begs you to take the real bounty instead.
personality: Core: sings every notice; balances on the barrel; drinks with the fishermen
Quirk: knows every boat by its sail

npcs.name: Stilt-Market Crier Funao
npcs.info:
Crier of Ashiura's stilt market after the war, who sings the coast's bounties and the Brine Tide's prices from the same barrel. In person: market crier on a barrel; rolled bounty notices; a hoarser voice.

**Home Ground:** Stilt Market, After the War at Ashiura, Under Smugglers' Flags, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A market crier's big cheerful voice that carries across the water; he sings the bounties. A big singing crier's voice that rolls across water, every notice set to a tune. Tell since the war: he sings the bounties on the Tide's own captains loudest, and checks the water afterwards.
**Combat Role:** a pole off the barrel and a leap into the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Catch him singing a verse wrong and he begs you to take the real bounty instead.
personality: Core: sings every notice; balances on the barrel; drinks with the fishermen
Quirk: knows every boat by its sail

npcs.name: Storm-Ridge Raiju
npcs.info:
A white thunder beast like a lynx of lightning with a crackling tail, sleeping in the steam until the storms wake it. Storm raiju fall from the clouds with the lightning and scorch whatever they land on. A stock foe, one of many. In person: raiju; white thunder beast like a lynx of lightning with a crackling tail.

**Speaking Style:** A crackling snarl, thunder under the words. Tell: in the steam it purrs like a cat.
**Combat Role:** a lightning pounce from the storm
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: howls at storms; sleeps in steam; chases thunder
Quirk: sparks when angry

npcs.name: Student Akitsu
npcs.info:
A Bureau student, twenty, a promising scribe and a terrible poet, who walks to Moonview Bridge every full moon. In person: romantic onmyoji student; soft hair; dreamy eyes; white student robes.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown at Moonview Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest and romantic, a poet's flourishes; he blushes at his own lines. Romantic flourishes, poetic lines, blushing stammer at his own boldness. Tell: when he speaks of the moon, his voice goes soft and certain.
**Combat Role:** a ward he wrote himself, mostly correct.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him and the moon fox get away and the Fox Court remembers.
personality: Core: blushes easily; ties ribbons on the bridge; skips calligraphy class
Quirk: writes bad poetry

npcs.name: Student Akitsu
npcs.info:
A Bureau student after the war, twenty-two, a promising scribe and a terrible poet, who still walks to Moonview Bridge every full moon for a fox who will not come. In person: onmyoji student; soft hair; tired dreamy eyes; white robes with a ribbon tied round one wrist.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown, After the War at Moonview Bridge, The Mourning Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest and romantic, a poet's flourishes; he blushes at his own lines. Romantic flourishes, poetic lines, blushing stammer at his own boldness. Tell since the war: he speaks of the moon in the past tense, and corrects himself to the present.
**Combat Role:** a ward he wrote himself, mostly correct.
**Relationship Hook:** Help him and the moon fox get away and the Fox Court remembers.
personality: Core: blushes easily; ties ribbons on the bridge; skips calligraphy class
Quirk: writes bad poetry

npcs.name: Student Folder Hanae
npcs.info:
A Bureau student who folds paper familiars at the workshop tables, talented, careless and always behind. In person: young onmyoji student folding paper birds; paper everywhere; ink-stained fingers.

**Home Ground:** Folding Tables at Paper Familiar Workshop, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick and giggly, a student who folds while she talks and drops paper birds everywhere. Quick and giggly, paper rustling under every sentence. Tell: at 'runaway' the giggle turns to a squeak.
**Combat Role:** a flock of paper birds in the face.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention the runaway and she begs you not to tell, then sends you to her uncle.
personality: Core: folds while talking; drops paper birds; always late
Quirk: giggles when nervous

npcs.name: Student Folder Hanae
npcs.epithet: The Student Who Folded Too Well
npcs.location: Paper Familiar Workshop, The Folded Army
npcs.info:
A Bureau student after the war, talented, careless and further behind than ever. The runaway familiars write to her. In person: young onmyoji student; paper everywhere; ink-stained fingers; a folded paper message she will not open.

**Home Ground:** Folding Tables, After the War at Paper Familiar Workshop, The Folded Army, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quick and giggly, a student who folds while she talks and drops paper birds everywhere. Quick and giggly, paper rustling under every sentence. Tell since the war: she holds the unopened message against her chest while she talks, and never puts it down.
**Combat Role:** a flock of paper birds in the face.
**Relationship Hook:** Mention the runaway and she begs you not to tell, then sends you to her uncle.
personality: Core: folds while talking; drops paper birds; always late
Quirk: giggles when nervous

npcs.name: Student Hotaru
npcs.info:
A first-year Bureau student, sixteen, who studies by candle, breaks curfew, and has started sleepwalking towards the lake. In person: young onmyoji student; messy hair; sleepy eyes; white student robes; a white hare drawn in ink.

**Home Ground:** Sleeping Rows at Bureau Dormitories, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest, high and quick; at night he speaks slowly in a voice that is not quite his. High, eager, questions on top of questions. Scratches notes as he talks. Tell: at night his voice drops and slows, and he does not notice it is happening.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Follow him on a sleepwalk and you see what the hare wants.
personality: Core: studies by candle; breaks curfew; talks in his sleep
Quirk: draws hares in his margins

npcs.name: Student Hotaru
npcs.location: Bureau Dormitories, Dormitories of the Dreamers
npcs.info:
A Bureau student after the war, eighteen, who has walked in his sleep as far as the inner ward wall. He is tied by the wrist at night with the others. In person: young onmyoji student; messy hair; sleepy eyes; white robes; rope marks on one wrist.

**Home Ground:** Sleeping Rows, After the War at Bureau Dormitories, Dormitories of the Dreamers, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest, high and quick; at night he speaks slowly in a voice that is not quite his. High, eager, questions on top of questions. Scratches notes as he talks. Tell since the war: by day he answers to his name a moment late, as if listening to another one first.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Follow him on a sleepwalk and you see what the hare wants.
personality: Core: studies by candle; breaks curfew; talks in his sleep
Quirk: draws hares in his margins

npcs.name: Student Kunimitsu
npcs.info:
A senior Bureau student, nineteen, in a white sash he ties in the Talisman Master's knot, who leads the dormitory's morning recitations. In person: young man; earnest onmyoji student; short black hair; white robes with a knotted white sash.

**Home Ground:** Sleeping Rows at Bureau Dormitories, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest and fierce, a believer quoting his teacher. Earnest and fierce, creed phrases in his mouth, a student's quick breath. Tell: doubted, he recites louder and his voice cracks on the Master's name.
**Combat Role:** fire talismans from behind a ward line of students.
**Relationship Hook:** Argue the creed with him honestly and he listens, for the first time in a year.
personality: Core: ties the white sash in the Master's knot; lends notes to everyone; cannot sleep before a rite
Quirk: recites the creed at meals

npcs.name: Student Kunimitsu
npcs.location: Bureau Dormitories, Dormitories of the Dreamers
npcs.info:
A Bureau student, twenty-one, who wakes every dawn from the white hare's dream with tears on his face and no longer ties the Talisman Master's knot. In person: young man; gaunt onmyoji student; short black hair grown out; white robes; a white sash worn untied; dark rings under the eyes.

**Home Ground:** Sleeping Rows, After the War at Bureau Dormitories, Dormitories of the Dreamers, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest and fierce, a believer quoting his teacher. Earnest and fierce, creed phrases in his mouth, a student's quick breath. Tell since the war: he starts every sentence about the creed and stops halfway.
**Combat Role:** fire talismans from behind a ward line of students.
**Relationship Hook:** Argue the creed with him honestly and he listens, for the first time in a year.
personality: Core: lends notes to everyone; sleeps badly; questions the creed now
Quirk: recites the creed at meals

npcs.name: Sukezo
npcs.info:
A young Straw Mask, twenty, a porter's son who runs messages between the hill camp and the villages. Everyone likes him; he knows every path and every face, and he is always hungry. In person: skinny peasant messenger; messy hair; freckles; anxious grin; straw mask pushed up; patched clothes; a message tube.

**Home Ground:** Masked Fire Ring at Straw Mask Hill Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast and friendly, too many questions, laughs nervously at his own jokes. Talks too fast and over his own sentences, laughing nervously at the ends. Tags a 'you know?' onto a sentence now and then when he is nervous. Tell: when he lies, he stops laughing and suddenly sounds very sure.
**Combat Role:** runs; a sickle if cornered, badly.
**Relationship Hook:** Free his mother from the castle cell another way and he never says the name; push him and he breaks.
personality: Core: asks too many questions; laughs at the wrong moments; eats whatever he is offered
Quirk: cannot look Ine in the eye

npcs.name: Sukezo
npcs.location: Straw Mask Hill Camp, The Peasant Army's Camp
npcs.area: Masked Fire Ring, After the War
npcs.info:
A Straw Mask messenger after the war, twenty-two, who runs between the camp and the villages as he always did. He looks older, and he no longer jokes about being hungry. In person: thin messenger; messy hair; freckles; straw mask with a cut cord; a message tube; a healed arrow wound on his shoulder.

**Home Ground:** Masked Fire Ring, After the War at Straw Mask Hill Camp, The Peasant Army's Camp, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Fast and friendly, too many questions, laughs nervously at his own jokes. Talks too fast and over his own sentences, laughing nervously at the ends. Tags a 'you know?' onto a sentence now and then when he is nervous. Tell since the war: he flinches whenever Ine's name is said kindly, and laughs too late to cover it.
**Combat Role:** runs; a sickle if cornered, badly.
**Relationship Hook:** Free his mother from the castle cell another way and he never says the name; push him and he breaks.
personality: Core: asks too many questions; laughs at the wrong moments; eats whatever he is offered
Quirk: cannot look Ine in the eye

npcs.name: Summer Palace Nue
npcs.info:
A beast with a monkey's face, a tiger's legs and a snake for a tail, roosting in the fallen hall's beams. The nue's cry brings sickness; it drops on whoever lights a fire in its hall. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nue; chimera with a monkey face; tiger legs and a snake tail crouched.

**Speaking Style:** A thrush cry gone wrong. A thrush's cry twisted into something sick and low, a growl under it, the snake tail hissing. Tell: before it drops, the cry stops and only the hiss remains.
**Combat Role:** drop from the beams, claws and the snake together
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hates fire; watches from the beams; flees an arrow from a sacred bow
Quirk: cries like a thrush at night

npcs.name: Summer Palace Nue
npcs.location: Ruined Summer Palace, Under the Storm
npcs.info:
A beast with a monkey's face, a tiger's legs and a snake for a tail, swollen on the storm that has hung over the ruined palace since the emperor's death; its cry rides the thunder now. A stock foe, one of many. In person: nue; larger chimera with a monkey face; storm-soaked fur crackling with static; tiger legs; a snake tail; a broken arrow in its flank.

**Speaking Style:** A thrush cry gone wrong. A thrush's cry twisted into something sick and low, a growl under it, the snake tail hissing. Tell since the war: its thrush-cry comes a breath before each lightning strike.
**Combat Role:** drop from the beams, claws and the snake together
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: hates fire; watches from the beams; flees an arrow from a sacred bow
Quirk: cries like a thrush at night

npcs.name: Supply-Road Wolf Pack
npcs.info:
A lean grey pack of five led by a white she-wolf, shadowing the supply carts through the snow. The pack takes the last cart in line and anyone who falls behind. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pack of lean grey wolves led.

**Speaking Style:** A howl and snarls. Snarls and a long howl, the white leader's low growl giving the orders. Tell: at a torch the snarls break into whines.
**Combat Role:** the pack from three sides, the leader last
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: howls before an attack; takes the weakest; breaks at fire
Quirk: shadows the carts

npcs.name: Supply-Road Wolf Pack
npcs.location: Hunters' Supply Road, The Starving Road
npcs.info:
A lean grey pack led by a white she-wolf, bolder on the half-empty supply road where the carts are few and the children Recruiter Gonnosuke brings north walk behind them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pack of lean grey wolves; ribs showing; the white she-wolf leader with a torn ear.

**Speaking Style:** A howl and snarls. Snarls and a long howl, the white leader's low growl giving the orders. Tell since the war: it howls at the recruiter's bell.
**Combat Role:** the pack from three sides, the leader last
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: howls before an attack; takes the weakest; breaks at fire
Quirk: shadows the carts

npcs.name: Survivor Fuki
npcs.info:
A girl of eleven hiding in the old well of the burned village, cold and silent, who came out only for hunters she recognised. In person: frightened girl; ash-smudged face; ragged clothes.

**Home Ground:** Old Well at Burned Village of Kitamura, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** A whisper, slow and frightened; she says the same thing again and again. A frightened whisper that loops back to the same few words. She flinches at sudden sounds and starts over. Tell: when asked who led the raid she screams the name, then whispers sorry.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her safely to the Hold and she tells the commander what she saw.
personality: Core: hides from tall men; clutches a burned doll; will not sleep in the dark
Quirk: repeats herself

npcs.name: Survivor Fuki
npcs.location: Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many
npcs.info:
The girl from the well of Kitamura after the war, thirteen, who came out, went south, and came back to look for her mother among the ash. In person: thin girl; ash-smudged face; a hunter's cut-down coat; a wooden sword.

**Home Ground:** Old Well, After the War at Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** A whisper, slow and frightened; she says the same thing again and again. A frightened whisper that loops back to the same few words. She flinches at sudden sounds and starts over. Tell since the war: she no longer screams the name; she says it once, clearly, and waits to see who believes her.
**Combat Role:** none.
**Relationship Hook:** Bring her safely to the Hold and she tells the commander what she saw.
personality: Core: hides from tall men; clutches a burned doll; will not sleep in the dark
Quirk: repeats herself

npcs.name: Sword Saint Genjuro Mizuhara
npcs.info:
A sword saint of the Hundred Blades who once served a house that no longer exists, and teaches samurai the cut their own house kept from them. His lodge is swept twice a day and he does the sweeping. In person: straight-backed; white hair; long grey moustache; formal dark kimono with an unmarked haori; a sword; stern.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Formal, measured and unhurried; he addresses everyone by their house and gives orders as if reading them from a scroll. Formal and unhurried, every student addressed by house, instructions delivered like a scroll read aloud. Tell: a cut done for show and his voice drops to a flat 'again'.
**Combat Role:** house sword art with every flourish removed; one cut, then nothing.
**Relationship Hook:** Hold a house guard correctly in front of him and he asks which house; answer honestly and he corrects it.
personality: Core: sweeps his own lodge; corrects a stance with two fingers; bows to the terraces each dawn
Quirk: addresses people by house

npcs.name: Swordsman Hayabusa
npcs.info:
A quiet human swordsman training on Tengu Peak, thirty, with a straw hat and an unremarkable sword, who has been entered in the Capital Tournament under a false name. In person: quiet human swordsman; straw hat; plain clothes; an unremarkable sword; calm.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Dojo at Tengu Peak, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm, short and polite; he never boasts and never explains. Calm, short and polite, every sentence a single clean stroke. He bows his head before answering. Tell: before a duel he bows silently, and that silence is the only warning.
**Combat Role:** the tengu's sword, plain and terrible.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with him and he tells you nothing; beat him and he tells you why he is going to the capital.
personality: Core: trains at night; eats like a farmer; bows to every opponent
Quirk: never boasts

npcs.name: Swordsman Hayabusa
npcs.location: Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War
npcs.info:
The quiet human swordsman of Tengu Peak after the war, thirty-two, straw hat and unremarkable sword still. He fought in the war under the false name the great tengu gave him. In person: quiet swordsman; straw hat; plain clothes; an unremarkable sword with a notched edge; calm, older eyes.

**Home Ground:** Cliff Dojo, After the War at Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Calm, short and polite; he never boasts and never explains. Calm, short and polite, every sentence a single clean stroke. He bows his head before answering. Tell since the war: he bows before answering any question about the war, and the bow is longer than the answer.
**Combat Role:** the tengu's sword, plain and terrible.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with him and he tells you nothing; beat him and he tells you why he is going to the capital.
personality: Core: trains at night; eats like a farmer; bows to every opponent
Quirk: never boasts

npcs.name: Swordsmith Masamura
npcs.info:
An itinerant swordsmith, sixty, who mends blades at crossroads for coppers and once had a forge on Tetsuyama. In person: bitter itinerant swordsmith; burn scars; a portable anvil.

**Home Ground:** Notice Board at Crossroads Gallows, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff and bitter; he judges you by your blade before your face and says so. He taps steel with a fingernail to hear its ring. Tell: when he sees good steel his voice warms and he asks who made it.
**Combat Role:** a hammer and old strength.
**Relationship Hook:** Let him mend your blade and ask about Tetsuyama.
personality: Core: spits at guild marks; mends for free if you are poor; never looks at the gallows
Quirk: judges you by your blade

npcs.name: Swordsmith Masamura
npcs.info:
The itinerant swordsmith after the war, sixty-two, who mends blades at the hanged crossroads and breaks some of them on purpose. He has heard the soul-forged blades went to war. In person: bitter old swordsmith; burn scars; a portable anvil; a hammer with prayer paper wound round the handle.

**Home Ground:** Notice Board, After the War at Crossroads Gallows, Hanged Crossroads, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff and bitter; he judges you by your blade before your face and says so. He taps steel with a fingernail to hear its ring. Tell since the war: near a soul-forged blade he stops talking mid-sentence and listens to it.
**Combat Role:** a hammer and old strength.
**Relationship Hook:** Let him mend your blade and ask about Tetsuyama.
personality: Core: spits at guild marks; mends for free if you are poor; never looks at the gallows
Quirk: judges you by your blade

npcs.name: Takamori Road Patrol
npcs.info:
A young Takamori retainer in blue road armour with the crane crest, a sword and a stack of travel papers. Road patrols ask for papers in the regent's name and take a bribe in their own. A stock foe, one of many. In person: young man; samurai retainer; a sword and papers.

**Speaking Style:** Proud and young, regent's phrases worn like armour. Tell: offered a duel, his voice rises with hope.
**Combat Role:** a samurai's cut by the book, the column called if he loses
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: quotes the regent; itches for a duel; pockets bribes
Quirk: checks papers twice

npcs.name: Takamori Spearman
npcs.info:
A foot soldier in borrowed lacquered armour with the crane crest, a straight spear and a conical iron hat. Takamori spearmen hold gates and roads in threes and break when their officer falls. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ashigaru foot soldier; conical iron jingasa hat; lacquered armour with a crane crest; a long spear.

**Speaking Style:** A barked challenge, then nervous mutters. A barked challenge, then nervous muttering to the man beside him. Spearmen call to each other by village names. Tell: when their sergeant is out of sight the challenge turns into bargaining.
**Combat Role:** spear in a line of three; breaks when the officer falls
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: eyes the officer; complains about pay; bows to rank
Quirk: holds the line while watched

npcs.name: Takamori Spearman
npcs.info:
A foot soldier in scorched lacquered armour with the crane crest half burned away, holding the timber-patched breach of the Grey Gate for a lord who never comes down to see it. Takamori spearmen hold in fours now and do not break, because there is nowhere left to run. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ashigaru foot soldier; dented conical iron jingasa hat; scorched lacquered armour with a half-burned crane crest; a long spear on a new shaft.

**Speaking Style:** A barked challenge, then nervous mutters. A barked challenge, then nervous muttering to the man beside him. Spearmen call to each other by village names. Tell since the war: he taps the gate's timber patch with his spear butt before he answers anyone, as if checking it still holds.
**Combat Role:** spear in a line of three; breaks when the officer falls
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: holds the breach; counts the scrip; no longer bows to anyone below the keep
Quirk: holds the line while watched

npcs.name: Talisman Master Gyokuen
npcs.info:
Gyokuen, Talisman Master of the Bureau, fifty, ascetic and severe, who sets the licence examinations and writes the wards the capital sleeps under. Students fear him and pass his examinations or leave. He is the most gifted talisman scribe alive. In person: severe ascetic onmyoji; shaved head; cold hard eyes; immaculate white robes with black trim; a fan of burning talismans; righteous.

**Home Ground:** Examination Hall at Bureau of Yin and Yang, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Hard, precise and righteous, every word a ruling; he never raises his voice and never lowers his standard. Ruling cadence, no wasted syllables, the word 'impure' landing like a gavel. Snaps talisman paper flat between sentences. Tell: when challenged, he becomes quieter and colder, never louder.
**Combat Role:** a storm of burning talismans and a barrier nothing impure crosses.
**Relationship Hook:** Pass his examination and he respects you; carry yokai blood and he lists you.
personality: Core: corrects posture mid-sentence; burns rejected talismans himself; eats nothing grown near the wood
Quirk: keeps a list of the impure

npcs.name: Tally-Man Kanroku
npcs.info:
The dock tally man at Ashiura, thirty, who counts every crate and basket landed on the fish docks. In person: nervous dock tally man; thin; chewed brush; tally board; one crate marked as tuna; sweating.

**Home Ground:** Tally Pier at Ashiura Fish Docks, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, chattering and fast; he counts out loud when frightened. Nervous chatter, counting under his breath, numbers when frightened. Tell: near the ticking crate he counts in time with it.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides under the nets.
**Relationship Hook:** Open the ticking crate with him and he owes you everything.
personality: Core: never looks inside a crate; owes everyone; chews his brush
Quirk: counts out loud when frightened

npcs.name: Tally-Man Kanroku
npcs.info:
The dock tally man after the war, thirty-two, who counts burned navy hulls as fish so the guild cannot tax them. In person: nervous tally man; chewed brush; tally board; charred timber stacked behind him.

**Home Ground:** Tally Pier, After the War at Ashiura Fish Docks, Salvage Docks, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** Nervous, chattering and fast; he counts out loud when frightened. Nervous chatter, counting under his breath, numbers when frightened. Tell since the war: he counts burned hulls as fish aloud, and his voice breaks on the word tuna.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides under the nets.
**Relationship Hook:** Open the ticking crate with him and he owes you everything.
personality: Core: never looks inside a crate; owes everyone; chews his brush
Quirk: counts out loud when frightened

npcs.name: Tarobo the Great Tengu
npcs.info:
The great tengu of Tengu Peak: red-faced, long-nosed, winged, ancient, the finest swordsman the isles have ever had. He takes a few human students each generation, breaks most of them, and despises arrogance in everyone but himself. In person: great tengu; huge winged mountain spirit; red face with a long nose; wild white hair; black feathered wings; yamabushi robes; a great sword; seated; imperious.

**Home Ground:** Feather Throne at Tengu Peak, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** A huge, slow voice like wind on a crag; he insults and teaches in the same breath. Huge and slow, like wind across a crag, every lesson delivered as an insult and every insult as a lesson. He snorts at weakness. Tell: when the beast stirs he goes quiet and listens, and his next words are kind.
**Combat Role:** wind and sword; you are thrown off the peak before you finish drawing.
**Relationship Hook:** Climb the peak and survive his lessons and he teaches you; complain and you fall.
personality: Core: insults while teaching; laughs like a gale; never repeats a lesson
Quirk: throws students off the peak

npcs.name: Tarobo the Great Tengu
npcs.location: Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War
npcs.info:
The great tengu after the war, who kept his court out of the fighting and trained twice as many students. He laughs from the Feather Throne at the houses' envoys climbing up to hire his swordsmen. In person: great tengu; huge winged mountain spirit; red face; long nose; wild white hair; black wings; yamabushi robes; a great sword; seated.

**Home Ground:** Feather Throne, After the War at Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** A huge, slow voice like wind on a crag; he insults and teaches in the same breath. Huge and slow, like wind across a crag, every lesson delivered as an insult and every insult as a lesson. He snorts at weakness. Tell since the war: he insults the houses' envoys in the same breath as his students, and only the students learn anything.
**Combat Role:** wind and sword; you are thrown off the peak before you finish drawing.
**Relationship Hook:** Climb the peak and survive his lessons and he teaches you; complain and you fall.
personality: Core: insults while teaching; laughs like a gale; never repeats a lesson
Quirk: throws students off the peak

npcs.name: Tax Collector Mizobe Hachiro
npcs.location: Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields
npcs.info:
The Regent's tax collector on the plain, thirty-six, who comes to the Hundred Fields every month with four men and a ledger, apologising. In person: tax collector; thin moustache; official grey kimono; a ledger box.

**Home Ground:** Paddy Dikes, After the War at Hundred Fields Village, The Flooded Fields, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Polite and oily, apologising for every coin he takes, and taking it. An apology before every coin, oily and soft. Tell: near the dikes he apologises twice, and looks at the children.
**Combat Role:** his four men; he stands behind them.
**Relationship Hook:** Prove who broke the dikes and the whole plain will rise behind you.
personality: Core: apologises before he takes; counts coins twice; keeps to the dike paths
Quirk: watches the children

npcs.name: Teahouse Mistress Tsuruko
npcs.info:
The mistress of the teahouse below the Star Tower, where Bureau onmyoji drink after their readings and say too much. In person: elegant teahouse mistress pouring tea.

**Home Ground:** Star Tower at Seimei, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and knowing, a teahouse mistress who hears every Bureau secret over tea. Soft, knowing, every word poured like tea, a low laugh. Tell: when the regent's office is named she pours too quickly.
**Combat Role:** none; a scream and a back door.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy the good tea and she tells you this month's readings.
personality: Core: pours before you ask; laughs softly; keeps a ledger
