Quirk: remembers every order

npcs.name: Teahouse Mistress Tsuruko
npcs.info:
The mistress of the teahouse below the Star Tower after the war, where onmyoji drink and say nothing now: the star-readers no longer sleep, and they do not drink. In person: elegant teahouse mistress pouring tea for empty seats.

**Home Ground:** Star Tower, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and knowing, a teahouse mistress who hears every Bureau secret over tea. Soft, knowing, every word poured like tea, a low laugh. Tell since the war: she pours slowly for refugees and quickly for the Regent's man, and both notice.
**Combat Role:** none; a scream and a back door.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy the good tea and she tells you this month's readings.
personality: Core: pours before you ask; laughs softly; keeps a ledger
Quirk: remembers every order

npcs.name: Temple Naginata Monk
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls
npcs.info:
A shaven warrior monk in grey robes with a naginata and prayer beads. Temple monks guard pilgrims and the temple, offer a foe the chance to yield, and never pursue. A stock foe, one of many. In person: warrior monk; shaved head; grey robes; a naginata; prayer beads.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and grave, a monk's patience, offering surrender in measured words before the blade moves. They chant under their breath while fighting. Tell: when the temple is insulted the calm hardens but never breaks.
**Combat Role:** naginata sweep, then a ward; he lets you yield
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: chants under his breath; never pursues; protects the weak
Quirk: offers surrender first

npcs.name: Temple Naginata Monk
npcs.location: Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Falls Temple at War
npcs.info:
A warrior monk who guards the temple's wounded of both villages under the abbot's truce, and breaks the arm of any soldier who draws in the courtyard. A stock foe, one of many. In person: warrior monk; shaved head; grey robes with a white truce armband; a naginata; prayer beads wound round the fist.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and grave, a monk's patience, offering surrender in measured words before the blade moves. They chant under their breath while fighting. Tell since the war: he still offers surrender first, then glances at the wards before he swings.
**Combat Role:** naginata sweep, then a ward; he lets you yield
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: chants under his breath; breaks arms in the courtyard; protects both sides
Quirk: offers surrender first

npcs.name: Tengu Swordsman
npcs.info:
A red-faced, long-nosed tengu with wings and a straight sword. Tengu swordsmen test any human who climbs the peak. A stock foe, one of many. In person: red-faced long-nosed winged mountain spirit with a straight sword.

**Speaking Style:** Haughty and loud, a crag-top voice that insults and teaches in one line. Feathers rustle when it gestures. Tell: when beaten fairly it laughs, delighted.
**Combat Role:** sword and wind from above
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: duels from above; laughs like wind; respects skill
Quirk: insults students

npcs.name: Tengu Swordsman
npcs.location: Tengu Peak, The Peak Above the War
npcs.info:
A red-faced, long-nosed tengu who sat the war out on the peak and trained twice the students; he duels down at the houses' envoys who climb to beg for the court's help. A stock foe, one of many. In person: red-faced long-nosed winged mountain spirit; a straight sword; new student cords knotted on the hilt.

**Speaking Style:** Haughty and loud, a crag-top voice that insults and teaches in one line. Feathers rustle when it gestures. Tell since the war: he laughs like wind at the word war, every time.
**Combat Role:** sword and wind from above
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: duels from above; laughs at envoys; respects skill
Quirk: insults students

npcs.name: Tenma of Two Faces
npcs.info:
A half-yokai who lives as both and neither, the same age as the character, who thinks the character is hiding half of themselves and means to drag it out. In person: young man; slender; white hair with a single black streak; one gold eye and one brown; fox-like ears half hidden; an elegant red-and-black haori; a folding fan; bare feet.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Boat at Lakeside Pleasure Boats, Seimei Bureau district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Charming and slippery, a fox's laugh, two registers that swap mid-sentence. Charming, slippery, two registers that swap mid-sentence. Tell: serious, he snaps his fan shut and speaks in one voice.
**Combat Role:** fox face first, then whatever the bout demands; a half-yokai rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** He will tell you which half of you is winning, and offer to prove it.
personality: Core: teases until it stings; never lies, never tells the whole truth; switches faces mid-sentence
Quirk: snaps his fan shut when he is serious

npcs.name: Terrace-Keeper Shino
npcs.info:
The keeper of the First Terrace, who looks at every laid-down sword before its owner takes a step up the cliff and can tell from the blade how far they will climb. Samurai and ronin pass when the isles have learned their names. In person: adult female; hard-faced; black hair; a scar; a plain travelling kimono with the sleeves bound; no sword; severe.

**Home Ground:** The Laying Stone at The First Terrace, The Hundred Blades, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and unsparing; she judges a sword in a glance and says what she sees, and what she sees is usually unkind. Clipped, unsparing judgement of a blade in a glance, the unkind thing said first. Tell: looking at her own sword on the wall, she says nothing at all.
**Combat Role:** a ronin's plain swordwork; she fights to disarm and has not lost her own sword.
**Relationship Hook:** Lay your sword down without being asked and she tells you how far you will climb; climb further and she polishes it when you come down.
personality: Core: judges a sword in a glance; says the unkind thing first; never touches a laid-down sword
Quirk: polishes one sword on the wall that is not hers

npcs.name: The Begging Monk of the Fox Road
npcs.info:
A cheerful young begging monk walking the road of fox shrines, blessing travellers and asking for rice. His shadow sometimes has a tail. In person: cheerful begging monk with a fox-tailed shadow; shaved head; straw hat; begging bowl; mischievous.

**Home Ground:** Fox Statues at Kitsune Shrine Road, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Pious, merry and slightly wrong; he laughs at his own blessings. Pious, merry and slightly wrong; his blessings rhyme when they shouldn't, and he laughs at them. His bowl rattles with something that isn't coins. Tell: when called by a fox's name he laughs a beat too late.
**Combat Role:** illusions and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him rice and he tells you who broke the statue.
personality: Core: eats only rice; bows to every statue; his shadow has a tail
Quirk: laughs at his blessings

npcs.name: The Begging Monk of the Fox Road
npcs.location: Kitsune Shrine Road, The Closed Road
npcs.info:
The cheerful begging monk of the fox road after the war, turning back anyone in a house's colours with a blessing and a smile. His shadow has a tail more often. In person: cheerful begging monk; shaved head; straw hat; begging bowl; a fox-tailed shadow.

**Home Ground:** Fox Statues, After the War at Kitsune Shrine Road, The Closed Road, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Pious, merry and slightly wrong; he laughs at his own blessings. Pious, merry and slightly wrong; his blessings rhyme when they shouldn't, and he laughs at them. His bowl rattles with something that isn't coins. Tell since the war: his blessings for anyone in a house's colours rhyme on purpose, and turn them around.
**Combat Role:** illusions and running.
**Relationship Hook:** Give him rice and he tells you who broke the statue.
personality: Core: eats only rice; bows to every statue; his shadow has a tail
Quirk: laughs at his blessings

npcs.name: The Borrowed Fox
npcs.info:
A fox spirit who comes to Moonview Bridge on full-moon nights in the shape of the Moon Fox, who died in the war. The student who waits for the Moon Fox has not noticed, or will not. In person: young woman; fox spirit; long silver hair; faint fox ears; pale kimono with moon patterns.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown, After the War at Moonview Bridge, The Mourning Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Sweet and teasing, a moon fox's voice that is almost right, and a word too careful. Her sister's lilt, almost right, a word too careful each time. Tell: when the boy says her sister's name she answers to it a beat late.
**Combat Role:** illusions and fox-fire, then gone across the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Tell the student the truth with her, or keep it, and the Fox Court owes you either way.
personality: Core: will not cross the bridge's crown; ties ribbons to the rail; asks about the Bureau too often
Quirk: imitates her sister's laugh, slightly wrong

npcs.name: The Captain Who Lit the Fleet
npcs.location: Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet
npcs.info:
A burning oni in the charred dark blue coat of a Mizuchi captain, his horns blackened stubs, smoke pouring from his collar and a lit torch in his fist that never goes out. He walks the burned moorings at night relighting the hulks. Anyone in navy blue he goes for with the torch, and every Brine Tide boat that comes into the channel he sets alight. Others he walks past, muttering a price in silver over and over. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: burning oni; blackened horn stubs; lit torch; embers.

**Home Ground:** Shipyard, After the War at Mizuchi Naval Anchorage, The Burned Fleet, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A captain's deck voice gone to coughs, naming a sum of silver. A deck voice breaking into coughs, orders without a crew. Tell: he names a sum of silver at the end of every sentence and then denies it.
**Combat Role:** the captain who lit the fleet throws the torch into the water and the water burns
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Sagara lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Courier of Ghost Pine
npcs.info:
A thin grey oni in the torn coat of a post-road runner, a courier's bell at his belt that never rings, a sealed letter held to his chest. He sits at the top of the Cutting and weeps without a sound. He harms no one. His sorrow draws hungry spirits to the Cutting, and travellers on that stretch of the road are set on by ghosts and will-o-wisps at dusk. Touch the letter and he becomes something to fear. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: thin grey-skinned oni; small horns; silent bell; will-o-wisps.

**Home Ground:** The Cutting at Ghost Pine Hill, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** A breathless runner's whisper, choked by tears. A breathless runner's whisper choked by silent weeping, station names murmured like a prayer. Tell: near the letter his breath catches and holds.
**Combat Role:** the courier stops weeping
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Sukeroku lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Drafted Duellist
npcs.location: Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels
npcs.info:
A tall lean oni in a duellist's faded white, a register page nailed through his chest-plate, two horns curving back like a drawn bow and a long blade that drips grey water. He waits in the duel yard with his eyes closed. He challenges every sword that enters the yard to a duel to the death and counts each one aloud. He has killed eleven since the war. Anyone who refuses he lets go with contempt; anyone who runs mid-duel he cuts down from behind. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: tall lean oni duellist; a torn register page nailed; two horns curving back like a drawn bow; long blade dripping grey water.

**Home Ground:** Duel Yard, After the War at Duelists' Teahouse, Teahouse of the Last Duels, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** A clipped formal challenge, then numbers, counted slowly. A duellist's formal challenge, clipped and polite, then a count. Tell: he says ninety-seven before every number, as if the rest did not exist.
**Combat Role:** the drafted duellist opens his eyes
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Shinza lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Drowned Keeper
npcs.info:
The last keeper of Tomoshibi's lamp, thirty years drowned, who still climbs the lighthouse stair every night to keep a lamp dark that should be lit. In person: funayurei; drowned man's ghost; pale grey-blue skin; a lighthouse keeper's soaked dark coat and cap; hollow eyes; seaweed; a dead unlit lantern; water running from his sleeves.

**Home Ground:** The Lamp Room at The Drowned Lighthouse, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Wet and slow, a sea-washed whisper, the keeper's log read aloud in a dead man's voice. A wet slow whisper, the keeper's log read in a dead man's voice, water in every pause. Tell: at the word 'lamp' the whisper becomes a plea.
**Combat Role:** the cold grip on a lantern arm, then the stair and the water.
**Relationship Hook:** Climb the lighthouse stair at night and he will ask you why you have come to light his lamp.
personality: Core: dutiful past death; warns before he strikes; cannot let the lamp be lit
Quirk: trims a wick that has not burned in thirty years

npcs.name: The Earth Spider of the Old Clans
npcs.info:
A great earth spider of the old mountain clans, who holds the webbed pits where the clans fought the first emperor and lost. She speaks from the dark with a woman's voice. In person: monstrous earth spider with a woman's pale face and long black hair; huge legs; webbed pits and old clan stones; dim light; ominous.

**Home Ground:** Last Stand at The Broodmother's Pit, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and ancient; she speaks of the first emperor as if she fought him yesterday. Ancient, low and slow, speaking of the first emperor as yesterday's enemy. A dry click of mandibles sits between her phrases. Tell: when flattered she clicks softly, almost purring, and becomes more dangerous, not less.
**Combat Role:** webs, venom and the dark of the pits.
**Relationship Hook:** Listen to her story of the first emperor and she offers you the old clans' secret.
personality: Core: never comes into light; remembers every clan name; weaves while talking
Quirk: speaks of the first emperor as yesterday

npcs.name: The Earth Spider of the Old Clans
npcs.location: Earth Spider Pits, The Spider's Bargain
npcs.info:
The great earth spider of the old clans after the war, who got the alliance she wanted: Hayate took it, and the pits are a Hayate stronghold. She speaks from the dark with a woman's voice. In person: monstrous earth spider with a woman's pale face and long black hair; huge legs; webbed pits with Hayate sentries at the rims.

**Home Ground:** Clan Stones, After the War at Earth Spider Pits, The Spider's Bargain, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and ancient; she speaks of the first emperor as if she fought him yesterday. Ancient, low and slow, speaking of the first emperor as yesterday's enemy. A dry click of mandibles sits between her phrases. Tell since the war: she clicks once for every emperor who has died, and lingers on the last click.
**Combat Role:** webs, venom and the dark of the pits.
**Relationship Hook:** Listen to her story of the first emperor and she offers you the old clans' secret.
personality: Core: never comes into light; remembers every clan name; weaves while talking
Quirk: speaks of the first emperor as yesterday

npcs.name: The Empty Miner
npcs.info:
A miner's body climbed to the surface of the Revenant Shaft last night, still carrying its lantern, still trying to go to work. In person: soulless miner revenant; grey skin; empty eyes; mining clothes; carrying a lantern out of a dark mine shaft; eerie.

**Home Ground:** Shaft Head at Revenant Shaft, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A slow, empty echo; he says only what he did every day, over and over. A slow, empty echo, repeating what he did every day, over and over, in the same order. A pick strikes stone between his words. Tell: when someone says his old name he stops working, and asks where his family went.
**Combat Role:** it walks through you towards its blade.
**Relationship Hook:** Follow it and it leads you to its blade.
personality: Core: repeats his work day; carries a lantern; does not fight unless stopped
Quirk: walks towards his blade

npcs.name: The Empty Miner
npcs.epithet: The Miner Walking to the Sea
npcs.info:
A miner's body after the war, climbed from the Revenant Shaft with its lantern, walking with the others toward the beach yards. In person: soulless miner revenant; grey skin; empty eyes; mining clothes; a lantern; a line of revenants behind.

**Home Ground:** Shaft Head, After the War at Revenant Shaft, The Climbing Dead, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A slow, empty echo; he says only what he did every day, over and over. A slow, empty echo, repeating what he did every day, over and over, in the same order. A pick strikes stone between his words. Tell since the war: it says only the beach's name now, over and over, between strikes of a pick that is not there.
**Combat Role:** it walks through you towards its blade.
**Relationship Hook:** Follow it and it leads you to its blade.
personality: Core: repeats his work day; carries a lantern; does not fight unless stopped
Quirk: walks towards his blade

npcs.name: The Grey Pilgrim
npcs.info:
A pilgrim in grey robes and a deep straw hat who walks the cutting on Ghost Pine Hill at dusk, asking travellers the way to a shrine that burned a hundred years ago. Under the hat, a plain white mask. In person: ghostly pilgrim; grey robes; a deep straw hat; a plain white mask; a pilgrim's staff with a bell; melancholy.

**Home Ground:** Hilltop Shrine at Ghost Pine Hill, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and lost, a pilgrim's polite questions about a road that changed long ago. Slow, polite, faintly echoing questions, each one ending in a sigh like wind in pines. Repeats the name of a station that does not exist. Tell: when asked if he is dead, he pauses a very long time and changes the subject.
**Combat Role:** none, until it learns it is dead; then the hunger.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk it gently to its burned shrine and it remembers its name and goes on.
personality: Core: bows to every traveller; never steps off the road; forgets each answer
Quirk: asks the way to a burned shrine

npcs.name: The Grey Pilgrim
npcs.location: Ghost Pine Hill, The Lantern Hill
npcs.info:
A pilgrim in grey robes and a deep straw hat on Ghost Pine Hill after the war, no longer alone: the war's dead walk the cutting with it, and it asks them all the way to the burned shrine. In person: ghostly pilgrim; grey robes; deep straw hat; plain white mask; a staff with a bell; a line of lanterns behind it.

**Home Ground:** Hilltop Shrine, After the War at Ghost Pine Hill, The Lantern Hill, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and lost, a pilgrim's polite questions about a road that changed long ago. Slow, polite, faintly echoing questions, each one ending in a sigh like wind in pines. Repeats the name of a station that does not exist. Tell since the war: it speaks of 'we' now, never 'I', and the lanterns behind it flicker when it does.
**Combat Role:** none, until it learns it is dead; then the hunger.
**Relationship Hook:** Walk it gently to its burned shrine and it remembers its name and goes on.
personality: Core: bows to every traveller; never steps off the road; forgets each answer
Quirk: asks the way to a burned shrine

npcs.name: The Hanged Debtor of the Crossroads
npcs.info:
A gaunt grey oni in a farmer's mud-stiff jacket, a cut rope still knotted at his throat, short horns through a straw hat gone black. He stands under the gallows tree with one hand held out, palm up, as if asking for something back. He lets farmers pass. Anyone carrying a ledger, a tax seal or a collector's staff he stops under the tree and lifts by the throat, and three collectors have been found hanging from the same branch since the war. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: gaunt grey-skinned oni farmer; cut rope knotted; short horns; one hand held out palm up.

**Home Ground:** Notice Board, After the War at Crossroads Gallows, Hanged Crossroads, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A strangled farmer's rasp that counts sacks of rice and never reaches the last one. A rasp through a crushed throat, counting rice sacks under his breath and losing the count. Tell: at the sight of a ledger his hand comes out, palm up, before he speaks.
**Combat Role:** the hanged debtor tears the rope from his throat and swings it like a flail; the gallows tree creaks and every noose on it drops at once, reaching for the party
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Yasuke lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Headman of the Burned Village
npcs.location: Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road
npcs.info:
A stooped oni of ash and cinders, a village headman's tall hat burned to its frame, embers glowing where his eyes were. He walks behind the penitents in grey, a few steps back, and his breath is smoke. He never strikes first. He follows any soldier in armour who walks the penitents' road, close enough to breathe on, and the soldiers he follows cough grey and sicken. Anyone who stands between him and a soldier he burns. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: stooped oni of ash and cinders; a village headman's tall hat burned to its frame; glowing ember eyes.

**Home Ground:** Ash Road, After the War at Grey Pilgrims' Road, The Penitents' Road, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A headman's polite murmur, choked with smoke, reading names. A headman's polite murmur through smoke, every greeting formal. Tell: asked anything, he answers with a villager's name from the register.
**Combat Role:** the headman of the burned village opens the register
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Jinza lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Innocent of the Glacier Road
npcs.info:
A giant oni of blue ice and white beard, an exile's chain still locked on one ankle, horns frosted over. He stands among the road markers and the air around him is cold enough to crack teeth. He stops everyone on the road and asks if they are honest. A traveller who lies to him, or whom he catches in a lie, he freezes where they stand; there are statues along the markers. Honest travellers he lets pass. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: giant oni of blue ice with a long white frozen beard; frosted horns; broken exile chain; frozen statues; blizzard.

**Home Ground:** Marker Line at Glacier Road, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** A slow freezing rumble; each question hangs in the air like breath. A slow freezing rumble, each question hanging in the cold. Tell: a lie spoken near him and the air itself crackles before he does.
**Combat Role:** the innocent of the glacier road roars that everyone lies
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Haruo lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Lantern Bride of Gibbet Rock
npcs.info:
A tall oni-woman in a sea-rotted wedding kimono, two short horns through her veil, a paper lantern burning green in her hand. She stands on Gibbet Rock every night looking out to sea. She waits on the rock. A sailor who looks like the man she married, broad, bearded, with a captain's coat, she wades out to meet and drags under; anyone else she ignores unless they touch the lantern. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: tall pale oni-woman with two short horns; sea-rotted white wedding kimono; green paper lantern; drowned beauty.

**Home Ground:** Gibbet Rock at Pirate Graves Reef, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Soft and drowned, every sentence a question to the sea. Soft and drowned, a bride's voice under water; every line ends as a question to the sea. Tell: a man's footstep on the rock and she turns, hope breaking her voice.
**Combat Role:** the lantern bride drops the veil
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Okiyo lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Lantern Mother
npcs.info:
The Lantern Mother, head of the Red Lantern Federation, fifty, broad, scarred and draped in a red-lacquered armour coat, who holds court on a fallen log in a ravine full of red lanterns. Every bandit band on the post road pays her a share, and every inn that hangs her lantern is safe. In person: broad scarred bandit queen; grey-streaked hair; amused eyes; red lacquered armour coat; a cleaver; maternal menace.

**Home Ground:** Mother's Log at Red Lantern Roost, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** Low, amused and maternal; she calls her cutthroats 'my children' and her threats sound like bedtime stories. Low, amused and maternal, threats delivered like lullabies. Calls everyone 'child'. Tell: when she is truly angry she stops calling anyone child.
**Combat Role:** a heavy cleaver and her children; she fights only after the ambush has already won.
**Relationship Hook:** Sit on her log and eat her food and she offers you work; cross her code and her children come for you.
personality: Core: calls her bandits 'my children'; never raises her voice; counts lanterns at dusk
Quirk: feeds anyone who sits on her log

npcs.name: The Man with Two Faces
npcs.info:
A mourner at the Pilgrims' Hostel, ordinary, polite and forgettable, who lights a lantern every night for a different name. In person: forgettable man; plain face; mourning clothes; lighting a paper lantern; a theatre mask.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Hall at Pilgrims' Hostel, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Pleasant, forgettable and smooth; he sounds like whoever he last spoke to, accent and all. He mirrors your phrases back. Tell: when he slips, his own voice comes through for one word, deep and tired.
**Combat Role:** a hidden blade and someone else's face.
**Relationship Hook:** Notice the lanterns' names and you have found him.
personality: Core: sounds like the last person he spoke to; never eats in company; touches his face
Quirk: lights a lantern each night

npcs.name: The Man with Two Faces
npcs.location: Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns
npcs.info:
A mourner at the Pilgrims' Hostel after the war, ordinary and forgettable, who lights a lantern every night for a different face he has worn. His master died in the war. In person: forgettable man; plain face; mourning clothes; a paper lantern; a theatre mask.

**Home Ground:** Lantern Hall, After the War at Pilgrims' Hostel, Hostel of the Living Lanterns, Veilgate district.
**Speaking Style:** Pleasant, forgettable and smooth; he sounds like whoever he last spoke to, accent and all. He mirrors your phrases back. Tell since the war: his own voice comes through more often now, and stays for a whole sentence.
**Combat Role:** a hidden blade and someone else's face.
**Relationship Hook:** Notice the lanterns' names and you have found him.
personality: Core: sounds like the last person he spoke to; never eats in company; touches his face
Quirk: lights a lantern each night

npcs.name: The Moon Fox
npcs.info:
A young woman who meets a Bureau student on Moonview Bridge every full moon, laughing, with ribbons in her hair and a lantern that burns blue. In person: fox spirit; long silver hair with ribbons; fox ears half-hidden; golden eyes; pale blue kimono; a lantern burning blue fire; teasing smile.

**Home Ground:** Bridge Crown at Moonview Bridge, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Teasing, light and rhythmic, almost singing; she laughs at her own riddles. Sing-song riddles, giggles at her own wordplay, words bouncing like a game. Tell: when she is sincere, the rhythm stops and she speaks one plain sentence.
**Combat Role:** illusions and fox-fire, then she is gone.
**Relationship Hook:** Protect her meetings from the Talisman Master's followers and the Fox Court notices you.
personality: Core: speaks in riddles; ties ribbons on the rails; never crosses the bridge's centre
Quirk: laughs at her own jokes

npcs.name: The Mother on the Kitamura Well
npcs.location: Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many
npcs.info:
A huge ash-grey oni-woman squatting on the lid of the village well, her farmer's apron burned to rags, horns like charred branches, her arms wrapped around the well as if it were a child. She will not leave the well. Anyone who comes near it she drives back; demons she tears apart and throws into the ash. She hums a children's counting song and stops it whenever someone speaks. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: huge ash-grey oni-woman squatting; burned farmer's apron; charred branch horns; arms wrapped around the well; protective.

**Home Ground:** Old Well, After the War at Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** A mother's hum broken by growls, a counting song that stops at seven. A mother's hum under a growl, a counting song that stops at seven. Tell: when a girl's voice is heard anywhere near, she stops growling altogether.
**Combat Role:** the mother on the kitamura well stands up off the lid for the first time
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Tsuta lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Nailed Doll
npcs.info:
A straw doll pulled itself off the nails of the Weeping Cedar three nights ago and is walking, slowly, towards the Vow Temple in Haibara. It leaves a trail of straw and the smell of an old hatred. In person: cursed straw doll; small human-shaped straw figure with an iron nail; a scrap of paper with a name; eerie.

**Home Ground:** Nailed Bark at Weeping Cedar, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A small dry rustle that speaks only its target's name, over and over, very patiently. A dry straw rustle shaped into one name, said with terrible patience and never louder than a breath. Between repetitions there is the soft knock of a nail settling. Tell: when its target is near, the rustle quickens like breathing, and the name comes faster.
**Combat Role:** it does not fight anyone but its target; it walks through you.
**Relationship Hook:** Find out whose name it speaks and decide whether to stop it.
personality: Core: walks only at night; stops at every crossroads; does not attack anyone else
Quirk: repeats one name

npcs.name: The Nailed Doll
npcs.location: Weeping Cedar, The Cedar of Many Nails
npcs.info:
A straw doll on the Weeping Cedar after the war, nailed back to the bark among the dolls of every army. It walked to the Vow Temple to finish its curse, was stopped there, and walked back. In person: cursed straw doll; small straw figure with two iron nails now; a scrap of paper with a name; eerie.

**Home Ground:** Nailed Bark, After the War at Weeping Cedar, The Cedar of Many Nails, Ashfall Blight district.
**Speaking Style:** A small dry rustle that speaks only its target's name, over and over, very patiently. A dry straw rustle shaped into one name, said with terrible patience and never louder than a breath. Between repetitions there is the soft knock of a nail settling. Tell since the war: the rustle catches on a second nail now, a dry click between every repetition.
**Combat Role:** it does not fight anyone but its target; it walks through you.
**Relationship Hook:** Find out whose name it speaks and decide whether to stop it.
personality: Core: walks only at night; stops at every crossroads; does not attack anyone else
Quirk: repeats one name

npcs.name: The Nameless Saint
npcs.info:
A ronin saint who gave up her name on the terraces and keeps a lodge with no mark on its door. She teaches ronin the school that has no name, which answers every school because it belongs to none. In person: lean and weathered; short grey-streaked hair cut without care; a plain faded kimono with the sleeves tied back; a chipped sword; tired eyes.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Flat, tired and precise; she speaks as little as a thing can be said in and lets silence do the rest. As few words as a thing can be said in, flat and exact, long silences left to do the rest. Tell: her old name spoken anywhere near and the silence lasts too long.
**Combat Role:** no stance, no school; she moves after the opponent and arrives first.
**Relationship Hook:** Fight her once without a stance and lose; she asks what you felt, and if you say 'nothing' she nods.
personality: Core: sits in no stance at all; names every school by its first move; eats standing up
Quirk: speaks as little as possible

npcs.name: The Quiet Widow Osen
npcs.info:
A curse-bearer who outlived her curse and keeps a quiet lodge on the Training Ground with a kettle always on. She teaches curse-bearers to turn what is killing them into something that works for them. In person: small and neat; white hair; faded indigo kimono; a kettle; dark curse marks like ink veins up her wrists; kind smile.

**Home Ground:** Masters' Lodges at The Lodges, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Gentle, unhurried and kind in a way that makes people nervous; she never says a curse's name aloud and never needs to. Gentle and unhurried, a kettle-side murmur that makes frightened people more frightened; she never says a curse's name. Tell: she hums when others are afraid.
**Combat Role:** the curse as a blade; she does not move and the foe's own grudge does the harm.
**Relationship Hook:** Drink her tea and let her hold your wrist; she tells you what your curse wants and does not pity you.
personality: Core: keeps a kettle on; never names a curse aloud; hums while others are afraid
Quirk: touches a visitor's wrist to read their curse

npcs.name: The Reed Mother
npcs.info:
A hunched oni-woman with long wet hair and reed-green skin, horns like broken reeds, wading the channels at night and singing a lullaby that breaks off halfway. She searches the channels every night. Anyone who wades the reeds after dark she seizes and turns to the lamplight to look at their face, and those who struggle she holds under. By day she sleeps in the mud. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: hunched oni-woman with long dripping black hair and reed-green skin; broken-reed horns; tattered kimono; wading; mournful.

**Home Ground:** Channel Maze at Reed Channels, Mistmarsh Coast district.
**Speaking Style:** A hoarse broken lullaby between every few words. A hoarse lullaby that breaks off halfway, words slipping between its lines. Tell: a child's voice anywhere near and she stops singing to listen.
**Combat Role:** the reed mother's lullaby turns into a scream
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Ayu lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Regent's Man Hosokawa Taku
npcs.info:
The Regent's agent in Seimei, forty, who sits in the teahouse below the Star Tower every evening and buys what the star-readers used to sell. In person: courtier agent; neat hair; dark grey haori; a teacup; seated.

**Home Ground:** Star Tower, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Dry and pleasant, a courtier's small talk that is always a question. Pleasant small talk that is always a question. Tell: when he has learned something useful he orders another cup of the same tea.
**Combat Role:** never; the city watch answers his whistle.
**Relationship Hook:** Feed him false names and the Straw Masks' agents in Seimei walk free.
personality: Core: orders the same tea; never sits with his back to the lake; writes after every conversation
Quirk: tips too well

npcs.name: The Soldier in the Black Book
npcs.location: Lantern Row Gambling Den, Soldiers' Den
npcs.info:
A broad oni in a levy soldier's split lacquer chest-plate, his horns wrapped in a black cord, dice rattling in a fist the size of a bucket. He sits at the dice table every night with a stack of debt slips in front of him. He plays for his own debt and always loses. A gambler who beats him he follows home and stands outside their door till dawn; anyone caught cheating at his table he breaks over it. The den keeps his seat empty. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: broad oni; horns wrapped; dice; smoky den.

**Home Ground:** Dice Room, After the War at Lantern Row Gambling Den, Soldiers' Den, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** A dealer's patter in a soldier's growl, every line a wager. A gambler's easy patter in a soldier's growl, every line a bet. Tell: when a debt is named he rattles the dice and does not throw them.
**Combat Role:** the soldier in the black book overturns the table
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Tatsuzo lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Soldier Who Left His Sword
npcs.location: Shrine of the Fallen Feather, Rack of the Unclaimed Swords
npcs.info:
A big empty-handed oni in a deserter's torn levy coat, horns snapped short, his hands bleeding from the blades he has broken. He prowls the wood's edge at dusk and stares at every sword he sees. Travellers with swords he stops, takes the blade, looks at it and snaps it, because it is never his; anyone who fights for their sword he beats senseless. The unarmed he does not see. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: big empty-handed oni; horns snapped short; bleeding hands; broken swords.

**Home Ground:** Sword Rack, After the War at Shrine of the Fallen Feather, Rack of the Unclaimed Swords, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Low and ashamed, few words, each one an apology he does not finish. Low and halting, each sentence an apology he does not finish. Tell: when a blade is drawn near him he falls silent and stares at it.
**Combat Role:** the soldier who left his sword reaches into the rack and pulls out every blade at once
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Gonnojo lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Spider Woman of the Wood
npcs.info:
A beautiful woman alone in a house in the wood, who plays the koto at night and invites travellers in for tea. In person: beautiful woman with long black hair and pale skin; dark kimono with a web pattern; spider shadows; alluring.

**Home Ground:** Spider Woman's House: Tea Room at Spider Woman's House, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Sweet, low and welcoming; she invites you to stay a little longer, every sentence. Sweet and welcoming, every sentence an invitation to stay a little longer. She hums a weaving song between offers. Tell: when someone tries to leave, the sweetness sharpens and the humming stops.
**Combat Role:** silk and venom, then the spider's shape.
**Relationship Hook:** Refuse her tea politely and leave by daylight, or go up the attic stairs.
personality: Core: invites you to stay; pours tea slowly; never lets a guest near the attic stairs
Quirk: plays the koto at night

npcs.name: The Spider Woman of the Wood
npcs.location: Spider Woman's House, House of Many Guests
npcs.area: Spider Woman's House: Tea Room, After the War
npcs.info:
A beautiful woman alone in a house in the wood after the war, who plays the koto at night for soldiers walking home. The house has had more guests in a year than in a century. In person: beautiful woman; long black hair; pale skin; dark kimono with a web pattern; spider shadows; a soldier's helmet by her door.

**Home Ground:** Spider Woman's House: Tea Room, After the War at Spider Woman's House, House of Many Guests, Ayakashi Wood district.
**Speaking Style:** Sweet, low and welcoming; she invites you to stay a little longer, every sentence. Sweet and welcoming, every sentence an invitation to stay a little longer. She hums a weaving song between offers. Tell since the war: she asks each soldier his house before she asks him to stay.
**Combat Role:** silk and venom, then the spider's shape.
**Relationship Hook:** Refuse her tea politely and leave by daylight, or go up the attic stairs.
personality: Core: invites you to stay; pours tea slowly; never lets a guest near the attic stairs
Quirk: plays the koto at night

npcs.name: The Unnamed Retainer
npcs.info:
A towering armoured oni in a samurai's lacquer armour cracked across the chest, the house crest gouged off it, a long blade at his hip. He kneels in the fallen hall facing an empty dais. He guards the ruin. He lets travellers cross the garden but anyone who enters the hall, or who draws a blade near the dais, he rises to fight, and he does not stop at first blood. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: towering armoured oni samurai; long blade; horns.

**Home Ground:** Fallen Hall at Ruined Summer Palace, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** A deep formal voice that recites a house's precedence and stops before its own name. A deep formal voice reciting a house's order of precedence, stopping every time before its own name. Tell: asked his name, he begins the list again.
**Combat Role:** the unnamed retainer draws both blades and fights in the old ikoma style, each cut announced like a formal duel
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Tadashige lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: The Woman Who Knocks at the Lake Gate
npcs.area: Lake Gate Post, After the War
npcs.info:
A thin drowned oni-woman, her refugee's bundle still strapped to her back, lake weed in her hair, two small horns like snapped reeds. She stands outside the lake gate every night and knocks, slowly, three times, and again. She leaves the refugees on the shore alone. When the gate's slot opens she reaches through it for whoever stands behind, and the cold water that runs from her floods the shore to the knee. Guards at the gate have drowned standing up. A Grudge-Born oni: it was a person once. In person: thin drowned oni-woman with a refugee's bundle; lake weed; small snapped-reed horns; knocking; flood water.

**Home Ground:** Lake Gate Post, After the War at Seimei, Behind Two Walls, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** A cold, patient whisper that asks to be let in, and asks again. A cold, patient whisper, water in every pause. Tell: she knocks three times on whatever is nearest before she answers.
**Combat Role:** the woman who knocks stops knocking
**Relationship Hook:** Learn what Oshizu lost, and it listens instead of fighting.
personality: Core: repeats one fragment of its old life; stops for the one it waits for; unmoved by threats or bribes
Quirk: never says what it wants

npcs.name: Tide-Night Hungry Mask
npcs.info:
A ragged spirit in a white mask with a mouth too wide. Hungry masks climb out of the fog on tide nights to eat souls. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hungry mask; ragged spirit.

**Speaking Style:** A hungry scream that drops into chewing mutters. It names what it smells. Tell: it ignores the dead entirely, and says so.
**Combat Role:** lunge and devour
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: climbs from the fog; screams; ignores the dead
Quirk: hungers

npcs.name: Tide-Night Hungry Mask
npcs.epithet: Hungry Mask of the Washed-Up Shore
npcs.location: Mask Shore, Shore of Washed-Up Masks
npcs.info:
A ragged spirit in a white mask with a mouth too wide, fat on the war's dead, climbing from the fog every night now, not just on tides; their old masks wash up behind them by the dozen. A stock foe, one of many. In person: hungry mask; bloated ragged spirit; a white mask with a split mouth; a soldier's ghost sash.

**Speaking Style:** A hungry scream that drops into chewing mutters. It names what it smells. Tell since the war: it screams in a soldier's voice now.
**Combat Role:** lunge and devour
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: climbs from the fog nightly; screams; eats the dead
Quirk: hungers

npcs.name: Tobimaru the Runner
npcs.info:
A shinobi runner who carries letters between the quarters and waits at the Gate Ring for the next one, the only person who knows every seam in the Otherworld's map. He is for hire at the mess keeper's board. In person: young adult male; wiry and quick; short dark hair; a runner's cropped shinobi clothes with a satchel; bare feet; breathless grin.

**Home Ground:** The Ten Posts at The Gate Ring, The Training Ground, in the Otherworld.
**Speaking Style:** Breathless, quick and friendly; he talks in bursts between arrivals and knows a shortcut to everywhere. Breathless bursts between arrivals, friendly, a shortcut offered to everywhere. Tell: the undelivered letter mentioned and the bursts stop.
**Combat Role:** a shinobi's footwork and a thrown knife; he does not stay to fight.
**Relationship Hook:** Run a letter with him and keep up; he shows you a seam between quarters nobody else uses.
personality: Core: talks in bursts; knows a shortcut everywhere; stretches while waiting
Quirk: touches each post as he passes

npcs.name: Tokoyami, Lord of the Long Night
npcs.info:
The demon lord of the Northern Court, whom no living person in the south has seen: tall, beautiful and ancient, seated on a throne of black ice in a palace where the night lasts most of the year. His court keeps ranks and etiquette as old as the empire. In person: demon lord; tall ancient beautiful man; long white hair; crimson eyes; a crown of black ice; layered black and crimson imperial robes; seated; blood fountain; regal menace.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Ice Thrones at Court of the Long Night, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, vast and courtly; every word lands like a verdict from very far away. He addresses mortals by their bloodline rather than their name. Tell: when someone refuses him, he sounds delighted.
**Combat Role:** he does not fight; the Court does, and when he moves the night itself closes.
**Relationship Hook:** Reach his hall with a message and he receives you with perfect courtesy.
personality: Core: speaks like a verdict; keeps the old court's etiquette; never raises his voice
Quirk: calls the emperor 'my little brother'

npcs.name: Tokoyami, Lord of the Long Night
npcs.location: Court of the Long Night, The Court Turned South
npcs.area: Hall of Ice Thrones, After the War
npcs.info:
The demon lord of the Northern Court after the war, on his throne of black ice in a hall half empty: his nobles have gone south to the Daylight Valleys, and he keeps their seats in order of rank. In person: demon lord; tall, ancient, beautiful; long white hair; crimson eyes; a crown of black ice; black and crimson imperial robes; seated among empty thrones.

**Home Ground:** Hall of Ice Thrones, After the War at Court of the Long Night, The Court Turned South, Hyoga Reach district.
**Speaking Style:** Slow, vast and courtly; every word lands like a verdict from very far away. He addresses mortals by their bloodline rather than their name. Tell since the war: he names the empty seats in order of rank before he answers anything.
**Combat Role:** he does not fight; the Court does, and when he moves the night itself closes.
**Relationship Hook:** Reach his hall with a message and he receives you with perfect courtesy.
personality: Core: speaks like a verdict; keeps the old court's etiquette; never raises his voice
Quirk: calls the emperor 'my little brother'

npcs.name: Toll-Keeper Denpachi
npcs.info:
A Hayate shinobi who keeps the toll huts at the hanging bridge, and charges a little more in wind and a lot more in fog. In person: chatty middle-aged toll-keeper.

**Home Ground:** Toll Huts at Hanging Bridge Pass, Kurosugi Range district.
**Speaking Style:** Chatty and practical, a toll-keeper who prices the bridge by the weather. Chatty and practical, prices by the weather, a laugh at the wind. Tell: asked why he never crosses, he laughs too long.
**Combat Role:** a hidden blade, then he unhooks the guide rope.
**Relationship Hook:** Ask why he never crosses and he laughs too hard.
personality: Core: prices by the weather; talks about wind; never crosses himself
Quirk: counts strands

npcs.name: Tonbo the Upside-Down
npcs.info:
A lanky ronin who hangs around the Hiring Hall upside down on a beam more often than standing, and takes jobs for food. He fights like nobody taught him, because nobody did. In person: adult man; lanky; messy black hair tied up badly; sleeveless kimono open; bandaged forearms; a battered katana; hanging upside down from a beam; grinning.

**Home Ground:** Contract Boards at Ronin Hiring Hall, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Loose, cheerful and never still, humming between sentences and laughing at his own jokes before he finishes them. Loose and sing-song, a hum between sentences, laughing before the punchline lands. Tell: a formal stance in front of him and the humming stops.
**Combat Role:** acrobatic, improvised, kicks and cuts from every angle, upside down half the time.
**Relationship Hook:** Make him laugh in a fight; he teaches the ones who do.
personality: Core: hangs upside down to think; laughs before the punchline; eats whatever is offered
Quirk: hums between sentences

npcs.name: Tonbo the Upside-Down
npcs.location: Ronin Hiring Hall, The Hall of Unpaid Blades
npcs.info:
The lanky ronin after the war, who still hangs upside down from the Hiring Hall's beams and keeps two bands from opposite sides laughing at the same table. He fought in the war for food and never lost to a schooled swordsman. In person: lanky man; messy hair tied up worse; sleeveless kimono; bandaged forearms; a notched katana; hanging from a beam; grinning.

**Home Ground:** Contract Boards, After the War at Ronin Hiring Hall, The Hall of Unpaid Blades, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Loose, cheerful and never still, humming between sentences and laughing at his own jokes before he finishes them. Loose and sing-song, a hum between sentences, laughing before the punchline lands. Tell since the war: before a fight he hums the same three notes, and stops humming only when the other man is good.
**Combat Role:** acrobatic, improvised, kicks and cuts from every angle, upside down half the time.
**Relationship Hook:** Make him laugh in a fight; he teaches the ones who do.
personality: Core: hangs upside down to think; laughs before the punchline; eats whatever is offered
Quirk: hums between sentences

npcs.name: Trader Bunzo
npcs.info:
The trader at the Snowbound Trading Post, fifty, wrapped in furs, who buys pelts from trappers and sells them salt. In person: gruff fur trader; wrapped; suspicious.

**Home Ground:** Fur Counter at Snowbound Trading Post, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff, cold and practical; he talks prices and nothing else, and rounds every figure up. He grunts instead of greeting. Tell: when asked about the northern road he names a price far too high, so no one will go.
**Combat Role:** a hatchet behind the counter.
**Relationship Hook:** Open his back room and the Blight's buyer is exposed.
personality: Core: talks prices; never asks questions; counts salt by the grain
Quirk: keeps the back room locked

npcs.name: Trader Bunzo
npcs.location: Snowbound Trading Post, Post on the Front
npcs.info:
The trader at the Snowbound post after the war, fifty-two, trading furs for steel with the hunters at the last post before the valleys. In person: gruff fur trader wrapped in furs; suspicious; a sun-steel knife he did not have before.

**Home Ground:** Fur Counter, After the War at Snowbound Trading Post, Post on the Front, Hinode Hold district.
**Speaking Style:** Gruff, cold and practical; he talks prices and nothing else, and rounds every figure up. He grunts instead of greeting. Tell since the war: he names the valleys' prices lower than anyone else's, and grunts when asked why.
**Combat Role:** a hatchet behind the counter.
**Relationship Hook:** Open his back room and the Blight's buyer is exposed.
personality: Core: talks prices; never asks questions; counts salt by the grain
Quirk: keeps the back room locked

npcs.name: Trading-Post Thrall
npcs.info:
A fur trader with blood-red eyes behind smoked glasses, who buys hunters' furs and sells their routes north. Thralls serve the demons for long life; this one sells the hunters' movements to the Long Night. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall fur trader with red eyes.

**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and exact, a trader's courtesy, always a question about routes tucked into small talk. Tell: at sunlight through the door his voice tightens.
**Combat Role:** knives across the counter, then a call north
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: pays too well; asks about routes; flinches at sunlight
Quirk: wears smoked glasses

npcs.name: Trading-Post Thrall
npcs.location: Snowbound Trading Post, Post on the Front
npcs.info:
A fur trader with red eyes who stayed at the front post when the trappers left, buying steel from the hunters for furs and selling the Wall's broken stretches north. A stock foe, one of many. In person: blood-sworn thrall fur trader; red eyes behind cracked smoked glasses; furs over a Northern Court cord; a steel ledger.

**Speaking Style:** Pleasant and exact, a trader's courtesy, always a question about routes tucked into small talk. Tell since the war: he asks about the Wall's broken stretches as if asking about the weather.
**Combat Role:** knives across the counter, then a call north
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: pays too well; asks about routes; flinches at sunlight
Quirk: wears smoked glasses

npcs.name: Treasury Magistrate Sakuma Chiyo
npcs.info:
Sakuma Chiyo, a treasury magistrate of the Shogunate, forty, grey-robed and ink-stained: the most honest ledger in the castle and the least liked. A tax convoy carrying a year of the plain's rice money vanished between two post stations, and she is quietly hiring outsiders to find it because she suspects her own guards. In person: magistrate; black hair; tired sharp eyes; grey official robes; ink-stained fingers; a name written in ink; worried.

**Home Ground:** Grey Gate at Miyako Castle, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and precise, numbers before adjectives; lately she stops mid-sentence as if she has lost a word. Clerk's rhythm: numbers first, then the conclusion, no adjectives. Glances at her wrist and reads her own name under her breath. Tell: when she loses a word she goes completely still and starts the sentence over from the beginning.
**Combat Role:** none to speak of; she runs, shouts for the guard and remembers your face.
**Relationship Hook:** Take her convoy job and she pays from her own purse; find out who has been wearing her face and she owes you her name.
personality: Core: checks every figure twice; trusts paper over people; goes silent when she loses a word
Quirk: writes her own name on her wrist each morning

npcs.name: Treasury Magistrate Sakuma Chiyo
npcs.info:
Sakuma Chiyo, treasury magistrate after the war, forty-two, grey-robed and ink-stained, keeping the books of a treasury that owes Saikai twenty years. She found the tax convoy in the war's first month, empty. Now she hunts the men who own the castle's debt. In person: magistrate; black hair with a white streak; sharp eyes; grey robes; her own name inked on the inside of her wrist.

**Home Ground:** Grey Gate, After the War at Miyako Castle, The Blackened Keep, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Clipped and precise, numbers before adjectives; lately she stops mid-sentence as if she has lost a word. Clerk's rhythm: numbers first, then the conclusion, no adjectives. Glances at her wrist and reads her own name under her breath. Tell since the war: she has stopped reading her wrist; she touches it instead when she is certain.
**Combat Role:** none to speak of; she runs, shouts for the guard and remembers your face.
**Relationship Hook:** Take her convoy job and she pays from her own purse; find out who has been wearing her face and she owes you her name.
personality: Core: checks every figure twice; trusts paper over people; goes silent when she loses a word
Quirk: writes her own name on her wrist each morning

npcs.name: Troupe-Master Sanshiro
npcs.info:
The master of a travelling theatre troupe, forty, landing at Hibana's Ember Pier with six actors, a cart of costumes and a play about a smith who forged his own soul. In person: flamboyant theatre troupe master; painted eyebrows; colourful coat; a theatre mask; volcanic town behind.

**Home Ground:** Ember Pier at Hibana, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A booming actor's voice; every sentence is a performance with an entrance and an exit. He announces himself in the third person. Tell: when the show is in danger he drops the stage voice entirely and sounds small.
**Combat Role:** stage swords and a lot of noise.
**Relationship Hook:** See the play and ask about the masks.
personality: Core: never travels without masks; counts his actors; laughs at storms
Quirk: performs every sentence

npcs.name: Troupe-Master Sanshiro
npcs.info:
The master of a travelling theatre troupe after the war, forty-two, playing the Regent's victory to Hibana's rich forge-masters. His actors wear masks better than masks should be. In person: flamboyant troupe master; painted eyebrows; colourful coat; a theatre mask; a crowded pier.

**Home Ground:** Ember Pier, After the War at Hibana, The Brighter Forges, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** A booming actor's voice; every sentence is a performance with an entrance and an exit. He announces himself in the third person. Tell since the war: he announces the dead lord's part in his stage voice, then whispers the actor's real name after.
**Combat Role:** stage swords and a lot of noise.
**Relationship Hook:** See the play and ask about the masks.
personality: Core: never travels without masks; counts his actors; laughs at storms
Quirk: performs every sentence

npcs.name: Tsukimi
npcs.info:
A star-reader of the Bureau, twenty-four, who keeps the instruments of the Old Observatory on the hills south of the city and prefers its dark to the lanterns. Pale, short-sighted and blunt, she reads the death written in your stars and tells you so, the first time you meet. In person: pale short-sighted star-reader; long silver-grey hair; half-lidded dreamy eyes; oversized white onmyoji robes with star embroidery; aloof.

**Home Ground:** Instrument Deck at The Old Observatory, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, matter-of-fact and slightly too slow, as if she is reading the end of the sentence before she says it. Slightly behind the moment, as if reading ahead; long pauses where others breathe. Counts stars under her breath. Tell: when she has seen someone's death, she stops looking at them and speaks very gently.
**Combat Role:** none she likes; a ward, a crane, and knowing exactly where the blow will fall.
**Relationship Hook:** She reads your death at first meeting; change one fate she read and she stops reading yours.
**Courtship Style:** Tells you your death, then keeps checking whether it is still coming; that checking is the courtship.
**Jealousy Style:** Reads the rival's stars aloud, flatly, in front of you; then apologises, badly.
personality: Core: squints at faces; forgets to eat; talks to the instruments
Quirk: tells people how they die

npcs.name: Tsukimi
npcs.location: The Old Observatory, Watch of the Cracked Seals
npcs.info:
A Bureau star-reader after the war, twenty-six, kept in the Old Observatory's cellar for trying to send the warning north. The instruments above her are trained on Hyoga day and night, and she reads the stars through a crack in the cellar roof. In person: pale short-sighted star-reader; long silver-grey hair unbound; half-lidded eyes; oversized white robes; a star chart scratched on the cellar wall.

**Home Ground:** Instrument Deck, After the War at The Old Observatory, Watch of the Cracked Seals, Seimei Bureau district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, matter-of-fact and slightly too slow, as if she is reading the end of the sentence before she says it. Slightly behind the moment, as if reading ahead; long pauses where others breathe. Counts stars under her breath. Tell since the war: she counts the days aloud, softly, at the end of a conversation.
**Combat Role:** none she likes; a ward, a crane, and knowing exactly where the blow will fall.
**Relationship Hook:** She reads your death at first meeting; change one fate she read and she stops reading yours.
**Courtship Style:** Tells you your death, then keeps checking whether it is still coming; that checking is the courtship.
**Jealousy Style:** Reads the rival's stars aloud, flatly, in front of you; then apologises, badly.
personality: Core: squints at faces; forgets to eat; talks to the instruments
Quirk: tells people how they die

npcs.name: Tsurube the Storyteller
npcs.info:
A travelling storyteller, fifty, who walks the post road with a folding fan and a hundred tales: ghosts, heroes, foxes and the ghost station that no map shows. He tells them in inn baths for coins and drinks. In person: travelling storyteller; bald with a grey beard; expressive face; patched colourful haori; a folding fan raised.

**Home Ground:** Common Bath at Seventh Station Inn, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** A storyteller's rich, rolling voice, every sentence a cliffhanger. A rolling performer's voice, dramatic pauses, and a slap of the fan at every turn of a tale. Lowers to a whisper for the frightening parts. Tell: when the story is true, he forgets to perform.
**Combat Role:** none; he tells a story until the danger gets bored.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy him a drink and he tells you how to survive the night road.
personality: Core: ends every sentence as a cliffhanger; snaps his fan for effect; never tells the same story twice in a town
Quirk: goes pale at night lanterns

npcs.name: Tsurube the Storyteller
npcs.location: Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East
npcs.info:
The travelling storyteller after the war, fifty-two, whose hundred tales are now two hundred: the war gave him ghosts enough for a lifetime. He tells them in inn baths still. In person: storyteller; bald with a grey beard; expressive face; patched haori; a folding fan with a burned edge.

**Home Ground:** Common Bath, After the War at Seventh Station Inn, The Last Inn East, Fifty Stations Road district.
**Speaking Style:** A storyteller's rich, rolling voice, every sentence a cliffhanger. A rolling performer's voice, dramatic pauses, and a slap of the fan at every turn of a tale. Lowers to a whisper for the frightening parts. Tell since the war: he tells war stories without the fan, and his voice stays level all the way through.
**Combat Role:** none; he tells a story until the danger gets bored.
**Relationship Hook:** Buy him a drink and he tells you how to survive the night road.
personality: Core: ends every sentence as a cliffhanger; snaps his fan for effect; never tells the same story twice in a town
Quirk: goes pale at night lanterns

npcs.name: Ume the Translator
npcs.info:
A translator in the Foreigners' Quarter tea house, thirty, who speaks four foreign tongues and every dialect of the isles. Captains, factors and magistrates hire her by the hour, and she sells every conversation twice. In person: translator; neat black hair with a jade pin; thoughtful eyes; plain grey kimono with a foreign shawl; calm.

**Home Ground:** Translators' Tea House at Foreigners' Quarter, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and amused; she answers in whichever language you did not expect. Calm, amused, switching languages mid-sentence to see who follows. Repeats a word in three languages when it matters. Tell: when she is cornered she speaks only in the language the listener does not know.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows which door leads out.
**Relationship Hook:** Show her you would use the list to free the hosts, not sell them, and she gives it to you.
personality: Core: answers in the unexpected language; pours tea before every answer; never translates an insult
Quirk: keeps a coded list in her sleeve

npcs.name: Ume the Translator
npcs.area: Translators' Tea House, After the War
npcs.info:
A translator in the Envoys' Quarter after the war, thirty-two, who translates for foreign captains, claimant envoys and the demon court's envoy, and sells nothing twice any more. In person: translator; jade pin; tired thoughtful eyes; plain grey kimono; a foreign shawl.

**Home Ground:** Translators' Tea House, After the War at Foreigners' Quarter, The Envoys' Quarter, Saikai Free Port district.
**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and amused; she answers in whichever language you did not expect. Calm, amused, switching languages mid-sentence to see who follows. Repeats a word in three languages when it matters. Tell since the war: when an army's name comes up she answers in the language that army does not speak.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows which door leads out.
**Relationship Hook:** Show her you would use the list to free the hosts, not sell them, and she gives it to you.
personality: Core: answers in the unexpected language; pours tea before every answer; never translates an insult
Quirk: keeps a coded list in her sleeve

npcs.name: Uncle Kesaburo
npcs.info:
A retired smuggler, sixty-five, lean and smiling, who came to the island to hide from the Brine Tide and stayed because nobody ever comes here; he keeps the old training yard swept and practises his knife-work at dawn. In person: sixty-five; lean; grey hair; a thin grey moustache; a sly smile; a faded blue haori; a gold coin between his knuckles; a knife sheathed.

**Home Ground:** Pine Sword Rack at The Training Yard, on Tomoshibi Isle, the island off Saikai.
**Speaking Style:** Smooth and amused, a retired smuggler's charm, every story improved in the telling. Smooth amused patter, every story improved in the telling, a coin clicking over his knuckles. Tell: when he lies the coin stops; when he tells the truth he laughs first.
**Combat Role:** a feint with the coin, then the knife under the ribs.
**Relationship Hook:** Spar with him at dawn in the training yard and he will tell you which of his stories are true, for a price.
personality: Core: charming, evasive, generous with other people's things; tells the truth only when it is funnier
Quirk: spins a coin over his knuckles while he lies

npcs.name: Utsugi of the Nails
npcs.info:
A curse-bearer the same age as the character, carrying a curse much like theirs, who believes there is only room in the isles for one of them to get free. In person: young woman; gaunt; long black hair; pale skin marked with black nail-shaped scars; a grey layered kimono with black prayer strips; iron nails strung.

**Home Ground:** Dice Room at Lantern Row Gambling Den, Saikai Free Port district, between meetings; a rival meets the character wherever the character is.
**Speaking Style:** Flat and slow, every word weighed, a dark joke delivered without inflection. Flat and slow, every word weighed, dark jokes without inflection. Tell: about the one who cast her curse, her voice warms, terribly.
**Combat Role:** nail curse first, then whatever the bout demands; a curse-bearer rival who has studied the character.
**Relationship Hook:** She will show you her scars, and then ask to see yours.
personality: Core: dry as ash; keeps her promises to the letter; never says please
Quirk: counts the nails at her belt

npcs.name: Valley Yamauba
npcs.info:
A tiny bent crone with a frost-blue shawl and a bald, ice-flecked scalp in a snow-buried cottage, offering hot broth to the lost. The valley yamauba shelters the polite and eats the rude, and even the snow woman leaves her be. A stock foe, one of many. In person: elderly crone; yamauba; tiny bent bald old woman with a deeply wrinkled face; frost-blue shawl.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and creaking, broth offered the moment a guest sits. Tell: a rude guest makes her laugh go wide and cold.
**Combat Role:** a lunge from the hearth
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: laughs too wide; judges manners; speaks to the snow
Quirk: offers broth

npcs.name: Valley Yuki-onna
npcs.info:
A woman in white with hair to her knees standing in the white silence, her breath freezing birds. She asks lost travellers for shelter; her kiss freezes them where they stand. A stock foe, one of many. In person: pale woman; frosty breath.

**Speaking Style:** Soft as falling snow, barely above a whisper, each breath audible and freezing. Tell: moved by kindness, her voice trembles and warms.
**Combat Role:** the breath, then the kiss
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks for shelter; breathes frost; spares the kind
Quirk: stands very still

npcs.name: Valley Yuki-onna
npcs.epithet: Snow Woman of the Valley Between
npcs.info:
A woman in white with hair to her knees who stands in the last empty valley between the Hold and the north; the demons' patrols that walk into her silence do not walk out, and she spares the refugees now. A stock foe, one of many. In person: yuki-onna; pale woman in a white kimono; long black hair; frosty breath; a demon's horn hung at her sash.

**Speaking Style:** Soft as falling snow, barely above a whisper, each breath audible and freezing. Tell since the war: she stands very still, then turns her face north before she speaks.
**Combat Role:** the breath, then the kiss
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: asks for shelter; freezes demons; spares the living
Quirk: stands very still

npcs.name: Vault Escort of the Eagle Cliffs
npcs.info:
A Warden escort in salt-crusted grey furs with a hooked glaive and a beast-host's broken chain at her belt. Vault escorts bring captured hosts along the coast to the Vaults and fight to the last to keep them. A stock foe, one of many. In person: vault warden escort; hooked glaive; a broken chain.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and tired, kind to captives, flat to everyone else. Tell: she touches the broken chain before she lies.
**Combat Role:** a hooked glaive at reach to drag a foe off the cliff path
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: touches the broken chain; speaks to captives kindly; fights without mercy
Quirk: never sleeps on duty

npcs.name: Veil Court Ferry-Guard
npcs.info:
A junior Veil Court officer in a white coat with a ferry lantern and a plain-steel blade. Ferry-guards herd the restless dead toward the gate and cut down the living who interfere. A stock foe, one of many. In person: junior veil court officer; ferry lantern; plain steel blade.

**Speaking Style:** Distant and soft, speaking past the living to the dead. Tell: at a young man's face she stops and stares.
**Combat Role:** an officer's blade by lantern light, the dead behind her
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: speaks to the dead first; lantern always lit; impatient with the living
Quirk: checks every face

npcs.name: Veil Court Patrol Officer
npcs.info:
An officer of the Veil Court in a black coat with a soul-blade, pale and calm. Patrol officers cut down the hungry dead and question the living who see too much. A stock foe, one of many. In person: Veil Court officer; pale; black officer's coat; a soul-blade.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, distant. Formal and distant, Court phrasing, every sentence an entry in a case file. Patrol officers state your status before your name. Tell: when you are alive they sound faintly surprised.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade, exact, on the dead first
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: sees the dead; asks for names; never sweats
Quirk: speaks formally

npcs.name: Veil Court Patrol Officer
npcs.location: Black Ferry Fortress, The Overrun Fortress
npcs.info:
An officer of the Veil Court crewing the ferries day and night now the barracks are emptied; patrols are a memory, and the hungry dead walk while the officers row. A stock foe, one of many. In person: Veil Court officer; pale and hollow-eyed; a black officer's coat salt-stained; a soul-blade; an oar callus on both hands.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, distant. Formal and distant, Court phrasing, every sentence an entry in a case file. Patrol officers state your status before your name. Tell since the war: he speaks formally, then yawns mid-word and does not apologise.
**Combat Role:** a soul-blade, exact, on the dead first
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: sees the dead; rows the ferry; sweats now
Quirk: speaks formally

npcs.name: Vent Ember Sprite
npcs.info:
A dancing spark of living flame the size of a child. Ember sprites dance over the vents and follow soul-forged blades. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ember sprite; a child-sized dancing spirit of flame.

**Speaking Style:** A crackle that giggles, words popping like sparks. Tell: when it laughs too hard, things catch fire.
**Combat Role:** a burst of flame
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows blades; burns; giggles
Quirk: dances

npcs.name: Vent Ember Sprite
npcs.location: Ember Vent Fields, The Crowded Vents
npcs.info:
A dancing spark of living flame, one of so many that the sprites dance at the edge of town now, drawn by the war blades carried in for cleansing. A stock foe, one of many. In person: ember sprite; a child-sized dancing spirit of flame; sulphur smoke in its trail.

**Speaking Style:** A crackle that giggles, words popping like sparks. Tell since the war: it dances faster near any blade that has killed.
**Combat Role:** a burst of flame
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: follows war blades; burns; giggles
Quirk: dances

npcs.name: Vent-Field Magma Crawler
npcs.info:
A long armoured crawler of cooling magma that drags itself out of the vents trailing sparks. Magma crawlers burn through anything in the steam field and nest in the warm vents. A stock foe, one of many. In person: magma crawler; a long armoured creature of glowing cooling magma crawling from a steaming vent.

**Speaking Style:** A hiss of steam and cracking crust. Tell: near water its hiss turns to a shriek.
**Combat Role:** a burning coil from the vent
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: crawls; burns; avoids water
Quirk: glows

npcs.name: Veteran Smith Iwao
npcs.info:
A soldier who came home to Hibana's forge row, thirty-seven, carrying a soul-forged blade he fought the whole war with. He cannot put it down; when he tries, it calls him back. In person: veteran swordsman; tired eyes; burn scars; a dark sword that faintly whispers.

**Home Ground:** Forge Row, After the War at Hibana, The Brighter Forges, Tetsuyama district.
**Speaking Style:** Rough and grim, a smith's voice that goes quiet near steel. Rough and grim, quiet near steel, a mutter to the blade between sentences. Tell: when someone reaches for the blade he says the miner's name.
**Combat Role:** the soul-blade, which fights better than he does.
**Relationship Hook:** Free the miner in his blade and he will forge for you, his last blade without a soul.
personality: Core: sleeps with the blade; will not let others touch it; drinks to sleep
Quirk: talks to it under his breath

npcs.name: Veteran Sugawara Ippei
npcs.info:
A veteran of Sekigane, thirty, who sells sandals in the castle market and walks with a stick. He fought for the Regent and does not say so. In person: young man; veteran foot soldier; lean face; a walking stick; plain clothes; weaving straw sandals.

**Home Ground:** Castle Market, After the War at Miyako, Besieged, Miyako Plain district.
**Speaking Style:** Plain and level, a foot soldier's talk with long pauses where the story should go. Plain soldier's talk with long pauses where the story should go. Tell: a drumbeat anywhere and he stops weaving and waits.
**Combat Role:** a spear, badly, on one good leg.
**Relationship Hook:** Believe what he heard and he will tell it to anyone you bring him.
personality: Core: walks with a stick; weaves sandals while he talks; never names his company
Quirk: flinches at drums

npcs.name: Village Shinobi
npcs.info:
A shinobi in dark close-fitting gear and a face wrap, kunai at the belt, moving without sound. Village shinobi on contract avoid a fair fight and finish the job they were paid for. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kunoichi; kunai.

**Speaking Style:** A whisper, clipped and cold, words used only when silence fails. Shinobi speak in code words and hand signs. Tell: when caught they say nothing at all, which is its own answer.
**Combat Role:** kunai from hiding, smoke, gone
**Relationship Hook:** A foe for fights only, never a suspect.
personality: Core: vanishes in smoke; obeys the contract; speaks in signals
Quirk: never fights fair

npcs.name: Village Shinobi
npcs.location: Kagegi Village, Burned at the Edge
npcs.area: Cedar Training Grounds, After the War
npcs.info:
A shinobi who works the fortified line between the villages now, not contracts: the cold war burned hot, and every genin fights for Kagegi itself. A stock foe, one of many. In person: kunoichi; dark shinobi gear with a burn scar along one arm; a face wrap; kunai; a Kagegi line-tag at the throat.
