Each meeting is a bout. Win it, lose it, or win and spare them out of respect: the isles keep the record. The last meeting decides how it ends. Spare them then and they become a friend for good. Win without sparing and they leave the roads. Lose and they walk away the better, and tell you so.

Each of the eight traditions has its own: Shinobi, Samurai, Ronin, Veil Officer, Half-Yokai, Onmyoji, Breath Hunter, Curse-Bearer. Every new character carries this book; a copy costs 2 Mon at any post station or temple.

items.name: The Rooted King's Crown of Roots
items.info: A circlet of living roots that still grows a little. The wood answers the wearer, and the paths in it open. The one unique piece of the depths under The Rooted Deep, left by The Rooted King. Found, never sold: The Rooted Deep.

items.name: The Sailor's-Face Mask
items.info: A thin mask in the shape of a drowned sailor's face. Whoever wears it is taken for someone else, for a while. The one unique piece of the depths under Heron Island after the war, left by a nure-onna wearing a sailor's face. Found, never sold: Heron Island after the war.

items.name: The Sea Ledger
items.info:
A salt-stained ledger from the Landing's net shed, Boatwright Hanzaemon's hull drawings in the back.

Hanzaemon builds three hulls at the Landing, one after another:
- The fishing boat: 30 hull, 2-6 hands, 2 lots of cargo, coastal lanes only, no guns
- The coaster: 60 hull, 6-16 hands, 6 lots of cargo, every lane, 1 gun
- The war junk: 100 hull, 12-30 hands, 4 lots of cargo, every lane, 3 guns
A hull is mended at The Landing, Saikai, Mizuchi Naval Anchorage for 2 Mon a point. A ship sunk at sea is a wreck: the cargo is lost, half the hands drown, and Hanzaemon rebuilds her for 40 Mon (the fishing boat), 150 Mon (the coaster), 400 Mon (the war junk).

Hands are hired at Saikai, Ashiura Fish Docks, Mizuchi Naval Anchorage for 1 Mon a head a week, paid in port on the household's terms (7 days, 2 days' grace). Their morale rises with pay, prizes and quiet crossings; at 30 or below, a quarter of them walk off at the next port.

Four officers can sign on, each through their own quest (sworn) or for wages:
- Navigator: Old Captain Hamada Gennai, 12 Mon a week; takes a day off any lane of three days or more and calms the weather
- Gunner: Mizuchi Toranosuke, 12 Mon a week; makes the broadside hit harder
- Bosun: Aoi of the Wreck, 8 Mon a week; patches hull after a fight and loses fewer hands
- Pilot: Chidori the Runner, 10 Mon a week; keeps the navy off a smuggling run and helps the ship slip a fight

Ports and what they trade (prices drift week to week; contraband sells for about 2.5 times its price where it is wanted, and raises infamy):
- The Landing: makes dried fish; wants timber, rice, iron
- Saikai: makes sake, silk; wants iron, dried fish; buys under the counter: forbidden books
- Ashiura Fish Docks: makes dried fish, salt; wants rice, timber
- Foreign Quay Warehouses: makes foreign glass; wants silk, sake; buys under the counter: forbidden books, yokai relics
- Mizuchi Naval Anchorage: makes timber; wants iron, salt, rice
- Drifting Fish Market: makes salt; wants sake, silk, foreign glass
- Black Sand Beach: makes timber; wants salt, dried fish; buys under the counter: foreign powder
- Heron Island: makes rice; wants iron, sake; buys under the counter: yokai relics
- Pirate Graves Reef: an anchorage, no market
- Hibana: makes iron; wants timber, rice, salt; buys under the counter: untaxed salt-iron, foreign powder

14 lanes join the ports, one to four days each. Every crossing makes one roll: a quiet passage, weather, a wreck to pick over, pirates, the drowned, or a navy patrol if the hold carries contraband. A fight lasts at most 3 rounds; order broadside, board, run or ward, and bribe or submit to a patrol (20 Mon and 10 more a contraband lot, or lose the contraband and pay 30 Mon). Every new character carries this book; a copy costs 2 Mon at any post station or temple.

items.name: The Second Hammer
items.info: Kanemasa's own forging hammer, whole again, dark and heavy. In a smith's hand it rings true: work done with it comes out a grade cleaner. Left when the Second Hammer was finally called an equal. Found, never sold: Ember Vent Fields.

items.name: The Second Thrall's Sun-Ward Coat
items.info: A thrall's coat lined with stolen sunrise talismans; the Long Night sent it out in daylight in this. The one unique piece of the depths under Burned Village of Kitamura after the war, left by the thrall the Long Night sent to replace the first. Found, never sold: Burned Village of Kitamura after the war.

items.name: The Shadow Head's Cedar Ring
items.info: A ring carved from the oldest cedar in the valley: every Kagegi shinobi obeys it.

items.name: The Soul Current
items.info:
A shrine primer on the one current every art draws on.

Soul (40 at the start, plus what your tradition and lineage add) is spent whenever a technique is really used: a flicker of sensing or a spark costs 0 to 5, a standard technique 5 to 12, a heavy technique, a release or a summoning 15 to 25, something that changes a battlefield 30 or more. A named technique carries its own price (Spends 12 Soul) and the world takes exactly that when you use it. Sensing a presence, talking about techniques or watching one costs nothing. A full rest restores all of it, a short rest about half, meditation at a shrine or a spring 10 more. Run dry and a technique you cannot pay for fails and costs 5 Health, every one you try until you rest.

Hold (100, full at the start) is the grip you keep on what lives inside you: a sealed beast, an inner mask, a curse, the spirit in a soul-blade. Only a Birthright, or a Veil Officer's blade release, spends it: 10 for drawing on its power, 25 for a full release. Ordinary techniques, wounds and fear never touch it, and only rest restores it. Without a Birthright or an unlocked blade release you never spend Hold. An officer who also carries a Named Soul-Blade has one blade and one spirit: its draws are the release, never charged twice.

When Hold falls the thing inside answers, once each fall: at 50 it starts to whisper; at 25 it bleeds through (eyes, voice, a hand that is not yours) and people notice; at 0 it takes your body for a scene, and you cannot act until the scene turns or someone brings you back. Climbing back to 90 resets it. Every new character carries this book; a copy costs 2 Mon at any post station or temple.

items.name: The Stone Warden's Bracers
items.info: Two bracers of grey sanctum stone, light as wood in the wearer's arms and heavy as a mountain on a blow. The one unique piece of the depths under Earth Sanctum, left by The Stone Warden. Found, never sold: Earth Sanctum.

items.name: The Sun-Arrow Lord's Bow-Ring
items.info: A thumb ring of horn and gold from the lord's own bow.

items.name: The Thawed Noble's Court Blade
items.info: A long court sword of the frozen field's next noble, its steel blue with cold that does not thaw. The one unique piece of the depths under Frozen Battlefield after the war, left by the next noble of the frozen court, thawed to take the field. Found, never sold: Frozen Battlefield after the war.

items.name: The Tide Council's Pearl
items.info: A black pearl that every Brine Tide captain must answer to.

items.name: The Tide Serpent's Coil Whip
items.info: A long whip of blue serpent scale that coils back to the hand like water finding its level. The one unique piece of the depths under Water Sanctum, left by The Tide Serpent. Found, never sold: Water Sanctum.

items.name: The Tsuchigumo's Lantern Gauntlets
items.info: Miner's gauntlets the shaft spider wore as trophies, each knuckle set with a small cold lamp that shows what moves in the dark. The one unique piece of the depths under Revenant Shaft, left by Shaft Tsuchigumo. Found, never sold: Revenant Shaft.

items.name: The Tunnel-Mother's Digging Claws
items.info: A pair of claw-gauntlets cut from the tunnel-mother's forelimbs. Stone gives way to them like snow. The one unique piece of the depths under The Long Night Wall after the war, left by the tunnel-mother that dug the breach. Found, never sold: The Long Night Wall after the war.

items.name: The Umibozu's Tide Mantle
items.info: A mantle of black kelp woven tight as lacquer. Water slides off it and the sea seems to keep its distance. The one unique piece of the depths under Pirate Graves Reef, left by Bay Umibozu. Found, never sold: Pirate Graves Reef.

items.name: The Unbound Beast's Shed-Skin Coat
items.info: A coat cut from the white skin the beast shed in the fissure. Cold does not reach its wearer. The one unique piece of the depths under Glacier Road after the war, left by the unbound beast that cracked the road. Found, never sold: Glacier Road after the war.

items.name: The Unforged Soul-Blade
items.info: A blade from the blue furnace with no soul in it, the only one: clean steel that listens to its wielder alone. The one unique piece of the depths under The Deep Forges after the war, left by the forge-wraith of the souls unforged. Found, never sold: The Deep Forges after the war.

items.name: The War Gashadokuro's Rib-Shield
items.info: A great curved breastplate made from one of the war skeleton's ribs. Arrows break on it. The one unique piece of the depths under Bone Gully after the war, left by the war's gashadokuro, bigger than before. Found, never sold: Bone Gully after the war.

items.name: The War-Fat Devourer's Jaw
items.info: A club made from the devourer's own jaw, its teeth still set in it, grown heavy on the war's dead. The one unique piece of the depths under Mask Shore after the war, left by a new devourer, fat on the war's dead. Found, never sold: Mask Shore after the war.

items.name: The War-Wreck Lantern Helm
items.info: A drowned sailor's helmet with a lantern bolted to its brow; its light shows the drowned before they move. The one unique piece of the depths under Pirate Graves Reef after the war, left by the drowned of the war's wrecks, risen as one. Found, never sold: Pirate Graves Reef after the war.

items.name: The Warden-General's Ice Key
items.info: A key of blue glass that opens the outer Vaults.

items.name: The Warlord's Terms
items.info: A dead warlord's tachi, its scabbard tied shut with a cord of surrender that its owner never untied. The one unique piece of the depths under Old Battle Barrow after the war, left by the dead warlord who asks for terms. Found, never sold: Old Battle Barrow after the war.

items.name: The Well's Stolen Voice
items.info: A cloth mask with the turned well's water dried into it. Through it the wearer speaks in a voice that is not theirs. The one unique piece of the depths under Sunken Well Village after the war, left by the well's voice, speaking with the voice the headman's son lost. Found, never sold: Sunken Well Village after the war.

items.name: The Wind Head's Kite
items.info: A small paper kite with the village mark: raised on the ridge, it calls every Hayate shinobi.

items.name: The Wreck-Raider's Gaff
items.info: A long iron boarding gaff, barnacled at the hook, that has pulled a hundred men off a hundred rails. The one unique piece of the depths under Smugglers' Caves, left by Cave Wreck-Raider. Found, never sold: Smugglers' Caves.

items.name: Thunder Boar Tusk Chip
items.info: A chip of tusk that crackles in a storm, found where the Thunder Boar sleeps. Blows land like thunder; the bearer cannot sit still. Found, never sold: Ascetics' Peak.

items.name: Thunder Fur
items.info: A tuft of fur that crackles when stroked. A bowstring or haft wrapped in it strikes like lightning. Taken from a beaten Raiju, Nue; a market pays 14 Mon.

items.name: Tide Runner's Oilskin
items.info: An oilskin pouch that keeps papers dry through a swim, given to the Tide's runners.

items.name: Tide Serpent's Pearl
items.info: A black pearl the tide serpent kept under its tongue; it pulls like the moon. A lair rarity: left by the boss of Water Sanctum, never sold.

items.name: Token of the Other Parent
items.info: The thing your yokai parent left: a white hair that never breaks, a scale, a feather, a bead that is warm. Yokai of that blood know it.

items.name: Tracker's Kit
items.info: Chalk, string, a bone ruler and a pouch of fine ash for reading tracks on hard ground. 8 Mon, sold at Hunters' Supply Road.

items.name: Travel Rations
items.info: Dried fish, roasted rice and miso balls for three days' walking, packed tight in oiled paper. 2 Mon, sold at Oiwake Station.

items.name: Travel-Worn Kit
items.info: A straw hat, a travel cloak gone grey, a rice bowl, a whetstone and a string of mon that is never long enough.

items.name: Traveller's Straw Hat
items.info: A deep woven hat that keeps sun and rain off and a face in shadow. 2 Mon, sold at any town market.

items.name: Tsuta's Well Rope
items.info: A short length of well rope, burned at one end, knotted the way a mother ties a child's sandal. The bearer endures cold, hunger and long nights better than anyone. Left when the Mother on the Kitamura Well heard her daughter's voice. Found, never sold: Burned Village of Kitamura, The First of Many.

items.name: Two-Blooded Kin Bracelet
items.info: A bracelet braided from yokai hair of many kinds.

items.name: Umbrella Blade
items.info: An oiled paper umbrella hiding a thin blade.

items.name: Umibozu Ink
items.info: A jar of black sea-ink that swallows lamplight. Seals drawn in it hold against water. Taken from a beaten Umibozu; a market pays 16 Mon.

items.name: Umibozu's Drowned Moonstone
items.info: A pale stone from the sea giant's eye-socket. It glows like a drowned moon. A lair rarity: left by the boss of Pirate Graves Reef, never sold.

items.name: Veil Cadet's Gate Badge
items.info: A black iron badge shaped like a gate, given to every cadet of the Court.

items.name: Veil Officer's Haori
items.info: A black officer's coat with the gate crest on the back.

items.name: Victory Omamori
items.info: A gold brocade amulet for warriors. Duelists touch it before they draw. 6 Mon, sold at Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain.

items.name: Void Thread
items.info: A grey thread the eye slides off. Sewn into a hem, it makes the wearer hard to look at. Taken from a beaten Void Shade; a market pays 15 Mon.

items.name: Void Ward Talisman
items.info: A ward inked in black on black paper, nearly invisible. It keeps the hollowness of void techniques from reaching the soul. 14 Mon, sold at Talisman Market.

items.name: Wakizashi
items.info: The short companion sword worn beside a katana, for close quarters and for honour's last duty. 12 Mon, sold at any town market.

items.name: Waraji Sandals
items.info: Plain straw sandals. A traveller on the post road wears out a pair every few days. 1 Mon, sold at any town market.

items.name: Ward Keeper's Stone
items.info: A smooth river stone carved with the Refuge's ward.

items.name: Ward Paper Strip
items.info: A single paper ward inked by a Bureau scribe. Slapped on a door, a box or a body, it holds a lesser spirit back for one scene and then burns to ash. 4 Mon, sold at Talisman Market.

items.name: Ward's Token
items.info: The token that marked you as a hostage of a house not your own.

items.name: Warden's Seal Paper
items.info: A packet of blank seal papers, ready for a Warden's brush.

items.name: Warm Sake Flask
items.info: A gourd flask of cheap sake. Warms a cold body, loosens a tongue at the inn and dulls a hand on the sword. 2 Mon, sold at any town market.

items.name: Water Ward Talisman
items.info: A blue-inked ward sewn into a sleeve. Sailors and marsh folk wear one against drowning and the cold of deep water. 10 Mon, sold at Talisman Market.

items.name: Well Master's Ladle
items.info: A long iron ladle that has touched the bottom of a curse well.

items.name: Whale Oil Cask
items.info: A small cask of rendered whale oil for lamps, armour and the foreign quay's machines. 6 Mon, sold at Whaling Station.

items.name: White Lotus Pin
items.info: A small enamel lotus worn by the princess's followers.

items.name: White Mask Chip
items.info: A chip of smooth white mask that never yellows. Mask-makers grind it into their best gesso. Taken from a beaten Hungry Mask, Mask Wisp, Swarming Masks, Great Mask, Mask Lord, Masked Devourer, Nopperabo; a market pays 8 Mon.

items.name: White Stag Antler Tine
items.info: A tine of white antler that frosts the hand holding it. Wards drawn near it hold; the bearer is always cold. Found, never sold: Ice Shrine of the White Stag.

items.name: Wind Swordsman's Fan
items.info: A feather fan that stirs a wind when flicked.

items.name: Wind Ward Talisman
items.info: A green-inked ward knotted to a sash. Cutting wind and flying things turn a hair aside. 10 Mon, sold at Talisman Market.

items.name: Wound Salve
items.info: A clam shell of yellow salve that smells of camphor and pine. Smeared on a cut after a fight it closes small wounds and restores a little health; it does nothing for a wound still being made. 3 Mon, sold at any apothecary or temple dispensary. Restores 10 Health when used (the engine adds it).

items.name: Wreck-Raider's Black Coral
items.info: A branch of black coral from the raiders' grotto, hard as horn and cold as the sea floor. A lair rarity: left by the boss of Smugglers' Caves, never sold.

items.name: Yari
items.info: A straight-bladed spear.

items.name: Yasuke's Paid Receipt
items.info: A rice-tax receipt, the seal clear, the paper soft from a sleeve. Officials who read it bow a little lower: the bearer's word is taken against a ledger's. Left by the Hanged Debtor when the plain heard the truth. Found, never sold: Crossroads Gallows, Hanged Crossroads.

items.name: Yokai Finery
items.info: Old-fashioned silk in colours no tailor sells, cut for a body that is not always the same shape. Garb, worn in the body slot. Price: 8 Mon at any outfitter.

abilities.name: A Blade with a Name
abilities.info:
The isles will know this sword by name for a thousand years. Greatly improves the next Forging action, and the blade is legendary.
[Skill: forging 24]

abilities.name: A Cut the River Remembers
abilities.info:
One stroke the isles will tell stories about. Greatly improves the next Blade action, and whoever sees it remembers your name.
[Skill: blade 24]

abilities.name: A Day in Their House
abilities.info:
Live in their house for a day unseen. Greatly improves the next Stealth action over a long time.
[Skill: stealth 21]

abilities.name: A Lie the Court Believes
abilities.info:
The whole court acts on it. Greatly improves the next Deception action, and history records it as truth.
[Skill: deception 24]

abilities.name: A Post Stage Before Noon
abilities.info:
Run a day's road by noon. Greatly improves the next Footwork action over long distance.
[Skill: footwork 21]

abilities.name: A Thousand Unseen Edges
abilities.info:
The room was a trap all along. Greatly improves the next Hidden Arms action, and nobody saw it laid.
[Skill: hidden-arms 24]

abilities.name: Abbot's Sanctuary
abilities.info:
Anyone under your roof is under the Order's protection. Greatly improves the next action to shelter someone from those who hunt them.
[Trait: The Mountain Temple Order: Temple Abbot]

needs.variable: The Mountain Temple Order: Temple Abbot

abilities.name: Across the Blight
abilities.info:
Track through ash that holds no prints. Greatly improves the next Tracking action in impossible ground.
[Skill: tracking 21]

abilities.name: Across the Room
abilities.info:
Crosses a hall, a courtyard or a river crossing in a single step. Improves the next Footwork action that covers a distance at once.
[Skill: footwork 12]

abilities.name: Afterimage
abilities.info:
Leaves the image of a stance behind and strikes from the side. Improves the next Footwork or Blade action that misleads a foe.
[Skill: footwork 6]

abilities.name: Afterimage Step
abilities.info:
They hit where you were. Strongly improves the next Footwork action that dodges.
[Skill: footwork 18]

abilities.name: Aim Along the Hand
abilities.info:
Sights along the off hand before the lunge and does not miss. Improves the next Blade action that thrusts at a weak point.
[Trait: Fang Thrust]

abilities.name: All Nine Lines
abilities.info:
Every angle at once: no guard, no dodge and no block covers all nine. Strongly improves the next Blade action against a single foe.
[Skill: blade 18]

abilities.name: All-Night Fight
abilities.info:
The fight lasted till dawn, and so did you. Strongly improves the next Stamina action in a long fight.
[Skill: stamina 15]

abilities.name: All-Seeing
abilities.info:
No ambush finds you unready and no clue is left behind. Greatly improves the next Awareness action, and the party is never surprised.
[Skill: awareness 24]

abilities.name: Among People
abilities.info:
Live as human without suspicion. Greatly improves the next action among humans.
[Trait: Human Heart]

abilities.name: Ancestor's Glamour
abilities.info:
The grandparent's glamour: a face or shape that fools anyone. Strongly improves the next Shapeshifting action that disguises. Spends 10 Hold.
[Skill: shapeshifting 18]

abilities.name: Answer in Kind
abilities.info:
Strike back at whoever struck first. Strongly improves the first counterattack of a fight.
[Trait: Never Draw First]

abilities.name: Answer in the Stillness
abilities.info:
Answer an attack inside a stilled heartbeat: your cut lands first. Strongly improves the next Blade action that counters. Spends 10 Hold.
[Skill: blade 18]

abilities.name: Answer to Every School
abilities.info:
The masterless school's reply to a named form: seen once, answered once. Strongly improves the next Blade action against a technique the ronin has already seen this fight.
[Trait: The Masterless School]

abilities.name: Answering Draw
abilities.info:
The katana clears the scabbard and cuts in one motion. Improves the next Blade action made as a first or an answering cut.
[Trait: Katana]

abilities.name: Antidote in Time
abilities.info:
The cure before the poison wins. Strongly improves the next Medicine action against a deadly poison.
[Skill: medicine 15]

abilities.name: Apprentice's Bellows
abilities.info:
You keep a forge at the right heat. Greatly improves the next Forging action to repair a weapon or armour.
[Trait: The Tetsuyama Forge Guild: Forge Apprentice]

needs.variable: The Tetsuyama Forge Guild: Forge Apprentice

abilities.name: Army of the Realm
abilities.info:
Command a regiment. Greatly improves the next action directing soldiers.
[Trait: Shogunate General]

abilities.name: Arrive First
abilities.info:
Closes a distance before the foe has finished deciding to move. Improves the next Footwork action that closes on a foe.
[Trait: Thousand Steps]

abilities.name: Arrow at the Gallop
abilities.info:
The Hiwada shot from a running horse. Greatly improves the next Archery action made from horseback or on the move.
[Trait: House Hiwada: Outrider]

abilities.name: Arrow from the Saddle
abilities.info:
Loose at full gallop and hit. Improves the next Archery action made while mounted or moving.
[Trait: House Hiwada]

abilities.name: Arrow Through the Rain
abilities.info:
Rain, night, smoke: you hit anyway. Greatly improves the next Archery action in poor sight.
[Skill: archery 21]

abilities.name: Artisan: Craft
abilities.info:
Make an item from a recipe in your party's crafting ledger. Click this, then name the recipe: Cedar-Haft Spear (square brackets optional). You need the recipe's materials in hand and you must be at its station; the roll uses the recipe's craft (Forging, Medicine, Artifice or Warding).
Results: a critical success makes it one quality higher (Fine); a basic success, success or great success makes it at Base; mixed results makes it at Base but uses one extra material; a failure wastes nothing and makes nothing; a critical failure ruins the materials.
When it works, the narration names the finished item in square brackets, and that is the moment the ledger records it. 40 recipes are known from the start, all in The Isles Recipe Book, among them Cedar-Haft Spear, Lacquered Cuirass, Clam-Shell Salve, Mountain Root Tonic, Spring Trap, Artificer's Tool Roll, Paper Ward-Charm and Battle Sutra Strip. Your first crafting action opens The Craftsman's Ledger quest, which tracks your progress.
[Level: 1]

abilities.name: Artisan: Design Recipe
abilities.info:
Invent a recipe of your own and add it to your party's crafting ledger. Click this, then say what it is in plain words: a frost spear from iron spearhead, ice crystal and cedar haft. Materials (up to 5) after from, with or using; leave them out and the narrator picks two or three that fit. Add at a forge, at a shrine and so on to choose the station; leave it out and the item's own words choose the craft: talismans, charms and wards are Warding (shrine); traps, bombs, locks and hooks are Artifice (workshop); salves, tonics, teas and poisons are Medicine (apothecary); anything else is Forging (forge). The old form still works: [Frost Spear] = iron spearhead + ice crystal at a forge (never type @: the game turns it into a place name).
A name of at most 48 letters (so its Master-made and Named names still fit), and no quality word (Fine, Superior, Master-made, Named) in a new name. Soul-blades, sealed beasts and their vessels cannot be designed. A designed item starts at Base quality with one theme taken from its words (frost, fire, lightning, venom, shadow, warding, swiftness, healing); its strength is capped by quality, never by the idea, so raising it is how it grows.
Designing costs nothing and you need not be at the station. The narrator names the recipe in square brackets, and that is the moment the ledger records it. A name already in the ledger is refused. Recipes belong to the whole party.
[Level: 1]

abilities.name: Artisan: Upgrade
abilities.info:
Raise an item you crafted one quality step: Base, Fine, Superior, Master-made, Named. Click this, then name the item as it is now: Cedar-Haft Spear to make it Fine, Fine Cedar-Haft Spear to make it Superior (square brackets optional). The party's ledger must hold the item at that quality.
Each step needs a higher craft skill (Fine 3, Superior 7, Master-made 12, Named 18), one rarer material (Fine: a refined one, Superior: a rare one, Master-made: an exotic one, Named: a legendary one) and the recipe's station. Master-made and Named need a master-grade station: Forging: Forge Guild Hall, Hibana, The Workshop; Medicine: Hayate Ridge Village; Artifice: Mask-Maker's Workshop; Warding: Bureau of Yin and Yang, Crater Rim Shrine.
Results: a basic success, success or great success raises it one step; a critical success raises it and saves the material; mixed results raises it but costs a second material; a failure changes nothing and keeps the material; a critical failure loses the material, never the item. The upgraded item replaces the old one and the narration names it.
[Level: 1]

abilities.name: Ash Where You Stood
abilities.info:
For a scene the shinobi leaves ash where they stood and is already elsewhere. Strongly improves every Footwork and Hidden Arms action in the scene.
[Trait: Second Style: Fire]

abilities.name: Awaken Art
abilities.info:
Reach for the technique that is yours alone and make it your Awakened Art: use this in a fight or in downtime, name it, say what it does and which discipline it comes from, and it is created at the scale your level there allows. You hold one Awakened Art at most; it grows by upgrading it, never by awakening a second. It can be used once a fight, spends Soul by its tier, and a Birthright holder's Art also spends 25 Hold. A Named Soul-Blade's bearer awakens it as the blade's second release.
[Level: 1]

abilities.name: Back from the Edge
abilities.info:
Someone who was dying is not. Greatly improves the next Medicine action on the dying.
[Skill: medicine 21]

abilities.name: Band Boss's Ambush
abilities.info:
You set the road's best ambushes. Greatly improves the next action to plan or spring an ambush on a convoy or a patrol.
[Trait: The Red Lantern Federation: Band Boss]

needs.variable: The Red Lantern Federation: Band Boss

abilities.name: Bandit Hunter's Trail
abilities.info:
You know how raiders move on the plain. Greatly improves the next action to track, cut off or ambush bandits in open country.
[Trait: House Hiwada: Arrow Captain]

abilities.name: Bandit Toll
abilities.info:
Pass a bandit road by paying the right person. Improves the next Streetwise action with outlaws.
[Skill: streetwise 12]

abilities.name: Bane's Mark
abilities.info:
Demons fear you on sight. Greatly improves the next action against a demon.
[Trait: Demon's Bane]

abilities.name: Banner Bearer
abilities.info:
People gather where you stand. Strongly improves the next Command action to rally a broken group.
[Skill: command 15]

abilities.name: Banner Command
abilities.info:
You command Takamori retainers and ashigaru as a banner officer. Greatly improves the next action directing a group of soldiers in a fight or a search.
[Trait: House Takamori: Banner Officer]

abilities.name: Banner Unbroken
abilities.info:
Name Spoken mastered: your house's name steadies every ally who hears it. Improves the next Resolve or Blade action of each ally in earshot, once a fight.
[Trait: Samurai: Mastered Art]

abilities.name: Banners Rally
abilities.info:
Your house's soldiers rally to you. Greatly improves the next action leading samurai in battle.
[Trait: House Champion]

abilities.name: Barrier Captain's Inspection
abilities.info:
Nothing passes your barrier unseen. Greatly improves the next action to search, question or hold a traveller at a barrier.
[Trait: The Post-Road Wardens: Barrier Captain]

abilities.name: Barrier Line
abilities.info:
A line nothing lesser crosses. Improves the next Sealwork action that holds a passage. Spends 8 Soul.
[Skill: sealwork 9]

abilities.name: Barrier of Five Seals
abilities.info:
Five talismans thrown to the points of a star: a barrier nothing lesser crosses. Strongly improves the next Warding action that holds a place. Spends 25 Soul.
[Trait: Onmyoji]

abilities.name: Battlefield Weather
abilities.info:
Your Soul changes the field: wind, fire, earth, rain answer. Greatly improves the next Soulcraft action that shapes terrain or weather. Spends 18 Soul.
[Skill: soulcraft 21]

abilities.name: Beast Shape
abilities.info:
Become the animal of your blood. Improves the next Shapeshifting action into a beast. Spends 8 Soul.
[Skill: shapeshifting 9]

abilities.name: Beast's Bargain
abilities.info:
Strike a bargain through the seal: the beast answers one question it knows, or lends its element to an ally. Greatly improves the next action that uses what it gave. Spends 25 Hold.
[Skill: resolve 24]

abilities.name: Beast's Eye
abilities.info:
The beast looks out through your eyes and the lesser freeze. Strongly improves the next Resolve action that cows a foe. Spends 10 Hold.
[Skill: resolve 6]

abilities.name: Beast's Tail
abilities.info:
One tail of the beast's power lashes out. Strongly improves the next action that attacks with the beast's element. Spends 10 Hold.
[Skill: resolve 12]

abilities.name: Beast-Host Sense
abilities.info:
You feel the weight of a sealed beast in a person. Greatly improves the next action to recognise a beast host or a sealed object.
[Trait: The Vault Wardens: Warden]

abilities.name: Beast-King's Favour

[Skill: wildcraft 12]

abilities.name: Weather Sign
abilities.info:
Rain tomorrow. Improves the next Divination action about weather or travel. Spends 5 Soul.
[Skill: divination 3]

abilities.name: Weigh the Coin
abilities.info:
You know the true worth of coin, goods and promises. Greatly improves the next action to value, haggle over or spot a false item, coin or contract.
[Trait: The Saikai Merchant Guild: Counting-House Runner]

needs.variable: The Saikai Merchant Guild: Counting-House Runner

abilities.name: Welcome at the Edge
abilities.info:
Yokai places know half their own: a hidden path opens, a yokai court's servants answer, a forest stops rearranging itself. Improves the next action taken to enter or move through a yokai place.
[Trait: Half-Yokai]

abilities.name: Welcome Mastered
abilities.info:
Welcome at the Edge mastered: yokai read your blood before your face and treat you as kin. Improves the next Deception or Sensing action with a yokai.
[Trait: Half-Yokai: Mastered Art]

abilities.name: Well Master's Draught
abilities.info:
You drink from the wells and come back. Greatly improves the next Cursecraft action in a fight, at a cost the narrator names. Spends 18 Soul.
[Trait: The Grudge Well Sorcerers: Well Master]

needs.variable: The Grudge Well Sorcerers: Well Master

abilities.name: Well-Water Sense
abilities.info:
You feel a curse's flavour. Greatly improves the next action to identify a curse, its maker or its cure.
[Trait: The Grudge Well Sorcerers: Well Apprentice]

needs.variable: The Grudge Well Sorcerers: Well Apprentice

abilities.name: What They Took
abilities.info:
Fight with the borrowed parts that replaced yours. Improves the next action against a demon that holds a piece of you.
[Trait: Body-Traded]

abilities.name: Whetstone
abilities.info:
A dull blade made keen. Improves the next Forging action to sharpen.
[Skill: forging 3]

abilities.name: Whirling Blades
abilities.info:
Both blades spin into a circle of cuts that covers every side. Improves the next Blade action against foes on several sides.
[Skill: blade 12]

abilities.name: Whisper of Preferment
abilities.info:
You promise posts in the coming reign. Greatly improves the next action to win over an official or a lord with the hope of advancement.
[Trait: The Nephew's Banner: Hidetsugu's Officer]

abilities.name: Whispered Alliance
abilities.info:
A promise made in a corridor. Improves the next Intrigue action to win an ally.
[Skill: intrigue 12]

abilities.name: Whispered Blade
abilities.info:
A blade thrown on the wind that arrives without a sound. Strongly improves the next Hidden Arms action at range.
[Trait: Second Style: Wind]

abilities.name: Whistling Signal
abilities.info:
A humming arrow that carries an order across a battlefield. Strongly improves the next action that coordinates allies at range.
[Skill: archery 15]

abilities.name: White Breath
abilities.info:
Breathe frost that slows and numbs whatever it touches. Improves the next Soulcraft action that chills or slows. Spends 18 Soul.
[Trait: Snow-Blooded]

abilities.name: Wild Contract
abilities.info:
Bind a wild spirit no one else could. Greatly improves the next Summoning action. Spends 25 Soul.
[Trait: Wild Exorcist]

abilities.name: Will of the Isles
abilities.info:
The kind of will that ends wars. Greatly improves the next Resolve action, and those with you hold too.
[Skill: resolve 24]

abilities.name: Wind Step
abilities.info:
The air carries you a stride farther. Improves the next Soulcraft or Footwork action that moves you. Spends 5 Soul.
[Skill: soulcraft 6]

abilities.name: Wind-Carried Blades
abilities.info:
Thrown steel that curves on the wind around cover. Improves the next Hidden Arms action against a hidden target.
[Skill: hidden-arms 12]

abilities.name: Wind-Read Shot
abilities.info:
You read the wind across a valley. Strongly improves the next Archery action at extreme range.
[Skill: archery 18]

abilities.name: Wind-Step
abilities.info:
You move like a tengu on the wind. Greatly improves the next Footwork action in a fight or on high ground.
[Trait: The Tengu Court: Tengu Disciple]

abilities.name: Wire Snare
abilities.info:
A kunai thrown, the wire pulled: a limb bound, a blade turned. Improves the next Hidden Arms action that binds or disarms.
[Trait: Kunai and Wire]

abilities.name: Wire Trap
abilities.info:
String wire where they will run. Improves the next Hidden Arms action prepared in advance.
[Skill: hidden-arms 9]

abilities.name: Wood-Wise
abilities.info:
The Ayakashi Wood's paths stop leading you astray. Strongly improves the next Wildcraft action in a haunted wild.
[Skill: wildcraft 18]

abilities.name: Written Ward
abilities.info:
Write a talisman for a specific danger: it holds against that one thing. Improves the next Warding action against a named threat. Spends 18 Soul.
[Trait: Talisman Scribe]

abilities.name: Yokai Companion
abilities.info:
A lesser yokai agrees to walk with you. Strongly improves the next Beast-bond action with a yokai beast.
[Skill: beast-bond 18]

abilities.name: Yokai Manners
abilities.info:
Know which yokai want salt, which want silence, which want you gone. Improves the next Lore action about yokai.
[Skill: lore 6]

abilities.name: Yokai Retinue
abilities.info:
Yokai servants answer. Greatly improves the next action backed by yokai.
[Trait: Lord of the Wood]

abilities.name: Zero-Distance Fang
abilities.info:
The stance with no room at all: chest to chest, the upper body alone throws the thrust, and nothing that close can stop it. Greatly improves the next Blade action at grappling range.
[Skill: blade 24]

traits.name: Bare Fists
traits.info:
Wrapped hands and nothing else. Monks, wrestlers, oni-blooded brawlers: you are never disarmed, and nobody at a toll barrier takes your weapons away.

Gives: Open Hand +1; technique Open Palm (Bare fists, open palm: the blow lands where armour does not cover. Improves the next Open Hand action against an armoured foe); starts with Hand Wraps (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Oni-Blooded, Exorcist Monk, No Steel. Open hand, never disarmed.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Barred
traits.info: The barriers have your description. The post road, the ferries and every respectable door are closed to you.

traits.name: Beast Breath
traits.info:
A breath of the wild hunt: forms that harry a quarry and wear it down like a wolf pack. You can follow a demon's trail for days and strike only when it is too tired to turn. Beast hunters come back last, and they come back with the head.

Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +2, Tracking +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Harrying Form (Strike again and again at a wounded quarry. Improves the next attack against a foe you have already wounded).
Pairs well with: Steel, Earth, Chain-Sickle. Wearing a quarry down; a chain to hold it.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Blade Awakened
traits.info: Your blade's spirit stands beside you as an equal. Its second release is yours.

traits.name: Blade Named
traits.info: You have learned your blade's true name. It answers when you speak it.

traits.name: Blindfolded
traits.info:
You keep your eyes bound and see by Soul instead. The world comes to you as warmth, weight and intent, sharper than sight in a fight and useless for a letter. People speak more freely in front of a blind stranger. The vow: your eyes stay covered; you cannot read writing or see colour. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Spirit +2; Sensing +2; technique Sight Without Eyes (Feel every Soul in the room. Improves the next action against someone hidden or invisible).
Pairs well with: Veil Officer, Soul, Staff. Sensing replaces sight; a staff reads the ground.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Blossom Breath
traits.info:
A breath of grace: flowing, beautiful forms that read an enemy's rhythm and answer it. People stop to watch you fight, and so do demons, to their cost.

Gives: Will +1; Breathcraft +2, Artistry +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Petal Fall (Read the enemy's rhythm and cut between its beats. Improves the next Breathcraft action against a foe you have watched. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Steel, Wind, Naginata. Graceful sweeping forms with reach.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Body-Traded
traits.info:
Demons took pieces of you before you were born: an eye, a voice, a heartbeat. Something borrowed fills each gap, and it is not always on your side. Every piece you win back from the demon who holds it returns something of yourself.

Gives: Body +1; Stamina +2, Blade +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique What They Took (Fight with the borrowed parts that replaced yours. Improves the next action against a demon that holds a piece of you).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Retreat. Stamina and blade to win your pieces back.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Bonded Relic
traits.info:
A cursed object chose you: a comb, a sword guard, a doll. It will not leave, it protects you jealously, and it punishes anyone who touches you. Shrine keepers ask to see it and then ask you to leave.

Gives: Spirit +1; Cursecraft +2, Warding +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique The Relic Wakes (Let the relic's curse loose on whoever touches you. Improves the next action against someone who struck you).
Pairs well with: Soul, Earth, Talismans. Cursecraft and warding: the relic protects, paper holds it.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Bone Weave
traits.info:
Your bones can be shaped: grown into blades along the forearm, plates under the skin, a spear from the palm. It is horrifying to watch and painful to do. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Open Hand +1, Stamina +1; technique Bone Blade (A blade of bone slides from the forearm. Spends 10 Hold); technique Ossuary Armour (A full shell of bone covers you for a fight. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Bone Spurs (Open Hand 6), Marrow Blade (Open Hand 12, with Steel), Ribcage Shield (Open Hand 12), Spine Whip (Open Hand 18), Ossuary Garden (Open Hand 24).
Pairs well with: Oni-Blooded, Bare Fists, No Steel. Your bones are the weapon, so you need no steel.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Both Bloods Known
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: the Half-Yokai's change. Opens Court Stride, The Other Face Speaks, Kin-Call.

traits.name: Bound Spirit
traits.info: Your summon has fed on ten souls and is bound to you for good: it remembers you, comes faster and fights with more of itself.

traits.name: Bow
traits.info:
A tall asymmetric bow, laminated bamboo and wood, and a quiver of arrows. It fights from range, from the saddle, or from a rooftop. Horse archers of the plain draw it at a gallop.

Gives: Archery +1; technique Held Breath Shot (The bow drawn, breath held, the arrow loosed between heartbeats. Improves the next Archery action at a still or distant target); starts with Longbow (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: House Hiwada, Far Eye, Wind. Archery from range or the saddle.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Breath Hunter
traits.info:
Sworn to the hunter fortress in the north and trained to breathe in forms that push Soul through the body for one impossible movement. You cut demons with sun-forged steel, and the Hold expects you back at the wall every Demon Night.

Gives: Body +2, Will +1; Breathcraft +2, Blade +2, Stamina +1, Resolve +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique First Breath Form (Draw the breath your style is built on and move once faster than anything human should. Strongly improves the next Breathcraft or Blade action. Spends 25 Soul); technique Sun-Steel Cut (Your blade was forged in the light of the Hold's wall: a demon's wound from it does not close. Improves the next action that attacks a demon, and the wound stays); cantrip Measured Breath (One measured breath: the heart slows and the hands steady. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Stamina or Resolve action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Second Breath Form (Breathcraft 6), Night-Watch Breath (Breathcraft 12), Sunrise Ember Form (Breathcraft 12, with Fire), Breath Between Heartbeats (Breathcraft 18, with Still Eye), Dawn-Seeker Form (Breathcraft 18), Breath of the Wall (Breathcraft 24); starts with Hunter's Sun-Steel Tanto (Breathcraft +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Fire, Never Retreat. Breathcraft and blade cut demons, and Fire burns what sunlight cannot reach.

Primary Attribute: Body
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Breath Hunter: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Breath Hunter art, deepened. Level 10, after Breath Hunter. Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +1; technique Held Breath Form (First Breath Form deepened: the breath holds one movement longer than a body should).

traits.name: Breath Hunter: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Breath Hunter art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Will +1; Breathcraft +1; technique Sun-Steel Mastered (Sun-Steel Cut mastered: the cut carries daylight into the wound and a demon cannot close it).

traits.name: Breath Hunter: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Breath Hunter art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +2; technique Breath of Dawn (Perfected hunter's art: for a scene your breathing is the sun rising; demons falter and your body does not tire).

traits.name: Bridge of Two Worlds
traits.info: Humans and yokai both send envoys to you. You keep peace between them.

traits.name: Bureau Summoner
traits.info:
Trained at the Seimei Bureau in paper familiars and contracted spirits. You learned the Bureau's paper arts and hold a contract with at least one spirit. The Bureau's seal opens doors in the capital and closes them in the shrines.

Gives: Spirit +1; Summoning +3, Lore +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Contracted Spirit (Call the spirit you hold a contract with; it comes and serves for a scene. Improves the next Summoning action. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Earth. Summoning through paper; Earth keeps the circle.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Can't Back Down
traits.info:
A challenge is a debt you have to pay at once. You have fought men twice your size and won; you have also lost. Your friends have learned to stand between you and any loud stranger.

Gives: Might +1.
Pairs well with: Oni-Blooded, Never Retreat. A temper that answers every challenge.

traits.name: Cat-Blooded
traits.info:
A cat parent: night eyes, silent feet, a split tail some days, and the dead's fondness. You see in the dark, land on your feet and hear the dead. Cats follow you, and some of them are not cats.

Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +2, Footwork +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Nine Lives' Luck (Land on your feet from a fall or a blow that should have finished you. Improves the next action taken to escape harm); resists curse; weak to piercing.
Pairs well with: Shadow, Void, Kunai and Wire. Night eyes and silent feet; resists curses, weak to points.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Chain-Sickle
traits.info:
A sickle on a weighted chain: the weight entangles, the blade finishes. It disarms swordsmen and frightens horses, and it takes years to swing without hurting yourself.

Gives: Hidden Arms +1; technique Chain Catch (The chain-sickle's weight wraps a weapon or a leg and the sickle follows. Improves the next Hidden Arms action that entangles); starts with Chain-Sickle (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Pursuit Division, Shadow. Entangle and finish.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Coin-Hungry
traits.info:
You count every mon and you never have enough. Bargains find you, and so do schemes that seemed clever at the time. Merchants respect you, which worries your friends.

Gives: Artifice +1.
Pairs well with: Merchant's Child, Gambler of Saikai. A head for profit that sometimes outruns sense.

traits.name: Court Diviner
traits.info: The Bureau's diviner at court: the capital's wards and the regent's stars are yours to read.

traits.name: Curse Embraced
traits.info: You stopped fighting it. The curse feeds on grudges and you feed it.

traits.name: Curse Mastered
traits.info: The curse obeys you now. You turn it against other curses.

traits.name: Curse-Bearer
traits.info:
You carry a curse, or a grudge given shape, and you have learned to use what is killing you. Your Soul is sour with it, and it answers when you call.

Gives: Will +2, Spirit +1; Cursecraft +2, Resolve +2, Lore +1, Deception +1; Soul +10 (maximum and starting); technique Pass It On (Take a curse, a poison or a wound's sickness from another into yourself, where you can carry it. Improves the next Cursecraft or Resolve action that bears a burden for someone else. Spends 25 Soul); technique Grudge Given Shape (Name someone who wronged you or yours and lay a curse of ill luck on them: their next important act goes wrong. Improves the next Cursecraft action aimed at a named person. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Sour Touch (A touch leaves a day of small bad luck: a snapped strap, a slipped cup. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Cursecraft or Deception action, never a strike or a wound); unlocks as you train: Bitter Shield (Cursecraft 6), Curse Fed to the Beast (Cursecraft 12, with Sealed Great Beast), Empty Curse (Cursecraft 12, with Void), Grudge Mark (Cursecraft 12), Curse Off the Leash (Cursecraft 18), The Grudge of a Hundred Years (Cursecraft 24); starts with Bound Relic (Cursecraft +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Soul, Void, Talismans, Untouchable. Cursecraft and resolve suit Soul; Void and paper carry a curse well.

Primary Attribute: Will
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Curse-Bearer: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Curse-Bearer art, deepened. Level 10, after Curse-Bearer. Gives: Will +1; Cursecraft +1; technique Pass It On Deepened (Pass It On deepened: the curse leaps from your touch and lingers a day longer).

traits.name: Curse-Bearer: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Curse-Bearer art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Spirit +1; Cursecraft +1; technique Grudge Given Teeth (Grudge Given Shape mastered: the shape has a mouth now, and it bites what you hate).

traits.name: Curse-Bearer: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Curse-Bearer art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Will +1; Cursecraft +2; technique The Curse Serves (Perfected curse-bearer's art: for a scene what is killing you fights for you instead).

traits.name: Curse-Breaker
traits.info: You break curses no one else could, even old ones.

traits.name: Curse-Hunter
traits.info:
You carry a curse so that you can taste others, and you hunt the people who lay them. Shrines hire you, curse-layers know your face, and the Brotherhood keeps your name on its rolls.

Gives: Guile +1; Tracking +2, Cursecraft +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Taste of the Curse (Follow a curse back to whoever laid it. Improves the next action that traces or breaks a curse).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Void, Chain-Sickle. Tracking and cursecraft hunt the curse-layer down.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Cut-Cord
traits.info:
A deserter who cut the village's cord and runs with its secrets. The village's hunters are somewhere behind you. You burned off the village mark and live on what you took with you: techniques, names, a map of the hidden paths. Every shinobi stranger might be a hunter.

Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +2, Streetwise +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Nobody's Shinobi (No village, no mark, no pattern: you fight in no style they have trained against. Improves the next action against a village-trained shinobi).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Outcast, Umbrella Blade. A deserter lives by stealth and streetwise; a hidden blade passes every barrier.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Dangerous Air
traits.info:
Something in how you stand makes people step aside. Thugs pick other targets; officials pick their words carefully. You did not ask for it, and it rarely helps you make friends.

Gives: Command +1.
Pairs well with: Ronin, Outcast. A presence that ends arguments early.

traits.name: Deep Well
traits.info: Hours of still breathing at a shrine or a forge until the Soul runs deeper than it did. Any character, level 10 or higher. Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +1.

traits.name: Demon's Bane
traits.info: Demons tell stories about you in the dark. Their lord has sent for your head.

traits.name: Devoted Heart
traits.info:
When you love someone you commit fully and for good. You are steady, sincere and built for the long road, not the passing night.

Gives: Resolve +1.
Pairs well with: Sworn to One Master, Samurai. Loyalty given once and kept.

traits.name: Disgraced Retainer
traits.info:
You were dismissed in shame, rightly or not. Your old house remembers and so do you. You know exactly what you did, or exactly what was done to you. Either way the old house's samurai will not drink with you, and some would duel you on sight.

Gives: Will +1; Blade +2, Resolve +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Nothing Left to Lose Face (Shame has already happened to you: you do the thing a samurai would not. Improves the next action that breaks etiquette or honour to win).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Retreat. Resolve and blade, and a name to win back.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Division Commander
traits.info: You command a whole division. Its officers and its secrets are yours.

traits.name: Double Strike
traits.info:
A temple breaker's art: two impacts in one blow, the second landing an instant after the first while the target is still braced against it, so it breaks what the first only struck. Its users carry a sword and rarely draw it.

Gives: Open Hand +1; technique Two in One (A punch that lands twice: the second impact breaks what the first braced. Improves the next Open Hand action against armour or stone); technique Hilt Breaker (The same art through a sword's hilt or pommel, without drawing. Improves the next Open Hand action made while wearing a sheathed blade); unlocks as you train: Through the Guard (Open Hand 6), Breaking the Stone (Open Hand 12), Two-Handed Double (Open Hand 18), The Strike Without a Fist (Open Hand 24).
Pairs well with: Bare Fists, Ronin, Steel. Open-hand and might: bare fists for the art, a ronin's sword for when it is not enough.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Dragon Vein
traits.info:
A vein of a dragon's Soul runs in you: a deep well of power, scales that rise under stress, a roar in the chest. Rain follows your temper. Shrines bow and lords want you. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Soulcraft +1, Stamina +1; technique Dragon's Breath (Breathe out your Soul as raw force. Spends 10 Hold); technique Dragon Ascendant (Scales cover you and your Soul floods every technique for a fight. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Dragon Scales (Soulcraft 6), Rain Calling (Soulcraft 12), Storm-Blooded Change (Shapeshifting 12, with Half-Yokai), Dragon's Roar (Soulcraft 18), Dragon's Well (Soulcraft 24).
Pairs well with: Dragon-Blooded, Water, Soul. A dragon's Soul and rain.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Dragon-Blooded
traits.info:
A dragon parent, rare as rain in drought: scales at the wrists, a pearl's luck, and power over water. Rain comes when you call it, and luck follows you like the pearl in a dragon's claw. Shrines bow and lords want you.

Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +2, Lore +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Rain Called (Call rain or still it for a scene. Improves the next Soulcraft action that works through water or weather. Spends 18 Soul); resists slashing; weak to piercing.
Pairs well with: Soul, Water, Dragon Vein. Rain and a pearl's luck through Soul; resists cuts, weak to points.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Duty Before Heart
traits.info:
Your duty comes first and your heart knows it. You love, but you would leave a lover at the gate if your oath called. It is the hardest thing about you, and the most honest.

Gives: Command +1.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Veil Officer. An oath that outranks longing.

traits.name: Earth
traits.info:
Your Soul is earth: heavy, slow to move, impossible to move once it does. Earth resists earth and fears the wind that wears it down.

Gives: Soulcraft +1; technique Stone Rises (The ground answers: a wall, a pillar, a fist of stone. Improves the next Soulcraft action that shapes the earth. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Pebble Weight (A stone grows heavy or light in the hand; a footing firms underfoot. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Soulcraft or Stamina action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Stone Skin (Soulcraft 6), Mountain Body (Open Hand 12, with Giant's Frame), Shifting Ground (Soulcraft 12), Mountain Spire (Soulcraft 18), The Isle Stands Up (Soulcraft 24); resists earth; weak to wind.
Pairs well with: Stone Breath, Talisman Scribe, Iron Skin. Heavy and holding; weak to Wind, so keep Fire friends close.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Easy Smile
traits.info:
Strangers relax around you without knowing why. Innkeepers give you the better room, and children tell you secrets. It is a gift, and you have learned to use it.

Gives: Streetwise +1.
Pairs well with: Peasant, Merchant's Child. A face the street trusts.

traits.name: Ember Breath
traits.info:
A breath that burns: forms of cutting fire pushed down the blade. Your chest burns when you fight, and your cuts leave the smell of a forge. Ember hunters are the Hold's front line.

Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +2, Blade +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Ember Arc (A cut trailing fire that keeps burning in the wound. Improves the next Breathcraft attack. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Steel, Fire, Katana. Fire breath down a sword.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Ember Edge
traits.info:
A heretic Tetsuyama school: the blade is notched like a saw and carries the oil and fat of what it has cut, and the friction of a fast cut lights it. Smiths call it a crime against steel; its users burn what they cut.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Spark Drag (Drags the notched edge along stone to throw sparks into the foe's eyes. Improves the next Blade action after blinding a foe); technique Kindled Cut (A fast cut whose friction lights the oil in the notches: the wound burns. Improves the next Blade action against a foe weak to fire); unlocks as you train: Burning Arc (Blade 6), Flame Through the Gap (Blade 12), Ember Wall (Blade 18), The Crimson Lotus (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Fire, Katana, Steel. Fire and a blade: the notched edge carries the flame the Element feeds.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Exile King
traits.info: A court of exiles and renegades gathers around you among the living.

traits.name: Exiled Officer
traits.info:
Cast out of the court for a crime you did or did not commit. You keep the powers; the court wants them back. You were cast out with your powers still in you, and the Pursuit Division has your name. Among the living you have found people worth protecting.

Gives: Guile +1; Deception +2, Soulcraft +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Outside the Law (The court's rules do not bind you any more: break one in the open. Improves the next action that uses an officer's power on the living).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Katana, Outcast. Deception keeps you ahead of the Pursuit Division.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Exorcist Monk
traits.info:
A temple monk trained to drive out possessing spirits with sutra, staff and fist. You fast before an exorcism and fight like a wrestler during one. The possessed scream when you come through the door.

Gives: Will +1; Warding +2, Open Hand +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Sutra Strike (A sutra spoken into a blow: it strikes the spirit inside, not the body. Improves the next action against a possessing or masked spirit).
Pairs well with: Soul, Bare Fists, No Steel. Warding and open hand: fist and sutra, no metal needed.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Fang Thrust
traits.info:
A one-handed charging thrust from a crouched stance, the off hand aimed along the blade like a bowstring. Watchmen and police captains of the capital swear by it; it has one idea, and the idea goes through armour.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Level Fang (The basic charge: a level one-handed thrust from the crouch. Improves the next Blade action that charges a single foe); technique Aim Along the Hand (Sights along the off hand before the lunge and does not miss. Improves the next Blade action that thrusts at a weak point); unlocks as you train: Rising Fang (Blade 6), Downward Fang (Blade 12), Through the Second Man (Blade 18), Zero-Distance Fang (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Spear, Steel. The thrust is a spear's idea in a sword: Steel carries the charge.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Far Eye
traits.info:
An eye that sees through walls, across valleys and into the flow of Soul in a body. The iris pales to frost when it opens. Shinobi clans prize it above gold. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Sensing +1, Tracking +1; technique Far Glance (See through a wall, across a valley or into a body's Soul for a breath. Spends 10 Hold); technique Eye of the Whole Field (For a scene, nothing within a hundred paces is hidden from you. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Soul Map (Sensing 6), Marked From Afar (Sensing 12), Seal Through the Eye (Sealwork 12, with Shinobi), Sight Shared (Sensing 18), The Eye of the Isles (Sensing 24).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Bow, Pursuit Division. Sensing and tracking at range.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Ferry Division
traits.info:
The court's ferrymen: you escort the dead from where they fell to the gate. You have walked thousands of the dead to the gate and know every way a soul clings on. You are patient with grief and impatient with the living who prolong it.

Gives: Will +1; Sensing +2, Resolve +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Last Crossing (Walk a dead soul to the gate, whatever holds it back. Improves the next action that frees a lingering soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Void, Blindfolded. Sensing and resolve walk the dead home; a blindfold sees them clearer.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Fiercely Protective
traits.info:
Hurt someone you love and you will not stop. You stand between your people and danger without thinking. Your friends feel safe with you, and your enemies learn whom not to touch.

Gives: Might +1.
Pairs well with: Never Retreat, Iron Skin. A body put in harm's way for others.

traits.name: Fire
traits.info:
Your Soul is fire: fast, hungry, beautiful and hard to stop once lit. Fire resists fire and fears the water that drowns it.

Gives: Soulcraft +1; technique Kindled Hand (Fire leaps from the hand or the blade. Improves the next Soulcraft action that burns. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Candle Finger (A flame on the fingertip: light to read by, warmth, a pipe lit. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Soulcraft or Awareness action in the dark, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Ember Lash (Soulcraft 6), Burning Ground (Soulcraft 12), Burning Name (Blade 12, with Named Soul-Blade), Funeral Pyre Rite (Soulcraft 12, with Veil Officer), Mask of Cinders (Resolve 12, with Inner Mask), Sunrise Ember Form (Breathcraft 12, with Breath Hunter), Ring of Embers (Soulcraft 18), Pyre of Heaven (Soulcraft 24); resists fire; weak to water.
Pairs well with: Ember Breath, Fox-Blooded, Shrine Maiden. Fast and burning; weak to Water.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Foreign Pistol
traits.info:
A foreign flintlock bought in Saikai: loud, slow, frightening and lethal at close range. One shot, then a long reload. Samurai call it dishonourable and then flinch at the sound.

Gives: Streetwise +1; technique Pistol Crack (The foreign pistol fires once, loud enough to stop a room. Improves the next Streetwise action to frighten or scatter); starts with Foreign Pistol (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Foreigner of the Port, Merchant's Child, Shadow. Streetwise from the port; one loud shot.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Foreigner of the Port
traits.info:
Born to a foreign sailor or trader in Saikai, or off a foreign ship. You speak two tongues and know the harbours. In Saikai nobody looks twice; in the capital everybody does, and toll clerks check your papers slowly.

Gives: Seafaring +1, Streetwise +1; starts with Foreign Coin.
Pairs well with: Ronin, House Mizuchi, Foreign Pistol. Seafaring and streetwise; the port's weapon.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Forgettable Face
traits.info:
Nobody remembers you clearly, which has saved your life twice. Guards look past you and witnesses describe someone else. It is lonely, and very useful.

Gives: Stealth +1.
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Shadow. A face made for slipping away.

traits.name: Fox-Blooded
traits.info:
A fox parent: clever, illusory, fond of fire. You see through illusions, cast your own, and like fire. Fox shrines watch over you, and expect favours back.

Gives: Guile +1; Shapeshifting +2, Deception +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Fox-Fire Glamour (Pale fire and a false image: they see what you want them to. Improves the next Shapeshifting or Deception action. Spends 18 Soul); resists curse; weak to bludgeoning.
Pairs well with: Soul, Fire, Fox-Fire Kindled. Fox illusions and fox-fire; resists curses, weak to blunt blows.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Fox-Fire Kindled
traits.info:
Pale blue fox-fire answers you, though no fox in your family will admit it. It lights the dark, lies to the eye, and in a storm it burns. Fox shrines notice you. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Soulcraft +1, Deception +1; technique Fox Lights (Pale lights that lead, confuse or burn a spirit. Spends 10 Hold); technique Fox-Fire Storm (A storm of blue fire that burns away illusions, spirits and masks. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Fox-Fire Brand (Soulcraft 6), Burning Illusion (Soulcraft 12), Fox-Fire Talisman (Warding 12, with Onmyoji), Foxfire Procession (Soulcraft 18), Nine Tails of Flame (Soulcraft 24).
Pairs well with: Fox-Blooded, Fire, Shadow. Lights and lies.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Free Spirit
traits.info:
You love freely and leave lightly, and you never pretend otherwise. The road matters to you as much as any person. Nobody owns you, and you have never asked to own anyone.

Gives: Wildcraft +1.
Pairs well with: Ronin, The Cheerful Wanderer. A heart that travels.

traits.name: Gale Breath
traits.info:
A breath that rushes: forms of speed and wind that close a courtyard in a heartbeat. You are there before your sound. Gale hunters scout ahead of every hunt.

Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +2, Footwork +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Gale Rush (Close any distance in a breath. Improves the next Footwork or Breathcraft action that closes on a foe. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Steel, Wind, Katana. Speed: Wind and a light blade.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Gambler of Saikai
traits.info:
You grew up in the gambling halls of the free port and you play for blood as easily as for mon. You learned the odds in the free port's halls and cheated in all of them. You owe money to someone dangerous and someone dangerous owes it to you.

Gives: Guile +1; Streetwise +2, Deception +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Loaded Dice (Bet on yourself and cheat to win: the odds turn your way once. Improves the next action taken on a wager or a bluff).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Umbrella Blade, Foreigner of the Port. Deception and streetwise from the free port's halls.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Gambler's Itch
traits.info:
Dice, cards, bets on a duel: you cannot walk past a game. You win often enough to keep going and lose often enough to keep moving.

Gives: Streetwise +1.
Pairs well with: Gambler of Saikai, Merchant's Child. Luck you keep testing.

traits.name: Gate Guard
traits.info:
The guards of the great torii at Veilgate, who keep the living out and the dead in. You have stood at the great torii for years and stopped things that tried to come back through it. You know the gate's moods as well as your own.

Gives: Will +1; Warding +2, Blade +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique None Shall Cross (Hold a threshold, gate or doorway against anything that would pass. Improves the next action that holds a passage).
Pairs well with: Steel, Spear, Never Retreat. Warding and blade hold the torii; reach and a vow to stand.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Ghost of the Range
traits.info: The mountains themselves hide you. You are a story told to young shinobi to frighten them.

traits.name: Giant's Frame
traits.info:
You can swell to twice your size for a while, and your strength with it: doorways become a problem and walls stop being one. Your clothes rarely survive. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Open Hand +2; technique Swell (One limb or the whole body grows for a strike. Spends 10 Hold); technique Twice the Size (For a fight you are a giant: strength, reach and target. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Giant's Grip (Open Hand 6), Earth-Shaking Stomp (Open Hand 12), Mountain Body (Open Hand 12, with Earth), Castle-Breaker (Open Hand 18), Shoulder the Gate (Open Hand 24).
Pairs well with: Oni-Blooded, Bare Fists, Steel. Size and open hands.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Great Familiar
traits.info: Sixty souls: your summon is a great familiar now, feared by lesser spirits and fit to fight beside a master in a real battle.

traits.name: Grown Familiar
traits.info: Thirty souls: your summon has grown into a true familiar, bigger and cleverer, with a power of its own drawn from what it ate.

traits.name: Grudge Sovereign
traits.info: Every grudge in the isles is a thread in your hand.

traits.name: Grudge-Born
traits.info:
You were born from a grudge: a mother's dying curse, a battlefield's hatred. You feel other people's hate as heat on your skin, and you always know who in a room wants someone dead. The dead of the Blight turn to watch you pass.

Gives: Spirit +1; Sensing +2, Cursecraft +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Feel the Hatred (Sense who in the room hates whom, and how much. Improves the next action that reads or turns someone's hatred).
Pairs well with: Soul, Void, Talismans. Sensing hate; Void sharpens it.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Grudge-Keeper
traits.info:
You never forget a wrong and you keep a list. It makes you hard to cross and harder to make peace with. Old enemies cross the street when they see you coming.

Gives: Tracking +1.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Last Heir of a Fallen House. A memory that keeps accounts.

traits.name: Half-Yokai
traits.info:
One of your parents was not human. You carry the other side's blood: its senses, its gift for changing shape, and its hunger, and you belong fully to neither world.

Gives: Spirit +2, Body +1; Shapeshifting +2, Sensing +2, Footwork +1, Stamina +1; Soul +10 (maximum and starting); technique The Other Side Shows (Let the yokai blood come up all at once: eyes, teeth, ears, the body's strength and speed. Improves the next Body action, and everyone in the scene sees what you are); technique Welcome at the Edge (Yokai places know half their own: a hidden path opens, a yokai court's servants answer, a forest stops rearranging itself. Improves the next action taken to enter or move through a yokai place); cantrip Small Change (Ears, eyes, a tooth: one small feature slips to the other side and back. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Shapeshifting or Deception action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Borrowed Senses (Shapeshifting 6), Half-Change (Shapeshifting 12), Storm-Blooded Change (Shapeshifting 12, with Dragon Vein), Other Parent's Shape (Shapeshifting 18), Both Worlds at Once (Shapeshifting 24); starts with Token of the Other Parent (Shapeshifting +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Soul, Fox-Fire Kindled, Bare Fists, Outcast. Your shapeshifting and senses suit Soul; most half-yokai grow up outside the order.

Primary Attribute: Spirit
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Half-Yokai: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Half-Yokai art, deepened. Level 10, after Half-Yokai. Gives: Spirit +1; Shapeshifting +1; technique The Other Side Deepened (The Other Side Shows deepened: the change comes faster and holds under pain).

traits.name: Half-Yokai: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Half-Yokai art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Body +1; Shapeshifting +1; technique Welcome Mastered (Welcome at the Edge mastered: yokai read your blood before your face and treat you as kin).

traits.name: Half-Yokai: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Half-Yokai art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Spirit +1; Shapeshifting +2; technique Both Bloods Awake (Perfected half-yokai art: for a scene both sides of you fight at once, human cunning and yokai strength).

traits.name: Hard Drinker
traits.info:
Sake makes the nights shorter and the memories quieter. You can drink anyone under the table, and you sometimes wake up somewhere new.

Gives: Stamina +1.
Pairs well with: Ronin, Rough Edges. A hard road eased by a cup.

traits.name: Hardened Body
traits.info: Roadwork, cold water and long days under a pack until the body stops complaining. Any character, level 10 or higher. Gives: Body +1; Stamina +1.

traits.name: Hatamoto Retainer
traits.info:
A sworn bannerman of the regent, owing service directly to the castle and outranking house retainers. You serve the regent directly and outrank house samurai who are older and better born. You are trusted with errands nobody else may know about.

Gives: Guile +1; Intrigue +2, Blade +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique By the Regent's Order (Invoke the regent's authority: officials comply, guards step aside, until someone checks. Improves the next Intrigue action with officials).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Katana, Sworn to One Master. The regent's errand-runner: intrigue, a blade and one master.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Haunted
traits.info:
Something from your past follows you: a face in dreams, a voice at the edge of hearing. It makes you watchful and it makes you tired.

Gives: Sensing +1.
Pairs well with: Curse-Bearer, Vessel of a Cursed Spirit. A ghost that sharpens the senses.

traits.name: Hayate Village: Gale Captain
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in Hayate Village: Gale Captain.

traits.name: Hayate Village: Storm Elite
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in Hayate Village: Storm Elite.

traits.name: Hayate Village: The Wind Head's Hand
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in Hayate Village: The Wind Head's Hand.

traits.name: Hayate Village: Wind Apprentice
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in Hayate Village: Wind Apprentice.

traits.name: Hayate Village: Wind Runner
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Hayate Village: Wind Runner.

traits.name: Healer's Gift
traits.info: Blood or training lets your Soul close wounds: healing techniques answer to you.

traits.name: Healing Division
traits.info:
The court's healers, who mend soul-bodies and the living alike and are not supposed to do the second. Your division mends officers that other divisions break, and you have bent the rule about the living more than once. The court keeps a count.

Gives: Spirit +1; Medicine +3, Soulcraft +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Soul Mending (Lay hands on a wound and close it with Soul. Improves the next Medicine action).
Pairs well with: Soul, Water, No Killing. Medicine and soulcraft mend; a healer who will not kill is trusted.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Hero of the Isles
traits.info: The isles tell stories about you.

traits.name: Hostage-Ward
traits.info:
Raised in another house as a hostage for your family's good behaviour. You grew up polite, watched and useful. You know two houses from the inside, and both of them think you belong to the other.

Gives: Intrigue +1, Resolve +1; starts with Ward's Token.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Hatamoto Retainer, Never Lie. Intrigue and resolve between two houses.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: House Champion
traits.info: The house's living legend. Its banners rally to you before they rally to the lord.

traits.name: House Hiwada
traits.info:
A house of mounted archers from the plains, the oldest martial line in the isles. You rode before you walked and shot before you wrote. Your house is the oldest and poorest of the great houses and minds both.

Gives: Will +1; Archery +2, Horsemanship +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Arrow from the Saddle (Loose at full gallop and hit. Improves the next Archery action made while mounted or moving).
Pairs well with: Steel, Bow, Wind. Mounted archers: the Bow and a fast Wind Soul.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: House Hiwada: Arrow Captain
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in House Hiwada: Arrow Captain.

traits.name: House Hiwada: Banner Rider
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in House Hiwada: Banner Rider.

traits.name: House Hiwada: Groom
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in House Hiwada: Groom.

traits.name: House Hiwada: Outrider
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in House Hiwada: Outrider.

traits.name: House Hiwada: The Sun-Arrow Lord's Hand
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in House Hiwada: The Sun-Arrow Lord's Hand.

traits.name: House Kurogane
traits.info:
A house of heavy armour and long blades that holds the passes north of the capital. You learned to fight in armour that would crush a lesser frame and to hold a pass with a handful of men. Your house is loyal, slow, and not forgiving.

Gives: Body +1; Blade +2, Stamina +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Iron Wall (Plant your feet and take the blow on the armour. Improves the next action that holds ground or protects someone behind you).
Pairs well with: Steel, Odachi, Earth. Heavy armour and long blades; Earth holds a pass.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: House Kurogane: Forge Captain
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in House Kurogane: Forge Captain.

traits.name: House Kurogane: Iron Hatamoto
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in House Kurogane: Iron Hatamoto.

traits.name: House Kurogane: Iron Retainer
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in House Kurogane: Iron Retainer.

traits.name: House Kurogane: Ironclad
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in House Kurogane: Ironclad.

traits.name: House Kurogane: The Black Iron Lord's Hand
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in House Kurogane: The Black Iron Lord's Hand.

traits.name: House Mizuchi
traits.info:
A sea house with a fleet, an island fortress and the right to tax the straits. You grew up on decks and island walls, with the right to stop any ship in the straits. Landsmen call your house pirates with a charter.

Gives: Will +1; Seafaring +3, Blade +1; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Deck-Footed (Fight as if the deck is solid ground and the enemy's is not. Improves the next action taken on a ship, a pier or in water).
Pairs well with: Steel, Water, Spear. A sea house fights on decks with reach.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: House Mizuchi: Boarding Spear
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in House Mizuchi: Boarding Spear.

traits.name: House Mizuchi: Captain of the River-Dragon
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in House Mizuchi: Captain of the River-Dragon.

traits.name: House Mizuchi: Deckhand Retainer
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in House Mizuchi: Deckhand Retainer.

traits.name: House Mizuchi: Ship's Officer
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in House Mizuchi: Ship's Officer.

traits.name: House Mizuchi: The Admiral's Right Hand
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in House Mizuchi: The Admiral's Right Hand.

traits.name: House Secret Cut
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: the Samurai's change. Opens Guard of the House, The Secret Cut, The Cut Unspoken.

traits.name: House Takamori
traits.info:
The regent's own house, masters of the draw-cut, closest to power and most hated for it. You were trained in the castle's own dojo beside the regent's sons. Your name opens doors, and your enemies are the regent's enemies whether you chose them or not.
