Gives: Body +1; Blade +2, Intrigue +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Takamori Draw (The house's draw-cut, taught only to its blood: a cut and a sheathing in one motion. Improves the next Blade action made from the scabbard).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Noble. The draw-cut house: a katana and a court name.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: House Takamori: Banner Officer
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in House Takamori: Banner Officer.

traits.name: House Takamori: Hatamoto
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in House Takamori: Hatamoto.

traits.name: House Takamori: Retainer
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in House Takamori: Retainer.

traits.name: House Takamori: Sworn Sword
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in House Takamori: Sworn Sword.

traits.name: House Takamori: The Regent's Blade
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in House Takamori: The Regent's Blade.

traits.name: Human Heart
traits.info: You mastered the blood instead of it mastering you. People trust you, and the yokai side answers when you call it.

traits.name: Hundred-Duel Seeker
traits.info:
You have sworn to fight a hundred duels against masters. You have a count and you know who is next. You carry a list of masters and their schools and you are working down it. Every dojo in the isles has heard of you, and few of them want you at the door.

Gives: Body +1; Blade +3, Lore +1; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Read the Master (Watch one exchange and see the school: where it is strong and where it opens. Improves the next Blade action against a trained swordsman).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Draw First. Pure blade skill; duels are won on the answer.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Inherited Curse
traits.info:
A curse on your family for something an ancestor did. It took your parents; it is waiting for you. An ancestor's crime cursed your blood, and it has taken your family one by one. You have learned to turn it, and you are looking for the end of it.

Gives: Will +1; Cursecraft +2, Lore +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Blood Remembers (The family curse answers its own blood: turn it outward once. Improves the next Cursecraft action. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Void, Talismans. Cursecraft and lore; Void carries the family's curse.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Inner Mask
traits.info:
Something hungry and masked lives inside you, the kind of thing Veil Officers kill. You can put on its mask: half for strength, whole for something worse. Every officer who sees it will want to know why you are alive. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Soulcraft +1, Resolve +1; technique Half Mask (Pull half the mask over your face and the hunger lends its strength. Spends 10 Hold); technique Full Mask (Put on the whole mask and let the hungry thing fight with your body. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Hunger Held (Resolve 6), Mask Cry (Resolve 12), Mask of Cinders (Resolve 12, with Fire), Two Powers Answer (Blade 12, with Veil Officer), Hunger's Breath (Resolve 18), The Mask Turned Inside Out (Resolve 18, with Void), The Mask Answers to Me (Resolve 24).
Pairs well with: Veil Officer, Void, Katana. The hungry thing officers hunt, worn by one of them.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Iron Skin
traits.info:
Your skin hardens like tempered steel when you will it, greying from the heart outwards. Blades skid, arrows snap, and you feel every blow as a dull bell. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Stamina +2; technique Tempered Skin (Harden against one blow; the edge skids off. Spends 10 Hold); technique Iron Body (For a fight, blades and fists barely mark you. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Iron Grip (Stamina 6), Bell-Ring Body (Stamina 12), Scars of the Road (Stamina 12, with Ronin), Unbreaking Wall (Stamina 18), Iron Shelter (Stamina 24).
Pairs well with: Steel, Earth, Never Retreat. Stand and take it.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.info: Fasts, vigils and refusals: the habit of not giving way when every part of you wants to. Any character, level 10 or higher. Gives: Will +1; Resolve +1.

traits.name: Kagegi Village: Shadow Apprentice
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in Kagegi Village: Shadow Apprentice.

traits.name: Kagegi Village: Shadow Captain
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in Kagegi Village: Shadow Captain.

traits.name: Kagegi Village: Shadow Elite
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in Kagegi Village: Shadow Elite.

traits.name: Kagegi Village: Shadow Runner
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Kagegi Village: Shadow Runner.

traits.name: Kagegi Village: The Shadow Head's Hand
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in Kagegi Village: The Shadow Head's Hand.

traits.name: Kappa-Blooded
traits.info:
A kappa parent: a river spirit's strength in water and its fondness for wrestling. You swim like a fish and wrestle like a bear. You must keep yourself wet, and river folk leave you cucumbers.

Gives: Body +1; Seafaring +2, Open Hand +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique River Grip (In water you are faster and stronger than anything on land. Improves the next action taken in or under water); resists bludgeoning; weak to slashing.
Pairs well with: Steel, Water, Bare Fists. A river wrestler; resists blunt blows, weak to cuts.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Karakuri Clan
traits.info:
A Kagegi clan of puppeteers who fight through dolls of lacquer, steel and hidden blades moved by threads of Soul. You learned joinery, lacquer and wire before you learned to fight, and your hands are always busy. A broken puppet is a grief to you.

Gives: Guile +1; Puppetry +3, Forging +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Lacquered Second (Your fighting puppet unfolds from its case and fights beside you, blades in its arms. Improves the next Puppetry action. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Puppet, Earth. A puppeteer clan needs the Puppet arm; Soul strings it.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Katana
traits.info:
A curved single-edged sword, the samurai's soul: fast from the scabbard, deadly in the first cut. Every school in the isles teaches it, and every samurai judges you by how you wear it.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Answering Draw (The katana clears the scabbard and cuts in one motion. Improves the next Blade action made as a first or an answering cut); starts with Katana (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Steel, Never Draw First. Blade skill; under the vow the fast draw becomes the answering cut.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Kazakiri Clan
traits.info:
A Hayate clan that cuts with the wind: blades of air thrown from the hand or the edge of a fan. You learned to read the wind in grass and smoke before a fight. Hayate expects you to hate Kagegi, and Kagegi expects you to try.

Gives: Body +1; Soulcraft +2, Hidden Arms +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Gale Edge (A crescent of cutting wind leaves your hand or fan and strikes at range. Improves the next Soulcraft or Hidden Arms attack at range. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Wind, War Fans. Wind-blades thrown from a fan are the clan's whole art.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.info: Markets, courts and bad inns: the habit of seeing the knife, the lie and the exit first. Any character, level 10 or higher. Gives: Guile +1; Awareness +1.

traits.name: Keeper of the Gate
traits.info: The great torii answers to you. Life and death in the isles bend to your judgement.

traits.name: Keeper of the Wall
traits.info: You keep the Hold's wall among its greatest hunters, with students of your own.

traits.name: Keeper of Tomoshibi
traits.info: You relit Tomoshibi's lamp. The island is yours in every way that matters, and the strait knows it.

traits.name: Kill on Sight
traits.info: There is a price on your head in every province. Guards attack on sight and bounty hunters follow you.

traits.name: Killing Edge
traits.info: The sharpest sword for hire in the isles. Your price is high and you are worth it.

traits.name: Kirisame Clan
traits.info:
The marsh clan of rain and poison, outside both villages, owed by every town on the coast. You learned poison and patience in the reeds, outside both villages' law. The marsh towns owe your clan, and so do people in the capital who would deny it.

Gives: Guile +1; Hidden Arms +2, Medicine +1, Stealth +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Poisoned Rain (A fine rain of Soul-carried poison drifts over a small area and seeps into skin. Improves the next action that poisons or weakens an enemy).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Water, Kunai and Wire. Rain and poison: Water carries it, a thrown blade delivers it.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Known Blade
traits.info: Your name is known in the district: people have heard what you did.

traits.name: Kunai and Wire
traits.info:
Throwing knives and steel wire: thrown, strung, snapped tight across a doorway in the dark. The shinobi's tools, light enough to hide and unfair enough to matter.

Gives: Hidden Arms +1; technique Wire Snare (A kunai thrown, the wire pulled: a limb bound, a blade turned. Improves the next Hidden Arms action that binds or disarms); starts with Kunai and Wire (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Shadow, Kirisame Clan. Hidden arms from the dark.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Kurobane Clan
traits.info:
A Kagegi clan that binds with its own shadow: a shadow stretched across the floor holds whoever it touches. You learned to stand still for hours and to read where the light will fall. The clan's elders decide who you may marry, and your shadow sometimes moves before you do.

Gives: Spirit +1; Sealwork +2, Stealth +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Shadow Tether (Your shadow runs across the ground to another's and holds them where they stand. Strongly improves the next action that pins or holds someone in place).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Void, Kunai and Wire. A shadow-binding clan fights from the dark; Void deepens it.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Kusurigi Clan
traits.info:
A Hayate clan of field medics and poisoners: the same hands close wounds and open them. You know which herb heals and which kills, and that most do both. Squads protect you first, and enemies aim at you first.

Gives: Will +1; Medicine +3, Hidden Arms +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Green Hands (Soul through the palms closes a wound or draws a poison, yours or another's. Improves the next Medicine action).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Water, Kunai and Wire. Healer-poisoners stay at the back with a thrown blade.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Last Heir of a Fallen House
traits.info:
The last of a house that was broken: its lands taken, its name struck from the rolls. You keep the house's sword, its crest hidden inside your collar, and a list of names. Old retainers may still serve you, if you can find them.

Gives: Will +1; Blade +2, Resolve +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique For the Fallen House (Fight in the name of the dead house and its dead. Improves the next Blade or Resolve action against those who broke it, or in front of witnesses who remember it).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Retreat. A grudge and a sword, and nowhere to retreat to.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Legendary Summon
traits.info: A hundred souls: your summon has taken a legendary form of its own, a dragon, a nine-tailed fox, a great tengu or a thunder beast, shaped by what it ate and what you wished.

traits.name: Living Substitute
traits.info:
A living human handed an officer's power by one who could not finish their duty. You are both, and the court does not know what to do with you. An officer died handing you their power, and you have been both alive and an officer since. The court cannot decide whether you are a crime or a recruit.

Gives: Body +1; Blade +2, Stamina +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Two Bodies (Step out of your living body as an officer and leave it sleeping. Improves the next action taken in your soul-body).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Peasant. A living body with an officer's blade; most substitutes were nobody before.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Lone Hunter
traits.info: No orders, no rest, no one beside you. The night valleys are yours.

traits.name: Lord of the Wood
traits.info: A yokai court is yours. The forest moves at your word.

traits.name: Master of the Bureau
traits.info: The Bureau's masters answer to you. The realm's wards are yours.

traits.name: Masterless Shade
traits.info: Owned by no one: you take your own contracts and keep your own rules, and every village's hunters know your face.

traits.name: Merchant's Child
traits.info:
Raised in a merchant house, counting mon before you could walk. You can read a ledger, a liar and a price. Guild halls open to you, samurai look down on you, and you know exactly what everyone in the room owes.

Gives: Streetwise +1, Deception +1; starts with Merchant's Abacus.
Pairs well with: Ronin, Gambler of Saikai, Foreign Pistol. Streetwise and deception; money opens the port.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Mirror Eye
traits.info:
An eye that sees a technique once and keeps it: the shape of the seals, the rhythm of the cut. A silver sheen crosses it when it watches. Clans covet it, and its owner is hunted for it. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Sensing +2; technique Mirror Glance (Copy the shape of a technique you just watched and use it once. Spends 10 Hold); technique Mirror Unbound (For a scene, read every technique before it lands. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Mirror Read (Sensing 6), Mirror Turned Back (Sensing 12), Mirrored Seals (Sealwork 12, with Shinobi), Mirror Lesson (Sensing 18), Every Shape Kept (Sensing 24).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Soul, Hundred-Duel Seeker. You copy what you watch; fight many masters.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Mist Breath
traits.info:
A breath that hides: forms of blurred, doubled movement, so the cut comes from where you are not. Demons swing at where you were. Mist hunters are rarely seen by what they kill.

Gives: Guile +1; Breathcraft +2, Stealth +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Mist Veil (Blur yourself and the cut comes from nowhere. Improves the next attack from an unexpected angle).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Water, Katana. A blurred, unseen cut.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Mountain Ascetic
traits.info:
A yamabushi of the mountain paths: hardship as practice, conch shell and staff, spirits of the peaks as company. You walk the mountain paths with conch and staff and sleep in the cold on purpose. Tengu tolerate you and villages feed you.

Gives: Body +1; Stamina +2, Warding +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Walk Through Fire (Your practice lets you endure what would break others: fire walked, cold slept in. Improves the next Stamina or Resolve action against the elements).
Pairs well with: Steel, Staff, Fire. Stamina and warding on the mountain path; a staff and the fire-walk.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Mountain Saint
traits.info: The mountains' spirits bow to you; pilgrims climb to ask your blessing.

traits.name: Mushiro Clan
traits.info:
A Kagegi clan that lets a hive of insects live in its bodies and fight for it. You grew up with the hive's hum in your bones and fed it from your own Soul. Animals avoid you, and you never sleep entirely alone.

Gives: Will +1; Beast Bond +3, Sensing +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique The Hive Answers (A cloud of your insects pours from your sleeves to blind, sting, track or carry a whisper. Improves the next Beast-bond action).
Pairs well with: Soul, Earth, Bare Fists. The hive answers your Soul, and empty hands leave room for it.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Naginata
traits.info:
A curved blade on a long pole that sweeps a circle around you. Temple warriors and samurai women carry it; cavalry fears it; it needs room to move.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Sweeping Moon (The naginata's curved blade sweeps a half-circle. Improves the next Blade action against two or more foes); starts with Naginata (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, Blossom Breath, Snow-Blooded. Sweeping reach.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Name on the Road
traits.info: Your name travels the post road ahead of you.

traits.name: Named Soul-Blade
traits.info:
Your blade has a spirit in it, and the spirit has a name you are still learning. Call the name and the blade wakes; learn it fully and it becomes something else. It wakes in two stages, and drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Blade +1, Resolve +1; technique Name Called (Speak the blade's name: it takes its woken shape and a power of its own for a scene. Spends 10 Hold); technique True Blade (The blade's spirit stands beside you and the blade becomes its true form for one terrible exchange. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Blade's Whisper (Blade 6), Burning Name (Blade 12, with Fire), Oath-Bound Blade (Blade 12, with Samurai), Second Syllable (Blade 12), Blade Called Home (Blade 18), Ferryman's Named Edge (Blade 18, with Veil Officer), The Blade Guards Its Wielder (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Katana, Odachi. A blade arm is the spirit's home.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Never Draw First
traits.info:
Your sword answers; it does not ask. Every fight is the other side's choice, and you answer it fully. Samurai who learn of your vow test it; a few have died finding out what the answer looks like. The vow: you never strike a foe who has not yet moved to attack; once a hand goes to a hilt, a blade is drawn on you or a blow begins, pinning, disarming or binding them first is defence and keeps the vow. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Will +2; Resolve +1, Blade +1; technique Answer in Kind (Strike back at whoever struck first. Strongly improves the first counterattack of a fight).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Steel, Katana. You never cut first, so your draw becomes the answering cut, and the vow pays for it.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Never Lie
traits.info:
You do not lie. Not to enemies, not to lovers, not to save your life. People learn that your word is iron, and the wrong people learn to ask you the right questions. The vow: you never say anything you believe is false. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Will +2; Intrigue +1, Resolve +1; technique True Word (Say a true thing in a way that cannot be doubted. Improves the next action to be believed).
Pairs well with: Noble, Hostage-Ward, Samurai. Intrigue backed by a word that is iron.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Never Retreat
traits.info:
You do not step back. Not in a duel, not in a battle, not in an argument. The vow makes you a wall; it also means you need friends who know when to carry you off. The vow: you never retreat or flee from a fight you have entered. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Body +2; Stamina +1, Resolve +1; technique Last Step Forward (Wounded and outmatched, you step in. Improves the next action taken while badly hurt).
Pairs well with: Steel, Iron Skin, Stone Breath. A wall that stands.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Nine Lines
traits.info:
An old mountain school that teaches the nine lines a sword can cut along and then teaches them all at once. Few finish it; those who do have learned a draw nobody else has seen and lived.

Gives: Blade +1; technique First Line (A cut along the one angle the foe's guard leaves open. Improves the next Blade action against a guarding foe); technique Reading the Lines (Watches a foe's stance and names which of the nine they cannot cover. Improves the next Awareness or Blade action to find an opening); unlocks as you train: Three Lines (Blade 6), Six Lines (Blade 12), All Nine Lines (Blade 18), The Draw Past the Nine (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Katana, Still Eye. A sword student's school: Still Eye stretches the heartbeat the nine lines need.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: No Killing
traits.info:
You will not kill. You fight to stop, to break and to bring down, and the vow makes every fight harder and every mercy stronger. Your enemies learn this and some of them use it. The vow: you never kill anyone; you disable, spare and bind. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Will +2; Open Hand +1, Medicine +1; technique Mercy's Strength (Strike to stop, not to kill, and the blow lands true. Improves the next action that disables a foe).
Pairs well with: Wanderer of the Reversed Edge, Healing Division, Staff. Open hand and medicine; a staff stops without killing.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: No Steel
traits.info:
Steel is not for you, by choice. Wood, paper, fist and Soul are enough, and the vow pays you back in power for the steel you gave up. Smiths think you a fool. The vow: you carry and use no metal weapon. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Spirit +2; Open Hand +1, Soulcraft +1; technique Empty Hand (Your bare hands carry your Soul. Improves the next unarmed technique).
Pairs well with: Bare Fists, Staff, Talismans, Soul. Fists, wood and paper; Soul fills the gap.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Noble
traits.info:
Born to a court family with a name and too many debts. You know the poems, the bows and the scandals. Commoners bow, barriers wave you through with the right papers, and every court in the isles knows something about your family.

Gives: Intrigue +1, Artistry +1; starts with Family Seal.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Onmyoji, War Fans. Intrigue and artistry open court doors.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Notorious
traits.info: Word of your killings has spread. People know your name and fear it, and the respectable want nothing to do with you.

traits.name: Odachi
traits.info:
A great curved sword taller than its bearer, worn across the back. It clears a bridge or a gate and needs the strength to swing it twice. Nobody misses an odachi coming down the road.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Odachi Cleave (The odachi comes down with its whole length behind it. Improves the next Blade action against a mounted or a large foe); starts with Odachi (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, House Kurogane, Stone Breath. A heavy blade for a strong body.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Okamura Clan
traits.info:
A Hayate clan that fights beside wolves raised from pups, two bodies with one mind in a fight. Your wolf was a pup in your arms and is a killer at your side. Where it cannot go, you do not go either, and inns rarely want it.

Gives: Body +1; Beast Bond +2, Tracking +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Two Bodies, One Hunt (You and your wolf strike together from two sides. Improves the next Open Hand or Beast-bond action made alongside your wolf).
Pairs well with: Steel, Earth, Chain-Sickle. You fight beside your wolf up close; beast-bond and tracking keep you on the trail.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: One Arm Bound
traits.info:
One arm stays inside your robe, bent across your chest or resting in its fold, and you never draw it out. You fight one-handed and better for it, because the vow pays you back in strength and speed. People think you crippled until they see you move. The vow: you keep one arm inside your robe and use only the other. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Body +2; Blade +1, Footwork +1; technique One Arm Enough (Everything your second arm would have done goes into the first. Improves the next one-handed attack).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Ronin. One-handed blade work.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Oni-Blooded
traits.info:
An oni parent: huge strength, a temper, and horns that grow when you are angry. You are big, strong and slow to tire, and you eat like three people. People see the horns before the person.

Gives: Body +1; Open Hand +3, Stamina +1; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Horns Out (The horns come and the strength comes with them. Strongly improves the next Open Hand action of raw force); resists bludgeoning; weak to piercing.
Pairs well with: Steel, Bare Fists, Giant's Frame. Raw strength in open hands; resists blunt blows, weak to points.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Onmyoji
traits.info:
Student of the yin-yang arts: wards, talismans, paper familiars, star reading and the calendar of lucky and unlucky days. You write your Soul into paper and the world keeps it.

Gives: Spirit +2, Will +1; Warding +2, Summoning +2, Divination +1, Lore +1; Soul +10 (maximum and starting); technique Paper Servant (Fold, breathe on and throw a paper talisman: it becomes a bird, a dog or a soldier of paper that serves until torn. Improves the next Summoning action. Spends 12 Soul); technique Barrier of Five Seals (Five talismans thrown to the points of a star: a barrier nothing lesser crosses. Strongly improves the next Warding action that holds a place. Spends 25 Soul); cantrip Paper Crane (A folded slip of paper flies where you point and tells you what it saw. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Divination or Awareness action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Talisman Volley (Warding 6), Fox-Fire Talisman (Warding 12, with Fox-Fire Kindled), Purification Rite (Warding 12), Purifying Rain (Warding 12, with Water), Star-Path Barrier (Warding 18), Grand Rite of Yin and Yang (Warding 24); starts with Talisman Case (Warding +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Earth, Temple Orphan. Warding and summoning want Soul and Talismans; Earth holds a ward line.

Primary Attribute: Spirit
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Onmyoji: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Onmyoji art, deepened. Level 10, after Onmyoji. Gives: Spirit +1; Warding +1; technique Paper Shield-Bearer (Paper Servant deepened: the servant takes a blow and fights on, a second rising if the first is torn).

traits.name: Onmyoji: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Onmyoji art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Will +1; Warding +1; technique Seven-Seal Barrier (Barrier of Five Seals mastered: two more seals, and the barrier turns a technique back on its maker).

traits.name: Onmyoji: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Onmyoji art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Spirit +1; Warding +2; technique The Calendar Bends (Perfected onmyoji art: for a scene you name the lucky hour and the stars agree).

traits.name: Open Book
traits.info:
You say what you feel when you feel it. People always know where they stand with you, for better and for worse. Courts find you impossible; friends find you restful.

Gives: Streetwise +1.
Pairs well with: Never Lie, Peasant. Nothing hidden.

traits.name: Outcast
traits.info:
Born outside the order: a village's shame, a criminal's child, a cursed name. You learned to keep out of sight and keep going. Respectable doors close on you, and the people behind the other doors look after their own.

Gives: Stealth +1, Stamina +1; starts with Hooded Cloak.
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Half-Yokai, Curse-Bearer. Stealth and stamina outside the order.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Paired Short Blades
traits.info:
Two short swords instead of one long one: a guard that turns every attack and then turns into a whirl. Bodyguards and secret watchmen favour it for close rooms, rooftops and corridors.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Crossed Guard (Catches a blow between both blades and holds it. Improves the next Blade action that blocks a heavy strike); technique Turn and Answer (One blade turns the attack, the other answers through the gap. Improves the next Blade action that counters in a narrow space); unlocks as you train: Rooftop Flow (Blade 6), Whirling Blades (Blade 12), Six Turns of the Guard (Blade 18), The Whirl That Becomes a Storm (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Kunai and Wire, Shadow. Close-quarters steel: two short blades suit rooftops, corridors and the ambush.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Peasant
traits.info:
Born to the rice fields and the tax collector. You can work from dawn to dark and read weather, tracks and soil. Samurai expect you to bow, toll barriers expect you to pay, other commoners trust you, and lords forget your face.

Gives: Stamina +1, Tracking +1; starts with Straw Rain Cape.
Pairs well with: Ronin, Breath Hunter, Staff. Stamina and tracking; a staff passes every barrier.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Polished Manners
traits.info:
Your bow is perfect and your speech is careful. Courts open a little wider for you, and commoners close a little tighter. Your bow says more than most people's speeches.

Gives: Intrigue +1.
Pairs well with: Noble, Hostage-Ward. Manners learned where mistakes cost heads.

traits.name: Proud to a Fault
traits.info:
You would rather fail than ask for help. It has kept you going through things that should have broken you, and it has cost you friends.

Gives: Resolve +1.
Pairs well with: Noble, Samurai. A pride that is also a spine.

traits.name: Puppet
traits.info:
A fighting puppet in a lacquered case, joints of steel and hidden blades, moved by threads of Soul. It fights while you stand back; if it breaks, you are a puppeteer with empty hands.

Gives: Puppetry +1; technique Puppet Feint (The puppet draws the eye and the blade comes from its sleeve. Improves the next Puppetry action. Spends 12 Soul); starts with Fighting Puppet (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Karakuri Clan, Soul. Puppetry: the Karakuri art.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Pursuit Division
traits.info:
The Veil Court's hunters and executioners, who chase rogue officers and the dead who run. You are good at it, and everyone knows. Other officers lower their voices around you, and the guilty run when they see the division's sash.

Gives: Guile +1; Tracking +2, Stealth +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Veil Stride (Step half out of the living world and back: three paces become thirty. Improves the next Footwork or Stealth action that closes distance).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Void, Chain-Sickle. Tracking and stealth run the dead down; a chain holds them.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Ranked Officer
traits.info: A rank in your division: officers under you, the court's trust, its law to keep.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.info:
You leap before you look and usually land. When you do not, it is spectacular, and your friends have stopped being surprised.

Gives: Footwork +1.
Pairs well with: Thunder Breath, Never Retreat. Speed that outruns caution.

traits.name: Records and Research
traits.info:
The Veil Court's archivists and inventors. You keep the ledgers of the dead and study things that should not exist, and your experiments make the other divisions nervous. Every name you write down is a name the court can find.

Gives: Spirit +1; Lore +2, Sealwork +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Name in the Ledger (Look up a soul in the court's records: who they were, how they died, what they owe. Improves the next Lore action about the dead).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Earth. Lore and sealwork bind what you study.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Renegade of the Veil
traits.info: You broke the court's law for the living and kept your power. The Pursuit Division has your name.

traits.name: Rival at Heart
traits.info:
You fall for the people who can beat you. A good duel is how you say hello, and losing to someone is how you start to like them.

Gives: Footwork +1.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Breath Hunter. Affection forged in sparring.

traits.name: Ronin
traits.info:
Masterless: your house fell, your lord died, or you walked away. You kept the sword and lost everything that made it lawful. The road feeds you if you are good enough.

Gives: Body +2, Guile +1; Blade +3, Streetwise +2, Stamina +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Road-Worn Guard (Years of fighting tired, hungry and outnumbered: you fight best when it is unfair. Improves the next Blade action taken while wounded or outnumbered); technique Sell the Sword (Name a price and a job and the road finds you a buyer: a bodyguard post, a bounty, a duel for someone else's honour. Improves the next Streetwise action that finds paid work); cantrip Road Manners (The slouch, the bowl, the sword kept in plain sight: you read a room and let it read you. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Streetwise action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Tavern Brawl Blade (Blade 6), Masterless Feint (Blade 12), Scars of the Road (Stamina 12, with Iron Skin), Duel at the Crossroads (Blade 18), The Wandering Sword (Blade 24); starts with Travel-Worn Kit (Stamina +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Odachi, Never Retreat. Blade and stamina carry a road fighter; a heavy arm and a hard vow suit a masterless sword.

Primary Attribute: Body
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Ronin: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Ronin art, deepened. Level 10, after Ronin. Gives: Body +1; Blade +1; technique Road Guard Deepened (Road-Worn Guard deepened: the guard that has met every school's opening meets this one too).

traits.name: Ronin: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Ronin art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Guile +1; Blade +1; technique Price Paid in Full (Sell the Sword mastered: the paid blade fights as if the whole purse were on the line).

traits.name: Ronin: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Ronin art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Body +1; Blade +2; technique Masterless Perfected (Perfected ronin art: with no house to shame and nothing to lose, you fight past the point others yield).

traits.name: Rough Edges
traits.info:
You look like you slept on the road, because you did. Labourers buy you a drink; clerks make you wait. You have stopped minding which of them is right.

Gives: Stamina +1.
Pairs well with: Peasant, Ronin. A body hardened by the road.

traits.name: Samurai
traits.info:
Sworn to a house and its lord, trained from childhood in the sword, the bow and the code that says when to die. Your Soul runs through the blade's edge, and a house's honour runs through you.

Gives: Body +2, Will +1; Blade +3, Intrigue +1, Resolve +1, Horsemanship +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Drawn Edge (The first cut, from the scabbard, faster than the eye: the draw is the strike. Strongly improves the first Blade action of a fight); technique Name Spoken (You announce your name, house and lineage to an enemy. The lesser hesitate, and your blade arm steadies. Improves the next Resolve or Blade action taken against the one you named yourself to); cantrip Scabbard Word (Hand on the hilt, the blade an inch out: a warning every soldier in the isles understands. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Intrigue or Blade action that must be taken seriously, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Retainer's Stance (Blade 6), Cut of the House (Blade 12), Oath-Bound Blade (Blade 12, with Named Soul-Blade), Answer in the Stillness (Blade 18, with Still Eye), Mounted Charge (Blade 18), The Lord's Last Sword (Blade 24); starts with House Armour (Resolve +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Draw First, Noble. The blade and resolve skills stack with Steel and a sword; the vow turns your draw into the answering cut.

Primary Attribute: Body
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Samurai: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Samurai art, deepened. Level 10, after Samurai. Gives: Body +1; Blade +1; technique Second Edge (Drawn Edge deepened: the cut that follows the draw lands before the first is understood).

traits.name: Samurai: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Samurai art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Will +1; Blade +1; technique Banner Unbroken (Name Spoken mastered: your house's name steadies every ally who hears it).

traits.name: Samurai: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Samurai art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Body +1; Blade +2; technique The Cut That Ends It (Perfected samurai art: one cut, announced, that a duel is decided on).

traits.name: Scholar's Squint
traits.info:
Ink on your fingers and a book in your sleeve. Scribes treat you as one of their own; soldiers assume you cannot fight. It is a mistake people make once.

Gives: Lore +1.
Pairs well with: Veil Officer, Records and Research. A reader who is underestimated.

traits.name: Sealed Great Beast
traits.info:
One of the nine great beasts is sealed inside you. It hates the seal and it is waiting, and some nights it talks. Its power is enormous and borrowed, and people who know what you carry are afraid of you. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Resolve +1, Soulcraft +1; technique Borrowed Power (Pull a thread of the beast's power through the seal. Spends 10 Hold); technique The Beast's Cloak (Wear the beast's power like a burning cloak for a fight, and hear it laugh. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Beast's Eye (Resolve 6), Beast's Tail (Resolve 12), Curse Fed to the Beast (Cursecraft 12, with Curse-Bearer), Seal Tightened (Resolve 18), Beast's Bargain (Resolve 24).
Pairs well with: Soul, Never Retreat, Outcast. Resolve keeps the seal; people fear the host.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Second Style: Earth
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: a shinobi's second Element, Earth. Opens Stone Skin Step, Buried Blade, Earth Swallows the Trail.

traits.name: Second Style: Fire
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: a shinobi's second Element, Fire. Opens Ember Trail, Smoke Face, Ash Where You Stood.

traits.name: Second Style: Void
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: a shinobi's second Element, Void. Opens Empty Step, Unseen Edge, Nothing Was There.

traits.name: Second Style: Water
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: a shinobi's second Element, Water. Opens Mist Double, Rain Veil, The River Takes the Blade.

traits.name: Second Style: Wind
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: a shinobi's second Element, Wind. Opens Gale Step, Whispered Blade, Scattered on the Wind.

traits.name: Self-Vowed Ascetic
traits.info:
You cursed yourself on purpose, in a vow temple, for power you needed. You know exactly what it costs, you pay it every day, and you would do it again. Curse-bearers who were born to it think you mad.

Gives: Will +1; Resolve +2, Cursecraft +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Price Paid (Spend a piece of yourself (sleep, sight, a memory) for one great act. Strongly improves the next action, and the narrator names what it cost).
Pairs well with: Soul, Never Retreat, Staff. Resolve and cursecraft; one vow more.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Shadow
traits.info:
You fight unseen and unfair: the ambush, the lie, the blade in the back. Whatever your tradition, you settle things before they start. Your free-form moves roll your lane (Stealth, Hidden Arms, Deception) whenever they can be done your way.

Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +2, Hidden Arms +1, Deception +1; technique First Strike Unseen (Strike from where they are not looking. Improves the next attack against a foe who has not seen you); unlocks as you train: Blend In (Stealth 6), Behind You (Stealth 12), Silent Kill (Stealth 18), The Shadow Army (Stealth 24).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Cut-Cord, Kunai and Wire, Umbrella Blade. Stealth and deception; first strike from hiding.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Shadow of the Village
traits.info: The village's trusted blade: inner-circle techniques, the elders' confidence, and missions no one else is told about.

traits.name: Sharp Tongue
traits.info:
You always have the last word, and it is usually the wrong one. Your wit wins arguments and loses allies. Courtiers fear your mouth more than your sword.

Gives: Intrigue +1.
Pairs well with: Noble, The Trickster. A wit that wounds both ways.

traits.name: Sheath Draw
traits.info:
The draw-cut school: the sword lives in its scabbard and the cut is the draw, faster than an eye can follow. Its masters say the fight is over before the blade is seen, and the second strike comes from the scabbard itself.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Sheathed Flash (Draws, cuts and sheathes in one motion too fast to see. Improves the next Blade action made from a sheathed blade); technique Scabbard Answer (Blocks a blow with the scabbard and draws through the opening. Improves the next Blade action that counters an attack); unlocks as you train: Rain on a Still Pond (Blade 6), Double Draw (Blade 12), Sheathed Before the Fall (Blade 18), The Heavenward Draw (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Katana, Never Draw First. A katana and the answering cut: under the vow the draw is always the second move and still lands first.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Shikigami Pact
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: the Onmyoji's change. Opens Shikigami, Familiar's Sight, Familiar's Strike.

traits.name: Shinobi
traits.info:
Raised in a hidden village and sold, by contract, to whoever pays. You shape your Soul through hand seals into tricks a samurai calls cowardice and a lord calls necessary: false faces, vanishing, a wire across the dark.

Gives: Guile +2, Body +1; Stealth +2, Hidden Arms +2, Sealwork +1, Footwork +1; Soul +10 (maximum and starting); technique Borrowed Face (Three seals and a breath: you wear another person's face and voice until struck or until you let it go. Improves the next Deception action taken while disguised); technique Cast-Off Husk (As the blow lands you are no longer in the coat it lands on. Turn one hit into a miss and reappear a few paces away. Improves the next Footwork or Stealth action that escapes an attack); cantrip Smoke and Step (A pinch of smoke, one hand sign, and you are two paces from where their eyes left you. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Stealth action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Silent Seal (Sealwork 6), Mirrored Seals (Sealwork 12, with Mirror Eye), Seal Through the Eye (Sealwork 12, with Far Eye), Smoke-Step Seal (Sealwork 12), Wind-Carried Blades (Hidden Arms 12, with Wind), Stillness Seal (Sealwork 18), Hundred-Seal Rain (Sealwork 24); starts with Shinobi Kit (Hidden Arms +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Kunai and Wire, Chain-Sickle, Outcast. A shinobi's skills (stealth, hidden arms, seals) all pay off from the ambush.

Primary Attribute: Guile
excludedBy: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii

traits.name: Shinobi Turned Ronin
traits.info:
You left a village and took up a sword instead of a mask. You still move like a shinobi. You left your village for a sword and a straw hat, but you still sleep facing the door. Your old village has not forgotten you.

Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +2, Hidden Arms +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Two Schools (Open like a swordsman and finish like a shinobi. Improves the next action that surprises an enemy who thinks they know your style).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Kunai and Wire, Outcast. You still fight like a shinobi; the old tools still fit your hands.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Shinobi: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Shinobi art, deepened. Level 10, after Shinobi. Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +1; technique Hundred Faces (Borrowed Face deepened: the face holds through a blow and a search, and the voice fools someone who knew its owner).

traits.name: Shinobi: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Shinobi art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Body +1; Stealth +1; technique Husk Legion (Cast-Off Husk mastered: three husks fall where you stood and each takes a strike meant for you before it tears).

traits.name: Shinobi: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Shinobi art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Guile +1; Stealth +2; technique The Village Forgets You (Perfected shinobi art: for a scene you leave no track, no scent, no memory in those who glanced your way).

traits.name: Shogunate General
traits.info: You command the realm's own armies. Houses bow to your banner.

traits.name: Shrine Maiden
traits.info:
A shrine's maiden: purification, the kagura dance, and a direct line to the shrine's god. You serve a shrine and its god: purifications, festivals, the kagura dance. Villagers trust you more than any Bureau official.

Gives: Will +1; Warding +2, Artistry +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Purifying Dance (Dance the kagura and the unclean things in the area weaken. Improves the next Warding action against spirits or curses. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Fire. Warding and the dance; purifying fire.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Shy Admirer
traits.info:
You feel a great deal and say very little. Your care shows in a gift left without a note and a poem never sent. The people you love find out years later, if they find out at all.

Gives: Artistry +1.
Pairs well with: Vow of Silence, Temple Orphan. Feelings spoken through craft.

traits.name: Slow to Trust
traits.info:
You have been betrayed before and you have not forgotten it. Trust is earned in years with you, and once given it is iron. The few who are inside the wall know what that costs you.

Gives: Awareness +1.
Pairs well with: Outcast, Shinobi. A wall built for good reasons.

traits.name: Snow-Blooded
traits.info:
A snow-woman or snow-man parent: cold breath, still face, a heart people think is frozen. Your breath can freeze and your face rarely moves. People think you cold, and they are wrong about why.

Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +2, Resolve +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique White Breath (Breathe frost that slows and numbs whatever it touches. Improves the next Soulcraft action that chills or slows. Spends 18 Soul); resists piercing; weak to bludgeoning.
Pairs well with: Soul, Water, Naginata. Cold breath through Soul; resists points, weak to blunt blows.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Soft Touch
traits.info:
You cannot refuse a sad story, true or not. Beggars, liars and lost children find you in every town. Half of them are lying to you, and you help them anyway.

Gives: Medicine +1.
Pairs well with: The Gentle Heart, Temple Orphan. A kindness that is easy to use.

traits.name: Soul
traits.info:
You fight with the current itself: raw technique, released and shaped. Whatever your tradition, you settle things with what your Soul can do. Your free-form moves roll your lane (Soulcraft, Sealwork, Sensing) whenever they can be done your way.

Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +2, Sealwork +1, Sensing +1; technique Open the Current (Let your Soul run wide for one technique: bigger, louder, more costly. Improves the next Soulcraft action. Spends 12 Soul); unlocks as you train: Current Read (Soulcraft 6), Soul Overflow (Soulcraft 12), Twin Current (Soulcraft 18), The River Beneath (Soulcraft 24).
Pairs well with: Onmyoji, Veil Officer, Curse-Bearer, Talismans. Soulcraft and seals; the traditions that shape Soul directly.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Spear
traits.info:
A straight yari: reach, a point and a shaft that holds a charge or a doorway. Foot soldiers' weapon, master's weapon. Swordsmen who close the distance learn to respect the butt end.

Gives: Blade +1; technique Spear's Reach (The spear keeps them at the point's length. Improves the next Blade action against a foe trying to close); starts with Yari (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Steel, House Mizuchi, Gate Guard. Reach to hold a deck or a gate.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Spider-Blooded
traits.info:
A spider-woman parent: silk, patience, venom and a beautiful face that hides all three. You spin silk, wait well and strike with venom. Weavers whisper about your family.

Gives: Guile +1; Hidden Arms +2, Stealth +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Silk Snare (Threads from your fingers bind a limb, a door or a fall. Improves the next action that traps or binds); resists poison; weak to bludgeoning.
Pairs well with: Shadow, Kunai and Wire, Earth. Silk and venom from hiding; resists poison, weak to blunt blows.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Staff
traits.info:
A plain hardwood staff, the pilgrim's and the monk's weapon. It is never confiscated at a toll barrier, it breaks bones without cutting, and in good hands it beats a sword.

Gives: Open Hand +1; technique Staff Circle (The staff turns in a guard no blade passes easily. Improves the next Open Hand action that parries or trips); starts with Hardwood Staff (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Mountain Ascetic, No Killing, Temple Orphan. Open hand through wood.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Star Reader
traits.info:
A Bureau astrologer who names lucky days, reads births and sees what is coming in the sky. You read the stars for the Bureau and name lucky days and ill births. Lords consult you and dislike what you say.

Gives: Spirit +1; Divination +3, Intrigue +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique The Hour Is Wrong (Read the day's omens and act at the one right moment. Improves the next action timed by your reading).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Void. Divination reads the sky; Void sees between the stars.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Steel
traits.info:
You fight with the body and what it holds: the blade, the fist, the long fight. Whatever your tradition, you settle things up close. Your free-form moves roll your lane (Blade, Open Hand, Stamina) whenever they can be done your way.

Gives: Body +1; Blade +2, Open Hand +1, Stamina +1; technique Steel Answers Steel (Meet a weapon with yours and push through. Improves the next Blade or Open Hand action against an armed foe); unlocks as you train: Pressing Edge (Blade 6), Marrow Blade (Open Hand 12, with Bone Weave), Weapon Break (Blade 12), Iron Rhythm (Blade 18), Last Blade Standing (Blade 24).
Pairs well with: Samurai, Ronin, Breath Hunter, Katana, Odachi. Body and blade; any tradition that settles things up close.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Still Eye
traits.info:
An eye that slows the world: a ring of gold wakes around the pupil, a heartbeat stretches, and you move in the gap. Using it burns your sight for a while after. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Gives: Footwork +1, Resolve +1; technique Still Moment (One heartbeat stretches and you act inside it. Spends 10 Hold); technique The World Holds Its Breath (For a few heartbeats you move while everything else is still. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Falling Leaf (Footwork 6), Gap in Time (Footwork 12), Answer in the Stillness (Blade 18, with Samurai), Breath Between Heartbeats (Breathcraft 18, with Breath Hunter), The Frozen Arrow (Footwork 18), Borrowed Heartbeat (Footwork 24).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, Never Draw First. The stretched heartbeat lets you strike second and still land first.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Stone Breath
traits.info:
A breath that holds: slow, heavy forms of weight and endurance. You hold ground nothing else can, and demons break their claws on you. Stone hunters stand at the gate on Demon Nights.

Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +2, Stamina +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Stone Stance (Hold a form and become immovable. Improves the next action that endures a blow or holds ground).
Pairs well with: Steel, Earth, Odachi. Weight and endurance: Earth and the heaviest blade.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Street Rhythm
traits.info:
A style with no school, learned in harbour fights and gambling dens: the blade comes from any angle, the feet kick as often as the sword cuts, and the fighter is upside down as often as not. Formal swordsmen hate it because it never does the same thing twice.

Gives: Footwork +1; technique Handstand Cut (Drops to the hands and cuts from below with the blade held in the feet's swing. Improves the next Footwork action that strikes from an unexpected angle); technique Broken Beat (Changes rhythm mid-exchange so a trained opponent's timing lands on nothing. Improves the next Blade action against a schooled fighter); unlocks as you train: Off the Wall (Footwork 6), Spinning Scabbard Kick (Footwork 12), Never the Same Twice (Footwork 18), Last Dance at the Harbour (Footwork 24).
Pairs well with: Ronin, Katana, Bare Fists. Footwork and a light sword, and fists for when the sword is somewhere else.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Striking Presence
traits.info:
People look twice when you enter a room. It opens doors, and it makes hiding very hard. Painters ask to draw you; spies hate working with you. You have learned to wear a hood when it matters.

Gives: Artistry +1.
Pairs well with: Noble, Blossom Breath. A presence that is its own art.

traits.name: Sun Peak Forms
traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: the Breath Hunter's change. Opens Dawn Cut, Noon Without Shadow, The Sun Does Not Set.

traits.name: Sunless
traits.info:
You keep out of daylight. You travel by night, sleep through the day, and fight best where the sun cannot follow. The vow pays you in shadow; daylight weakens you. The vow: you avoid sunlight, and in it you are weakened. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Guile +2; Stealth +2; technique Night's Own (In darkness you are at your best. Improves the next action taken at night or in darkness).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Void, Cat-Blooded. Night work; Void and night eyes.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Sunrise Incarnate
traits.info: When you breathe, the night ends. The demon lord fears one thing, and it is you.

traits.name: Sword of the House
traits.info: Your lord's chosen blade: the house's honour rides on your sword, and its enemies are yours.

traits.name: Sword of the Realm
traits.info: You carry the regent's commission: the law of the realm in a samurai's hand, over every house.

traits.name: Sword-for-Hire
traits.info:
You sell your sword by the day: bodyguard, debt collector, duellist for someone else's honour. You have guarded merchants, collected debts and fought other men's duels. You keep your contracts, because a sword nobody trusts earns nothing.

Gives: Guile +1; Streetwise +2, Blade +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Paid in Advance (A paid job is a promise: you fight harder for the client in front of you. Improves the next action that protects your current employer).
Pairs well with: Steel, Spear, Merchant's Child. Streetwise and blade sell by the day; a merchant's eye reads the contract.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Sworn to One Master
traits.info:
You serve one person and none other. Their word is your law; any other lord's is noise. Name your master in your backstory; the vow makes you stronger at their side and in their cause. The vow: you name one master and never act against them. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Will +2; Blade +1, Intrigue +1; technique For My Master (Act in your master's service. Improves the next action taken on your master's behalf).
Pairs well with: Hatamoto Retainer, Samurai, Katana. A blade at one master's side.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Sworn: The Veil Court
traits.info: You are sworn to The Veil Court.

traits.name: Talisman Scribe
traits.info:
A calligrapher of talismans whose ink holds Soul as stone holds heat. Your calligraphy holds Soul like stone holds heat, and every shrine in the isles buys your work. Forgers copy you badly, and you can always tell.

Gives: Will +1; Warding +2, Sealwork +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Written Ward (Write a talisman for a specific danger: it holds against that one thing. Improves the next Warding action against a named threat. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Soul, Talismans, Earth. Warding and sealwork are the brush's art.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Talismans
traits.info:
Paper and ink as weapons: wards thrown like knives, seals slapped on a blade, curses folded small. They run on Soul and skill rather than muscle.

Gives: Warding +1; technique Ink Strike (A talisman thrown flares on touch. Improves the next Warding action against a spirit or a technique. Spends 12 Soul); starts with Battle Talismans (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Onmyoji, Soul, Talisman Scribe. Warding as a weapon.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Tanuki-Blooded
traits.info:
A tanuki parent: a trickster's disguises, a drum of a belly, and a love of sake and people. You love sake, songs and people, and you can disguise yourself as almost anything. Innkeepers check your coins twice.

Gives: Will +1; Shapeshifting +2, Artistry +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Leaf Disguise (A leaf on the head and you are a teapot, a monk, a statue. Improves the next Shapeshifting action to pass as an object or a stranger. Spends 18 Soul); resists bludgeoning; weak to slashing.
Pairs well with: Shadow, Earth, Staff. Disguises and songs; resists blunt blows, weak to cuts.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Teasing Flirt
traits.info:
You show affection by poking at it. Banter is your love language, and a straight answer from you is rare and precious. The people you never tease are the ones to worry about.

Gives: Deception +1.
Pairs well with: Merchant's Child, The Trickster. A sharp tongue that means well.

traits.name: Temple Orphan
traits.info:
Raised by monks or shrine keepers after your family was lost. You learned the sutras, the old stories and how to sweep a ward line. Temples feed you anywhere in the isles, and you never quite stopped looking for your parents.

Gives: Lore +1, Warding +1; starts with Prayer Beads.
Pairs well with: Onmyoji, Exorcist Monk, Staff. Lore and warding from the temple.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Tender Caretaker
traits.info:
You show love by looking after people: a meal, a bandage, a blanket at the right moment. Being cared for in return makes you awkward.

Gives: Medicine +1.
Pairs well with: Temple Orphan, The Gentle Heart. Care given with the hands.

traits.name: Tengu-Blooded
traits.info:
A tengu parent: proud mountain spirits of wind and swordsmanship. You leap like the wind and fight with a swordsman's pride. Tengu Peak would take you in if you bowed.

Gives: Body +1; Blade +2, Footwork +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Mountain Wind (A gust carries you up or across further than a leap should. Improves the next Footwork action); resists piercing; weak to slashing.
Pairs well with: Steel, Wind, Katana. Wind and swordsmanship; resists arrows, weak to cuts.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: The Cheerful Wanderer
traits.info:
Every road is a good road and every stranger a meal you have not shared yet. You travel light and laugh easily, even in the rain.

Gives: Wildcraft +1.
Pairs well with: Peasant, Shinobi. A village kid who never lost the habit of wandering.

traits.name: The Cold Strategist
traits.info:
You see a fight as a board and people as pieces, and you hate how often you are right. Feelings come later, if they come at all.

Gives: Command +1.
Pairs well with: Samurai, Noble. A court-trained mind that commands as easily as it calculates.

traits.info: Earned in the Otherworld: the Curse-Bearer's change. Opens The Curse Obeys, Grudge Lent, Quiet Blood.

traits.name: The Devout
traits.info:
The kami, the Buddha or your ancestors are watching, and you mean to give them something worth seeing. Your faith is a practice.

Gives: Warding +1.
Pairs well with: Onmyoji, Temple Orphan. A practice that wards as much as it prays.

traits.info:
You would rather bind a wound than open one, and you notice who is hurting before anyone else does. Kindness is your stubborn streak.

Gives: Medicine +1.
Pairs well with: Temple Orphan, No Killing. Kindness kept as a discipline.

traits.name: Thousand Steps
traits.info:
A movement school any blade can take: steps so fast and so low that the walker seems to vanish from one place and appear in another. Its students say there is no secret, only a thousand steps a day.

Gives: Footwork +1; technique Vanishing Step (Steps out of a blow so fast the foe sees only where they were. Improves the next Footwork action that dodges); technique Arrive First (Closes a distance before the foe has finished deciding to move. Improves the next Footwork action that closes on a foe); unlocks as you train: Afterimage (Footwork 6), Across the Room (Footwork 12), Everywhere at Once (Footwork 18), The Step Between Two Places (Footwork 24).
Pairs well with: Wind, Katana, Shinobi. Wind and footwork: speed carries any blade, and shinobi learn it gladly.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Thunder Breath
traits.info:
A breath that cracks like a storm: short, violent bursts and a body that tenses like a drawn bow. You cover a courtyard between two heartbeats. Thunder hunters are loud, fast and hard to keep alive.

Gives: Body +1; Breathcraft +3, Blade +1; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Storm Breaks (Burst forward and strike; the sound arrives after the cut. Improves the next Breathcraft action that opens an exchange. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Steel, Wind, Katana. Bursts of speed; a katana for the single cut.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Tide Breath
traits.info:
A breath that flows: forms that turn and redirect like water, so a demon's strength carries it past you. You never meet force with force. Tide hunters live longest.

Gives: Will +1; Breathcraft +2, Resolve +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Turning Tide (Flow around a blow and turn it back. Improves the next action that counters an attack).
Pairs well with: Steel, Water, Katana. Flowing forms: Water and a blade that turns.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Two-Blooded
traits.info:
Not a half-yokai, but a quarter or an eighth: a yokai grandparent's gift surfaces in you now and then, a pair of ears, a shadow with a tail, a scent of rain. You pass as human most days. Drawing on it spends Hold; a Half-Yokai cannot take it.

Gives: Shapeshifting +1, Sensing +1; technique Old Blood Stirs (The grandparent's gift surfaces for a moment. Spends 10 Hold); technique Blood Remembered (For a scene the yokai blood shows fully. Spends 25 Hold); unlocks as you train: Grandmother's Ears (Shapeshifting 6), Quarter Change (Shapeshifting 12), Ancestor's Glamour (Shapeshifting 18), Grandparent's Kin (Shapeshifting 24).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Onmyoji, Soul. A touch of yokai for a human tradition (not for Half-Yokai).

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Umbrella Blade
traits.info:
A paper umbrella with a thin blade in the shaft. Nobody stops a traveller for an umbrella; nobody expects the draw. It is a weapon for liars and the well dressed.

Gives: Deception +1; technique Umbrella Draw (The umbrella opens as a shield and the blade slides from the shaft. Improves the next Deception action that hides an attack); starts with Umbrella Blade (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Gambler of Saikai, Yumeno Clan. Deception: a weapon nobody suspects.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Unsettling Calm
traits.info:
You stay still when others flinch, and it makes people nervous. Even the dead seem to wait for you to finish speaking. It has ended more fights than your blade.

Gives: Resolve +1.
Pairs well with: Veil Officer, Untouchable. A calm that has met death before.

traits.name: Untouchable
traits.info:
Born to the work the clean will not do: the dead, the hides, the executions. You know bodies, their wounds and their burial. The clean step around you in the street, and the dead are easy with you.

Gives: Medicine +1, Resolve +1; starts with Burial Tools.
Pairs well with: Curse-Bearer, Healing Division, Ferry Division. Medicine and resolve; easy with the dead.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Veil Officer
traits.info:
An officer of the Veil Court, which ferries the dead through the great torii at Veilgate. You are made of Soul more than flesh, carry an officer's blade, and see the hungry and the masked dead the living cannot.

Gives: Spirit +2, Will +1; Soulcraft +2, Blade +2, Sensing +2; Soul +10 (maximum and starting); technique Ferryman's Rite (Touch the hilt of your blade to the brow of a lingering dead soul and send it through the Veil. Strongly improves the next action that lays a spirit to rest or drives one back); technique Unseen Among the Living (Let the living stop seeing you: only the spiritually gifted, yokai and the dead still do. Improves the next Stealth action among ordinary people); cantrip Veil Sense (A held breath and the dead's side shows: a cold thread, a fresh grave, a spirit's pull. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Sensing action for the dead or the masked, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Officer's Edge (Blade 6), Ferry Cut (Blade 12), Funeral Pyre Rite (Soulcraft 12, with Fire), Officer's Blade Released (Blade 12), Two Powers Answer (Blade 12, with Inner Mask), Void Ferry (Soulcraft 12, with Void), Ferryman's Named Edge (Blade 18, with Named Soul-Blade), Gate Step (Blade 18), The Blade's Final Shape (Blade 24), Veil Rent (Blade 24); starts with Officer's Black Robe (Sensing +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Soul, Void, Katana, Blindfolded. Soulcraft, blade and sensing fit Soul and Void, and a blindfolded officer sees the dead best.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Veil Officer: Deepened Art
traits.info: Your Veil Officer art, deepened. Level 10, after Veil Officer. Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +1; technique Deeper Rite (Ferryman's Rite deepened: the rite takes a stubborn spirit on the first word).

traits.name: Veil Officer: Mastered Art
traits.info: Your Veil Officer art, mastered. Level 30, after Deepened Art. Gives: Will +1; Soulcraft +1; technique Walking Both Shores (Unseen Among the Living mastered: you step onto the dead's side of the road for a breath and back).

traits.name: Veil Officer: Perfected Art
traits.info: Your Veil Officer art, perfected. Level 40, after Mastered Art. Gives: Spirit +1; Soulcraft +2; technique The Gate Opens for You (Perfected officer's art: for a scene the great torii's authority is in your blade; the hungry and the masked know it).

traits.name: Vessel of a Cursed Spirit
traits.info:
A cursed spirit lives in your body and lends you its strength for its own reasons. Sometimes its voice answers for you, and sometimes its hands throw the punch. You are still not sure what it wants.

Gives: Body +1; Cursecraft +2, Open Hand +2; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Let It Fight (Give the spirit your hands for a moment. Strongly improves the next Open Hand action, and it enjoys it).
Pairs well with: Steel, Bare Fists, Void. The spirit fights with your fists.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Village Elder
traits.info: You sit on the council now. The village's hidden techniques are yours to teach, and its wars are yours to start.

traits.name: Void
traits.info:
Your Soul is void: the stillness between the other four, where masked and hungry things come apart. Void resists void and thins in sunlight.

Gives: Soulcraft +1; technique Empty Touch (A touch of nothing: a technique dies in the air, a spirit's mask cracks. Improves the next Soulcraft action against a technique or a spirit. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Still Air (A patch of air goes silent and dull: a footstep unheard, a candle's glow thinned. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Soulcraft or Stealth action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Empty Palm (Soulcraft 6), Empty Curse (Cursecraft 12, with Curse-Bearer), Mask Breaker (Soulcraft 12), Void Ferry (Soulcraft 12, with Veil Officer), Silence Field (Soulcraft 18), The Mask Turned Inside Out (Resolve 18, with Inner Mask), The Space Between (Soulcraft 24); resists void; weak to sunlight.
Pairs well with: Veil Officer, Kurobane Clan, Inner Mask. Tears masked and hungry things apart; thins in sunlight, so it suits night work.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.info: You broke your vow (Never Retreat) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow Broken: No Killing
traits.info: You broke your vow (No Killing) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow Broken: No Steel
traits.info: You broke your vow (No Steel) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow Broken: One Arm Bound
traits.info: You broke your vow (One Arm Bound) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow Broken: Sworn to One Master
traits.info: You broke your vow (Sworn to One Master) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow Broken: Vow of Silence
traits.info: You broke your vow (Vow of Silence) and its power has left you. The monks of the Vow Temple in Haibara hear atonement; until then the vow gives you nothing.

traits.name: Vow of Silence
traits.info:
You do not speak. Your techniques come without a word, and people fill your silence with what they want to hear. You talk with your hands, a brush, or not at all. The vow: you never speak aloud; you gesture, write or stay silent. Break it and its power leaves you until you atone at a vow temple.

Gives: Will +2; Stealth +1, Resolve +1; technique Silent Technique (Your techniques need no word or sound. Improves the next technique used without warning).
Pairs well with: Shinobi, Shadow, Talismans. Silent techniques and silent movement.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Wanderer of the Reversed Edge
traits.info:
You walk the road under a vow not to kill, with a blade whose edge faces you. You killed too many once, in a war or for a master, and now you walk the road putting things right without killing anyone. The vow is harder than any fight.

Gives: Will +1; Blade +2, Medicine +2; Health +5 (maximum and starting); technique Reversed Edge (Strike with the back of the blade: the enemy falls and lives. Improves the next Blade action that disables without killing).
Pairs well with: Steel, Katana, No Killing. The reversed edge IS the No Killing vow; medicine mends what you break.

Primary Attribute: Will

traits.name: Wandering Saint
traits.info: The road knows you as the swordsman who helps. Villages leave a bowl of rice out in case you pass.

traits.name: War Fans
traits.info:
Iron-ribbed fans that cut, block and hide the hand behind them. Court ladies carry them, wind clans throw air with them, and nobody searches a fan.

Gives: Hidden Arms +1; technique Fan Flourish (The war fans open: one blocks, one cuts, both hide the hands. Improves the next Hidden Arms action a foe does not expect); starts with Iron War Fans (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Kazakiri Clan, Wind, Noble. Hidden arms and thrown wind.

Primary Attribute: Guile

traits.name: Warden of the Wall
traits.info: One of the wardens who hold the Hold's wall. Your breath style bears your name.

traits.name: Water
traits.info:
Your Soul is water: it flows around what it cannot break and drowns what it can. Water resists water and fears the earth that dams it.

Gives: Soulcraft +1; technique Tide Drawn (Water gathers from air, ground or river and moves as you will. Improves the next Soulcraft action that shapes water. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Cup of Rain (Water gathers from the air into a cupped hand, or wrings itself out of a soaked sleeve. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Soulcraft or Medicine action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Water Whip (Soulcraft 6), Mist Shroud (Soulcraft 12), Purifying Rain (Warding 12, with Onmyoji), Crashing Wave (Soulcraft 18), The Sea Remembers (Soulcraft 24); resists water; weak to earth.
Pairs well with: Tide Breath, Kirisame Clan, Dragon-Blooded. Flowing and drowning; weak to Earth.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Weathered Traveller
traits.info:
Sun-dark skin, worn sandals and a pack that has seen every road. People ask you for news and directions before they ask your name.

Gives: Tracking +1.
Pairs well with: Ronin, Shinobi. A road that shows on you.

traits.name: Wide-Eyed Newcomer
traits.info:
Everything is new and you look at all of it. People explain things to you, and some of them take advantage. You are learning the isles fast, one mistake at a time.

Gives: Awareness +1.
Pairs well with: Foreigner of the Port, Temple Orphan. A stranger who notices everything.

traits.name: Wild Exorcist
traits.info: You go where the hauntings are worst and no Bureau seal reaches.

traits.name: Wind
traits.info:
Your Soul is wind: quick, cutting, never where it was. Your techniques slice and scatter and carry far. Wind resists wind and fears the fire that eats its air.

Gives: Soulcraft +1; technique Cutting Gust (A blade of air at range. Improves the next Soulcraft action that cuts or pushes with wind. Spends 12 Soul); cantrip Breath of Wind (A puff lifts a hat, snuffs a lamp or carries a whisper across a room. A cantrip: free and repeatable, a small edge to the next Soulcraft or Stealth action, never a strike); unlocks as you train: Wind Step (Soulcraft 6), Vacuum Cut (Soulcraft 12), Wind-Carried Blades (Hidden Arms 12, with Shinobi), Typhoon Wall (Soulcraft 18), The Sky Splits (Soulcraft 24); resists wind; weak to fire.
Pairs well with: Kazakiri Clan, Gale Breath, War Fans. Quick and cutting; weak to Fire.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Yokai Heart
traits.info: You let the blood come up. You are stronger, stranger, and welcome in places humans are not.

traits.name: Yumeno Clan
traits.info:
A Kagegi clan of mind-walkers who enter other people's thoughts through a touch and a held breath. You were taught to keep your own mind locked while you walk in others'. You have seen things in people's heads that you cannot forget.

Gives: Spirit +1; Mindwalk +3, Intrigue +1; Soul +5 (maximum and starting); technique Step Inside (A touch and a held breath: you are inside their mind for a moment, hearing what they think. Improves the next Mindwalk action. Spends 18 Soul).
Pairs well with: Shadow, Water, Umbrella Blade. Mind-walkers win before the fight; a quiet weapon keeps the cover.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

categories.name: Tradition
categories.info:
Which of the isles' arts made you; it decides your lineages. Pick one.

YOUR FOUR STATS. Every stat starts at 8 and your picks raise it, to 16 at most. Above 10 a stat helps every roll that uses it; below 10 it hurts them; at 4 or lower you also carry a weakness.
BODY: strength, toughness and the blade. Each point gives +3 max Health, +2% damage and 0.5% less damage taken. Used for Blade, Open Hand, Footwork, Stamina, Might, Breathcraft, Forging, Horsemanship and Seafaring.
SPIRIT: the power behind your techniques. Each point gives +3 max Soul and +1% damage. Used for Soulcraft, Sealwork, Sensing, Summoning, Divination, Lore, Mindwalk, Shapeshifting and Wildcraft.
WILL: nerve and self-control. Each point gives +2 max Hold and 1% less damage taken. Used for Resolve, Warding, Command, Cursecraft, Medicine, Archery, Artistry and Beast-bond.
GUILE: cunning, stealth and lies. Each point gives +3 Slip and 1% less damage taken. Used for Stealth, Deception, Intrigue, Streetwise, Hidden Arms, Awareness, Tracking, Artifice and Puppetry.

YOUR MAIN BARS. HEALTH: drops when you get hurt. SOUL: the energy your techniques spend; run dry and a technique fails and costs you 5 Health instead. Rest refills it. HOLD: your grip on whatever lives inside you; only a Birthright or a blade release spends it (see Birthright). SLIP: your dodge; when a hit takes 8 or more Health, Slip gives half of it back and the blow lands as a graze. It refills 4 a turn and fully on rest.

BARS YOU EARN. They start at 0 and the game moves them as you play. RENOWN: fame for good deeds; titles at 25, 50 and 75, and it never falls. INFAMY: hatred for needless killing; Notorious at 25, Barred at 50, Kill on Sight at 75; only penance at the vow temple in Haibara lowers it. EXPOSURE: only if you swear to two rival factions; working one against the other raises it, lying low lowers it, and at 100 you are caught and lose both. FED SOULS: summoners only; every soul fed to your summon counts, and it evolves at 10, 30, 60 and 100. HUNTERS TALLY: cleared lair runs; ranks at 100, 300, 700 and 1500. TOURNAMENT STANDING: official Capital Tournament bouts; ranks at 100, 250, 500 and 800. SHOP STANDING: delivered Workshop orders; ranks at 100, 250 and 450.

categories.name: Lineage
categories.info: Your village clan, samurai house, court division, yokai blood, shrine, breath style or curse: the line within your tradition. Pick one.

categories.name: Path
categories.info:
How you fight, whatever your tradition: Steel (the body and the blade), Soul (raw technique), Shadow (unseen and unfair). Pick one.

Steel gives +1 Body, Soul gives +1 Spirit, Shadow gives +1 Guile, and each makes its three skills your main lane. The Soul Path is a fighting style, not the Soul bar: the bar is the energy every technique that says Spends Soul draws on, whatever your Path.

categories.name: Element
categories.info: Your affinity, any Path: Earth, Water, Fire, Wind or Void. Each resists itself and fears its bane. Pick one.

categories.name: Birthright
categories.info:
Optional. Something more inside you: an eye, a body art, a waking blade, a sealed beast, a mask. Drawing on it spends Hold.

Hold is your grip on it. It starts full, only rest refills it, and as it drops the thing inside fights back: at 50 it whispers, at 25 it shows through you, at 0 it takes your body for a scene. With no Birthright and no blade release, you never spend Hold.

categories.name: Station
categories.info: Where you were born in the isles' order; toll barriers and great houses treat you by it.

categories.name: Vow
categories.info: Optional. A binding vow: a limit you keep, paid back in power. Break it and the power goes with it.

categories.name: Signature Arm
categories.info: The weapon or tool your techniques flow through.

categories.name: Personality
categories.info: Optional. Who you are under the training: how your choices read to the people around you.

categories.name: First Impression
categories.info: Optional. What strangers think of you before you speak.

categories.name: Relationship Style
categories.info: Optional. How you love, trust and keep people close.

categories.name: Fatal Flaw
categories.info: Optional. The weakness that makes trouble for you, and the edge it gives you.

skills.name: archery
skills.info:
The bow, mounted or on foot, and the stillness it takes. A basic success hits what was aimed at; a great success hits the gap in the armour; a failure is an arrow wasted and a position given away.

Covers: the bow on foot or horseback, at a target, a fleeing rider or an enemy on the walls. Not: thrown weapons, which are hidden arms. Easy: hit a straw target at thirty paces. Medium: hit a running deer. Hard: hit a rider's gap in the armour from the saddle. Very hard: hit a tengu in flight at night. Extremely hard: hit the seal on a beast's brow through a storm.

Primary Attribute: Will

skills.name: artifice
skills.info:
Locks, traps, mechanisms and machines: picking a lock, setting or springing a trap, keeping a foreign musket loaded and firing, rigging a bridge to fall. A basic success works it; a great success works it silently and leaves no sign; a failure jams it or springs it on yourself. The Artisan abilities roll it for crafting at a workshop or workbench.
