📍 The Inner Palace, The Asagiri Isles. Behind its own walls inside the capital, the emperor's palace keeps the old rites: cypress roofs, raked gravel, poets and priests and court ladies in layered silks.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-15)

You were given to the court as a hostage-ward for your family's good conduct. Tonight the princess you guard asked you a question.
🎭 Captain Mori Sayo, Female, captain of Princess Ayame's sworn guard. Short black hair, stern eyes, dark armour over a white lotus surcoat. Show her you would take Ayame's side against the court and she lets you past the screens.
🎭 Dowager Empress Shoshi, Female, the emperor's widowed elder sister-in-law and the senior lady of the court. Calm dark eyes, a white lotus embroidered at the collar. Serve the Lotus Ward without asking about Ayame's past and she trusts you with her letters; ask about the past and she decides what you are.
🎭 Princess Ayame, Female, the Dowager's ward. Bright mischievous dark eyes. She tests you with teasing and small betrayals offered as gifts; refuse to use her when you could and the game stops.

starts.name: Hyoga Reach: The Ice Pier
starts.info:
HYOGA REACH · any tradition · guided
📍 Shirokawa, The Asagiri Isles. The exiles' town on the ice isle's sheltered shore: black stone houses, smoke, and people who do not ask where you came from.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 35-60)

Shirokawa at the end of the world: exiles, Wardens, beast hosts, and the Sealing Vaults up the road.
🎭 Hunter Captain Gaku, Male, captain of the Warden hunters. Furs and chains. He offers a bounty for the shore host.
🎭 Officer Tsubame, Female, a Veil Court officer who has come to Hyoga. Short black hair, cold eyes, black officer's coat with a white sash. Convince her the exiles are not her enemy and she carries their proof south.

starts.name: Kappa: The Angry Ford
starts.info:
KAPPA · Miyako Plain · guided
📍 Kappa River Fords, The Asagiri Isles. Shallow fords on the plain's great river where travellers cross on foot.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-18)

The kappa of the river fords are angry with everyone since a merchant drowned with a stolen cucumber cart, and you need to cross.

starts.name: Kurosugi Range: The Outer Checkpoint
starts.info:
KUROSUGI RANGE · any tradition · guided
📍 Kagegi Village, The Asagiri Isles. The hidden village of the southwestern slopes, built into a mist-filled valley among black cedars: training grounds, clan compounds, and the mission hall that sells its shinobi to the realm.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 5-30)

The cedar mountains of the hidden villages: Kagegi, Hayate, a feud older than anyone in it, and a stolen scroll.
🎭 Yumeno Kasumi, Female, head of the Yumeno mind-walker clan. Long pale hair, half-closed lilac eyes, layered dark kimono with a moth crest. Let her read you and she tells you what she saw in the dead man's dream.
🎭 Kagekiri Jin, Male, a shinobi of the hidden villages the same age as the character. A sleeveless charcoal shinobi jacket. He will tell you exactly how many times he has beaten you, and offer to make it one more.
🎭 Mission-Hall Steward Kiri, Female, Steward of Kagegi's mission hall. Finish three outsider bounties and she offers you one from the other board.

starts.name: Lantern: The Road After Dark
starts.info:
LANTERN · Fifty Stations Road · guided
📍 Ghost Pine Hill, The Asagiri Isles. A hill where the road runs through a cutting, notorious for lanterns that float along it at night with no one carrying them.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 6-15)

Night has fallen between two post stations on Ghost Pine Hill, and a lantern-lit inn is waiting where no inn should be.
🎭 The Grey Pilgrim, Non-binary, a pilgrim in grey robes and a deep straw hat who walks the cutting on Ghost Pine Hill. A plain white mask under it. Walk it gently to its burned shrine and it remembers its name and goes on.

starts.name: Market: The Leaf-Money Relic
starts.info:
MARKET · Ayakashi Wood · guided
📍 Tanuki Market, The Asagiri Isles. A night market in a clearing where tanuki sell anything for money that turns to leaves at dawn.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 10-20)

Someone bought a real sealed relic at the Tanuki Market with leaf money, and the tanuki think it was you.
🎭 Ponta of the Tanuki Market, Male, the fattest. Fat jolly raccoon-dog yokai in a straw hat and a merchant's apron. Find the leaf-money buyer and he pays you in something real.

starts.name: Masks: The Face at the Grey Gate
starts.info:
MASKS · Miyako Plain · guided
📍 Miyako Castle, The Asagiri Isles. The regent's white castle above the capital: keep, councils and the crane banners of House Takamori.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-25)

The Treasury Magistrate is forgetting her own name, and she has just asked you whether you have met her before.
🎭 Hayase Ayane, Female, a samurai of a minor house the same age as the character. Sharp grey eyes, a white kimono under black-lacquered do and kote. She will bow, give you her name and her house's, and ask yours as though it were a challenge. It is.
🎭 Roll-Keeper Tadokoro, Male, a dry, careful archivist of the Council Hall who keeps the rolls of retainers of every. Ask about House Ikoma's roll and he shows you the scraped-out name.
🎭 Treasury Magistrate Sakuma Chiyo, Female, Sakuma Chiyo, a treasury magistrate of the Shogunate, forty, grey-robed and ink-stained. Tired sharp eyes. Take her convoy job and she pays from her own purse; find out who has been wearing her face and she owes you her name.

starts.name: Mistmarsh Coast: The Stilt Market
starts.info:
MISTMARSH COAST · any tradition · guided
📍 Ashiura, The Asagiri Isles. The largest stilt town of the marsh, built over reed channels on poles of black timber, where the road ends and the boats begin.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-30)

Ashiura on its stilts: fish, smugglers, navy patrols, and a rain clan whose poisons nobody can cure.
🎭 Headman Uozumi, Male, Headman of Ashiura. Practical indigo jacket. Help him keep all three masters happy one more month and the town is yours.
🎭 Stilt-Market Crier Funao, Male, Crier of Ashiura's stilt market. Catch him singing a verse wrong and he begs you to take the real bounty instead.

starts.name: Miyako Plain: Dawn on the Dawn Bridge
starts.info:
MIYAKO PLAIN · any tradition · guided
📍 Miyako, The Asagiri Isles. The walled castle city: the regent's keep and the emperor's palace side by side, samurai mansions, markets, temples, and the river bridges where duels are fought at dawn.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 1-25)

Miyako wakes under a dying emperor. Every house is hiring, every village is hungry, and you have just arrived.
🎭 Magistrate's Scribe Oriha, Female, Scribe of the capital magistrate's public board at the riverside post house. Neat hair, pale blue official kimono. Ask her about the names on the regent's bounties and she goes quiet, then asks if you can keep a secret.

starts.name: Monastery: The Riders at the Gate
starts.info:
MONASTERY · Kurosugi Range · guided
📍 Mountain Temple of the Seven Falls, The Asagiri Isles. The Order's oldest temple, built among seven waterfalls where ascetics fast under the cold water and the sutras are chanted day and night.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-25)

Riders who say they come from the court are at the Mountain Temple's gate, asking for an old woman sheltering inside.
🎭 Hermit Shirakumo, Male, a white-bearded hermit who lives behind the Seven Falls and practises the same cut under. Long white beard and hair. Climb to him and stay after the first line.
🎭 Novice Jikaku, Male, a young temple novice. Bright eager eyes. Ask him what he hears through the floor and he tells the party more than the abbot ever has.
🎭 Old Nurse Tsuru, Female, an old woman, eighty-five, dying, sheltering in the temple's guest cells. Thin white hair, kind wet eyes. Hear her confession and decide who else hears it.

starts.name: Onmyoji: The Director's Garden
starts.info:
ONMYOJI · Seimei Bureau · guided
📍 Bureau of Yin and Yang, The Asagiri Isles. The college of onmyoji: lecture halls of talisman scribes, a library of star charts and calendars, and examination rooms where licences are won and lost.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-25)

You hold a Bureau licence, or are about to, and the Director has called you to his garden on a matter he cannot put in writing.
🎭 Director Tachibana Seiran, Male, Tachibana Seiran. Long white hair, calm wise eyes. Bring him a question he cannot answer and he takes you as a student; bring him Sorei and he owes you.

starts.name: Orphan: The Lodge on the Wall
starts.info:
ORPHAN · Hinode Hold · guided
📍 Orphans' Lodge, The Asagiri Isles. A lodge where children orphaned by demon raids are raised and, when old enough, trained as hunters.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 15-20)

You grew up in the Orphans' Lodge of Hinode Hold. One of the new children has stopped eating, and you know why.
🎭 Orphan Shiro, Male, an orphan at the lodge. Find a way for him to live with what he is and the Hold gains a hunter no demon sees coming.

starts.name: Pilgrim: The Spring Sun Rite
starts.info:
PILGRIM · Miyako Plain · guided
📍 Sun-Rite Shrine of the Plain, The Asagiri Isles. An old shrine of the sun rites where the court's priests come each spring to bless the plain's rice.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-12)

You came to the Sun-Rite Shrine to pray for the emperor's waking, and the priest who leads the prayer has stopped believing it.
🎭 Priest Ujibe Kiyonari, Male, a priest of the sun rites. Kind worried eyes. Tell him what the burned talisman means and he tells you what the priests fear about the emperor's death.
🎭 Shrine Maiden Hayashida Yae, Female, a shrine maiden of the plain's sun shrine. Help fund the dawn rite and she teaches you a sun sutra.

starts.name: Rice: The Hidden Seed
starts.info:
RICE · Miyako Plain · guided
📍 Hundred Fields Village, The Asagiri Isles. A rice village of thatched roofs and flooded paddies, typical of the hundred that feed the capital.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Hundred Fields Village has hidden its seed rice, and the tax collector arrives tomorrow with soldiers.
🎭 Headman Tahei, Male, Headman of Hundred Fields Village. Thin grey hair, patched brown kimono. Stand between the village and the tax collector tomorrow and the village hides you forever after.
🎭 Widow Okiku of the Fields, Female, a farmer's widow who works her husband's paddy alone and cooks for the headman's house. Tired young widow in a plain kimono holding a paper receipt in a farmhouse kitchen. Ask about her husband and she shows you the paid receipt.

starts.name: Ronin: The Captains' Tables
starts.info:
RONIN · Saikai Free Port · guided
📍 Ronin Hiring Hall, The Asagiri Isles. A big drinking hall where masterless swords wait for work and clients come to hire them.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 3-18)

You are a masterless sword in Saikai with an empty purse and a reputation, good or bad, that walked in before you.
🎭 Tonbo the Upside-Down, Male, a lanky ronin who hangs around the Hiring Hall upside down on a beam more often than. Sleeveless kimono open at the chest. Make him laugh in a fight; he teaches the ones who do.
🎭 Captain Ishimura, Male, captain of the Ishimura band. Help him turn the two bands on the people who sent them and you have a seat at his table.
🎭 Gonroku the Broker, Male, Gonroku, broker of the Ronin Hiring Hall, seventy, one-armed. Worn dark kimono. Take his small contracts and keep them, and he teaches you the road; break one and the boards close to you.

starts.name: Saikai Free Port: The Foreign Quay
starts.info:
SAIKAI FREE PORT · any tradition · guided
📍 Saikai, The Asagiri Isles. The free port town on the bay: warehouses, quays, foreign ships at anchor among the junks, and lantern-lit streets that never close.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 1-20)

The free port never sleeps. Ships from beyond the isles, the guild's coin, the auction's crates, and you, just off a boat.
🎭 Gunrunner Kaneda Rokuro, Male, a foreign-quay broker. Oilcloth coat. Bring him a better buyer than the rain clan's war party and he sells the party the next crate's route.
🎭 Harbourmaster Watanuki, Male, the guild's harbourmaster. Sharp eyes, dark blue guild coat with brass buttons. Find the escort that took the humming chest north and he shows you the second ledger.

starts.name: Samurai: The Waking Hall
starts.info:
SAMURAI · Tetsuyama · guided
📍 Forge Guild Hall, The Asagiri Isles. The swordsmiths' guild hall: inspection rooms where every blade is marked, the oldest forge on the isle, and a hall where masters wake soul-blades.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 15-35)

You came to Tetsuyama to collect a blade from the Forge Guild, and the Fire Master has a different errand for you.
🎭 Fire Master Homura, Male, the Fire Master of the Tetsuyama Forge Guild. Leather apron. Work his forge for a season and he teaches you blade and discipline; bring Tetsuo home and he forges your sword.
🎭 Blade Inspector Kaji Sota, Male, the guild's blade inspector. Show him a deep-forge blade and his hands shake.
🎭 Smith Apprentice Tsubaki, Female, a smith's apprentice in the waking hall. Curious eyes. Ask her about the deep forges and she tells you what she saw.

starts.name: Seimei Bureau: The Ward-Wall Walk
starts.info:
SEIMEI BUREAU · any tradition · guided
📍 Seimei, The Asagiri Isles. The onmyoji city on the lake, laid out on a grid that is itself a ward, with an observatory tower at its heart and talismans on every gate.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-25)

Seimei, city of onmyoji, where every wall is warded and every ward is failing a little more each month.
🎭 Bureau Petition-Clerk Tokiwa, Female, Petition-clerk at Seimei's lake gate. Settle a petition she renamed and she tells you whose familiar it really was.
🎭 Gate Guard Isozaki Gonzo, Male, the lake gate's guard. Win at dice against him and he tells you about the fox.

starts.name: Shinobi: The Cedar Training Grounds
starts.info:
SHINOBI · Kurosugi Range · guided
📍 Kagegi Village, The Asagiri Isles. The hidden village of the southwestern slopes, built into a mist-filled valley among black cedars: training grounds, clan compounds, and the mission hall that sells its shinobi to the realm.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 5-30)

You are Kagegi-trained, or Kagegi-tolerated, on the morning after the joint rank exam went wrong.
🎭 Kagegi Sojun, Male, head of Kagegi Village. Calm unreadable eyes. Take his scroll contract and keep his rule (read none of it), and he trains you.
🎭 Kagegi Rin, Female, a Kurobane shadow-binder, twenty, top of her year at Kagegi and certain of it. Cold dark eyes. She calls you dead weight; carry your share on a mission and she stops.
🎭 Kagekiri Jin, Male, a shinobi of the hidden villages the same age as the character. A sleeveless charcoal shinobi jacket. He will tell you exactly how many times he has beaten you, and offer to make it one more.

starts.name: Slow Burn: The Long Watch
starts.info:
SLOW BURN · Seimei Bureau · guided
📍 The Old Observatory, The Asagiri Isles. The Bureau's first observatory, a lone tower of bronze instruments on the hills south of the city, kept by a few star-readers who prefer its dark to the city's lanterns.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 5-15)

The Bureau has sent you to keep the star-reader at the Old Observatory company through a season of night watches. She read your death in the stars the first time she saw you, and told you so.
🎭 Tsukimi, Female, a star-reader of the Bureau. Long silver-grey hair, half-lidded dreamy eyes. She reads your death at first meeting; change one fate she read and she stops reading yours.

starts.name: Smuggler: The Tally Pier
starts.info:
SMUGGLER · Mistmarsh Coast · guided
📍 Ashiura Fish Docks, The Asagiri Isles. The working docks of the coast town where fishermen land their catch and mend their nets.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 10-15)

You count crates for the Brine Tide on the Ashiura Tally Pier. One crate counted as tuna is ticking.
🎭 Tally-Man Kanroku, Male, the dock tally man at Ashiura. Open the ticking crate with him and he owes you everything.

starts.name: Student: The Paper Warrior
starts.info:
STUDENT · Seimei Bureau · guided
📍 Paper Familiar Workshop, The Asagiri Isles. Where Bureau students learn to fold and wake paper familiars: long tables of paper cranes, warriors and hounds that twitch when no one is looking.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-18)

You are a student at the Paper Familiar Workshop, and the paper warrior you folded last night refuses to go back to paper.
🎭 Instructor Shirokane, Male, the instructor of the Paper Familiar Workshop. Short greying hair, kind tired eyes. Find the runaway familiar quietly and he teaches you to fold your own.
🎭 Student Folder Hanae, Female, a Bureau student who folds paper familiars at the workshop tables. Mention the runaway and she begs you not to tell, then sends you to her uncle.

starts.name: Teahouse: The Tea Benches
starts.info:
TEAHOUSE · Fifty Stations Road · guided
📍 Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest, The Asagiri Isles. A cluster of stalls selling rice cakes and tea to walkers, the best gossip on the road for the price of a cup.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-6)

Your feet gave out on the post road and Granny Kiku put you to work for your tea. The rice cakes are good, the gossip is better, and nobody is chasing you.
🎭 Granny Kiku, Female, the old woman at the end stall of the Rice-Cake Peddlers' Rest. Patched kimono. Buy a cake and listen and she tells you where the courier went.

starts.name: Tetsuyama: The Ember Pier
starts.info:
TETSUYAMA · any tradition · guided
📍 Hibana, The Asagiri Isles. The largest forge town on the volcano's slopes: chimneys glowing all night, the ring of hammers, hot springs used for quenching, and masters who choose their customers.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 15-40)

Hibana under the volcano: forges, soul-steel, a theatre troupe on the pier, and a mask that has been worn too often.
🎭 Troupe-Master Sanshiro, Male, the master of a travelling theatre troupe. Colourful coat. See the play and ask about the masks.
🎭 Old Kanetsugu, Male, the master of the forge on Hibana's Forge Row that has been cold for twenty years. Learn from him how to put a spirit to rest.

starts.name: The Otherworld: Behind the Gates
starts.info:
BEHIND THE GATES · any tradition · 1-5 players · the Otherworld at level 20
📍 The Lodges, The Otherworld. Eight low lodges in a half-ring, one for each tradition's master, with a long mess between them and a bunk hall behind where a party sleeps off a day's drills.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-30)

Skip the long road: you are already through the gates, on the Training Ground where every tradition's master keeps a lodge, with a level's worth of the isles behind you.
🎭 Bunk-Hall Keeper Fuyu, Female, the keeper of the bunk hall behind the Lodges. A padded winter kimono. Sleep badly and she brings you tea without asking why; ask whose the empty bunk is and she tells you, quietly.
🎭 Mess-Keeper Sanjuro, Male, the keeper of the Lodges' mess. Short black hair, a cook's apron over a hired blade's old jacket. Ask for work without mentioning a faction and he hands you a job on the spot.

starts.name: Toll: The Cedar Pass Queue
starts.info:
TOLL · Fifty Stations Road · guided
📍 Cedar Pass Barrier, The Asagiri Isles. A barrier where the road climbs into a pass: an inspection hall, a gate, and guards who check every pass and every woman's face for runaways.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 3-15)

You are in the queue at the Cedar Pass Barrier behind a monk who is not a monk, carrying a letter a lord would kill to keep.
🎭 Captain Nagai, Male, captain of the Cedar Pass Barrier. Flat eyes, Warden's dark coat. Pay him, or make him believe the courtesan is worth less caught, and the gate opens.
🎭 Shinonome Tatsumi, Male, a breath hunter of the character's cohort who counts every demon he kills out loud. Short wild red-brown hair, a black hunter's uniform with the Hinode sun crest. He will tell you his count and demand yours, then challenge you to beat it by dawn.
🎭 Komurasaki, Female, a young monk in a straw hat waiting in the barrier queue. Get her through the barrier and she gives you the letter she stole.

starts.name: Tomoshibi: Cast Off
starts.info:
TOMOSHIBI ISLE · any tradition · 1-5 players · a ship of your own
📍 The Landing, Tomoshibi Isle. A short stone quay on the island's east side, where the strait from Saikai comes in calm.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 5-15)

The island is yours, and so is the coaster riding at its quay: Hanzaemon launched her yesterday and the paint is still wet. Eight hands, an empty hold, fourteen sea lanes and ten ports. Fill her, sail her, and keep her afloat.

starts.name: Tomoshibi: The Island Is Yours
starts.info:
TOMOSHIBI ISLE · any tradition · 1-5 players · a home of your own
📍 The Cliff House, Tomoshibi Isle. A two-storey house on the west cliff with a deep tiled roof and a walled yard, looking out over the open sea: the keeper's family's home, the household behind the shop.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-20)

You bought a ruined island off Widow Toki for less than a good sword, and rowed out with the deed in your sleeve. The lighthouse is dead, the rooms are wrecks, and a handful of people live here anyway.
🎭 Sora of the Lamp House, Male, Widow Toki's grandson. Short messy black hair, sleeveless indigo work jacket. He will show you every room of the house that is still standing, and every room that is not, if you help him patch the roof.

starts.name: Tomoshibi: The Lamp Relit
starts.info:
TOMOSHIBI ISLE · any tradition · 1-5 players · a household to run
📍 The Workshop, Tomoshibi Isle. A long low workshop on the lane up from the quay: a forge with a cold chimney, a workbench under a collapsed skylight, a stillroom of cracked jars, and an open counter facing the lane where the keeper's family once sold rope, lamp oil and repairs.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-20)

The island has been yours for a season. The house has a roof, the forge has a fire, two islanders work for you, and the rest of the ruins are waiting. Run the household: pay it, send it out, and choose who else to bring home.
🎭 Boatwright Hanzaemon, Male, a one-eyed boatwright. Grey cropped hair, a sawdust-covered work apron over a dark kimono. Show him your hands and he will decide whether you are worth teaching how to fix the forge.

starts.name: Tournament: The Open Bouts
starts.info:
TOURNAMENT · Miyako Plain · guided
📍 Tournament Grounds, The Asagiri Isles. The Capital Tournament's grounds: a sand ring under the castle walls, ringed by stands and the pavilions of the great houses.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 5-25)

The Capital Tournament's open bouts begin today: ronin, village champions and you, for a place before the regent.
🎭 Otama the Bookmaker, Female, the Tournament's leading bookmaker. Clever eyes, bright patterned kimono. Bring her a champion's secret and she pays in coin or in odds; fight in the ring and she sells you the field.
🎭 Ring-Crier Okabe Hisashi, Male, the tournament's crier. Ask him which bout is fixed and he names one, loudly, by accident.

starts.name: Veil Officer: The Great Pale Torii
starts.info:
VEIL OFFICER · Veilgate · guided
📍 Tasogare, The Asagiri Isles. The shrine city on the cliffs, its streets climbing to the great pale torii at the edge where the dead pass through, its lanterns drifting out over the Sea of Fog at night.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 10-40)

You are an officer of the Veil Court on your first watch at the Great Pale Torii, and the commander has a quiet order for you.
🎭 Commander Kirigaya Shion, Female, Commander of the Veil Court's post at Tasogare. Calm tired eyes, black officer's coat with a white sash. Help her ferry the backlog and she trains you as one of her living recruits.

starts.name: Veilgate: The Pilgrim Post
starts.info:
VEILGATE · any tradition · guided
📍 Tasogare, The Asagiri Isles. The shrine city on the cliffs, its streets climbing to the great pale torii at the edge where the dead pass through, its lanterns drifting out over the Sea of Fog at night.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 10-40)

Tasogare, on the cliffs above the sea of the dead: mourners, Veil officers, and lanterns for those who crossed.
🎭 Captain Shirasagi Ren, Female, a captain of the Veil Court's Ferry Division. Cold violet eyes, immaculate black officer's coat. Bring her a soul she failed to reach and she looks at you for the first time.
🎭 Pilgrim-Post Monk Hakuun, Male, Monk of Tasogare's pilgrim post, who keeps the board of the dead who would not go. Bring proof a mask is ended and he tells you why he left the Veil Court.
🎭 Lantern-Seller Oiwa, Female, a lantern-seller at the Pilgrim Post in Tasogare. Look at her list of lanterns that turn back.

starts.name: Write Your Own
starts.info:
MAKE IT YOURS · open-ended
Write your own beginning anywhere in the Asagiri Isles. Say who you are, which tradition made you, and where your road starts.

modes.name: Clan War
modes.info:
WAR · Hard
The feuds boil over: Kagegi and Hayate, the houses, the bands. Every faction is arming.
Expect · battles, sides, betrayals
Lighter on · quiet downtime
Starts · (Party) The Exam Team · (Party) The Lot in the Black Warehouse · Kurosugi Range: The Outer Checkpoint · Shinobi: The Cedar Training Grounds

modes.name: Court Intrigue
modes.info:
INTRIGUE · Medium
The succession is the only story: the regent, the nephew, the princess, the hidden heir.
Expect · secrets, leverage, whispered deals
Lighter on · open combat
Starts · (Party) The Mirror and the Dowager · Hostage: The Ward of the Inner Palace · Masks: The Face at the Grey Gate

modes.name: Ghost Road
modes.info:
HORROR · Hard
The Fifty Stations Road after dark: an inn that is not there, the dead who do not arrive, lanterns with no one holding them.
Expect · dread, ghosts, curses
Lighter on · politics
Starts · Lantern: The Road After Dark · (Party) The Note at the Jizo Shrine · Festival: Obon at Tasogare

modes.name: Hardcore
modes.info:
HARDCORE · Very hard
The isles do not forgive. Wounds linger, enemies remember, and nobody comes to save you.
Expect · lethal fights, scarce help, real stakes
Lighter on · rescues
Starts · Bounty: A Price on Your Name · Beast Host: The Crate That Opened · Ashfall Blight: The Grey Banner Waystation

modes.name: Hunt Night
modes.info:
HUNT · Hard
Night falls on the isles and the monsters come out: demons in the north, spirits on the road, beasts in the wood.
Expect · monster hunts, dread, survival
Lighter on · court politics
Starts · Breath Hunter: The Breathing Yards · (Party) The Sword Under the Great Mound · Hinode Hold: The Sunrise Wall

modes.name: Multiplayer
modes.info:
TABLE · Medium
Two to five players, one story: every character gets the spotlight, nobody is talked over.
Expect · shared scenes, split parties, party choices
Lighter on · one hero's plot
Starts · any (Party) start

modes.name: Rising Legend
modes.info:
POWER FANTASY · Easy
The party is the story the isles will tell: techniques that land, rivals who fall, crowds that remember names.
Expect · big fights, fast fame, spectacle
Lighter on · grinding setbacks
Starts · Tournament: The Open Bouts · Duelist: The Ninety-Nine · Samurai: The Waking Hall · Delver: The Salvage Licence · The Otherworld: Behind the Gates

modes.name: Shinobi Contracts
modes.info:
CONTRACTS · Medium
The hidden villages' trade: missions taken, scrolls stolen, targets watched, and no questions asked.
Expect · stealth, missions, betrayal
Lighter on · open battles
Starts · Shinobi: The Cedar Training Grounds · (Party) The Lot in the Black Warehouse · Toll: The Cedar Pass Queue

modes.name: Slow Burn
modes.info:
ROMANCE · Easy
A story of people: bonds, trust and slow-burning love among the isles' cast, with the world's dangers behind it.
Expect · relationships, quiet scenes, devotion
Lighter on · constant danger
Starts · Slow Burn: The Long Watch · (Party) The White Hare · Guest: The Lord's Retinue

modes.name: Teahouse Days
modes.info:
SLICE OF LIFE · Very easy
Lanes, inns, markets and festivals: the isles' everyday life, with danger far off the road.
Expect · small jobs, neighbours, food, festivals
Lighter on · fights and dread
Starts · Teahouse: The Tea Benches · Fifty Stations Road: The Post Stable · Pilgrim: The Spring Sun Rite

modes.name: The Long Night
modes.info:
LATE WAR · Very hard
The emperor is dying, the seals are failing, and the Lord of the Long Night is coming south.
Expect · war in the north, beasts, last stands
Lighter on · quiet life
Starts · Hinode Hold: The Sunrise Wall · Orphan: The Lodge on the Wall · Hyoga Reach: The Ice Pier · Breath Hunter: The Breathing Yards

modes.name: The Tournament
modes.info:
TOURNAMENT · Medium
The Capital Tournament is the centre of the isles: bouts, bets, scouts and the houses' champions.
Expect · duels, rivals, honour
Lighter on · wilderness travel
Starts · Tournament: The Open Bouts · Duelist: The Ninety-Nine · Ronin: The Captains' Tables

modes.name: Wanderer
modes.info:
SANDBOX · Medium
The isles as they are: no push toward any line, every road open, the world moving on its own.
Expect · travel, chance meetings, jobs you choose
Lighter on · authored plots pressing in
Starts · Miyako Plain: Dawn on the Dawn Bridge · Saikai Free Port: The Foreign Quay · Fifty Stations Road: The Post Stable
